name: Dawna Ballard
title: Professor
summary: Studies chronemics, how time and pace of life shape communication in organizations, leadership, and health care, through engaged applied research.
summary_zh: 研究时间传播学，即时间与生活节奏如何塑造组织、领导力与医疗场景中的传播，并开展应用型的参与式研究。

name: Michael Butterworth
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes the rhetoric of sport and its ties to democracy, national identity, militarism, and public memory through rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 通过修辞批评分析体育修辞及其与民主、国族认同、军国主义和公共记忆的关联。

name: René Dailey
title: Professor, Graduate Advisor
summary: Studies communication in families and dating relationships, including partner support for weight loss and on-again/off-again romantic relationships.
summary_zh: 研究家庭与恋爱关系中的传播，包括伴侣对减重的支持以及分分合合的恋爱关系。

name: John Daly
title: Professor
summary: Examines practical interpersonal communication skills, advocacy, and influence that help people succeed in personal and professional relationships.
summary_zh: 研究帮助人们在私人与职业关系中取得成功的实用人际传播技能、倡导与影响力。

name: Erin Donovan
title: Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal health communication: how patients, families, and providers handle bad news, social support, coping, and uncertainty in illness.
summary_zh: 研究人际健康传播：患者、家人与医护人员在疾病中如何处理坏消息、社会支持、应对与不确定性。

name: Joshua Gunn
title: Professor
summary: Examines how people use signs and symbols to negotiate the ineffable in music, religion, and affect, drawing on rhetorical criticism and psychoanalytic theory.
summary_zh: 借助修辞批评与精神分析理论，研究人们如何在音乐、宗教与情感中运用符号来处理不可言说之物。

name: Johanna Hartelius
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the rhetoric of expertise and digital rhetoric, analyzing how experts and laypeople construct knowledge in public and online discourse.
summary_zh: 研究专业知识修辞与数字修辞，分析专家与普通人如何在公共与网络话语中建构知识。

name: Sharon Jarvis
title: Professor
summary: Studies political language, labels, and persuasion in American politics, including conservative media and how journalism treats electoral participation.
summary_zh: 研究美国政治中的政治语言、标签与说服，包括保守派媒体以及新闻报道如何对待选举参与。

name: Matthew McGlone
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of language in persuasion, social influence, and deception, including word choice in health messages, stereotyping, and online incivility.
summary_zh: 研究语言在说服、社会影响与欺骗中的作用，包括健康信息的措辞、刻板印象与网络不文明言论。

name: Roselia Mendez Murillo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies family communication and support among Latinx immigrant families and language brokers using longitudinal surveys, focus groups, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用纵向调查、焦点小组和访谈，研究拉丁裔移民家庭与语言中介者的家庭沟通和支持。

name: Nik Palomares
title: Professor
summary: Studies the social cognitive mechanisms of message production and processing, including goals, gender identity, cyberbullying, and fact-checking inferences.
summary_zh: 研究信息生产与处理的社会认知机制，涉及沟通目标、性别认同、网络欺凌以及对事实核查的推断。

name: Ashwin Rajadesingan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies online political discussion and designs spaces for cross-partisan interaction, combining large-scale computational methods with qualitative interviews.
summary_zh: 结合大规模计算方法与质性访谈研究网络政治讨论，并设计促进跨党派互动的网络空间。

name: Craig Scott
title: Department Chair, Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication with a focus on anonymity, identity, and identification in hidden organizations that conceal aspects of themselves.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播，聚焦隐藏型组织中的匿名性、身份与认同问题。

name: Stacey Sowards
title: Associate Chair, Professor
summary: Studies environmental, intercultural, and gender communication and rhetoric in Indonesia, Latin America, and the US, including environmental organizations.
summary_zh: 研究印度尼西亚、拉丁美洲和美国的环境传播、跨文化传播与性别传播及修辞，包括环保组织。

name: Keri Stephens
title: Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication technology, mobile technologies, and AI in crisis, disaster, infrastructure, and health communication contexts.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播技术、移动技术与人工智能在危机、灾害、基础设施及健康传播情境中的作用。

name: Jürgen Streeck
title: Professor
summary: Studies embodied, multimodal face-to-face interaction such as gesture, gaze, and touch using video-based micro-ethnographic methods.
summary_zh: 运用基于视频的微观民族志方法，研究手势、目光与触摸等具身的多模态面对面互动。

name: Scott Stroud
title: Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, philosophy, and culture through American pragmatism, Kant, and Ambedkar, with work on comparative rhetoric and communication ethics.
summary_zh: 通过美国实用主义、康德与安贝德卡研究修辞、哲学与文化，并涉及比较修辞与传播伦理。

name: Natalie Jomini Stroud
title: Professor
summary: Studies news media's role in democracy, including partisan selective exposure, news engagement, and social media effects in US elections.
summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体在民主中的作用，包括党派选择性接触、新闻参与以及社交媒体在美国选举中的影响。

name: Anita Vangelisti
title: Senior Associate Dean, Professor
summary: Studies the links between communication and emotion in close personal and family relationships, including hurt feelings.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系与家庭关系中传播与情绪的关联，包括受伤感受。

name: Brittany Wheeler
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies workplace bullying, harassment, and AI-mediated communication in organizations using surveys, computational text analysis, and agent-based modeling.
summary_zh: 运用调查、计算文本分析和基于主体的建模，研究组织中的职场霸凌、骚扰与AI中介传播。

name: Jasmine Wu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies communication and relationships in teams and organizations, including flexible work, using statistical, computational, and social network methods.
summary_zh: 运用统计、计算与社会网络方法，研究团队与组织中的沟通和关系，包括灵活工作安排。

name: Rosental Alves
title: Professor
summary: Studies international and online journalism and the struggle for press freedom in Latin America, drawing on long professional practice and journalist training.
summary_zh: 依托长期新闻从业与记者培训经验，研究国际新闻、网络新闻以及拉丁美洲新闻自由的斗争。

name: Mary Bock
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual communication and the sociology of photographic practice in journalism, including citizen journalism, representation, and word-image rhetoric.
summary_zh: 研究新闻中的视觉传播与摄影实践社会学，包括公民新闻、再现以及图文修辞。

name: Renita Coleman
title: Professor
summary: Studies agenda setting, race, visual communication, and journalism ethics, often with experiments on how images shape ethical reasoning and news framing.
summary_zh: 研究议程设置、种族、视觉传播与新闻伦理，常用实验考察图像如何影响伦理推理与新闻框架。

name: Donna DeCesare
title: Associate Professor
summary: Practices and teaches documentary photojournalism on Latin America, including youth affected by gang violence.
summary_zh: 从事并教授以拉丁美洲为题材的纪实摄影新闻，包括受帮派暴力影响的青少年。

name: Shengchun Huang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how AI-driven media systems and algorithmic curation shape news consumption, affective polarization, and democratic engagement using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究AI驱动的媒介系统与算法推荐如何影响新闻消费、情感极化与民主参与。

name: Tom Johnson
title: Professor
areas: Social media misinformation and conspiracy theories
summary: Studies media use and credibility in US election campaigns, including selective exposure, social media, misinformation, and conspiracy theories.
summary_zh: 研究美国选举中的媒介使用与可信度，包括选择性接触、社交媒体、虚假信息与阴谋论。

name: Gina Masullo
title: Associate Professor and Graduate Advisor
summary: Studies how digital spaces connect and divide people, focusing on online incivility, engagement with news and politicians, news trust, and polarization.
summary_zh: 研究数字空间如何连接与分化人群，聚焦网络不文明、与新闻及政治人物的互动、新闻信任与政治极化。

name: Kathleen McElroy
title: Professor
summary: Studies race and news media, racial discourse, and collective memory, including obituaries, sports media, food journalism, and newsroom ethics.
summary_zh: 研究种族与新闻媒体、种族话语与集体记忆，包括讣告、体育媒体、美食新闻与新闻编辑室伦理。

name: Paula Poindexter
title: Professor
summary: Studies news audiences, news engagement, and news literacy, including Gen Z and social media, and diversity in news coverage.
summary_zh: 研究新闻受众、新闻参与和新闻素养，包括Z世代与社交媒体，以及新闻报道中的多元性。

name: David Ryfe
title: Professor and Director
summary: Studies the disruption of American journalism and local news through newsroom ethnography, along with the history and sociology of news and deliberation.
summary_zh: 通过新闻编辑室民族志研究美国新闻业与地方新闻的变革，并涉及新闻史、新闻社会学与公共协商。

name: Sharon Strover
title: Professor
summary: Studies telecommunications policy, rural broadband and the digital divide, and AI and social media disinformation such as Russian Facebook ads.
summary_zh: 研究电信政策、农村宽带与数字鸿沟，以及人工智能和社交媒体虚假信息（如俄罗斯脸书广告）。

name: Yibing Sun
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies visual persuasion, visual politics, and AI-generated multimodal messages using computational methods, multimodal LLMs, and experiments.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法、多模态大语言模型和实验，研究视觉说服、视觉政治以及AI生成的多模态信息。

name: Raymond Thompson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Practices and teaches photojournalism and documentary photography.
summary_zh: 从事并教授新闻摄影与纪实摄影。

name: Anita Varma
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies media ethics and solidarity journalism, including humanizing techniques in coverage of homelessness, using case study research.
summary_zh: 研究媒介伦理与团结新闻，包括无家可归问题报道中的人性化手法，采用个案研究方法。

name: S. Craig Watkins
title: Professor
summary: Studies the ethical and social implications of AI, including bias and disparate impacts in health AI and youth interactions with digital assistants.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能的伦理与社会影响，包括健康AI中的偏差与不平等影响，以及青少年与数字助手的互动。

name: Lucy Atkinson
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how message components shape environmental attitudes and behaviors, including carbon capture acceptance, AR/VR science messaging, and climate resilience.
summary_zh: 研究信息要素如何影响环境态度与行为，包括碳捕集接受度、AR/VR科学传播与气候韧性。

name: Laura Bright
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies consumer behavior in social media feeds and new technologies, focusing on digital wellbeing, data analytics, and consumer privacy.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体信息流与新技术中的消费者行为，聚焦数字福祉、数据分析与消费者隐私。

name: Erica Ciszek
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations and strategic communication for advocacy and activism with marginalized publics, using critical theory and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用批判理论与质性方法，研究面向边缘群体的倡导与行动主义公共关系和战略传播。

name: Isabella Cunningham
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Studies marketing, advertising, and consumer research, and serves as an expert witness in advertising-related legal cases.
summary_zh: 研究营销、广告与消费者行为，并在广告相关法律案件中担任专家证人。

name: Natalie Brown Devlin
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies crisis communication and digital media in sport, examining how social media empowers stakeholders during sports-related crises.
summary_zh: 研究体育领域的危机传播与数字媒体，考察社交媒体如何在体育危机中赋权利益相关者。

name: Minette Drumwright
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Studies advertising and marketing with a focus on ethics, leadership, corporate social responsibility, and countering persistent unethical behavior.
summary_zh: 研究广告与营销，聚焦伦理、领导力、企业社会责任以及如何应对持续的不道德行为。

name: Anthony Dudo
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies scientists' public engagement, science communication training, and how news and entertainment media represent science and the environment.
summary_zh: 研究科学家的公众参与、科学传播培训，以及新闻与娱乐媒体如何呈现科学与环境议题。

name: Matthew Eastin
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Director, Professor
summary: Studies consumer behavior and information processing from a social cognitive view, including technology adoption, privacy, virtual reality, and AI engagement.
summary_zh: 从社会认知视角研究消费者行为与信息处理，包括技术采纳、隐私、虚拟现实与AI使用。

name: Lee Ann Kahlor
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Studies health and environmental risk communication, especially information seeking and avoidance about cancer, nanotechnology, and carbon capture.
summary_zh: 研究健康与环境风险传播，尤其关注人们对癌症、纳米技术与碳捕集的信息寻求与回避。

name: Deena Kemp
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies persuasive health and charity campaigns, such as disgust-evoking images, drawing on emotion and behavioral economics to address substance misuse.
summary_zh: 借助情绪与行为经济学理论，研究健康与慈善说服传播（如引发厌恶的图像），以应对物质滥用问题。

name: Yeonsoo Kim
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies strategic communication and public relations, including CSR, corporate social advocacy, diversity in PR, reputation, and crisis management.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播与公共关系，包括企业社会责任、企业社会倡导、公关行业多元化、声誉与危机管理。

name: Jihye Lee
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies poverty, class, and digital inequality in targeted ads, government interactions, and digital health, using mobile data, NLP, and field experiments.
summary_zh: 运用移动数据挖掘、自然语言处理和田野实验，研究定向广告、政府互动与数字健康中的贫困、阶层与数字不平等。

name: Brad Love
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the persuasive capabilities of mass and digital media for prosocial goals such as public health.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒体与数字媒体在公共健康等亲社会目标上的说服能力。

name: Michael Mackert
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Develops evidence-based health communication strategies for audiences with low health literacy on issues like tobacco cessation and opioid overdose.
summary_zh: 为低健康素养人群开发循证健康传播策略，涉及戒烟与阿片类药物过量预防等议题。

name: Jeeyun Oh
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how interfaces, affordances, and algorithms shape cognitive and emotional processing of persuasive messages, using experiments.
summary_zh: 运用实验研究界面、可供性与算法如何影响人们对说服信息的认知与情绪加工。

name: Kate Pounders
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies prosocial advertising and consumer well-being, applying persuasion, emotion, and identity theories to giving, sustainability, health, and AI ads.
summary_zh: 研究亲社会广告与消费者福祉，将说服、情绪与身份理论用于慈善、可持续、健康与AI广告。

name: Natalie Tindall
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Studies public relations, stewardship, participatory culture, and communities.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系、关系维护、参与式文化与社群。

name: Laurent Wang
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies online privacy decisions, dataveillance, and digital inequality, testing message-based interventions against privacy helplessness.
summary_zh: 研究网络隐私决策、数据监控与数字不平等，并检验应对隐私无助感的信息干预。

name: Gary Wilcox
dept: Stan Richards School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: John A. Beck Centennial Professor
summary: Studies alcohol advertising effects, branding, and social media marketing, using unstructured data analysis and marketing mix modeling.
summary_zh: 运用非结构化数据分析与营销组合建模，研究酒类广告效果、品牌与社交媒体营销。

name: Mary Beltrán
title: Professor
summary: Studies Latina/o and mixed-race representation, media making, and diversity in US television and film industries through critical and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判与历史分析，研究美国影视产业中拉丁裔与混血族裔的再现、媒介创作及多元化。

name: Charles Ramírez Berg
title: Professor
summary: Studies Latino images in US film and the history and poetics of Mexican cinema through film history and narratology.
summary_zh: 通过电影史与叙事学研究美国电影中的拉丁裔形象以及墨西哥电影的历史与诗学。

name: Byron Fong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the global history of computer technologies and video game aesthetics and their impact on cultures of labor and media.
summary_zh: 研究计算机技术与电子游戏美学的全球历史，及其对劳动文化与媒介文化的影响。

name: Kathryn Fuller-Seeley
title: Area Head of Media Studies, Associate Chair, Professor
summary: Studies American film, radio, and television history and audience reception through archival research on early cinema and radio comedy.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究考察美国电影、广播与电视史及受众接受，包括早期电影与广播喜剧。

name: Lalitha Gopalan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Indian and world cinemas, film theory, feminist film theory, and experimental film and video in India.
summary_zh: 研究印度电影与世界电影、电影理论、女性主义电影理论以及印度的实验电影与录像艺术。

name: Noah Isenberg
title: Professor
summary: Studies film history, including classical Hollywood, Weimar cinema, émigrés in Hollywood, and independent cinema, through historical and biographical work.
summary_zh: 通过历史与传记研究考察电影史，包括经典好莱坞、魏玛电影、好莱坞流亡影人与独立电影。

name: Shanti Kumar
title: Associate Professor, Graduate Advisor for Media Studies
summary: Studies globalization, nationalism, and television in India and South Asia, and global communication more broadly.
summary_zh: 研究印度与南亚的全球化、民族主义与电视，以及更广泛的全球传播。

name: Madhavi Mallapragada
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies race and ethnicity in US media industries, Asian Americans and media, and Indian immigrant online cultures and transnational identity.
summary_zh: 研究美国媒介产业中的种族与族裔、亚裔美国人与媒介，以及印度移民的网络文化与跨国身份。

name: Alisa Perren
title: Professor
summary: Studies how film, TV, and digital media workers respond to streaming-era change in Hollywood and Texas, including the impact of film incentives.
summary_zh: 研究影视与数字媒体从业者如何应对流媒体时代好莱坞与德州的变革，包括电影激励政策的影响。

name: Suzanne Scott
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies fan cultures, convergence and participatory culture, and transmedia storytelling, with attention to gender and the marginalization of female fans.
summary_zh: 研究粉丝文化、融合与参与式文化以及跨媒介叙事，关注性别与女性粉丝的边缘化。

name: Lee Ahern
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the science of science communication, examining how audience segments make meaning of science and environmental messages and why campaigns fail.
summary_zh: 研究科学传播的科学，考察不同受众群体如何理解科学与环境信息，以及传播运动为何常常失效。

name: Christopher Ali
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Pioneers Chair, Professor of Telecommunications
summary: Studies broadband policy, the digital divide, and rural connectivity in the United States using critical, qualitative methods and community-based broadband stories.
summary_zh: 运用批判性质性方法和社区宽带故事，研究美国的宽带政策、数字鸿沟与农村网络连接。

name: Catharine Axley
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Makes independent feature documentaries, including work on Indigenous subjects and cruise tourism, as creative practice in documentary filmmaking.
summary_zh: 以纪录片创作为实践，拍摄独立长纪录片，题材包括原住民故事与邮轮旅游。

name: Denise Bortree
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor
summary: Studies nonprofit organizational communication, corporate social responsibility, sustainability, and volunteerism from a public relations perspective.
summary_zh: 从公共关系视角研究非营利组织传播、企业社会责任、可持续发展与志愿服务。

name: Jiyoung Cha
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
areas: Social Media and AI-Powered Social Chatbots
summary: Studies media management and platform business, including how audiences adopt technologies, choose streaming content, and respond to AI recommendation algorithms and companions.
summary_zh: 研究媒介管理与平台商业，包括受众如何采纳新技术、选择流媒体内容，以及如何回应AI推荐算法与AI陪伴。

name: Colleen Connolly-Ahern
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor / MPS Program Coordinator
summary: Conducts applied strategic communication research on international political advertising, health and science communication, and communication with refugees.
summary_zh: 开展应用型战略传播研究，涉及国际政治广告、健康与科学传播以及与难民相关的传播。

name: Frank Dardis
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor ; Interim Head, Department of Advertising/Public Relations
summary: Studies the persuasive and psychological effects of advertising, branded content, and corporate communication on information processing and attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究广告、品牌内容与企业传播对个体信息加工和态度的说服效果与心理影响。

name: Boaz Dvir
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Donald P. Bellisario Career Advancement Professor, Associate Professor
summary: Creates documentary films and multimedia journalism about ordinary people turned changemakers, with attention to filmmaking ethics and human rights education.
summary_zh: 创作关于普通人成为变革者的纪录片与多媒体新闻作品，关注纪录片伦理与人权教育。

name: Kaitlin Fitzgerald
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how narratives and entertainment media shape audience emotions, attitudes, well-being, and prosocial responses, including restorative and moral storytelling.
summary_zh: 研究叙事与娱乐媒介如何影响受众的情绪、态度、幸福感与亲社会反应，包括修复性叙事与道德叙事。

name: Russell Frank
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes on journalism ethics, literary journalism, and internet folklore, interpreting news practices and online legends through essays and textual analysis.
summary_zh: 研究新闻伦理、文学新闻与网络民俗，通过评论写作与文本分析解读新闻实践和网络传说。

name: Homero Gil de Zúñiga
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Distinguished Professor of Media Effects & AI
summary: Studies how social media, algorithms, and AI affect democracy and political life using survey, experimental, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验与计算方法，研究社交媒体、算法与人工智能如何影响民主与政治生活。

name: Pearl Gluck
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Donald P. Bellisario Career Advancement Professor, Associate Professor
summary: Writes and directs documentary and hybrid fiction films exploring gender, class, faith, and autobiographical storytelling, including domestic sex trafficking.
summary_zh: 编剧并执导纪录片与纪实-虚构混合影片，探讨性别、阶级、信仰与自传式叙事，包括国内性交易议题。

name: Virginia Harrison
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies stewardship and dialogic communication in nonprofit-donor relationships, plus corporate social responsibility and athlete advocacy in sports public relations.
summary_zh: 研究非营利组织与捐赠者关系中的关系维护（stewardship）与对话传播，以及体育公关中的企业社会责任与运动员倡导。

name: Yujin Heo
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how message characteristics and a shifting media landscape shape consumer responses to digital advertising and persuasion, including perceived polling effects.
summary_zh: 研究信息特征与变化的媒介环境如何影响消费者对数字广告的反应与说服效果，也涉及民调效应感知。

name: Matthew Jackson
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor ; Director of Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies how copyright shapes free speech and cultural production, along with First Amendment and policy issues affecting the internet and telecommunications.
summary_zh: 研究版权如何影响言论自由与文化生产，以及影响互联网和电信产业的第一修正案与政策问题。

name: Krishna Jayakar
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor of Telecommunications and Public Policy; Head of the Department of Telecommunications
summary: Studies telecommunications policy and media economics, especially universal broadband access, disability, and comparative information policy in China and India.
summary_zh: 研究电信政策与媒介经济，尤其关注普遍宽带接入、残障群体，以及中国与印度信息政策的比较。

name: Matthew Jordan
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor
summary: Studies how popular media and communication technologies construct identity and cultural ideology, using historical and critical analysis of sound, film, and media culture.
summary_zh: 运用历史与批判分析，研究流行媒介与传播技术如何建构身份与文化意识形态，涉及声音、电影与媒介文化。

name: Sara Liao
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor ; Co-Director, Feminist Technocultures Lab
summary: Examines how media technologies, the state, commerce, and gender shape culture and identity transnationally, focusing on digital feminism in Chinese societies.
summary_zh: 考察媒介技术、国家、商业与性别如何在跨国语境中共同塑造文化与身份，聚焦华人社会中的数字女性主义。

name: Simon Licen
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor ; Associate Director, John Curley Center for Sports Journalism
summary: Studies sports journalism and sports broadcasting in national and international contexts, including the Olympics, sports diplomacy, and media and identity.
summary_zh: 研究国内与国际语境中的体育新闻与体育转播，包括奥运会、体育外交以及媒介与身份认同。

name: Stephanie Madden
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations for social change, amplifying marginalized voices on issues like gender-based violence through activism, crisis communication, and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究以社会变革为导向的公共关系，借助行动主义、危机传播与质性方法，放大边缘群体在性别暴力等议题上的声音。

name: Martin Marinos
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies global media political economy and postsocialist media history, tracing how media liberalization fueled right-wing populism in Bulgaria via archives and interviews.
summary_zh: 研究全球媒介政治经济学与后社会主义媒介史，借助档案与访谈追溯保加利亚媒介自由化如何助长右翼民粹主义。

name: Matthew McAllister
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor ; Interim Head, Department of Film Production and Media Studies
areas: Political Economy of the Mass Media
summary: Critically analyzes advertising, commercialization, and popular culture, including superhero films and comics, from a political economy of media perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介政治经济学视角，批判性分析广告、商业化与流行文化，包括超级英雄电影与漫画。

name: Sascha Meinrath
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Palmer Chair in Telecommunications
summary: Works at the intersection of emerging technology and public policy, including broadband, net neutrality, spectrum, privacy, and building community internet infrastructure.
summary_zh: 研究新兴技术与公共政策的交叉领域，包括宽带、网络中立、频谱、隐私以及社区互联网基础设施建设。

name: Emily Metzgar
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Dean ; Professor
summary: Leads the college as dean, with a background spanning journalism, diplomacy, and policy analysis; the profile does not describe a specific research program.
summary_zh: 担任学院院长，职业背景涵盖新闻、外交与政策分析；个人简介未说明具体研究方向。

name: Andrea Miller
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor ; Director, Feminist Technocultures Lab
areas: Military and Police Uses of Technology
summary: Examines technoscience, surveillance, and security infrastructures through feminist, postcolonial, and STS theory, including drone warfare, predictive policing, and cybernetics.
summary_zh: 运用女性主义、后殖民与科学技术研究（STS）理论，考察技术科学、监控与安全基础设施，包括无人机战争、预测性警务与控制论。

name: Mary Beth Oliver
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Donald P. Bellisario Professor of Media Studies / Co-Director of Media Effects Research Laboratory
areas: Emotional and Cognitive Effects of Media
summary: Studies the emotional and cognitive effects of media, audience enjoyment and positive media psychology, and how racial portrayals shape viewers' attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究媒介的情绪与认知效果、受众的娱乐享受与积极媒介心理，以及种族形象呈现如何影响观众态度。

name: Anthony Olorunnisola
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor ; Associate Dean for Graduate Programs, Research and Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies how politics, economics, and culture shape media systems, focusing on media in African transitional societies and decolonization.
summary_zh: 研究政治、经济与文化如何塑造媒介体系，聚焦非洲转型社会中的媒介与去殖民化。

name: Holly Overton
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor ; Director of Graduate Programs
summary: Studies public relations ethics, CSR communication, and corporate social advocacy, and the psychological factors shaping how publics process and engage with messages.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系伦理、企业社会责任传播与企业社会倡导，以及影响公众信息加工与参与的心理因素。

name: Juliet Pinto
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor ; Interim Associate Dean
summary: Studies environmental and science journalism, especially news coverage of environmental challenges in Latin America and the Caribbean, and risk messaging on social media.
summary_zh: 研究环境与科学新闻，尤其是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区环境问题的新闻报道，以及社交媒体上的风险信息传播。

name: Patrick Lee Plaisance
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Don W. Davis Professor in Ethics
summary: Develops media ethics theory drawing on moral psychology and virtue, examining newsroom and PR practice and moral questions raised by AI design and use.
summary_zh: 借鉴道德心理学与美德伦理发展媒介伦理理论，考察新闻与公关实践以及AI设计与使用引发的道德问题。

name: Michelle Rodino-Colocino
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
areas: Critical and Cultural Studies of Media
summary: Studies relationships among media, labor, and social justice from feminist and critical cultural perspectives, including new media work, the gig economy, and activism.
summary_zh: 从女性主义与批判文化视角研究媒介、劳动与社会正义的关系，包括新媒体劳动、零工经济与社会行动。

name: Gustavo Rosa
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Writes, directs, and produces narrative films and shorts, including work set in Latin America on issues such as rapid urbanization.
summary_zh: 编剧、执导并制作剧情长片与短片，包括以拉丁美洲为背景、关注快速城市化等议题的作品。

name: Amy Kristin Sanders
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: John and Ann Curley Professor of First Amendment Studies
summary: Studies media law and the regulation of emerging technologies, focusing on freedom of expression, access to information, government transparency, and social media regulation.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法与新兴技术规制，关注言论自由、信息获取、政府透明以及社交媒体监管。

name: Michael Schmierbach
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Professor
summary: Studies media effects and perceptions of media, including third-person perception, news credibility, and enjoyment and difficulty in video games.
summary_zh: 研究媒介效果与人们对媒介的感知，包括第三人效应、新闻可信度以及电子游戏中的乐趣与难度。

name: Fuyuan Shen
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Donald P. Bellisario Professor of Advertising
summary: Studies how ads, message frames, emotions, and narratives affect information processing, attitudes, and risk perceptions, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用实验与调查方法，研究广告、信息框架、情绪与叙事如何影响信息加工、态度与风险感知。

name: Heather Shoenberger
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor ; Donald P. Bellisario Career Advancement Professor
areas: Consumer Behavior in Reaction to Media
summary: Studies how perceived authenticity shapes digital advertising effectiveness, consumer attitudes, and health outcomes amid digitally manipulated and misleading media content.
summary_zh: 研究在数字化修饰与误导性媒介内容盛行的环境下，感知真实性如何影响数字广告效果、消费者态度与健康结果。

name: Chris Skurka
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and efficacy shape audience responses to environmental, health, and science messages, including climate change and anti-tobacco communication.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与效能感如何影响受众对环境、健康与科学信息的反应，包括气候变化与控烟传播。

name: S. Shyam Sundar
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Evan Pugh University Professor ; James P. Jimirro Professor of Media Effects ; Co-Director, Media Effects Research Laboratory ; Director, Penn State Center for Socially Responsible Artificial Intelligence
areas: Social and Psychological Aspects of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Studies the psychology of human-computer interaction and social effects of AI, chatbots, and digital media, theorizing and testing them through experiments and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究人机交互心理以及人工智能、聊天机器人与数字媒介的社会影响，通过实验与计算方法进行理论建构与检验。

name: Dongqing Xu
dept: Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies ethical strategic communication and public relations, including crisis and risk communication, sociopolitical advocacy, and stakeholder dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究符合伦理的战略传播与公共关系，包括危机与风险传播、社会政治倡导以及利益相关者互动。

name: Joshua Trey Barnett
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Harry and Elissa Sichi Early Career Professor ; Associate Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies environmental rhetoric and the environmental humanities, including ecological grief, more-than-human rhetorics, and Hannah Arendt's environmental thought.
summary_zh: 研究环境修辞与环境人文，包括生态哀伤、超越人类的修辞以及汉娜·阿伦特的环境思想。

name: Shannon Cruz
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies social influence on environmental and climate change attitudes, examining ideology, group and network dynamics, and persuasive messages that bridge divides.
summary_zh: 研究环境与气候变化态度中的社会影响，考察意识形态、群体与网络动态，以及能弥合分歧的说服信息。

name: James Dillard
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies the production and effects of persuasive messages, including the role of emotion in persuasion and interpersonal influence, often applied to public health.
summary_zh: 研究说服信息的生成与效果，包括情绪在说服与人际影响中的作用，常应用于公共卫生问题。

name: Rosa Eberly
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Rhetoric
summary: Studies histories and theories of rhetoric, publics, public memory, sound, and deliberation, including rhetoric and violence in public education and broadcast archives.
summary_zh: 研究修辞的历史与理论、公众、公共记忆、声音与公共协商，包括公共教育中的暴力修辞与广播档案。

name: Jeremy David Engels
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Liberal Arts Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Theorizes democracy as a communal practice of care, deliberation, and mindfulness, offering rhetorical and philosophical accounts of civic life.
summary_zh: 将民主理论化为一种关于关怀、协商与正念的共同实践，从修辞与哲学角度阐释公民生活。

name: Lisa A. Flores
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Weiss Chair of the Humanities; Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences, and Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
summary: Studies intersectional rhetorical racialization, including Chicana feminism, whiteness, masculinity, and border and immigration rhetorics, through critical rhetorical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判修辞分析研究交叉性的修辞种族化，涉及奇卡纳女性主义、白人性、男性气质以及边境与移民修辞。

name: John Gastil
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences, Public Policy, and Political Science
summary: Studies political deliberation and group decision making, evaluating reforms like the Citizens' Initiative Review and juries and designing online deliberation platforms.
summary_zh: 研究政治协商与群体决策，评估公民倡议审查和陪审制度等改革，并设计在线协商平台。

name: Ekaterina Haskins
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Professor, Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies official and grassroots memory practices as political rhetoric and civic engagement, including how Soviet terror is remembered in Russia and former USSR states.
summary_zh: 研究官方与民间的记忆实践如何构成政治修辞与公民参与，包括俄罗斯及前苏联国家如何记忆苏联政治恐怖。

name: Andrew High
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences, Associate Head
summary: Studies supportive communication and computer-mediated communication, examining how messages and channel affordances shape coping outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究支持性传播与计算机中介传播，考察信息特征与渠道可供性如何影响人们的应对结果。

name: Michele Kennerly
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor Communication Arts and Sciences, and Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies
summary: Studies the history and theory of ancient Mediterranean rhetoric and its reception, including classical ideals in the early age of automation and cybernetics.
summary_zh: 研究古代地中海修辞的历史、理论及其接受史，包括自动化早期与控制论中的古典理想。

name: Erina L. (MacGeorge) Farrell
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Liberal Arts Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies advice and social support in interpersonal and health contexts, developing advice response theory and examining doctor-parent and patient decision conversations.
summary_zh: 研究人际与健康情境中的建议与社会支持，发展建议回应理论，并考察医生与家长、患者决策中的对话。

name: Brian Manata
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies organizational behavior in groups and teams, quantitatively testing how leadership, cohesion, and group dynamics affect performance.
summary_zh: 研究群体与团队中的组织行为，用定量方法检验领导行为、凝聚力与群体动态如何影响绩效。

name: Lijiang Shen
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how message features and audience characteristics shape persuasive health communication, message processing, and resistance to persuasion.
summary_zh: 研究信息特征与受众特征如何影响健康说服传播、信息加工以及对说服的抵制。

name: Rachel Smith
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Dr. Nancy J. Metzger Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences, and Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies social influence, including how prejudice diffuses into stigma and how social power and network topology shape persuasion, and designs and evaluates health campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究社会影响，包括偏见如何扩散为污名、社会权力与网络拓扑如何影响说服与抵制，并设计和评估健康传播运动。

name: Denise Solomon
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies communication in personal relationships, such as support and conflict, and develops relational turbulence theory to explain relationship transitions and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的支持与冲突等传播经验，并发展关系动荡理论以解释关系转变与幸福感。

name: Michael Steudeman
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies the rhetoric of U.S. education policy, analyzing how education debates since Reconstruction shape national belonging and political exclusion.
summary_zh: 研究美国教育政策的修辞，分析重建时期以来的教育辩论如何塑造国家归属感与政治排斥。

name: Mary Stuckey
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Sparks Professor, Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies political and presidential rhetoric, American public address, and American Indian politics through rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 通过修辞批评研究政治与总统修辞、美国公共演说以及美国印第安人政治。

name: Pamela VanHaitsma
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Communication Arts and Science and Women's, Gender, and Sexuality Studies ; Director of Graduate Studies in Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Bridges rhetoric, archives, and gender and sexuality studies, recovering queer histories of romantic friendship and rhetorical education through archival research.
summary_zh: 融合修辞、档案与性别和性向研究，通过档案研究重建浪漫友谊与修辞教育中的酷儿历史。

name: Bradford Vivian
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies rhetorical theory and public controversies over collective memory, witnessing, and forgetting, as well as campus misinformation and free speech.
summary_zh: 研究修辞理论以及围绕集体记忆、见证与遗忘的公共争议，并关注校园虚假信息与言论自由。

name: Kirt Wilson
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Department Head of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies nineteenth- and twentieth-century American political rhetoric, congressional debate, and the Black Freedom Struggle, focusing on race, racism, and public memory.
summary_zh: 研究19至20世纪美国政治修辞、国会辩论与黑人自由运动，聚焦种族、种族主义与公共记忆。

name: Lucas Youngvorst
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies supportive communication across face-to-face and mediated channels, examining how affordances, expectations, and verbal and nonverbal cues shape support outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究面对面与中介渠道中的支持性传播，考察可供性、期望以及言语和非言语线索如何影响支持效果。

name: Weimiao Zhou
dept: Department of Communication Arts and Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Communication Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how sibling and parent communication shapes adolescents' and emerging adults' well-being and health, using advanced quantitative and mixed methods with family data.
summary_zh: 运用高级定量与混合方法分析家庭数据，研究兄弟姐妹与父母的沟通如何影响青少年及成年初期个体的幸福感与健康。

name: Gary Bente
title: Professor
summary: Studies nonverbal communication, media effects, and avatar-based virtual reality, using psychophysiology, eye tracking, and continuous response measurement.
summary_zh: 研究非语言传播、媒介效果与基于虚拟化身的虚拟现实，采用心理生理测量、眼动追踪与连续反应测量。

name: Daniel E. Bergan
title: Professor
summary: Studies public opinion, advocacy campaigns, and partisan polarization, using field experiments that test how citizen contacts influence policymakers.
summary_zh: 研究舆论、倡导运动与党派极化，通过田野实验检验公民联络如何影响政策制定者。

name: Dustin Carnahan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how citizens engage with political information, how misperceptions form, and how fact-checks and corrections counter misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究公民如何接触政治信息、错误认知如何形成，以及事实核查与更正信息如何应对虚假信息。

name: James W. Dearing
title: Brandt Endowed Professor
summary: Studies the diffusion of innovations and the dissemination and implementation of evidence-based practices in public health, healthcare, and environmental programs.
summary_zh: 研究创新扩散，以及循证实践在公共卫生、医疗与环境项目中的传播与实施。

name: William A. Donohue
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in conflict, negotiation, and mediation, with attention to how framing shapes negotiation processes and leadership development.
summary_zh: 研究冲突、谈判与调解中的传播，关注框架如何影响谈判过程以及领导力发展。

name: Elizabeth Dorrance Hall
title: Associate Professor, Director of Communication Master's Program
summary: Studies communication in families and close relationships, including difficult conversations, family marginalization, and support for first-generation and STEM-interested youth.
summary_zh: 研究家庭与亲密关系中的传播，包括艰难对话、家庭边缘化，以及对第一代大学生和对STEM感兴趣青年的支持。

name: Allison Eden
title: Professor, Director of Doctoral Studies in Communication
summary: Studies media enjoyment and entertainment, examining how enjoyment drives attention and media selection and how entertainment affects well-being and morality.
summary_zh: 研究媒介享受与娱乐，考察享受如何驱动注意与媒介选择，以及娱乐如何影响幸福感与道德。

name: Jacob Fisher
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies attention and decision-making in digital media and moral messaging, using functional neuroimaging, big behavioral data, and computational and network modeling.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒介中的注意与决策以及道德信息，采用功能性神经影像、大规模行为数据以及计算与网络建模。

name: Amanda Holmstrom
title: Professor
summary: Studies supportive communication and social support messages in relationships and their links to physical, mental, and relational well-being.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系中的支持性传播与社会支持信息，及其与身心和关系福祉的关联。

name: Maria Lapinski
title: Professor
areas: Impact of persuasive messages on health and environmental risk perceptions and behaviors
summary: Studies how persuasive messages and social norms shape health and environmental risk behaviors, with attention to cultural dynamics in projects across many countries.
summary_zh: 研究说服信息与社会规范如何影响健康与环境风险行为，关注文化动态，项目覆盖多个国家。

name: David Markowitz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how language patterns reveal social and psychological processes such as deception, persuasion, and bias, using computational text analysis.
summary_zh: 研究语言模式如何揭示欺骗、说服与偏见等社会心理过程，采用计算文本分析方法。

name: Vernon Miller
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in organizations, including employment interviews, newcomer entry and socialization, role negotiation, and organizational change.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的传播，包括招聘面试、新员工进入与社会化、角色协商以及组织变革。

name: Yoo Jung (Erika) Oh
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human-AI communication with chatbots, examining how persuasive AI shapes perceptions, relationships, and health behavior change.
summary_zh: 研究人与AI聊天机器人的传播，考察具说服力的AI如何影响人的认知、关系与健康行为改变。

name: Tai-Quan "Winson" Peng
title: Professor
summary: Studies how successive communication technologies, from the internet to AI, shape attention, interpretation, and influence, using computational social science methods.
summary_zh: 研究从互联网到AI的历代传播技术如何影响注意、解读与影响过程，采用计算社会科学方法。

name: Ralf Schmälzle
title: Associate Professor of Communication Science
areas: Media Neuroscience: Motivational Response to Media
Neuroimaging of Health and Risk Communication
Neurocognitive Foundations of Mass Communication Campaigns
summary: Studies how the brain processes persuasive health and media messages, using fMRI, EEG, computational modeling, and VR/AI environments alongside behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何加工健康与媒介说服信息，结合fMRI、EEG、计算建模与VR/AI环境以及行为实验。

name: John L. Sherry
title: Associate Professor
areas: cognitive and behavioral aspects of video games
summary: Studies educational video games and communication as a complex dynamic system, using modeling, simulation, and experiments on learning during play.
summary_zh: 研究教育类电子游戏以及作为复杂动态系统的传播，采用建模、仿真以及关于游戏中学习的实验。

name: Stephen Spates
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication organizes and constructs identity, focusing on bias, discrimination, and social identity in organizations and on AI for communication skills.
summary_zh: 研究传播如何组织与建构身份，关注组织中的偏见、歧视与社会身份，以及利用AI提升沟通技能。

name: Ron Tamborini
title: Professor
summary: Studies how media technology characteristics shape psychological experience, including moral intuition, natural mapping in video games, and media enjoyment and appreciation.
summary_zh: 研究媒介技术特征如何塑造心理体验，包括道德直觉、电子游戏中的自然映射以及媒介享受与欣赏。

name: Monique Turner
title: Chair of the Department of Communication
summary: Studies persuasion and the role of emotions like guilt, anger, and fear in message design and processing for health, risk, and political communication.
summary_zh: 研究说服以及内疚、愤怒、恐惧等情绪在健康、风险与政治传播信息设计与加工中的作用。

name: Brandon Van Der Heide
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies computer-mediated and interpersonal communication, focusing on how online cues shape impressions, credibility, and influence in reviews and social media.
summary_zh: 研究计算机中介传播与人际传播，关注网络线索如何影响在线评论与社交媒体中的印象、可信度与影响力。

name: Brooke Wolfe
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people communicate when coping with acute and chronic stressors across the lifespan in interpersonal, family, and health contexts.
summary_zh: 研究人们在应对急性与慢性压力时如何沟通，涵盖整个生命历程中的人际、家庭与健康情境。

name: Danielle K. Brown
title: 1855 Community & Urban Journalism Professorship, Associate Professor
summary: Studies media representations, narrative change, social movements, and race and identity, and leads community-engaged work against misinformation via trusted messengers.
summary_zh: 研究媒介再现、叙事变革、社会运动与种族身份，并主持借助可信信使应对虚假信息的社区参与式项目。

name: Manuel (Manny) Chavez
title: Professor
summary: Studies sociology of the news media, media law, crisis reporting, disinformation, and access to information and press systems, especially in Ibero-America.
summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体社会学、媒介法、危机报道、虚假信息以及信息获取与新闻体制，尤其关注伊比利亚美洲。

name: Eric Freedman
title: Knight Chair in Environmental Journalism and Professor
summary: Teaches and practices environmental journalism, directing the Knight Center for Environmental Journalism, and has taught and trained journalists in post-Soviet countries, including Central Asia.
summary_zh: 讲授并从事环境新闻实践，主持奈特环境新闻中心，并在中亚等后苏联国家开展国际新闻教学与培训。

name: Muhammad Ittefaq
title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Communication
summary: Studies global news coverage of health and environmental issues, science misinformation, AI's impacts, and how publics interpret climate and science messages.
summary_zh: 研究全球健康与环境议题的新闻报道、科学虚假信息、AI的影响，以及公众如何解读气候与科学信息。

name: Serena Miller
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social science theory building, concept explication, scale development, and metascience, along with alternative journalism and non-scientific ways of knowing.
summary_zh: 研究社会科学理论建构、概念阐释、量表开发与元科学，以及另类新闻与非科学的认知方式。

name: Christina L. Myers
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Black representation in news, music and sports
summary: Studies depictions of Black experiences and implicit racial bias in news, music, and sports media, using qualitative methods and Critical Race Theory.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法与批判种族理论，研究新闻、音乐与体育媒体中的黑人经验呈现及隐性种族偏见。

name: Perry Parks
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how taken-for-granted news norms and values limit journalism, using historical, critical, and discourse analysis, including in science journalism.
summary_zh: 研究习以为常的新闻规范与价值如何限制新闻业，采用历史、批判与话语分析，也涉及科学新闻。

name: Swarnavel Eswaran Pillai
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history, theory, and production of documentary and Tamil cinema, including its ties to Hollywood and Hindi film and questions of caste and gender.
summary_zh: 研究纪录片与泰米尔电影的历史、理论与制作，包括其与好莱坞及印地语电影的关系以及种姓与性别议题。

name: Bruno Takahashi
title: Brandt Endowed Professor of Environmental Communication
summary: Studies news coverage of environmental issues and environmental journalism practices in Latin America and U.S. Latino media, plus identity in science communication.
summary_zh: 研究环境议题的新闻报道，以及拉丁美洲与美国拉丁裔媒体的环境新闻实践，并关注科学传播中的身份问题。

name: Tim P. Vos
title: Professor
summary: Studies journalistic roles, gatekeeping, and media sociology, along with media history and media policy across print, broadcast, and digital news.
summary_zh: 研究新闻从业者角色、把关与媒介社会学，以及纸媒、广电与数字新闻的媒介史与媒介政策。

name: Geri Alumit Zeldes
title: Professor + Associate Dean of Faculty & Academic Staff
areas: Documentary filmmaking and news coverage of race, ethnicity and religion
summary: Studies news coverage of race, ethnicity, and religion and produces documentary films that tell stories from the margins.
summary_zh: 研究有关种族、族裔与宗教的新闻报道，并制作讲述边缘群体故事的纪录片。

name: Fashina Aladé
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how young children comprehend and learn from educational media and technology, often in partnership with children's media producers and community groups.
summary_zh: 研究幼儿如何理解并从教育媒介与技术中学习，常与儿童媒体制作方及社区组织合作。

name: Saleem E. Alhabash
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional effects of social media in persuasion, including alcohol marketing, digital aggression, online counterfeits, and attitudes toward nations.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体在说服中的认知与情绪效果，包括酒类营销、网络攻击、网购假货以及对他国的态度。

name: John C. Besley
title: Ellis N. Brandt Professor of Public Relations
summary: Studies public views of science and scientists' views of communication, including trust and fairness perceptions, through large surveys and interviews of scientists.
summary_zh: 研究公众对科学的看法与科学家对传播的看法，包括信任与公平感，采用大规模调查与科学家访谈。

name: Matea Čaluk
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how executive leaders make decisions during crisis and uncertainty and how identity shapes those decisions.
summary_zh: 研究高层领导者在危机与不确定时期如何决策，以及身份如何影响其决策。

name: Luke Capizzo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations and social issues management, including activism, dialogue, organizational listening, sustainability, and PR pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与社会议题管理，包括行动主义、对话、组织倾听、可持续发展与公关教育。

name: Chuqing Dong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies CSR and ESG communication, nonprofit-corporate alliances, government communication, and AI in public relations, using multimethod designs.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任与ESG传播、非营利组织与企业联盟、政府传播以及公关中的AI，采用多方法设计。

name: Kelly Gaggin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies public relations and strategic communication as drivers of cross-cultural understanding and relationship-building, especially for nonprofit organizations.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与战略传播如何促进跨文化理解与关系建立，尤其关注非营利组织。

name: Dan Hiaeshutter-Rice
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies and identity shape political, health, and environmental information in the U.S., using computational methods, surveys, and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究传播技术与身份如何塑造美国的政治、健康与环境信息，采用计算方法、调查与实验。

name: Bree E. Holtz
title: Professor
summary: Studies adoption and outcomes of telemedicine, mHealth apps, wearable sensors, and AI in healthcare, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究远程医疗、移动健康应用、可穿戴传感器与医疗AI的采纳及其效果，采用混合方法。

name: Patricia T. Huddleston
title: Professor
summary: Studies consumer information processing of retail point-of-purchase displays, using eye tracking to link signage and price cues to purchase intention.
summary_zh: 研究消费者对零售终端陈列的信息加工，利用眼动追踪考察标识与价格线索对购买意向的影响。

name: Anastasia Kononova
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media multitasking across cultures and the lifespan and its effects on cognition, emotion, and resistance to advertising and health messages.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化与跨生命周期的媒介多任务行为，及其对认知、情绪以及对广告与健康信息抵抗的影响。

name: Hairong Li
title: Professor
summary: Studies the uses, effects, and implications of digital technology, including interactive media, AI, and big data, in advertising and marketing communication.
summary_zh: 研究数字技术（包括互动媒介、AI与大数据）在广告与营销传播中的使用、效果与影响。

name: Mengyan Ma
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how influencers, family communication, and AI shape health behaviors and well-being among youth and families, using mixed and community-engaged methods.
summary_zh: 研究网红、家庭沟通与AI如何影响青少年与家庭的健康行为与幸福感，采用混合方法与社区参与式研究。

name: Anna R McAlister
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies children's consumer behavior, applying developmental psychology to children's knowledge of food brands, responses to food advertising, and food preferences.
summary_zh: 研究儿童消费行为，运用发展心理学考察儿童对食品品牌的认知、对食品广告的反应及食物偏好形成。

name: Susan McFarlane-Alvarez
title: Professor
summary: Studies how historical, cultural, and ideological forces shape identity and image representations in advertising and strategic communication.
summary_zh: 研究历史、文化与意识形态力量如何塑造广告与战略传播中的身份与影像再现。

name: Dar Meshi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychology and neuroscience of technology use, including problematic social media use in adults and adolescents and the use of blockchain web3 apps.
summary_zh: 研究技术使用的心理与神经机制，包括成人与青少年的问题性社交媒体使用以及区块链web3应用的使用。

name: Maria D. Molina
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how technological affordances shape online persuasion in digital health, misinformation sharing, and privacy decisions with generative AI chatbots.
summary_zh: 研究技术可供性如何影响数字健康、虚假信息分享以及与生成式AI聊天机器人互动时隐私决策中的网络说服。

name: Juan Mundel
title: Associate Dean and Associate Professor
summary: Studies effects of marketing and social media advertising on underserved and at-risk groups, such as anxiety, addiction, and intent to buy alcohol or e-cigarettes.
summary_zh: 研究营销与社交媒体广告对弱势和高风险群体的影响，如焦虑、成瘾以及购买酒类或电子烟的意向。

name: Hannah Overbye-Thompson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people detect bias and limitations in AI and algorithmic systems and how they adapt their technology use in response.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何察觉AI与算法系统中的偏见与局限，以及如何相应调整其技术使用。

name: Nancy Rhodes
title: Professor
summary: Studies persuasion and social influence, especially how social norms affect message processing and health risk behaviors like smoking, drinking, and risky driving.
summary_zh: 研究说服与社会影响，尤其是社会规范如何影响信息加工以及吸烟、饮酒、危险驾驶等健康风险行为。

name: Edward Timke
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Disability and accessibility in advertising representations and the advertising workplace
Disability innovation and entrepreneurship in communication
International and intercultural dimensions of advertising
Cultural history of advertising and its role in shaping social change
Public and applied scholarship in advertising
summary: Studies the cultural history of advertising and disability innovation and accessibility in North America and Europe, using oral history, ethnography, and archives.
summary_zh: 研究广告文化史以及北美与欧洲的残障创新与无障碍实践，采用口述史、民族志与档案研究。

name: Aileen Torrance
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in advertising and public relations; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于广告与公共关系系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Mariah Wellman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social media influencers and wellness culture, including how wellness creators build authority, plus social media use in patient-provider health communication.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体网红与健康养生文化，包括养生创作者如何建立权威，以及社交媒体在医患健康沟通中的作用。

name: Maral Zakharia
title: Associate Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in advertising and public relations; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于广告与公共关系系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Young Anna Argyris
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health misinformation and social media influence, building deep learning models to classify vaccine misinformation and designing counter-campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究健康虚假信息与社交媒体影响力，构建深度学习模型识别疫苗虚假信息并设计反制传播活动。

name: Johannes M. Bauer
title: Quello Chair in Media and Information Policy
summary: Studies the digital economy and the governance and policy of information and communication technologies, with international and comparative scope.
summary_zh: 研究数字经济以及信息通信技术的治理与政策，具有国际与比较视野。

name: Susan Bonner
title: Associate Professor
summary: Designs and studies entertainment and serious games, including AR games, to transform healthcare and teach children social-emotional coping skills.
summary_zh: 设计并研究娱乐与严肃游戏（包括AR游戏），用于变革医疗以及教授儿童社会情绪应对技能。

name: Sandra Braman
title: Professor, Media and Information and Senior Scholar, Quello Center
summary: Studies the macro-level effects of digital technologies and information policy, analyzing U.S. statutes and constitutional law on falsity, disinformation, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究数字技术的宏观影响与信息政策，分析美国有关虚假陈述、虚假信息与AI的法规与宪法。

name: Celeste Campos-Castillo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how technologies like chatbots and health tools can be designed to reduce health inequalities, using multimethod, community-partnered research.
summary_zh: 研究如何设计聊天机器人与健康工具等技术以缓解健康不平等，采用多方法、与社区合作的研究。

name: Amanda Cote
title: Associate Professor and Director of the Serious Games Certificate
summary: Studies the game industry and gaming culture, including gender and identity, developer labor and crunch, and collegiate esports, through interviews and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究游戏产业与游戏文化，包括性别与身份、开发者劳动与加班文化以及大学电竞，采用访谈与话语分析。

name: David Ewoldsen
title: Professor
summary: Studies media psychology, including comprehension of media messages, racism and the media, cooperative video game play, and attitudes in risky health behavior.
summary_zh: 研究媒介心理学，包括媒介信息理解、种族主义与媒介、合作类电子游戏以及态度在健康风险行为中的作用。

name: Keith Hampton
title: Professor
summary: Studies how digital technologies and social networks shape community, well-being, adolescent mental health, social isolation, and willingness to voice opinions.
summary_zh: 研究数字技术与社会网络如何影响社区、幸福感、青少年心理健康、社会孤立以及表达意见的意愿。

name: Jean Hardy
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of technology in rural economic and community development, broadband policy, and collaborative technologies among rural LGBTQ people, drawing on CSCW and STS.
summary_zh: 借鉴CSCW与STS研究技术在乡村经济与社区发展中的作用、宽带政策，以及乡村LGBTQ群体的协作技术。

name: Megan Knittel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies tech harms, cybersafety, digital equity, and platform governance, using mixed methods in settings such as domestic violence and rural Michigan communities.
summary_zh: 研究技术伤害、网络安全、数字公平与平台治理，在家庭暴力与密歇根乡村社区等情境中采用混合方法。

name: Hee Rin Lee
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates social robots for social good, aiming to empower marginalized groups such as low-income people and older adults.
summary_zh: 设计并评估面向社会公益的社交机器人，旨在赋权低收入人群与老年人等边缘群体。

name: Sian Lee
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how information environments and generative AI shape beliefs and decisions, covering misinformation, sport analytics, and LLM alignment, using machine learning and statistics.
summary_zh: 研究信息环境与生成式AI如何影响信念与决策，涵盖虚假信息、体育数据分析与大模型对齐，采用机器学习与统计方法。

name: Megh Marathe
title: Assistant Professor
areas: information and communication technologies and development
summary: Studies inclusion in medical and civic expert practices and technologies, such as epilepsy care, brain implants, and gender-diverse data, through ethnography.
summary_zh: 通过民族志研究医疗与公民领域专家实践与技术中的包容性，如癫痫诊疗、脑植入设备与性别多元数据。

name: Casey O'Donnell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the creative collaborative work and culture of videogame design and development in AAA studios and independent communities, and develops games.
summary_zh: 研究3A工作室与独立开发社区中电子游戏设计与开发的创意协作及其文化，并亲自开发游戏。

name: Jennifer Olson
title: Associate Professor
areas: Information & Communications Technology and Development-- ICTD
Climate Change Impacts on Agricultural Systems
summary: Studies climate and land-use change impacts in Africa and runs ICT-for-development projects that co-design technologies with farmers and youth.
summary_zh: 研究非洲气候与土地利用变化的影响，并开展与农民和青少年共同设计技术的信息通信技术促进发展项目。

name: Wei Peng
title: Professor
areas: Psychological impacts of interactive media (mediators and moderators)
Utilizing technologies for health communication (persuasive technology)
Behavior change enabled by conversational agent and AI
Mobile apps for disease self-management and health promotion
Active video games (exergames) for physical activity promotion
summary: Studies psychological mechanisms of behavior change and designs and evaluates chatbots, exergames, and mobile apps for health promotion.
summary_zh: 研究行为改变的心理机制，并设计与评估用于健康促进的聊天机器人、运动游戏与移动应用。

name: Daniel Putman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social networks and digital technology shape vulnerability, resilience, and responses to risk among the poor, using applied microeconomics and computational social science.
summary_zh: 运用应用微观经济学与计算社会科学，研究社会网络与数字技术如何影响贫困人群的脆弱性、韧性与风险应对。

name: Rabindra Ratan
title: Professor and AT&T Endowed Chair
summary: Studies psychological effects of human-technology interaction such as avatars, VR/XR, video games, and AI, including the Proteus effect and gender stereotypes in gaming.
summary_zh: 研究人机交互的心理效应，涉及虚拟化身、VR/XR、电子游戏与AI，包括普罗透斯效应与游戏中的性别刻板印象。

name: Ruth Shillair
title: Assistant Professor, Director of Media + Information Master's Program,
summary: Studies how communication strategies and policy can improve cybersecurity practices, increase digital literacy, and reduce the digital divide.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过传播策略与政策改善网络安全实践、提升数字素养并缩小数字鸿沟。

name: Michael Stern
title: Department Chairperson
summary: Studies health information seeking and digital inequality among marginalized and rural groups, and advances survey methodology using web, mobile, and big data.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化与乡村群体的健康信息寻求与数字不平等，并利用网络、移动与大数据推进调查方法。

name: Morgan Vigil-Hayes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how rural and Indigenous communities build and govern networked information systems, and designs and deploys community-owned networks with tribal partners.
summary_zh: 研究乡村与原住民社区如何建设和治理网络信息系统，并与部落伙伴设计部署社区自有网络。

name: Brian Winn
title: Professor, Director of the Games for Entertainment and Learning Lab
summary: Designs, creates, and studies interactive media, including game design, digital game-based learning, and interactive health communication.
summary_zh: 设计、制作并研究互动媒介，包括游戏设计、数字游戏化学习与互动健康传播。

name: Susan Wyche
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies technology use in Sub-Saharan Africa for HCI and ICT-for-development, grounded in long-term fieldwork at Kenyan sites.
summary_zh: 基于在肯尼亚的长期田野调查，研究撒哈拉以南非洲的技术使用，服务于人机交互与信息通信技术促进发展领域。

name: Lucinda D. Davenport
title: University Distinguished Professor
summary: Journalism studies scholar working on digital media technologies in journalism, media history, journalism education, ethics, and women and media, including news source diversity tools.
summary_zh: 新闻学研究者，关注新闻业中的数字媒体技术、媒介史、新闻教育、新闻伦理及女性与媒介，并开发新闻信源多样性工具。

name: Ronald Walter Greene
title: Professor
summary: Studies how institutions regulate debate, discussion, and persuasion to shape democratic decision making, using rhetorical, argumentation, and cultural theory.
summary_zh: 从修辞、论辩与文化理论出发，研究机构如何规制辩论、讨论与说服以影响民主决策。

name: Atilla Hallsby
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how rhetoric shapes public perceptions of secrecy, transparency, surveillance, and AI in U.S. political culture through rhetorical criticism and critical theory.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评与批判理论，研究修辞如何塑造美国政治文化中公众对秘密、透明、监控与人工智能的认知。

name: Elaine Hsieh
title: Professor, Department Chair
areas: Health Communication, with an emphasis of interpersonal and intercultural issues in health contexts
Culture and Health, with a focus on cultural frameworks and perspectives that shape individual health behaviors and institutional policies
Interpreting Studies, highlighting the communicative and interactive nature of interpreter-mediated interactions
Bioethics, with expertise in interpersonal and crosscultural contexts
summary: Studies interpersonal and intercultural communication in health care, including interpreter-mediated medical interactions, cultural frameworks of health, and bioethics.
summary_zh: 研究医疗情境中的人际与跨文化传播，包括口译员介入的医患互动、健康的文化框架以及生命伦理。

name: Susanne M. Jones
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
areas: The effect of mindfulness and other cognitive-affective processes on emotion regulation and interpersonal communication
Social support and comforting in interpersonal relationships
Coping and emotion regulation in interpersonal relationships
summary: Studies supportive communication, nonverbal behavior, and mindfulness in emotion regulation using lab experiments with recorded and coded conversations.
summary_zh: 通过实验室实验并对录制的对话进行编码分析，研究支持性传播、非语言行为以及正念在情绪调节中的作用。

name: Zornitsa Keremidchieva
title: Associate Professor
areas: Institutional and Organizational Rhetoric and Democratic Governance
Critical Intercultural, International and Transnational Rhetoric
summary: Studies feminist, institutional, and congressional rhetoric, immigration and citizenship, and democratic governance through rhetorical and historical analysis of policy discourse.
summary_zh: 通过对政策话语的修辞与历史分析，研究女性主义修辞、制度与国会修辞、移民与公民身份以及民主治理。

name: Ascan F. Koerner
title: Professor
summary: Studies family and marital communication and the cognitive bases of relationships, including relational schemas, message production, and persuasion.
summary_zh: 研究家庭与婚姻传播以及人际关系的认知基础，包括关系图式、讯息生产与说服。

name: Kate Lockwood Harris
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how violence and communication relate, especially organizational responses to sexual assault and Title IX, using feminist, intersectional, and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用女性主义、交叉性与质性方法，研究暴力与传播的关系，尤其是组织对性侵害的回应与美国《第九条》。

name: Laurie Ouellette
title: Professor
summary: Studies how popular media such as reality TV, lifestyle media, and influencers govern bodies, subjectivities, and citizenship, using critical cultural and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 运用批判文化与历史分析，研究真人秀、生活方式媒体和网红等流行媒介如何治理身体、主体性与公民身份。

name: Gilbert B. Rodman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies critical media and cultural studies, popular culture, communication technologies, and the politics of race, including the history of race and copyright in the US.
summary_zh: 研究批判媒介与文化研究、流行文化、传播技术与种族政治，包括美国种族与版权的历史。

name: Mary Douglas Vavrus
title: Professor, Interim Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies news representations of gender, postfeminism, political women, and the links between media and militarism through feminist and political-economic critique.
summary_zh: 从女性主义与政治经济学批判视角，研究新闻中的性别再现、后女性主义、女性政治人物以及媒介与军事主义的关联。

name: Emily Winderman
title: Associate Professor
areas: affect theory & the cultural politics of emotion
summary: Studies the rhetoric of health and medicine, especially reproductive health, abortion, and infectious disease, using archival rhetorical history, feminist and affect theory.
summary_zh: 运用档案修辞史、女性主义与情感理论，研究健康与医学修辞，尤其是生殖健康、堕胎与传染病话语。

name: Deborah Yoon
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies identity uncertainty and information management in nontraditional families, such as adoptees seeking genetic family health history, and intercultural identity.
summary_zh: 研究非传统家庭中的身份不确定性与信息管理，例如寻求遗传家族健康史的被收养者，以及跨文化身份经验。

name: Colin Agur
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mobile communication, infrastructures, platforms, and digital economies as systems that organize social and political life, drawing on media history and political economy.
summary_zh: 借助媒介史与政治经济学，研究移动传播、基础设施、平台与数字经济如何组织社会与政治生活。

name: Sid Bedingfield
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalism's role in democracy during political change, especially the press, civil rights, and white supremacy in the US South, using historical archival research.
summary_zh: 运用历史档案研究，考察政治变革时期新闻业在民主中的作用，尤其是美国南方的报业、民权运动与白人至上主义。

name: Valérie Bélair-Gagnon
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Director of Undergraduate Studies & Associate Professor
summary: Studies how media management and journalism shape innovation, labor, and well-being in newsrooms, using qualitative and hybrid methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与混合方法，研究媒介管理与新闻业如何影响新闻编辑室中的创新、劳动与从业者福祉。

name: Matt Carlson
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Director of Graduate Studies & Professor
summary: Studies how actors compete to define journalism, its boundaries and norms, developing concepts like journalistic authority, metajournalistic discourse, and boundary work.
summary_zh: 研究不同行动者如何争夺对新闻业及其边界与规范的定义，发展了新闻权威、元新闻话语与边界工作等概念。

name: Elisia Cohen
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Vice Provost of Graduate and Professional Education & Dean of the Graduate School
areas: communication strategies to reduce health and cancer disparities
summary: Studies health communication and multilevel community interventions to reduce health and cancer disparities through community-engaged research.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究，探讨健康传播及多层次社区干预如何减少健康与癌症差异。

name: Nick Hagar
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how AI is changing journalism and public information, including AI design, governance, and newsroom adoption, using computational methods and tool building.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法与工具开发，研究人工智能如何改变新闻业与公共信息，包括AI系统设计、治理及新闻机构的采纳。

name: Jisu Huh
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor & Associate Dean for Research & Graduate Programs, CLA
areas: Data-driven computational advertising research / AI advertising
DTC pharmaceutical and medical device advertising
summary: Studies advertising effects and its role in society, including computational and AI advertising, influencer marketing, consumer trust, and DTC pharmaceutical advertising.
summary_zh: 研究广告的效果及其社会角色，包括计算广告与AI广告、网红营销、消费者信任以及直接面向消费者的药品广告。

name: Sherri Jean Katz
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
areas: Preventing youth uptake of tobacco, nicotine, and THC products
summary: Tests health messages and packaging features to prevent youth uptake of tobacco, nicotine, and THC products, drawing on construal level and reactance theory.
summary_zh: 借助解释水平理论与心理抗拒理论，检验健康讯息与产品包装特征对预防青少年使用烟草、尼古丁与THC产品的作用。

name: Jeff Kosseff
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Silha Professor & Director of the Silha Center for the Study of Media Ethics and Law
summary: Studies First Amendment law, free speech online, Section 230, anonymous and false speech, and cybersecurity law through legal and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过法律与历史分析，研究美国第一修正案、网络言论自由、第230条款、匿名与虚假言论以及网络安全法。

name: María Elizabeth Len-Ríos
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Interim Director & Professor
summary: Studies public relations, health communication, and diversity, equity, and inclusion, including culture as a social determinant of health and journalistic norms around race.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系、健康传播与多元、公平和包容，包括文化作为健康的社会决定因素以及新闻规范与种族不平等。

name: Rebekah Nagler
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies effects of routine exposure to conflicting and controversial health information in the media, and health equity, including population-based survey research.
summary_zh: 研究日常接触媒体中相互矛盾、具争议的健康信息所产生的效果以及健康公平，包括基于人口样本的调查研究。

name: Amy O'Connor
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Fellow in Strategic Communication and Corporate Social Responsibility
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility communication and stakeholder expectations of corporations, including a multi-year ethnography of Minnesota mining companies.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任传播与利益相关者对企业的期待，包括对明尼苏达北部矿业公司的多年民族志研究。

name: Haseon Park
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Trusted relationship building in brand communication
summary: Studies trust and consumer-brand relationships in emergent media and computational advertising, including influencer marketing and social listening data.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒体中的信任与消费者-品牌关系以及计算广告，包括网红营销与社交聆听数据。

name: Adam Saffer
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Honors Program Liaison
summary: Studies how individuals, groups, and organizations such as NGOs and agencies form and use communication networks, using network analysis of primary relational data.
summary_zh: 运用基于一手关系数据的网络分析，研究个人、群体以及非政府组织和政府机构等组织如何建立并运用传播网络。

name: Claire M. Segijn
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Mithun Program Fellow in Advertising
areas: Privacy concerns and ethical ramifications related to data-driven advertising
summary: Studies intended and unintended effects of digital advertising, including media multitasking, synced and personalized ads, privacy concerns, and visual attention measured through eye tracking.
summary_zh: 研究数字广告的预期与非预期效果，包括媒体多任务、同步与个性化广告、隐私担忧，以及借助眼动追踪测量的视觉注意。

name: Erich Sommerfeldt
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor & Director of Strategic Communication Hub
summary: Studies how public relations and public diplomacy contribute to social change and relationship building in developing, crisis-prone, and post-conflict societies, including network approaches.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与公共外交如何在发展中国家及危机频发、冲突后社会中促进社会变革与关系重建，并采用网络分析视角。

name: Christopher Terry
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Cowles Fellow in Journalism, Policy and Law
areas: Administrative Law, including Media Ownership and Advertising Regulation
Copyright, free expression, fair use, creativity, open access, scholarship, remix, publishing, distribution, creator rights
summary: Studies media law and regulation, including media ownership, political advertising rules, copyright and fair use, internet and broadband policy, through legal and regulatory analysis.
summary_zh: 通过法律与规制分析，研究媒介法与规制，包括媒体所有权、政治广告规则、版权与合理使用以及互联网与宽带政策。

name: Benjamin Toff
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor; Director, Minnesota Journalism Center; Cowles Fellow in Political Journalism
summary: Studies news audiences, news avoidance, trust in news, political engagement, and the role of opinion polls in coverage of American politics, including multi-country research.
summary_zh: 研究新闻受众、新闻回避、新闻信任、政治参与以及民调在美国政治报道中的作用，包括多国比较研究。

name: Carolina Velloso
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies journalism and identity, ethics, and practice from historical and contemporary lenses, with attention to gender, race, and sports journalism.
summary_zh: 从历史与当代视角研究新闻业与身份、伦理及实践，关注性别、种族与体育新闻。

name: Emily Vraga
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Interim Associate Director for Faculty & Administration; Professor; Don & Carole Larson Professorship in Health Communication
summary: Studies how people respond to health, science, and political information online, especially correcting misinformation on social media, using experiments, surveys, content analysis, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用实验、调查、内容分析与访谈，研究人们如何回应网络上的健康、科学与政治信息，尤其是社交媒体上的虚假信息纠正。

name: Michelle Wood
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Master's in Strategic Communication Program
summary: Studies strategic communication with an emphasis on persuasion theory, inoculation and resistance to influence, and consumer processing of media messages.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播，重点关注说服理论、免疫理论与抗拒影响，以及消费者对媒介讯息的加工。

name: Marco Yzer
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Fellow in Health Communication
summary: Studies how people use health information in behavioral decisions, focusing on mental health communication and message design grounded in reasoned action theory.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在健康行为决策中使用健康信息，聚焦心理健康传播及基于理性行为理论的讯息设计。

name: Alvin Zhou
dept: Hubbard School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how generative AI reshapes advantages among messages, organizations, and publics in strategic communication, using computational methods and causal inference.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法与因果推断，研究生成式AI如何在战略传播中重塑讯息、组织与公众之间的优势分配。

name: Kelly Garrett
title: Director, School of Communication, Professor
summary: Studies how online news use, selective exposure, and exposure to falsehoods and corrections shape political beliefs in U.S. elections using panel surveys, online experiments, and behavioral data.
summary_zh: 利用面板调查、在线实验和行为数据，研究在线新闻使用、选择性接触以及虚假信息与更正信息如何影响美国选举中的政治信念。

name: Osei Appiah
title: Professor
summary: Studies how ethnic-specific strategic messages and stereotypes in media affect minority audiences, and how race and partisanship shape fears about interracial conversations on political issues.
summary_zh: 研究媒体中针对特定族裔的战略传播信息与刻板印象如何影响少数族裔受众，以及种族与党派立场如何影响人们对跨种族政治议题对话的担忧。

name: Joseph Bayer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how smartphone and social media habits change the mental processes underlying social connection and digital well-being, using mobile methods that collect device and survey data.
summary_zh: 利用通过移动设备收集数字痕迹与调查数据的移动研究方法，研究智能手机与社交媒体习惯如何改变社会联结背后的心理过程及数字福祉。

name: Robert Bond
title: Professor
summary: Studies social interactions, social networks, and political behavior, including misinformation beliefs across election cycles, frequently using computational and network methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动、社会网络与政治行为（包括选举周期中的虚假信息信念），常采用计算与网络分析方法。

name: James "Alex" Bonus
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive obstacles that limit young children's learning from socioemotional and science media, and how nostalgic media prompts self-comparisons affecting adults' well-being.
summary_zh: 研究阻碍幼儿从社会情感类与科学类媒介中学习的认知障碍，以及怀旧媒介如何引发自我时间比较并影响成年人的心理福祉。

name: Miriam (Mimi) Brinberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the dynamics of everyday face-to-face and mediated interpersonal interactions using dyadic methods, intensive longitudinal data, ecological momentary assessment, and screenshot sequences.
summary_zh: 运用二元分析方法、密集纵向数据、生态瞬时评估和屏幕截图序列，研究日常面对面与中介化人际互动的动态过程。

name: Brad J. Bushman
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies the causes, consequences, and remedies of human aggression and violence, testing popular myths about guns, venting anger, self-esteem, and whether violence and sex sell products.
summary_zh: 研究人类攻击与暴力行为的成因、后果与对策，检验关于枪支、宣泄愤怒、自尊以及“暴力与性能促销”等流行迷思。

name: Scott Campbell
title: Professor, Rinehart Chair in Mediated Communication
summary: Studies the social uses and consequences of mobile media, including habit and automaticity, civic life, teens' phone use, and solitude and well-being in an always-connected era.
summary_zh: 研究移动媒体的社会使用与后果，包括使用习惯与自动性、公民生活、青少年手机使用，以及永远在线时代的独处与福祉。

name: HyunYi Cho
title: Professor
summary: Studies intersections between media, health, and identities.
summary_zh: 研究媒介、健康与身份认同之间的交叉关系。

name: Jason Coronel
title: Associate Professor, Undergraduate Communication Program Director
summary: Studies what eye movements reveal about memory, knowledge, and decisions about civic and scientific information, and how technologies that infer from eye tracking can be trusted and governed.
summary_zh: 研究眼动如何揭示人们对公民与科学信息的记忆、知识和决策，以及基于眼动推断的技术如何获得信任与治理。

name: David DeAndrea
title: Professor and Associate Director
