summary: Studies online self-presentation, impression management, and person perception, including how people judge the credibility and authenticity of online information in health and political contexts.
summary_zh: 研究网络自我呈现、印象管理与人际知觉，考察人们如何在人际、健康和政治等情境中判断网络信息的可信度与真实性。

name: Graham Dixon
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how misinformation, bigoted discourse, and violent rhetoric on social media distort public engagement with politicized science topics such as climate change and emerging technologies.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上的虚假信息、偏执言论与暴力修辞如何扭曲公众对气候变化和新兴技术等政治化科学议题的参与。

name: William "Chip" Eveland
title: Professor of Communication, Professor of Political Science (by courtesy)
summary: Studies political talk and interpersonal communication networks, examining exposure to partisan and racial disagreement and its effects on knowledge, participation, and polarization.
summary_zh: 研究政治讨论与人际传播网络，考察跨党派与跨种族的意见分歧接触及其对政治知识、政治参与和极化的影响。

name: Jesse Fox
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social media, virtual reality, video games, robots, and conversational agents shape identities, attitudes, and behaviors, using experiments, surveys, content analysis, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用实验、调查、内容分析和访谈，研究社交媒体、虚拟现实、电子游戏、机器人与对话代理如何塑造身份认同、态度与行为。

name: Sara Grady
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies why people engage with narrative entertainment, how media serves as a coping tool, and how media use and relationships shape each other, including through experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人们为何投入叙事娱乐、媒介如何成为应对压力的工具，以及媒介使用与人际关系和身份认同之间的相互影响，研究方法包括实验。

name: Matthew Grizzard
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how audiences make moral judgments of characters in popular media narratives and how these context-dependent judgments help explain polarization and schadenfreude.
summary_zh: 研究受众如何对流行媒介叙事中的角色作出道德判断，以及这些受情境影响的判断如何解释极化与幸灾乐祸等现象。

name: Lanier Holt
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the social and psychological effects of media messages on audiences' perceptions of African Americans, women, and other marginalized groups, bridging journalism and media effects.
summary_zh: 研究媒介信息如何影响受众对非裔美国人、女性及其他边缘群体的认知，融合新闻学、媒介效果与社会心理学视角。

name: Shelly Hovick
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cancer and chronic disease risk perceptions, health information seeking, and disparities, and develops tools for communicating family health history and genetic risk.
summary_zh: 研究癌症与慢性病风险认知、健康信息寻求与健康差距，并开发用于传达家族病史和遗传风险信息的工具。

name: Susan Kline
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal message design, persuasion, and argumentation from a constructivist view, including how children develop communication abilities and how deliberation shapes civic discourse.
summary_zh: 从建构主义视角研究人际信息设计、说服与论辩，包括儿童沟通能力的发展以及协商如何影响公民话语。

name: Roselyn Lee-Won
title: Associate Professor
areas: Cognitive and Affective Processes in in Computer-Mediated Communication and Human-Computer Interaction
summary: Studies cognitive and affective processes in social media use, computer-mediated communication, and human-computer interaction.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体使用、计算机中介传播与人机交互中的认知和情感过程。

name: Bingjie Liu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human interaction with AI for self-expression and interpersonal communication, such as identity management and supportive communication, using mixed methods and building human-centered AI.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究人们借助人工智能进行自我表达与人际沟通（如身份管理和支持性沟通），并构建以人为本的人工智能系统。

name: Teresa Lynch
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies sex and gender messages in video games and how interactivity shapes players' emotional processing, using content analysis, surveys, experiments, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用内容分析、调查、实验和深度访谈，研究电子游戏中的性与性别信息，以及操控性如何影响玩家的情绪加工。

name: Nic Matthews
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms and contexts that bias moral judgments, combining entertainment media and interpersonal communication theories with moral psychology.
summary_zh: 结合娱乐媒介与人际传播理论和道德心理学，研究使道德判断产生偏差的机制与情境。

name: Jingbo Meng
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies and designs online social networks that promote social support, credible health information, and health behavior change, including AI tools to counter health misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究并设计促进社会支持、可信健康信息传播和健康行为改变的在线社会网络，包括用人工智能应对健康虚假信息。

name: Emily Moyer-Gusé
title: Professor, Graduate Program Chair
areas: Effects of entertainment media on risky health behaviors
summary: Studies how entertainment narratives such as television storylines influence attitudes and behaviors on health and social issues, and children's emotional reactions to news and entertainment.
summary_zh: 研究电视剧情等娱乐叙事如何影响人们对健康与社会议题的态度和行为，以及儿童对新闻和娱乐节目的情绪反应。

name: Amy Nathanson
title: Professor
summary: Studies media effects on young children, including links between television exposure and executive function and theory of mind, and how parental mediation shapes children's responses.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对幼儿的影响，包括电视接触与执行功能、心理理论之间的关系，以及父母介入如何影响儿童对电视的反应。

name: Laura Partain
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Representations of Race, Ethnicity, Religion and Citizenship Status (refugees, immigrants)
summary: Studies intergroup communication, stereotype interventions, and prejudice reduction, including media representations of race, religion, refugees, and immigrants, and health communication.
summary_zh: 研究群际传播、刻板印象干预与偏见消减，包括媒介对种族、宗教、难民和移民的再现，以及健康传播。

name: Rob Potter
title: Professor
summary: Studies how audio elements of media messages affect audience attention and emotion through experiments combining self-reports with heart rate, skin conductance, facial EMG, eye tracking, and EEG.
summary_zh: 通过将自我报告与心率、皮肤电、面部肌电、眼动和脑电测量相结合的实验，研究媒介信息中的音频元素如何影响受众注意与情绪。

name: Felecia Ross
title: Associate Professor
areas: Mass media and traditionally discriminated groups, especially history of the black press
summary: Studies the history of the Black press and the relationship between mass media and traditionally discriminated groups through journalism history research.
summary_zh: 通过新闻史研究，探讨黑人报刊的历史以及大众媒介与传统上受歧视群体之间的关系。

name: Jane Shawcroft
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how family processes, context, and individual differences shape children's technology use and well-being, using experience sampling and long-lag longitudinal panel data.
summary_zh: 运用经验取样与长间隔纵向面板数据，研究家庭过程、外部环境与个体差异如何影响儿童的技术使用及其福祉。

name: Hillary Shulman
title: Associate Professor, Journalism Program Chair
summary: Studies how message design can increase engagement with politics, science, and health, especially among underrepresented groups, drawing on social cognition and social influence.
summary_zh: 借助社会认知与社会影响理论，研究信息设计如何提升人们（尤其是代表性不足群体）对政治、科学与健康议题的参与。

name: Michael Slater
title: Social and Behavioral Sciences Distinguished Professor
areas: Dynamic processes of selection and effect
summary: Develops theories of selective exposure and narrative influence, such as the Reinforcing Spirals Model, and studies media and health prevention, especially alcohol and tobacco use.
summary_zh: 构建选择性接触与叙事影响的理论（如强化螺旋模型），并研究媒介与健康预防，尤其是酒精与烟草使用。

name: Dominik Stecuła
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the supply and demand sides of the information environment and how they and misinformation shape public opinion on issues like climate change and vaccination.
summary_zh: 研究信息环境的供给与需求两端，以及它们和虚假信息如何影响公众在气候变化、疫苗接种等议题上的舆论形成。

name: Zheng Joyce Wang
title: Professor
areas: Motivation, emotion, and cognition in media processing and choice behavior
Reciprocal dynamics of choice behavior and information processing
Quantum probabilistic and dynamic models of cognition, decision, and communication
summary: Studies motivation, emotion, and cognition in media processing and choice using psychophysiological measures and dynamic and quantum probabilistic computational models, including mHealth design.
summary_zh: 运用心理生理测量以及动态与量子概率计算模型，研究媒介加工与选择中的动机、情绪和认知，并涉及移动健康应用设计。

name: Moya Bailey
title: Professor
summary: Studies Black women's and queer digital resistance, misogynoir, and hashtag activism, combining critical analysis of social media networks with documentary and health-justice work.
summary_zh: 研究黑人女性与酷儿群体的数字抵抗、厌黑女症和标签行动主义，结合对社交媒体网络的批判分析与纪录片及健康正义实践。

name: Claudio Benzecry
title: Professor; Director of Graduate Studies for the PhD in Media, Technology, and Society
summary: Studies culture, arts, creative work, and globalization through long-term ethnography, such as opera fandom and the global design and production of shoes.
summary_zh: 通过长期民族志研究文化、艺术、创意劳动与全球化，例如歌剧迷群体以及鞋类在全球的设计与生产。

name: Thomas J. Billard
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how media shape transgender equality, focusing on the digital media strategies of social movements for and against trans rights in the US, plus design in political branding.
summary_zh: 研究媒介如何影响跨性别平等，聚焦美国支持与反对跨性别权利的社会运动的数字媒体策略，并关注政治品牌中的设计。

name: Jeremy Birnholtz
title: Department Chair; Professor
summary: Studies attention, self-presentation, and collaboration in online environments from an HCI perspective, including LGBTQ+ experiences online and deception in text messaging.
summary_zh: 从人机交互视角研究线上环境中的注意力、自我呈现与协作，包括LGBTQ+群体的网络经验和短信中的欺骗。

name: Pablo J. Boczkowski
title: Professor; Hamad Bin Khalifa Al-Thani Professor
summary: Studies digital culture from a comparative perspective with a focus on Latin America and Latinx USA, currently examining mental health and selfhood in digital life.
summary_zh: 以比较视角研究数字文化，聚焦拉丁美洲与美国拉丁裔，目前探讨数字生活中的心理健康与自我。

name: Larissa Buchholz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the sociology of art and culture in a global frame, examining how artists from peripheral countries gain recognition in global cultural fields and markets.
summary_zh: 在全球框架下研究艺术与文化社会学，考察来自边缘国家的艺术家如何在全球文化场域和市场中获得认可。

name: Aymar Jean Christian
title: Professor; Director, Master of Science in Leadership for Creative Enterprises; Margaret Walker Chair
summary: Studies the political economy of legacy and web television and power in media, using community-based creative R&D and production to build reparative media platforms.
summary_zh: 研究传统电视与网络电视的政治经济及媒介中的权力，借助社区参与式的创意研发与制作建设修复性媒介平台。

name: Noshir Contractor
title: Jane S. & William J. White Professor of Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how social and knowledge networks form and perform in business, science, healthcare, and space teams using network science and computational social science.
summary_zh: 运用网络科学与计算社会科学，研究社会网络与知识网络如何在商业、科学、医疗和太空团队中形成并发挥作用。

name: Ignacio Fernandez Cruz
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how AI and digital platforms reshape work, hiring, and expertise in organizations, with a commitment to designing fair and accountable communication technologies.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能与数字平台如何重塑组织中的工作、招聘与专业知识，致力于设计公平、可问责的传播技术。

name: Leslie DeChurch
title: Professor; Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani Chair in Communication
summary: Studies leadership and teamwork, including multiteam systems and human-AI teams, using laboratory and online experiments, meta-analyses, and field studies.
summary_zh: 研究领导力与团队协作，包括多团队系统和人机团队，采用实验室与在线实验、元分析及田野研究。

name: Nicholas Diakopoulos
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational journalism, including automation and algorithms in news production, algorithmic accountability and transparency, and social media in news contexts.
summary_zh: 研究计算新闻学，包括新闻生产中的自动化与算法、算法问责与透明度，以及新闻语境下的社交媒体。

name: Rayvon Fouché
title: Professor; Associate Dean for Graduate Education
summary: Studies intersections of race, cultural representation, and technoscientific design, drawing on science and technology studies and history, from Black inventors to sports technology.
summary_zh: 研究种族、文化再现与技术科学设计的交叉，借助科学技术研究与历史方法，涵盖从黑人发明家到体育技术等议题。

name: Dilip Gaonkar
title: Professor, Culture and Communication; Director of the Center for Global Culture and Communication
summary: Studies rhetoric as an intellectual tradition and the political impact of global modernities, working through theoretical and interpretive analysis of public culture.
summary_zh: 研究作为思想传统的修辞学及全球多元现代性对政治的影响，以理论与阐释方法分析公共文化。

name: Darren Gergle
title: Bao Family Professor in Human-Computer Interaction
summary: Studies how technological mediation affects communication and collaboration, building and evaluating novel collaboration technologies in HCI and CSCW.
summary_zh: 研究技术中介如何影响沟通与协作，在人机交互与计算机支持的协同工作领域设计、开发并评估新型协作技术。

name: Robert Hariman
title: Owen L. Coon Professor of Argumentation and Debate; Director, Master of Science of Communication
summary: Studies rhetoric and modern visual public culture, such as public photography and civic spectatorship, through rhetorical and critical analysis of political judgment.
summary_zh: 研究修辞学与现代视觉公共文化，如公共摄影与公民观看，通过修辞与批判分析探讨政治判断。

name: Heather Hendershot
title: Professor; Cardiss Collins Professor of Communication Studies and Journalism
summary: Studies the history of American TV news, conservative and right-wing media, and political movements, using historical analysis of broadcasting and coverage such as Chicago 1968.
summary_zh: 研究美国电视新闻、保守派与右翼媒体以及政治运动的历史，运用历史分析考察广播电视及1968年芝加哥等事件的报道。

name: Ágnes Horvát
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how online spaces disseminate information and attention, including LLM use in science and music creation, using network science and human-centered computing.
summary_zh: 运用网络科学与以人为本的计算方法，研究线上空间如何传播信息与注意力，包括大语言模型在科研写作和音乐创作中的使用。

name: Matthew Kay
title: Associate Professor; Director of Graduate Studies for the PhD in Technology and Social Behavior
summary: Studies how to communicate uncertainty and make statistics usable through information visualization, building and evaluating interactive systems and visualization techniques.
summary_zh: 通过信息可视化研究如何传达不确定性、提升统计的可用性，构建并评估交互系统与可视化技术。

name: Marwan M. Kraidy
title: Dean Northwestern Univ, Qatar; Professor, Communication Studies; Anthony Shadid Chair in Global Media, Politics and Culture
summary: Studies global communication and Arab media, culture, and politics, examining geopolitics, identity, comparative media systems, media industries, and digital sovereignty.
summary_zh: 研究全球传播与阿拉伯媒体、文化和政治，考察地缘政治、身份、比较媒介体系、媒介产业与数字主权。

name: Bruce L. Lambert
title: Professor
summary: Studies health communication and patient safety, especially medication safety and drug name confusion, using health information technology and predictive analytics.
summary_zh: 研究健康传播与患者安全，尤其是用药安全与药名混淆，运用健康信息技术与预测分析方法。

name: Calvin Liang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Designs technologies to address health inequities for marginalized communities, particularly supporting queer and trans people's holistic health needs.
summary_zh: 设计技术以应对边缘化社群的健康不平等，尤其是支持酷儿与跨性别者的整体健康需求。

name: Duri Long
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies AI literacy and human-AI interaction, using learning sciences and design research to build public AI literacy interventions and co-creative, embodied museum exhibits.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能素养与人机交互，借助学习科学与设计研究开发公众AI素养干预及共创式、具身化的博物馆展项。

name: Yingdan Lu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how authoritarian governments like China use digital media and AI for information manipulation, combining computational and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究中国等威权政府如何利用数字媒体与人工智能进行信息操纵，结合计算方法与质性方法。

name: Erik C. Nisbet
title: Professor; Owen L. Coon Endowed Professor in Policy Analysis and Communication
summary: Studies media, public opinion, and policy on science, environment, elections, and international security, using cross-national surveys and field experiments.
summary_zh: 研究媒体、舆论与科学、环境、选举及国际安全政策的关系，采用跨国调查与田野实验。

name: Angela G. Ray
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetorical history of nineteenth-century US popular education and social reform, such as the lyceum system and clandestine debating among young Black men.
summary_zh: 研究十九世纪美国大众教育与社会改革的修辞史，例如讲习会制度和年轻黑人男性的秘密辩论。

name: Courtney Lynam Scherr
title: Associate Chair; Associate Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies how risk and uncertainty are communicated to patients and publics, especially in genetics, designing and evaluating theory-guided messages for informed decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究如何向患者与公众传达风险与不确定性，尤其在遗传学领域，设计并评估理论指导的信息以促进知情决策。

name: James Schwoch
title: Professor
summary: Studies media history alongside climate, energy, and environment and science and technology studies, through historical research on telegraphy, satellites, and global TV.
summary_zh: 结合气候、能源与环境以及科学技术研究开展媒介史研究，以历史方法考察电报、卫星与全球电视。

name: Aaron Shaw
title: Professor
summary: Studies collaboration, governance, and inclusion in participatory online communities such as Wikipedia, using community data science and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究维基百科等参与式网络社群中的协作、治理与包容，采用社群数据科学与计算方法。

name: Michelle Shumate
title: Professor, Delaney Family University Research Professor
summary: Studies how government and nonprofit interorganizational networks such as systems of care can be designed for social impact, using network analysis and service outcome data.
summary_zh: 研究政府与非营利组织之间的组织网络（如照护体系）如何设计以实现社会影响，采用网络分析与服务结果数据。

name: Nathan Walter
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies misinformation correction, strategic storytelling, and emotion in social influence across health, politics, and science, developing models of persuasion and debunking.
summary_zh: 研究健康、政治与科学领域中的虚假信息纠正、策略性叙事以及情绪在社会影响中的作用，构建说服与辟谣模型。

name: Sulafa Zidani
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Media Cultures in the Global South
summary: Studies internet cultures and memes in the Global South, examining how transnational youth use creative online tactics across five languages and geopolitical contexts.
summary_zh: 研究全球南方的网络文化与表情包，考察跨国青年如何在五种语言和不同地缘政治语境中运用创意网络策略。

name: Thomas Bradshaw
title: Department Chair; Professor
summary: Writes confrontational plays and television drama as a playwright and TV producer rather than conducting empirical communication research.
summary_zh: 作为剧作家与电视制片人创作具有对抗性的戏剧和电视剧，而非开展实证传播研究。

name: Vera Brunner-Sung
title: Associate Professor
summary: Makes experimental, narrative, and documentary films exploring American identity and belonging, including collaborative work with Hmong communities in Montana.
summary_zh: 创作实验、叙事与纪录电影，探讨美国身份与归属，包括与蒙大拿州苗族社区合作的作品。

name: Erin Courtney
title: Associate Professor; Associate Director, MFA in Writing for Screen and Stage
summary: Writes plays, operas, and musicals as an award-winning playwright rather than conducting empirical communication research.
summary_zh: 作为获奖剧作家创作戏剧、歌剧和音乐剧，而非开展实证传播研究。

name: Scott Curtis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of early and silent cinema and animation, especially how scientists, physicians, and educators used motion pictures, through archival film history.
summary_zh: 研究早期与默片电影及动画史，尤其是科学家、医生和教育者如何使用电影，采用档案式电影史方法。

name: Zayd Ayers Dohrn
title: Daniel Hale Williams Professor; Director, MFA in Writing for Screen and Stage
summary: Writes plays, screenplays, TV, and documentary podcasts, working as a dramatist and audio storyteller rather than an empirical researcher.
summary_zh: 创作戏剧、电影剧本、电视剧和纪录播客，以剧作家与音频叙事者身份工作，而非实证研究者。

name: Felicia D. Henderson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes and produces television and film and studies race, class, gender, and othering in the television writers' workspace.
summary_zh: 编剧并制作电视与电影，研究电视编剧工作空间中的种族、阶级、性别与他者化问题。

name: Kyle Henry
title: Professor; Head of Production; Director of Graduate Studies for the MFA in Documentary Media
summary: Directs and edits independent fiction and documentary films about individuals and communities transformed by crisis.
summary_zh: 执导并剪辑独立剧情片与纪录片，关注被危机改变的个人与社群。

name: Paloma Martinez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Makes nonfiction films that humanize complex social and political structures, drawing on labor rights organizing in Mexican migrant communities in Texas.
summary_zh: 创作纪录片以人性化方式呈现复杂的社会与政治结构，借鉴其在德州墨西哥移民社区从事劳工权益组织工作的经验。

name: Brett Neveu
title: Assistant Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Writes genre scripts, especially horror, sci-fi, and procedurals, for film, television, theatre, audio drama, and video games.
summary_zh: 创作类型剧本，尤其是恐怖、科幻与程序类作品，涵盖电影、电视、戏剧、广播剧和电子游戏。

name: Lakshmi Padmanabhan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies political, nonfiction, and experimental cinema, theorizing political realism in Indian documentary through anticolonial thought, Marxist aesthetics, and psychoanalysis.
summary_zh: 研究政治电影、纪录片与实验电影，借助反殖民思想、马克思主义美学与精神分析理论化印度纪录片中的政治现实主义。

name: Spencer Parsons
title: Associate Professor
summary: Directs independent feature and short films and curates film programs, working as a filmmaker rather than an empirical researcher.
summary_zh: 执导独立长片与短片并策划电影展映，以电影人身份工作，而非实证研究者。

name: Eric Patrick
title: Professor
summary: Creates animated films, infographics, and children's media, exploring animated ethnography and writing on information design and educational media.
summary_zh: 创作动画电影、信息图与儿童媒体，探索动画民族志，并撰写信息设计与教育媒体相关文章。

name: Miriam J. Petty
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies race, stardom, performance, and reception in film, especially the history of African American performers and audiences in classical Hollywood.
summary_zh: 研究电影中的种族、明星、表演与接受，尤其是古典好莱坞时期非裔美国演员与观众的历史。

name: Ariel Rogers
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history and theory of cinema and related media, examining how emerging technologies such as widescreen, digital cinema, and VR reshape spectatorship.
summary_zh: 研究电影及相关媒介的历史与理论，考察宽银幕、数字电影和虚拟现实等新兴技术如何重塑观看体验。

name: Ozge Samanci
title: Professor
summary: Creates interactive, data-driven, and VR media art and graphic novels that explore environmental politics such as ocean and space pollution through creative coding and making.
summary_zh: 创作交互式、数据驱动和虚拟现实媒体艺术及图像小说，通过创意编程与制作探讨海洋与太空污染等环境政治。

name: Jeffrey Sconce
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cultural history of electronic media and the occult, psychosis, and low or trash cinema, through historical and critical analysis of media and taste.
summary_zh: 研究电子媒介与神秘学、精神病以及低俗电影的文化史，以历史与批判方法分析媒介与品味。

name: Jacob Smith
title: Associate Chair; Professor
summary: Studies the cultural history of sound media and music, from phonograph cultures and performance to eco-sonic media, through historical and experimental audio scholarship.
summary_zh: 研究声音媒介与音乐的文化史，从留声机文化与表演到生态声音媒介，采用历史研究与实验性音频创作。

name: J.P. Sniadecki
title: Professor; Van Zelst Research Professor
summary: Makes ethnographic and experimental documentary films between the US and China, using anthropological fieldwork to explore discarded places and social transformation.
summary_zh: 在美国与中国之间创作民族志与实验纪录片，运用人类学田野工作探讨被遗弃的地方与社会变迁。

name: Lynn Spigel
title: Frances Willard Professor of Screen Cultures
summary: Studies the history and theory of television, film, and digital media with a feminist focus on gender, domestic technologies, design, and everyday life.
summary_zh: 以女性主义视角研究电视、电影与数字媒介的历史与理论，关注性别、家庭技术、设计与日常生活。

name: Michael Anthony Turcios
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies antiracist and anticolonial radical media histories, such as Chicana/o Los Angeles and Algerian Paris media activism in the 1970s, through archival research.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究探讨反种族主义与反殖民的激进媒介史，如1970年代洛杉矶奇卡诺社群与巴黎阿尔及利亚社群的媒介行动。

name: Neil Verma
title: Associate Professor; Director, Master of Arts in Sound Arts and Industries; Director of Graduate Studies, Screen Cultures
summary: Studies the history and form of narrative podcasting, radio drama, and audio fiction within sound studies, alongside field-recording-based sound art.
summary_zh: 在声音研究框架下研究叙事播客、广播剧与音频虚构作品的历史与形式，并创作基于田野录音的声音艺术。

name: Mimi White
title: Professor
summary: Studies film and television culture through critical-cultural theory, gender, and history, currently analyzing the appeal of formulaic Hallmark TV for women.
summary_zh: 以批判文化理论、性别与历史视角研究电影与电视文化，目前分析Hallmark公式化电视对女性的吸引力。

name: Marco Williams
title: Professor
summary: Directs documentary films on African American history, race, and US immigration policy, such as histories of HBCUs and the undocumented.
summary_zh: 执导关于非裔美国人历史、种族与美国移民政策的纪录片，如历史悠久的黑人大学和无证移民题材。

name: Tracey Scott Wilson
title: Barbara Berlanti Professor in Writing for the Screen and Stage
summary: Writes plays, television series, and screenplays as a dramatist and TV producer rather than conducting empirical communication research.
summary_zh: 作为剧作家与电视制片人创作戏剧、电视剧和电影剧本，而非开展实证传播研究。

name: Elizabeth Gerber
title: Professor; Charles Deering McCormick Professor of Teaching Excellence, Department of Mechanical Engineering
summary: Studies design, innovation management, and organizational behavior, focusing on human-centered design thinking, prototyping, and student design for social impact.
summary_zh: 研究设计、创新管理与组织行为，关注以人为本的设计思维、原型迭代，以及学生面向社会影响的设计实践。

name: Derek Johnson
title: Department Chair | Professor
summary: Studies media industries and production cultures across television, film, games, comics, and merchandising, using critical media industry studies to examine franchising and labor.
summary_zh: 运用批判性媒介产业研究方法，考察电视、电影、游戏、漫画与周边商品领域的媒介产业与生产文化，关注特许经营与劳动问题。

name: Jason Kido Lopez
title: Director of Undergraduate Studies | Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sports media, athlete activism, and sports-based games such as fantasy sports and betting through a media and cultural studies lens on power and ideology.
summary_zh: 从媒介与文化研究视角研究体育媒介、运动员行动主义以及梦幻体育和体育博彩等体育类游戏，关注权力与意识形态。

name: Jeff Smith
title: Associate Chair | Professor
summary: Studies film music and sound, cognitive film theory, and the history of the American film industry through historical and interpretive analysis of Hollywood films.
summary_zh: 通过对好莱坞电影的历史与阐释性分析，研究电影音乐与声音、认知电影理论以及美国电影产业史。

name: Lyn van Swol
title: Director of Graduate Studies | Professor
summary: Studies how group discussion, advice, language use, and chatbot partners shape persuasion and acceptance of information, including environmental issues like climate change and PFAS.
summary_zh: 研究群体讨论、建议、语言使用与聊天机器人对话如何影响说服与信息接受，包括气候变化和PFAS等环境议题。

name: Robert Asen
title: Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric and democratic practice, analyzing public discourse, law, and policy on school choice, public education, and structural racism through rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 以修辞批评方法研究修辞与民主实践，分析关于择校、公共教育与结构性种族主义的公共话语、法律与政策。

name: Anirban Baishya
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies selfies, digital image culture, platforms, viral nationalism, and South Asian media and pornographies through critical cultural analysis.
summary_zh: 以批判文化分析方法研究自拍、数字影像文化、平台、病毒式民族主义以及南亚媒介与色情文化。

name: Kelley Conway
title: Professor
summary: Studies French and transnational film history, filmmakers' creative processes, and women in the film industry through historical research and film analysis, plus digital humanities work.
summary_zh: 通过历史研究、电影分析与数字人文项目，研究法国与跨国电影史、电影人的创作过程以及电影业中的女性。

name: Jonathan Gray
title: Professor
summary: Studies television audiences, streaming viewing, TV comedy, and media dislike and taste through cultural studies of audience experience.
summary_zh: 以文化研究方法研究电视受众、流媒体观看、电视喜剧以及媒介厌恶与品味。

name: Aaron Greer
title: Professor
summary: Creates feature, documentary, and experimental films and studies race and representation in filmmaking and movie marketing.
summary_zh: 创作剧情片、纪录片与实验电影，并研究电影制作与电影营销中的种族与再现问题。

name: Matthew Hannah
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies online conspiracy movements such as QAnon and extremist beliefs, tracing their rhetorical and epistemological dynamics with historical and digital humanities methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史与数字人文方法研究QAnon等网络阴谋论运动与极端信念，追溯其修辞与认识论机制。

name: Robert Glenn Howard
title: Professor
summary: Studies vernacular expression and authority online, including firearms discourse, algorithms, and AI, using rhetorical, critical cultural, and performance theory.
summary_zh: 运用修辞学、批判文化与表演理论研究网络上的民间表达与民间权威，包括枪支话语、算法与人工智能。

name: Eric Hoyt
title: Professor
summary: Studies film and broadcasting history and the trade press, using data mining and digital humanities tools to build and analyze media history archives.
summary_zh: 研究电影与广播史及行业报刊，运用数据挖掘与数字人文工具建设并分析媒介史档案。

name: Jenell Johnson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the rhetoric of health, medicine, and science, including disability, neuroscience, bioethics, and light pollution, through rhetorical and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 以修辞与历史分析方法研究健康、医学与科学的修辞，涉及残障、神经科学、生命伦理与光污染。

name: Diana Leon-Boys
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies Latinx media, girlhood, and media industries through critical cultural, intersectional, and political economy analysis, including theme park ethnography.
summary_zh: 以批判文化、交叉性与政治经济学分析（包括主题公园民族志）研究拉丁裔媒介、少女文化与媒介产业。

name: Lori Lopez
title: Professor
summary: Studies how Asian Americans engage with media as audiences, producers, and activists, focusing on representation, diaspora media industries, and race and digital media.
summary_zh: 研究亚裔美国人作为受众、生产者与行动者如何参与媒介，关注再现、离散媒介产业以及种族与数字媒介。

name: Marie-Louise Mares
title: Professor
summary: Studies positive and developmental media effects, including prosocial and educational media, family co-use of media, and youth identity development such as LGBTQ identities.
summary_zh: 研究积极与发展性的媒介效果，包括亲社会与教育媒介、家庭共同使用媒介，以及LGBTQ等青少年身份发展。

name: Sara McKinnon
title: Professor
summary: Studies migration, asylum, and foreign policy rhetoric in the Americas, using rhetorical analysis of law and policy alongside qualitative field-based methods.
summary_zh: 结合法律与政策的修辞分析和质性田野方法，研究美洲地区的移民、庇护与外交政策修辞。

name: Darshana Sreedhar Mini
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies South Asian film and media, soft-porn cinema, gender and sexuality, and migrant media through historical and cultural analysis of postcolonial visual cultures.
summary_zh: 以历史与文化分析方法研究南亚电影与媒介、软色情电影、性别与性向以及移民媒介等后殖民视觉文化。

name: Jeremy Morris
title: Professor
summary: Studies how new technologies such as streaming, podcasts, software, and generative AI reshape music and sound industries and everyday cultural production.
summary_zh: 研究流媒体、播客、软件与生成式人工智能等新技术如何重塑音乐与声音产业及日常文化生产。

name: Allison Prasch
title: Nancy Obin Sukenik Professor | Associate Professor
summary: Studies US presidential rhetoric and foreign policy discourse, especially during the Cold War, through rhetorical criticism and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 以修辞批评与历史分析方法研究美国总统修辞与外交政策话语，尤其是冷战时期。

name: Catalina Toma
title: Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies such as online dating, social network sites, and AI shape self-presentation, deception, well-being, and relationships.
summary_zh: 研究在线约会、社交网站与人工智能等传播技术如何影响自我呈现、欺骗、心理健康与人际关系。

name: Lillie Williamson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how racial experiences and health communication shape medical mistrust among Black Americans, testing effects of news about racism on health outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究种族经历与健康传播如何影响美国黑人的医疗不信任，并检验有关种族歧视的新闻对健康结果的影响。

name: Kathleen Bartzen Culver
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor; James E. Burgess Chair in Journalism Ethics; Director, Center for Journalism Ethics
summary: Studies journalism and media ethics, First Amendment and campus free expression, and the ethical implications of emerging technologies like VR, drones, and AI in news.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与媒介伦理、第一修正案与校园言论自由，以及虚拟现实、无人机和人工智能等新技术在新闻中的伦理影响。

name: Chris Cascio
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neurocognitive mechanisms of persuasion and social influence, combining social neuroscience and communication methods to predict behavior change.
summary_zh: 结合社会神经科学与传播学方法，研究说服与社会影响的神经认知机制，以预测行为改变。

name: Ross Dahlke
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies political information exposure and effects on the open web and private messaging apps like WhatsApp and Telegram using computational social science and software tools.
summary_zh: 运用计算社会科学与软件工具，研究开放网络及WhatsApp、Telegram等私密通讯应用中的政治信息接触与效果。

name: Tomás Dodds
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how journalists and news organizations adopt AI and build open-source tools for the public interest, examining newsroom ethics and responsible AI practices.
summary_zh: 考察记者与新闻机构如何采用人工智能并开发服务公共利益的开源工具，关注新闻编辑室伦理与负责任的人工智能实践。

name: Greg Downey
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Evjue-Bascom Professor
summary: Studies the history and geography of information labor, from telegraph messengers to captioning and metadata workers, using historical and geographical methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史与地理方法研究信息劳动的历史与地理，从电报信差到字幕与元数据工作者。

name: Young Mie Kim
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Vilas Distinguished Achievement Professor
summary: Studies digital political campaigns, microtargeting, and disinformation on platforms, using a user-based ad tracking tool to reverse engineer political ad targeting.
summary_zh: 利用基于用户的广告追踪工具逆向分析政治广告投放，研究数字政治竞选、微定向与平台上的虚假信息。

name: Angela Y. Lee
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social media, smartphones, algorithms, and AI affect well-being, designing theory-based interventions with surveys, field experiments, and NLP.
summary_zh: 运用调查、田野实验与自然语言处理，研究社交媒体、智能手机、算法与人工智能如何影响心理健康，并设计理论驱动的干预。

name: Kathryn McGarr
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies twentieth-century US political and journalism history, focusing on gender, foreign policy, and Washington news culture through archival research.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究探讨二十世纪美国政治与新闻史，关注性别、外交政策与华盛顿新闻文化。

name: Douglas McLeod
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Evjue Centennial Professor of Journalism and Mass Communication
summary: Studies news framing and its effects on audiences and public opinion, especially news coverage of social protests and the protest paradigm.
summary_zh: 研究新闻框架及其对受众与舆论的影响，尤其是社会抗议的新闻报道与“抗议范式”。

name: Lindsay Palmer
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Helen Firstbrook Franklin Professor; Director, Graduate Studies
summary: Studies press freedom and human rights media, including war correspondents, local fixers, and press freedom advocacy groups, from a qualitative humanist perspective.
summary_zh: 以质性人文视角研究新闻自由与人权媒介，包括战地记者、当地协调员与新闻自由倡导组织。

name: Karyn Riddle
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Robert Taylor Professor of Strategic Communication; Director, Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies media violence, media enjoyment, and narrative entertainment effects on children, adolescents, and adults, documenting violent content and its audience impact.
summary_zh: 研究媒介暴力、媒介享受与叙事娱乐对儿童、青少年和成人的影响，记录暴力内容及其受众效果。

name: Susan Robinson
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Helen Firstbrook Franklin Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies how journalists and newsrooms build trust with audiences through engagement practices, using applied research and evaluation of newsroom interventions.
summary_zh: 研究记者与新闻编辑室如何通过参与式实践与受众建立信任，采用应用研究并评估新闻编辑室干预。

name: Hernando Rojas
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Helen Firstbrook Franklin Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies political communication, public opinion, and social mobilization via new technologies, examining perceived media influence and democracy across countries.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、舆论以及借助新技术的社会动员，跨国考察受众对媒介影响的感知与民主治理。

name: Dhavan Shah
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: McLeod Professor of Communication Research; Maier-Bascom Chair; Director, MCRC; Research Director, CCCR
summary: Studies political and health communication, linking media effects and framing with computational social science to examine polarization, civic engagement, and health support.
summary_zh: 研究政治与健康传播，将媒介效果与框架研究和计算社会科学相结合，考察极化、公民参与与健康支持。

name: Michael Wagner
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Director, School of Journalism and Mass Communication; William T. Evjue Distinguished Chair for the Wisconsin Idea; Director, CCCR
summary: Studies how people's information environments shape beliefs, policy preferences, and participation, using panel surveys, experiments, content analysis, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用追踪调查、实验、内容分析与访谈，研究人们的信息环境如何塑造其信念、政策偏好与政治参与。

name: Jing Wang
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies global communication, Muslim publics, Chinese diaspora media, feminist knowledge, and podcasts and online forums through anthropological and interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 以人类学与跨学科方法研究全球传播、穆斯林公众、华人离散媒介、女性主义知识以及播客与网络论坛。

name: Miya Williams Fayne
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the digital Black press and Black news audiences using interviews, focus groups, content analysis, and web metrics on news production and consumption.
summary_zh: 运用访谈、焦点小组、内容分析与网站指标，研究数字化黑人报刊与黑人新闻受众的新闻生产与消费。

name: Sijia Yang
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies message effects and persuasion in digital health and science communication using experiments, multimodal content analysis, causal machine learning, and persuasive AI.
summary_zh: 运用实验、多模态内容分析、因果机器学习与说服性人工智能，研究数字健康与科学传播中的信息效果与说服。

name: Scott Althaus
title: Professor
areas: data science methods for extreme-scale analysis of news coverage
the impact of strategic communication activities on news coverage and public opinion
summary: Studies public opinion, popular support for war, and news coverage using extreme-scale data science methods and cross-national comparative research.
summary_zh: 运用超大规模新闻数据科学方法与跨国比较研究，考察舆论、民众对战争的支持以及新闻报道。

name: Joshua Barbour
title: Professor
summary: Studies how organizational actors design communication to navigate laws, regulations, and norms, focusing on automation and the future of data-intensive work.
summary_zh: 研究组织行动者如何设计传播以应对法律、规章与规范等制度结构，关注自动化与数据密集型工作的未来。

name: William C. Barley
title: Director of Graduate Studies, Associate Professor
areas: Field studies of technology design, adoption, and use
summary: Studies how interdisciplinary science teams collaborate across knowledge boundaries and use technologies, drawing primarily on field studies inside organizations.
summary_zh: 主要基于组织内的田野研究，考察跨学科科研团队如何跨越知识边界开展协作并设计和使用技术。

name: Cabral Bigman-Galimore
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication about health, risk, and inequality, examining how messages about comparative risk and disparities shape health behavior and public support.
summary_zh: 研究关于健康、风险与不平等的传播，考察有关比较风险与健康差距的信息如何影响健康行为与公众支持。

name: Elisabeth Bigsby
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies why persuasive health and environmental messages such as anti-smoking campaigns succeed or fail, examining how message features shape perception and processing.
summary_zh: 研究反吸烟等健康与环境说服信息为何成功或失败，考察信息特征如何影响人们的感知与信息加工。

name: John P. Caughlin
title: Head, Professor
areas: interpersonal communication, health & relationships, technology & relationships
summary: Studies how interpersonal communication, including what people avoid saying and how they mix mediated channels, shapes relational and personal well-being and health.
summary_zh: 研究人际传播（包括回避谈论的内容以及多种中介渠道的组合使用）如何影响关系与个人福祉及健康。

name: Josue David Cisneros
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes public rhetoric about race, immigration, borders, and citizenship and rhetorics of resistance in Latina/o social movements using rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评分析关于种族、移民、边界与公民身份的公共修辞，以及拉丁裔社会运动中的抵抗修辞。

name: Stewart Coles
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media and entertainment depictions of social issues and marginalized groups evoke stereotypes, activate identity, and shape public opinion and political behavior.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与娱乐内容对社会议题和边缘群体的呈现如何引发刻板印象、激活身份认同并影响舆论与政治行为。

name: Travis L Dixon
title: David L. Swanson Professor of Communication
areas: media stereotypes, content and effects of traditional/digital media
summary: Studies the prevalence of racial stereotypes in television news, social media, and music and their effects on audiences, combining content analysis with effects research.
summary_zh: 结合内容分析与效果研究，考察电视新闻、社交媒体与音乐中种族刻板印象的普遍程度及其对受众的影响。

name: Cara A. Finnegan
title: Professor
summary: Writes rhetorical histories of photography, examining how photographs were produced, circulated, and received in U.S. public life, including presidential images.
summary_zh: 撰写摄影的修辞史，考察照片在美国公共生活中（包括总统形象）如何被生产、流通与接受。

name: Lisa Guntzviller
title: Professor
summary: Studies identity dilemmas in family and health interactions, such as language brokering and advice in Spanish-speaking families, using dyadic data and a multiple goals framework.
summary_zh: 运用二元数据与多重目标框架，研究家庭与健康互动中的身份困境，如西语家庭中的语言代理与建议提供。

name: Alisa Hardy
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how Black women use digital technologies for resistance and public memory, combining critical-cultural rhetoric, Black feminism, and methods for scraping Black Twitter.
summary_zh: 结合批判文化修辞、黑人女性主义与抓取“黑人推特”的方法，研究黑人女性如何借助数字技术进行抵抗与公共记忆。

name: Minkyung Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how organizations serving vulnerable populations use inter-organizational networks and symbolic and material artifacts to build community resilience and sustainability.
summary_zh: 研究服务弱势群体的组织如何借助组织间网络及象征性与物质性人工物来增强社区韧性与可持续性。

name: Leanne Knobloch
title: Associate Head, Professor
summary: Studies how communication shapes and reflects close relationships during transitions, such as military families after deployment and couples facing depression.
summary_zh: 研究在关系转变期沟通如何塑造并反映亲密关系，如部署归来后的军人家庭以及面对抑郁诊断的伴侣。

name: Michele Koven
title: Professor
areas: The role of culture in verbal interaction
how speakers perform and infer cultural identities in their own and others' talk
style shifting and code switching in discourse
summary: Studies how bilingual speakers in migrant communities enact cultural identities in talk, analyzing narrative discourse, code switching, and Franco-Portuguese language practices.
summary_zh: 分析叙事话语、语码转换与法葡语言实践，研究移民社群中的双语者如何在言谈中展演文化身份。

name: Joshua-Paul Miles
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how nonprofits, agencies, and health and human service organizations collaborate through interorganizational networks, focusing on network governance and effectiveness.
summary_zh: 研究非营利组织、政府机构及健康与人类服务组织如何通过组织间网络开展协作，关注网络治理与网络效能。

name: Isabel Molina-Guzmán
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes how media discourses about ethnoracial, gender, and sexual identity, especially Latina/o representation on television and film, reproduce inequality.
summary_zh: 分析关于族裔、性别与性身份的媒介话语（尤其是电视与电影中的拉丁裔再现）如何再生产不平等。

name: Matea Mustafaj
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how narrative and entertainment media shape social cognition, stereotypes, empathy, and well-being, focusing on character engagement and belief change.
summary_zh: 研究叙事与娱乐媒介如何影响社会认知、刻板印象、共情与心理福祉，关注角色投入与信念改变。

name: Ned O'Gorman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history of rhetoric and 20th-century American political culture, including Cold War image making, Hannah Arendt, and catastrophe imagery, through historical criticism.
summary_zh: 以历史批评方法研究修辞史与20世纪美国政治文化，涉及冷战影像生产、汉娜·阿伦特与灾难影像。

name: Brian L Quick
title: HCOM Director, Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates social marketing and health campaigns, studying cognition and emotion in processing promotional messages in contexts like organ donation and sports injury.
summary_zh: 设计并评估社会营销与健康传播运动，研究器官捐献、运动伤害等情境中人们处理推广信息时的认知与情绪。

name: Charee M. Thompson
title: Professor
areas: uncertainty, stigma, contested illness, identity work
summary: Studies interpersonal and patient-provider communication about uncertain, stigmatized chronic illness and develops communication skills trainings, including virtual reality.
summary_zh: 研究围绕不确定、受污名的慢性疾病的人际与医患沟通，并开发包括虚拟现实在内的沟通技能培训。

name: Emily Van Duyn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people talk about and keep secret their politics in contentious U.S. contexts like rural communities and romantic relationships, using surveys, experiments, interviews, and ethnography.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验、访谈与民族志，研究美国农村社区与恋爱关系等对立情境中人们如何谈论或隐藏政治立场。

name: JungHwan Yang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies computational social science and digital trace data to political communication, studying online toxicity, cross-platform discourse, and hate speech regulation.
summary_zh: 运用计算社会科学与数字痕迹数据研究政治传播，关注网络毒性言论、跨平台话语与仇恨言论监管。

name: Angela Aguayo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how documentary and participatory media mobilize publics for social change, combining rhetorical and cultural analysis with documentary production practice.
summary_zh: 结合修辞与文化分析以及纪录片创作实践，研究纪录片与参与式媒介如何动员公众推动社会变革。

name: Christopher Ball
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people use, experience, and are affected by immersive and interactive media such as virtual reality and video games, with attention to digital inequality and inclusion.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用、体验并受到虚拟现实、电子游戏等沉浸式与交互媒介的影响，关注数字不平等与包容。

name: Jason P. Chambers
title: Professor; Associate Dean for Access and Engagement
summary: Writes histories of African Americans in the advertising industry and the Black consumer market, including Black entrepreneurship in Chicago and biography of Tom Burrell.
summary_zh: 撰写非裔美国人在广告业及黑人消费市场中的历史，包括芝加哥黑人创业史与广告人汤姆·伯勒尔的传记。

name: Amanda Ciafone
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes cultural histories of capitalism and culture industries, such as a multinational history of Coca-Cola, linking political economy, the U.S. in the world, and Latin America.
summary_zh: 撰写资本主义与文化产业的文化史（如可口可乐的跨国史），将政治经济学、世界中的美国与拉丁美洲相联系。

name: CL Cole
title: Professor
summary: Studies sport as culture through critical cultural analysis of gender, corporate nationalism, biopolitics, and the boundaries of American democracy.
summary_zh: 以批判文化分析研究作为文化的体育，关注性别、企业民族主义、生命政治与美国民主的边界。

name: Stephanie Craft
title: Karin and Folke Dovring Professor in Journalism and Democratic Society; Associate Dean for Academic and Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies how news and media literacy are defined and measured and how they reduce susceptibility to misinformation, plus older adults' understanding of AI and journalism ethics.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与媒介素养如何界定和测量、如何降低对虚假信息的易感性，以及老年人对AI的理解与新闻伦理。

name: Melita Garza
title: Associate Professor and Tom and June Netzel Sleeman Scholar in Business Journalism; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies American journalism history, especially English- and Spanish-language news, the immigrant press, and newspaper coverage of Mexicans and immigrants, using historical methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史方法研究美国新闻史，尤其是英语与西语新闻、移民报刊以及报纸对墨西哥人和移民的报道。

name: Alexandre Gonçalves
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of social media in the rise of new social movements and uses computational methods to analyze media ecosystems.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体在新兴社会运动兴起中的作用，并运用计算方法分析媒介生态系统。

name: Chang-Dae Ham
title: Professor
summary: Researches advertising and integrated marketing communication, drawing on prior industry experience in account planning and internet marketing.
summary_zh: 研究广告与整合营销传播，其背景包括客户策划与网络营销的业界经验。

name: James Hay
title: Professor and Interim Head
summary: Studies media from cinema and television to new media and everyday technologies through cultural studies of citizenship, governmentality, and media and space.
summary_zh: 以文化研究视角考察从电影、电视到新媒介及日常技术的各类媒介，关注公民身份、治理术以及媒介与空间。

name: Jacqueline Hitchon
title: Professor
summary: Holds an advertising appointment; the profile lists only education and affiliations, with no description of research focus.
summary_zh: 任职于广告系；简介仅列出教育背景与所属单位，未描述研究方向。

name: Derek Long
title: Associate Professor; Director of Graduate Studies (ICR)
summary: Studies the history of media industries, especially Hollywood film distribution and the studio system, using archival research and digital datasets and tools.
summary_zh: 运用档案研究以及数字数据集与工具，研究媒介产业史，尤其是好莱坞电影发行与制片厂体系。

name: Ewa Maslowska
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how personalization and communication design on digital platforms shape persuasion and disengagement, and how fake reviews mislead consumers, using experiments, eye tracking, and trace data.
summary_zh: 运用实验、眼动与数字痕迹数据，研究数字平台上的个性化与传播设计如何影响说服与脱离，以及虚假评论如何误导消费者。

name: Michelle Nelson
title: Professor and Head
summary: Studies advertising and consumer literacy, including brands in entertainment and children's persuasion knowledge, using longitudinal ethnography with parents and preschoolers.
summary_zh: 研究广告与消费者素养，包括娱乐中的品牌植入与儿童的说服知识，采用针对家长与学龄前儿童的纵向民族志。

name: Margaret Yee Man Ng
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies technology use, social media, and information diffusion, analyzing user behavior, network structures, and content framing with large-scale data and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用大规模数据与计算方法研究技术使用、社交媒体与信息扩散，分析用户行为、嵌入结构与内容框架。

name: Sang-Hwa Oh
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emerging media effects on public health understanding, strategies to mitigate health and risk misinformation, and trust-building strategic communication by brands.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒介对公众健康认知的影响、减轻健康与风险虚假信息的策略，以及品牌建立信任的战略传播。

name: Jenny Oyallon-Koloski
title: Associate Professor; Director, Roger Ebert Center for Film Studies
summary: Studies the history of film style and craft, choreography and movement in the film musical, and Franco-American cinema, using film analysis and videographic criticism.
summary_zh: 运用电影分析与视频论文批评，研究电影风格与技艺史、歌舞片中的编舞与身体运动以及法美电影。

name: Sela Sar
title: Professor
summary: Studies how emotion, mood, and motivation shape responses to advertising, including health and risk ads, using EEG, self-report measures, and affective computational approaches.
summary_zh: 运用脑电（EEG）、自我报告与情感计算方法，研究情绪、心境与动机如何影响人们对广告（包括健康与风险广告）的反应。

name: Leona Yi-Fan Su
title: Associate Professor; Director, Institute of Communications Research
summary: Studies how social media and new technologies shape communication about science, health, and the environment, examining norms, humor, incivility, and engagement with big data and machine learning.
summary_zh: 运用大数据与机器学习，研究社交媒体与新技术如何影响科学、健康与环境传播，考察社会规范、幽默、不文明与互动。

name: Harsh Taneja
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people consume media amid abundant choice, focusing on global internet audiences, digital news consumption, and media metrics.
summary_zh: 研究在选择丰富的环境中人们如何消费媒介，聚焦全球互联网受众、数字新闻消费与媒介测量指标。

name: Cassandra L.C. Troy
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategic environmental and climate change communication, especially solutions-oriented messaging and drivers of collective pro-environmental action, with quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与定性方法研究战略性环境与气候变化传播，尤其是解决方案导向的信息与集体亲环境行动的驱动因素。

name: Julie Turnock
title: Professor
summary: Writes histories of Hollywood special effects and technology, such as Industrial Light and Magic and 1970s blockbuster aesthetics, analyzing films and industry practices.
summary_zh: 撰写好莱坞特效与技术史（如工业光魔与1970年代大片美学），分析电影作品与产业实践。

name: Patrick Vargas
title: Professor
summary: Studies implicit attitudes, stereotyping, prejudice, and mood in social judgment, bridging social psychology with consumer responses to advertising and marketing.
summary_zh: 研究社会判断中的内隐态度、刻板印象、偏见与心境，将社会心理学与消费者对广告和营销的反应相连接。

name: John Wirtz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how conversations before and during ad exposure shape memory, evaluation, and action on ads, and how to make health campaigns more effective and culturally relevant.
summary_zh: 研究观看广告前后及期间的交谈如何影响对广告的记忆、评价与行动，以及如何提升健康运动的有效性与文化相关性。

name: Kevin Wise
title: Professor; Associate Head of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies the psychology of interactive media use through experiments measuring physiological and self-report indicators of cognition, emotion, and motivation.
summary_zh: 通过测量认知、情绪与动机的生理与自我报告指标的实验，研究交互媒介使用背后的心理机制。

name: Guolan Yang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies persuasive communication in social media advertising and influencer marketing, including message appeals like storytelling and humor and responses to sponsorship disclosures.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体广告与网红营销中的说服传播，包括叙事、幽默等信息诉求以及受众对赞助披露的反应。

name: Mike Yao
title: Professor
summary: Studies the social and psychological impacts of interactive digital media, focusing on online privacy boundary management, video games, and social media use.
summary_zh: 研究交互式数字媒介的社会与心理影响，聚焦网络隐私边界管理、电子游戏与社交媒体使用。

name: Akinwumi Adesokan
title: Professor, Cinema and Media Studies, and Department of Comparative Literature; Editor-in-Chief, Black Camera
areas: Intersections of Print and Electronic Media
summary: Studies African cinema, Nollywood, and postcolonial writing to trace how globalization and digital culture reshape the production and circulation of African artistic forms.
summary_zh: 研究非洲电影、瑙莱坞与后殖民写作，探讨全球化与数字文化如何重塑非洲艺术形式的生产与流通。

name: Katina Bitsicas
title: Associate Professor and Director, EcoMedia Lab
summary: Creates video installation, BioArt, and EcoArt works that combine archival, microscopic, and digital imagery to explore grief, memory, and ecological decay.
summary_zh: 以影像装置、生物艺术与生态艺术创作，结合档案、显微与数字影像，探讨哀伤、记忆与生态衰变。

name: Nicholas Browning
title: Associate Professor of Public Relations
summary: Studies public relations ethics, corporate social responsibility and sociopolitical advocacy, and reputation and relationship management through theory-driven strategic communication research.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系伦理、企业社会责任与社会政治倡导，以及声誉与关系管理，开展理论导向的战略传播研究。

name: Ivica Ico Bukvic
title: KIX Lab Director, Professor Media Arts and Production
summary: Builds immersive audio and extended-reality technologies, from networked musical co-creation and data sonification to technology-mediated K-12 experiential learning.
summary_zh: 开发沉浸式音频与扩展现实技术，涵盖远程同步音乐共创、数据可听化以及技术支持的中小学体验式学习。

name: Cara Caddoo
title: Associate Professor, Cinema and Media Studies & Department of History
summary: Uses archival research to study the history of film and moviegoing in Native American and African American life in the nineteenth and twentieth-century United States.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究，考察十九至二十世纪美国原住民与非裔美国人生活中的电影与观影史。

name: Edward Castronova
title: Professor
summary: Studies the economies and markets of video games and social media from an economics perspective, including damages questions in legal cases.
summary_zh: 从经济学视角研究电子游戏与社交媒体的经济与市场，包括法律案件中的损害赔偿问题。

name: Galen Clavio
title: Professor, Director of the National Sports Journalism Center
summary: Studies how new and social media reshape interactions among sports consumers, media, and sports organizations, including fan content creation and sports journalism.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体与社交媒体如何重塑体育消费者、媒体与体育组织之间的互动，包括粉丝内容创作与体育新闻。

name: Ryan Comfort
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies science and environmental communication involving Indigenous peoples, using ethnography and interviews in newsrooms and agencies plus surveys and experiments on audiences.
summary_zh: 研究涉及原住民的科学与环境传播，在新闻机构与政府部门开展民族志与访谈，并以调查和实验研究受众。

name: Stephanie DeBoer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines media screens as infrastructure and environment across transnational and urban geographies, with a focus on inter-Asian, Japanese, and Chinese screen media and video art.
summary_zh: 研究作为基础设施与环境的媒介屏幕在跨国与城市地理中的形态，聚焦亚洲间、日本与中国的屏幕媒介及影像艺术。

name: Suzannah Evans Comfort
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how professional norms and economic pressures shape news production, especially the century-long history of environmental journalism and local news ecosystems in the U.S.
summary_zh: 研究职业规范与经济压力如何塑造新闻生产，尤其是美国环境新闻的百年历史与地方新闻生态。

name: Anthony Fargo
title: Associate Professor, Director Center for International Media Law and Policy Studies
summary: Analyzes media law and policy, especially legal protection of journalists' sources, the right to anonymous speech, and rationales for free expression online and internationally.
summary_zh: 分析媒介法律与政策，尤其是记者消息来源的法律保护、匿名言论权，以及网络与国际语境下言论自由的正当性依据。

name: Julia Fox
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies motivated cognition theories to how audiences process and remember mediated messages, analyzing television news and comedic news as sources of political information.
summary_zh: 运用动机认知理论研究受众如何加工与记忆媒介信息，分析电视新闻与喜剧新闻作为政治信息来源的作用。

name: Mike Gruszczynski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies agenda-setting, framing effects, and journalistic decision-making in political communication, drawing on political psychology and research methodology.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播中的议程设置、框架效果与新闻决策，借鉴政治心理学与研究方法论。

name: Raiford Guins
title: Professor and Director of Cinema and Media Studies, Adjunct Professor in the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
areas: Life Histories of Objects & Material Culture
summary: Studies the material lives of technological artifacts, from design history to video game history and preservation, through archival, museum, and object-centered research.
summary_zh: 以档案、博物馆与物件为中心的研究，考察技术制品的物质生命，涵盖设计史以及电子游戏史与保存。

name: Minjeong Kang
title: Professor, The Ralph Winslow Endowed Professor of The Media School
summary: Studies employee and stakeholder engagement, organizational listening, employee voice and dissent, and public trust in organizations, developing conceptual models of strategic communication.
summary_zh: 研究员工与利益相关者参与、组织倾听、员工发声与异议以及公众对组织的信任，构建战略传播的概念模型。

name: Talalah Khan
title: Assistant Professor of Advertising and Consumer Behavior
summary: Studies luxury marketing and fashion consumer behavior on social media, examining how sustainability, artificial intelligence, and body image shape consumer culture.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上的奢侈品营销与时尚消费行为，考察可持续性、人工智能与身体意象如何塑造消费文化。

name: Gerry Lanosga
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalism practice past and present, including the professionalization of journalism, prize culture, investigative reporting, and freedom of information, using historical and survey research.
summary_zh: 研究新闻实践的历史与现状，包括新闻职业化、新闻奖文化、调查报道与信息自由，采用历史与调查研究方法。

name: Novotny Lawrence
title: Associate Professor and Director of the Black Film Center & Archive
summary: Analyzes Black cinema and popular culture, from Blaxploitation to Black horror, in relation to racial discrimination and resistance in American film history.
summary_zh: 分析从黑人剥削电影到黑人恐怖片的黑人电影与流行文化，探讨美国电影史中的种族歧视与抗争。

name: Taeyoung Lee
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how platform-centric media and technology-driven information ecosystems reshape news engagement, trust in the press, and misinformation's threat to democratic values.
summary_zh: 研究以平台为中心的媒介环境与技术驱动的信息生态如何重塑新闻参与、对新闻界的信任，以及虚假信息对民主价值的威胁。

name: Lisa Lenoir
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses critical-cultural and sociological approaches to examine race, gender, and class in lifestyle and fashion media discourses, activism, and political polarization.
summary_zh: 以批判文化与社会学路径考察生活方式与时尚媒体话语、社会行动与政治极化中的种族、性别与阶级问题。

name: Nicky Lewis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how media choice and exposure shape cognitive and emotional responses in sports and entertainment contexts, and evaluates large-scale opioid and tobacco health campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究体育与娱乐情境中媒介选择与接触如何影响认知与情绪反应，并评估阿片类药物与控烟的大型健康运动。

name: Julien Mailland
title: Professor of Media Law & Management
summary: Studies the history, law, economics, and policy of technology platforms, including a geopolitical and legal history of how Soviet-born Tetris entered Western markets.
summary_zh: 研究技术平台的历史、法律、经济与政策，包括苏联诞生的俄罗斯方块如何进入西方市场的地缘政治与法律史。

name: Lesa Major
title: Associate Dean for Undergraduate Affairs, Associate Professor
summary: Uses framing analysis of health news to study responsibility and blame, public support for health policy, and AIDS messaging for African Americans.
summary_zh: 通过对健康新闻的框架分析，研究责任与归咎、公众对健康政策的支持以及面向非裔美国人的艾滋病信息。

name: Joshua Malitsky
title: Associate Professor, Cinema and Media Studies, Director of the Center for Documentary Research and Practice
summary: Studies the history and theory of documentary and nonfiction film, especially films of revolutionary nation-building in the USSR, Yugoslavia, and Cuba.
summary_zh: 研究纪录片与非虚构电影的历史与理论，尤其是苏联、南斯拉夫与古巴革命时期服务于国家建设的影片。

name: Laura Marciano
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how smartphone and social media use affect adolescent well-being and mental health, combining surveys, smartphone data, wearables, and digital biomarkers.
summary_zh: 研究智能手机与社交媒体使用如何影响青少年幸福感与心理健康，结合问卷、手机数据、可穿戴设备与数字生物标志物。

name: Michael T. Martin
title: Herman B. Wells Endowed Professor (Class of 1948)
areas: Latin, African, and Caribbean postcolonial cinemas
summary: Studies African, Caribbean, Latin American, and Black diasporic cinemas as practices of decolonization, migration, and redress through critical and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 以批判与历史分析研究非洲、加勒比、拉美及黑人离散电影，视其为去殖民化、迁移与补偿正义的实践。

name: Nicole Martins
title: Professor and unit director for Communication Science
summary: Studies the social and psychological effects of media on youth, including relationally aggressive portrayals, media violence, and children's self-esteem and body image.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对青少年的社会与心理影响，包括关系攻击描绘、媒介暴力以及儿童自尊与身体意象。

name: Eric McEver
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Writes and directs narrative feature films in English and Japanese that blend live action, tokusatsu effects, and animation.
summary_zh: 以英语和日语编导叙事长片，融合真人表演、特摄效果与动画。

name: Radhika Parameswaran
title: Herman B Wells Endowed Professor (Class of 1950)
summary: Studies gender, globalization, and postcolonial media in South Asia from a feminist cultural studies perspective, using qualitative and audience research methods.
summary_zh: 从女性主义文化研究视角研究南亚的性别、全球化与后殖民媒介，采用质性与受众研究方法。

name: Jason Peifer
title: Associate Dean of Graduate Affairs, Research, & Creative Activity
summary: Studies citizens' trust in and uncertainty about journalism and public institutions, including journalistic transparency, satirical news, and cross-national perceptions of news value.
summary_zh: 研究公民对新闻业与公共机构的信任与不确定感，包括新闻透明度、讽刺新闻以及跨国的新闻价值认知。

name: Rachel Plotnick
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history and culture of media technologies in everyday life, especially interfaces like buttons and screens, wearables, and body-technology relationships.
summary_zh: 研究媒介技术在日常生活中的历史与文化，尤其是按钮、屏幕等界面、可穿戴设备以及身体与技术的关系。

name: Ryan Powell
title: Associate Professor, Cinema and Media Studies
summary: Studies film historiography of queer and gay male life, independent and underground cinema, film exhibition and counterpublics, and cinematic sound.
summary_zh: 研究酷儿与男同性恋生活的电影史学、独立与地下电影、电影放映与反公众以及电影声音。

name: Melanie Sarge
title: Associate Professor and Director of Research & Creative Activity
summary: Works in advertising and strategic communication; the profile describes professional background rather than specific research topics.
summary_zh: 从事广告与战略传播领域工作；简介主要介绍职业背景，未说明具体研究主题。

name: Harmeet Sawhney
title: Professor
summary: Theorizes information and communication technologies, especially universal access, network development, and how metaphors and values shape our imagination of the Internet.
summary_zh: 对信息与传播技术进行理论化研究，尤其关注普遍接入、网络发展，以及隐喻与价值观如何塑造人们对互联网的想象。

name: James Shanahan
title: Professor
summary: Studies cultivation, cultural indicators, and media effects on public opinion, focusing on science and environmental communication, including LLM-assisted content analysis of climate news.
summary_zh: 研究涵化理论、文化指标及媒介对舆论的影响，聚焦科学与环境传播，包括以大语言模型辅助分析气候新闻内容。

name: Esi Thompson Tani-Eshon
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health risk and crisis communication around Ebola, COVID-19, and malaria vaccines in Ghana and Liberia, using qualitative methods and cross-national survey comparisons.
summary_zh: 研究加纳与利比里亚围绕埃博拉、新冠与疟疾疫苗的健康风险与危机传播，采用质性方法与跨国调查比较。

name: David Tolchinsky
title: Dean and Professor
summary: Creates films, plays, and sound works exploring mental illness, memory, trauma, and adolescence, spanning screenwriting, scoring, and media production.
summary_zh: 创作电影、戏剧与声音作品，探讨精神疾病、记忆、创伤与青少年，涵盖编剧、配乐与媒介制作。

name: Debra Tolchinsky
title: Professor
summary: Makes documentary and multimedia work examining false memory and contaminated beliefs in the criminal justice system and documentary's own role in shaping memory.
summary_zh: 创作纪录片与多媒体作品，探讨刑事司法系统中的虚假记忆与被污染的信念，以及纪录片本身如何影响记忆。

name: John Velez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the interpersonal, mental well-being, and learning benefits of video games and interactive media from a media psychology perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介心理学视角研究电子游戏与互动媒介在人际关系、心理健康与学习方面的益处。

name: Brandon Wallace
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Critically examines how power and ideology operate through sport and sports media, studying social movements such as Know Your Rights Camp through collaborative case research.
summary_zh: 批判性考察权力与意识形态如何通过体育与体育媒体运作，通过合作式个案研究考察“了解你的权利营”等社会运动。

name: Andrew Weaver
title: Associate Dean of Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies why people consume violent and morally charged media and how it affects them, using meta-analysis, psychophysiology, self-report, and content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人们为何消费暴力与道德相关的媒介内容及其影响，采用元分析、心理生理测量、自我报告与内容分析。

name: Paul Wright
title: Editor, Annals of the International Communication Association; Professor of Communication Science
summary: Studies health communication and media effects from a media psychology and audience-analysis perspective, with federally and privately funded research programs.
summary_zh: 从媒介心理学与受众分析视角研究健康传播与媒介效果，研究项目获联邦与私人资助。

name: Nan Zhang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human-AI interaction and AI-mediated communication in advertising, examining responses to generative AI and LLMs with experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究广告中的人机交互与人工智能中介传播，以实验与计算方法考察人们对生成式AI与大语言模型的反应。

name: Hector Amaya
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how globalization, violence and new media technologies reshape citizenship and publicness, through critical analysis of Latinx and Latin American media, immigration and narcoculture.
summary_zh: 通过对拉美裔与拉丁美洲媒体、移民及毒品文化的批判分析，研究全球化、暴力与新媒体技术如何重塑公民身份与公共性。

name: Mike Ananny
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication and Journalism
summary: Traces how journalism's sociotechnical systems, platforms, algorithms and AI shape public life, combining science and technology studies with normative theory of press freedom.
summary_zh: 结合科学技术研究与新闻自由的规范理论，追踪新闻业的社会技术系统、平台、算法与人工智能如何塑造公共生活。

name: Jonathan Aronson
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Analyzes international communication policy, global governance of digital disruption and telecommunications trade negotiations from a political-economy perspective.
summary_zh: 从政治经济学视角分析国际传播政策、数字颠覆的全球治理以及电信贸易谈判。

name: François Bar
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication and Spatial Sciences
summary: Studies the social and economic impacts of information technologies, telecom policy and technology appropriation via participatory co-design and community partnerships, from Skid Row to East Africa.
summary_zh: 通过参与式协同设计与社区合作（从洛杉矶贫民区到东非），探讨信息技术的社会经济影响、电信政策与技术挪用。

name: Ben Carrington
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism and Sociology
summary: Examines how ideologies of race, gender, class and nationalism are reproduced and resisted through sport and mass media in postcolonial societies, using critical cultural sociology.
summary_zh: 运用批判文化社会学，考察种族、性别、阶级与民族主义意识形态如何通过体育与大众媒体在后殖民社会中被再生产与抵抗。

name: Manuel Castells
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: University Professor; Wallis Annenberg Chair in Communication Technology and Society; Professor of Communication, Sociology, Planning, and International Relations
summary: Theorizes the network society, globalization and internet-era politics, with recent books on the crisis of liberal democracy, Europe's crises and the new Latin America.
summary_zh: 对网络社会、全球化与互联网时代的政治进行理论建构，近著涉及自由民主的危机、欧洲危机与新拉丁美洲。

name: Geoffrey Cowan
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: University Professor of Communication; Annenberg Family Chair in Communication Leadership
summary: Writes histories of American politics, law and media, from the birth of the presidential primary to battles over sex and violence on television, and leads communication leadership and policy programs.
summary_zh: 撰写美国政治、法律与媒体的历史著作，从总统初选的诞生到电视性与暴力之争，并主持传播领导力与政策项目。

name: David Craig
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies global and Chinese creator industries, social media entertainment and streaming platforms through political economy, production and creator studies.
summary_zh: 通过政治经济学、生产研究与创作者研究，探讨全球与中国的创作者产业、社交媒体娱乐及流媒体平台。

name: Nicholas Cull
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies public diplomacy and the historical role of mass communication in foreign policy as a historian, and advises foreign ministries on cultural diplomacy.
summary_zh: 以历史学视角研究公共外交以及大众传播在外交政策中的历史作用，并为各国外交部提供文化外交咨询。

name: Christina Dunbar-Hester
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Conducts interpretive ethnographies of the politics of technology, from activism in open technology and FM radio communities to toxic infrastructure in the ports of Los Angeles.
summary_zh: 对技术政治开展阐释性民族志研究，从开源技术与调频广播社群的行动主义到洛杉矶港口的有毒基础设施。

name: Emilio Ferrara
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Computer Science and Communication
summary: Develops network science and machine learning methods to study socio-technical systems, online social networks, collaboration and crowds, and their effects on human behavior and society.
summary_zh: 发展网络科学与机器学习方法，研究社会技术系统、在线社交网络、协作与群体，及其对人类行为与社会的影响。

name: Robeson Taj Frazier
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Explores Black and Afro-diasporic political and popular cultures through intellectual history and media analysis, from Cold War China in the Black radical imagination to Los Angeles community arts.
summary_zh: 通过思想史与媒介分析探讨黑人及非裔离散的政治文化与流行文化，从冷战时期中国在黑人激进想象中的位置到洛杉矶社区艺术。

name: Hernan Galperin
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Uses surveys, field experiments and other quantitative methods to study Internet policy, broadband adoption and digital inequality, including links between connectivity and poverty in Latin America.
summary_zh: 运用调查、田野实验等量化方法研究互联网政策、宽带采纳与数字不平等，包括拉丁美洲连通性与贫困之间的关联。

name: Jean Guerrero
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism
summary: Reports and writes on U.S. Latinos, immigration, borders and the politics of belonging through investigative journalism, opinion commentary and narrative nonfiction.
summary_zh: 通过调查报道、评论写作与叙事非虚构作品，关注美国拉美裔、移民、边境与归属政治。

name: Afua Hirsch
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Investigates discourses of race, identity and politics across Europe, Africa and America as a journalist, columnist, author and documentary producer.
summary_zh: 以记者、专栏作家、作者与纪录片制作人的身份，考察欧洲、非洲与美洲有关种族、身份与政治的话语。

name: Thomas Hollihan
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Analyzes argumentation, political campaign communication, media diplomacy and how media narratives shape public opinion in international disputes, using rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评分析论辩、竞选传播、媒体外交，以及媒体叙事如何在国际争端中塑造舆论。

name: Andrea Hollingshead
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how groups share expertise and knowledge and how group communication relates to performance and wellbeing in work, online and hybrid teams, including incivility and human-machine teaming.
summary_zh: 研究群体如何分享专长与知识，以及群体传播如何影响工作、线上与混合团队的绩效与福祉，包括网络不文明行为与人机协作。

name: Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Assistant Professor of Computational Communication Science & Artificial Intelligence and of Computer Science
summary: Studies human-AI interaction and how AI reshapes work in teamwork, content production and mental healthcare, using behavioral experiments, computational content analysis and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究人机交互以及人工智能如何重塑团队协作、内容生产与心理健康服务中的工作实践，综合行为实验、计算内容分析与质性方法。

name: Henry Jenkins
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Provost Professor of Communication, Journalism, Cinematic Arts and Education
summary: Studies participatory culture, fandom and civic media, examining how everyday people learn, create and advocate through popular culture using cultural analysis and case studies.
summary_zh: 研究参与式文化、粉丝与公民媒体，通过文化分析与个案研究考察普通人如何借助流行文化学习、创作与倡导。

name: Eunjin (Anna) Kim
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses quantitative methods to study how storytelling, influencers and AI-driven platforms shape audience responses to advertising, branding and prosocial messaging.
summary_zh: 运用量化方法研究叙事、网红与人工智能驱动的平台如何影响受众对广告、品牌与亲社会信息的反应。

name: Jonathan Kotler
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism
summary: Teaches and practices media law, media history and media ethics, drawing on decades of representing media clients in the American courts.
summary_zh: 教授并从事媒体法、媒体史与媒体伦理，拥有数十年在美国法院代理媒体客户的经验。

name: Robert Kozinets
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Develops netnography and other qualitative social media methods to understand digital culture, influencers, branding and consumer communities for marketing and communication research.
summary_zh: 发展网络民族志等质性社交媒体研究方法，为营销与传播研究理解数字文化、网红、品牌与消费者社群。

name: Josh Kun
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor and Chair in Cross-Cultural Communication
summary: Works as a cultural historian, critic and curator on popular music, archives, global migration and Los Angeles, producing books, exhibitions and public humanities projects.
summary_zh: 作为文化史学者、评论家与策展人，围绕流行音乐、档案、全球移民与洛杉矶开展研究，产出书籍、展览与公共人文项目。

name: Lynn Miller
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Develops and tests game-based, intelligent-agent and virtual-environment interventions to reduce health risks such as HIV, using experiments, computational modeling and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 开发并检验基于游戏、智能体与虚拟环境的健康风险干预（如艾滋病预防），运用实验、计算建模与神经科学方法。

name: Sheila Murphy
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how narratives and entertainment-education change health-related beliefs and behaviors, using experiments on identification and transportation plus community-based campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究叙事与娱乐教育如何改变健康相关的信念与行为，采用关于角色认同与叙事沉浸的实验以及社区健康运动。

name: Jennifer Petersen
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Traces how media technologies, from silent film to code and AI, reshape legal understandings of speech and personhood, using historical and textual analysis of law, media coverage and public feeling.
summary_zh: 追溯从默片到代码与人工智能的媒介技术如何重塑法律对言论与人格的理解，对法律文本、媒体报道与公共情感进行历史与文本分析。

name: Caitlin Petre
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Uses ethnography and other qualitative methods to study how data analytics, metrics and algorithms transform journalism, creative labor and power in media industries.
summary_zh: 运用民族志等质性方法研究数据分析、指标与算法如何改变新闻业、创意劳动以及媒体产业中的权力关系。

name: Allissa Richardson
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism and Communication
summary: Studies how African Americans and other marginalized communities use smartphones and social media to produce protest journalism in times of crisis, through interviews and archival work on Black media.
summary_zh: 通过访谈与黑人媒体档案工作，研究非裔美国人等边缘群体如何在危机时刻利用智能手机与社交媒体生产抗议新闻。

name: Patricia Riley
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies organizational communication, institutional politics and culture change, including how communication infrastructure and information technologies shape knowledge management and transformation.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播、制度政治与文化变革，包括传播基础设施与信息技术如何影响知识管理与组织转型。

name: Joe Saltzman
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Journalism and Communication
summary: Documents and analyzes the image of the journalist in film, television and popular culture, building the IJPC database and historical studies from silent film to Hallmark movies.
summary_zh: 记录并分析电影、电视与流行文化中的记者形象，建设IJPC数据库并开展从默片到Hallmark电影的历史研究。

name: Stacy Smith
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Runs large-scale content analyses of top-grossing films, television and popular music to document inequality by gender, race, LGBTQ+ status and disability in Hollywood and drive industry change.
summary_zh: 对高票房电影、电视与流行音乐进行大规模内容分析，记录好莱坞在性别、种族、LGBTQ+与残障方面的不平等，并推动产业变革。

name: Robin Stevens
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Combines digital epidemiology of social media data with community-engaged research to understand and improve sexual, mental and substance-use health among Black and Latinx youth in the US.
summary_zh: 将社交媒体数据的数字流行病学与社区参与式研究相结合，理解并改善美国黑人与拉美裔青少年的性健康、心理健康与物质使用问题。

name: Douglas Thomas
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Examines the intersection of technology and culture, from hacker subcultures and cybercrime to video game culture and how games transform learning and education.
summary_zh: 考察技术与文化的交汇，从黑客亚文化与网络犯罪到电子游戏文化，以及游戏如何改变学习与教育。

name: Sandy Tolan
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Produces long-form narrative journalism, books, radio documentaries and podcasts on land conflicts, identity, natural resources and the global economy, reporting from dozens of countries.
summary_zh: 制作长篇叙事新闻、书籍、广播纪录片与播客，关注土地冲突、身份认同、自然资源与全球经济，报道足迹遍及数十个国家。

name: Marlon Twyman II
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Uses social network analysis and computational methods to study how teams, online communities and organizations form and collaborate on digital platforms.
summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与计算方法，研究团队、在线社群与组织如何在数字平台上形成并协作。

name: Cristina Visperas
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies the cultural politics of science and medicine at the intersection of race and state violence, through critical and historical analysis of visual culture such as postwar US prison experiments.
summary_zh: 研究科学与医学的文化政治在种族与国家暴力交汇处的运作，对战后美国监狱实验等视觉文化进行批判与历史分析。

name: Jay Wang
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism; Director of the Master of Public Diplomacy (MPD) program
summary: Studies strategic communication and public diplomacy in a globalizing world, including nation branding, soft power, digital advocacy and the evaluation of public diplomacy programs.
summary_zh: 研究全球化背景下的战略传播与公共外交，包括国家品牌、软实力、数字倡导以及公共外交项目的评估。

name: Dmitri Williams
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Communication
