summary: Studies the social and economic impacts of games and online communities, including social value and influence, using experiments, longitudinal surveys, machine learning and content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究游戏与在线社群的社会经济影响（包括社会价值与影响力），运用实验、追踪调查、机器学习与内容分析。

name: Diane Winston
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Professor of Journalism and Communication; Knight Center Chair in Media and Religion
summary: Studies religion's entanglement with news and entertainment media in American history and politics, using historical and textual analysis of television, press coverage and presidential media strategy.
summary_zh: 研究宗教与新闻及娱乐媒体在美国历史与政治中的纠缠，对电视、新闻报道与总统媒体策略进行历史与文本分析。

name: Aimei Yang
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Journalism
summary: Applies social network analysis to strategic communication, studying how NGOs, corporations and governments form issue-advocacy alliances, transnational civil networks and public diplomacy ties.
summary_zh: 将社会网络分析应用于战略传播，研究非政府组织、企业与政府如何形成议题倡导联盟、跨国公民社会网络与公共外交关系。

name: Lindsay Young
dept: Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Combines social network analysis and computational methods with a critical lens to understand and address health inequities in sexual, gender and racial minority communities.
summary_zh: 将社会网络分析与计算方法同批判视角相结合，理解并应对性少数、性别少数及种族少数社群中的健康不平等，并设计基于网络的干预。

name: Dolores Albarracín
title: Amy Gutmann Penn Integrates Knowledge University Professor
summary: Studies how communication and persuasion shape attitudes, beliefs, and behavior, and designs interventions that promote health, science understanding, and beneficial policy.
summary_zh: 研究传播与说服如何塑造态度、信念与行为，并设计促进健康、科学理解和有益公共政策的干预措施。

name: Sarah Banet-Weiser
title: Walter H. Annenberg Dean; Lauren Berlant Professor of Communication
summary: Critically analyzes gender, race, and consumer culture in popular media, examining popular feminism and misogyny, brand culture, and the politics of believability.
summary_zh: 以批判视角分析流行媒介中的性别、种族与消费文化，考察流行女性主义与厌女、品牌文化以及“可信度”政治。

name: Damon Centola
title: Elihu Katz Professor of Communication, Sociology, and Engineering
summary: Studies how behaviors and innovations spread through social networks, using network analysis and agent-based modeling to explain collective intelligence and behavior change.
summary_zh: 研究行为与创新如何在社会网络中扩散，运用网络分析和基于主体的建模解释集体智慧与行为改变。

name: Emily Falk
title: Professor of Communication, Psychology, Marketing, and OID (Operations, Information, and Decisions)
summary: Uses neuroscience and psychology to study what makes messages persuasive, how ideas spread, and how communication can drive health and climate behavior change.
summary_zh: 运用神经科学与心理学方法研究信息何以具有说服力、观念如何传播，以及传播如何推动健康与气候相关的行为改变。

name: Deen Freelon
title: Presidential Professor
summary: Studies digital politics and the politics of race, gender, and ideology on social media, using computational methods and building open-source research software.
summary_zh: 研究数字政治以及社交媒体中种族、性别与意识形态的政治，运用计算方法并开发开源研究软件。

name: Sandra González-Bailón
title: Carolyn Marvin Professor of Communication and Sociology (Secondary Appointment)
summary: Studies how online communication networks and algorithmic curation shape exposure to news and political information, using network analysis and computational social science.
summary_zh: 研究在线传播网络与算法推荐如何塑造人们对新闻和政治信息的接触，采用网络分析与计算社会科学方法。

name: Amy Gutmann
title: Christopher H. Browne Distinguished Professor of Political Science, School of Arts and Sciences and Professor of Communication, Annenberg School for Communication
summary: Develops political theory on democracy, deliberation, and compromise, with work on democratic education, bioethics, identity politics, and ethics in public affairs.
summary_zh: 从政治理论角度研究民主、协商与妥协，涉及民主教育、生命伦理、身份政治与公共事务伦理。

name: John L. Jackson, Jr.
title: Penn Provost; Richard Perry University Professor
summary: Combines ethnography and filmmaking to study race, visual culture, Black religious media, and diasporic religious communities.
summary_zh: 结合民族志与影像创作，研究种族、视觉文化、黑人宗教媒体以及离散宗教社群。

name: Sarah J. Jackson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how Black, feminist, and activist publics use and are represented in media, journalism, and digital networks, from hashtag activism to histories of Black mediamakers.
summary_zh: 研究黑人、女性主义与社会运动群体如何使用媒介、新闻与数字网络并在其中被再现，涵盖标签行动主义与黑人媒体创作者的历史。

name: Kathleen Hall Jamieson
title: Elizabeth Ware Packard Professor of Communication
summary: Uses rhetorical analysis, surveys, and experiments to study campaign communication, the science of science communication, and ways to counter misinformation and conspiracy theories.
summary_zh: 运用修辞分析、调查与实验研究竞选传播、科学传播的科学，以及应对虚假信息与阴谋论的方法。

name: John B. Jemmott III
title: Kenneth B. Clark Professor of Communication and Psychiatry
summary: Develops and tests theory-based health behavior change interventions that reduce sexual risk behavior and health disparities among underserved populations.
summary_zh: 开发并检验基于理论的健康行为改变干预，以减少弱势人群的性风险行为和健康差距。

name: Yphtach Lelkes
title: Michael X. Delli Carpini Professor of Communication
summary: Studies affective polarization, political belief systems, and how changes in the information environment shape political attitudes, using surveys, experiments, and quasi-experiments.
summary_zh: 研究情感极化、政治信念体系以及信息环境变化如何影响政治态度，运用调查、实验与准实验方法。

name: Matthew Levendusky
title: Professor of Communication and Political Science
summary: Studies public opinion and the causes and consequences of political polarization in the U.S., including partisan media effects and ways to bridge the partisan divide.
summary_zh: 研究美国的公众舆论以及政治极化的成因与后果，包括党派媒体的影响和弥合党派分歧的途径。

name: Jessa Lingel
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Uses qualitative and interpretive methods to study digital culture, how marginalized groups appropriate technology, the politics of infrastructure, and technological activism.
summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释方法研究数字文化、边缘群体如何挪用技术、基础设施的政治以及技术行动主义。

name: Juan Llamas-Rodriguez
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Critically analyzes borders, migration, and Latin American and Latinx digital and screen media, drawing on media theory, infrastructure studies, and film and television analysis.
summary_zh: 运用媒介理论、基础设施研究与影视分析，批判性地考察边境、移民以及拉丁美洲和拉美裔的数字与影视媒介。

name: David Lydon-Staley
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies daily fluctuations in brain, behavior, and media environments to understand curiosity, emotion dynamics, and substance use, using fMRI, experience sampling, and network analysis.
summary_zh: 研究大脑、行为与媒介环境的日常波动，以理解好奇心、情绪动态和物质使用，采用功能磁共振、经验取样与网络分析方法。

name: Diana C. Mutz
title: Samuel A. Stouffer Professor of Political Science and Communication
summary: Studies political communication, political psychology, and how the American mass public forms opinions on issues, candidates, and globalization.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、政治心理学，以及美国大众如何就议题、候选人和全球化形成观点。

name: Desmond Upton Patton
title: Penn Integrates Knowledge (PIK) University Professor and Waldo E. Johnson, Jr. Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how social media relates to violence, trauma, grief, and mental health among youth of color, combining data science, qualitative methods, and community partnerships.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与有色人种青少年的暴力、创伤、哀伤和心理健康之间的关系，结合数据科学、质性方法与社区合作。

name: Victor Pickard
title: C. Edwin Baker Professor of Media Policy and Political Economy
summary: Studies media policy, political economy, media history, and journalism's democratic role, using historical and policy analysis of media reform and internet governance.
summary_zh: 研究媒介政策、政治经济学、媒介史以及新闻业的民主角色，以历史与政策分析考察媒介改革与互联网治理。

name: Aswin Punathambekar
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Takes cultural and historical approaches to media industries, audiences, and identity politics in South Asia and the South Asian diaspora in the U.S. and U.K.
summary_zh: 以文化与历史路径研究南亚及其在英美的离散社群中的媒介产业、受众与身份政治。

name: Andy Tan
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies marketing, media, and message effects on tobacco and cancer disparities, designing culturally tailored interventions with LGBT and underserved communities through mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究营销、媒体与信息效果对烟草和癌症健康差距的影响，通过混合方法与LGBT及弱势社群共同设计文化适配的干预。

name: Julia Ticona
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Uses qualitative methods to examine how phones, platforms, and management systems shape precarious low-wage work and inequalities of gender, race, and class.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法考察手机、平台与管理系统如何塑造不稳定的低薪劳动以及性别、种族和阶级不平等。

name: Duncan J. Watts
title: Stevens University Professor
summary: Uses web-based experiments and large-scale digital data to study social and organizational networks, collective dynamics, and the production and consumption of news.
summary_zh: 运用网络实验与大规模数字数据研究社会与组织网络、集体动态以及新闻的生产与消费。

name: Guobin Yang
title: Grace Lee Boggs Professor of Communication and Sociology
summary: Takes historical and cultural approaches to social movements, digital activism, and the politics of emotion and storytelling, with a focus on contemporary China.
summary_zh: 以历史与文化路径研究社会运动、数字行动主义以及情感与叙事的政治，聚焦当代中国。

name: Tamara Afifi
title: Distinguished Professor, and Department Chair
summary: Studies how family members and partners communicate under stress and how it shapes relational, mental, and physiological health, using surveys, diaries, lab interactions, and biomarkers.
summary_zh: 研究家庭成员与伴侣在压力下如何沟通及其对关系、心理和生理健康的影响，结合家庭问卷、日记、实验室互动与生物标志物等方法。

name: Walid Afifi
title: Professor, Associate Dean and Director of Initiatives for Community Engaged Research and Pedagogy, Division of Social Sciences
summary: Studies how uncertainty drives information seeking and decision-making, developing the Theory of Motivated Information Management and a Chronic Uncertainty Framework for immigrant communities.
summary_zh: 研究不确定性如何驱动信息寻求与决策，提出动机性信息管理理论，并针对移民社区发展慢性不确定性框架。

name: Norah Dunbar
title: Professor
summary: Studies credibility and deception detection, examining how dominance, nonverbal synchrony, and power shape impressions and persuasion in interpersonal and mediated interaction.
summary_zh: 研究可信度与欺骗识别，考察支配性、非言语同步和权力如何影响人际与中介互动中的印象形成与说服。

name: Jennifer Gibbs
title: Professor
summary: Studies collaboration in global, remote, and hybrid teams and how digital media and AI transform organizing, using field-based qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究全球化、远程与混合办公团队中的协作，以及数字媒体与人工智能如何改变组织过程，采用基于田野的定性与定量方法。

name: Amy Gonzales
title: Associate Professor, Associate Director Chicano Studies Institute
summary: Studies the digital divide, especially disruptions in device access, and how technology-mediated social support affects identity and well-being among disadvantaged communities.
summary_zh: 研究数字鸿沟（尤其是设备接入的短期中断），以及技术中介的社会支持如何影响弱势群体的身份认同与福祉。

name: Kristy Hamilton
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses experiments to study human memory, cognition, and metacognitive monitoring and control when people think with digital technologies.
summary_zh: 运用实验方法研究人们借助数字技术思考时的记忆、认知以及元认知监控与控制过程。

name: Jennifer Kam
title: Professor and Department Vice Chair
summary: Examines how structurally rooted stressors affect the health and well-being of immigrant youth and families and what promotes thriving, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与定性方法，研究源于结构性障碍的压力源如何影响移民青少年及其家庭的健康与福祉，以及促进其成长的因素。

name: Young Ji Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies team collaboration, examining how diversity, communication processes, and human-machine teaming shape collective intelligence and team performance, including neurodiversity at work.
summary_zh: 研究团队协作，考察多样性、沟通过程与人机协作如何影响集体智能和团队绩效，并关注职场神经多样性。

name: Dan Lane
title: Associate Professor & Grad Director
summary: Studies how political expression on social media can stimulate political engagement, improve intergroup relations, and reduce political inequality.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上的政治表达如何促进政治参与、改善群际关系并减少政治不平等。

name: Jiaying Liu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health message effects and risky health decisions such as youth vaping, using surveys, online and eye-tracking experiments, computational text analysis, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究健康信息效果与青少年电子烟等风险健康决策，结合全国性调查、在线与眼动实验、计算文本分析和神经影像方法。

name: Guadalupe (Lupita) Madrigal
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how identity, race, and information shape U.S. political processes, focusing on Latinx populations, immigration, and news portrayals of immigrant children.
summary_zh: 研究身份、种族与信息如何影响美国政治过程，聚焦拉丁裔群体、移民议题及新闻对移民儿童的呈现。

name: Dana Mastro
title: Professor & Vice Provost for Academic Affairs
summary: Documents how social groups are represented across media and tests how exposure to these portrayals affects users' cognitions, emotions, behaviors, and intergroup dynamics.
summary_zh: 记录不同社会群体在媒体中的呈现方式，并检验接触这些呈现如何影响受众的认知、情绪、行为与群际关系。

name: Andy Merolla
title: Professor
summary: Studies how everyday interpersonal communication relates to well-being, connection, forgiveness, and hope, using experience sampling of daily social interaction.
summary_zh: 研究日常人际沟通如何与福祉、联结感、宽恕和希望相关联，采用经验取样法追踪日常社交互动。

name: Miriam Metzger
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people judge the credibility of online information and make privacy decisions in digital environments, using quantitative social science methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量社会科学方法，研究人们如何判断网络信息的可信度以及如何在数字环境中做出隐私决策。

name: Karen Myers
title: Professor, Affliate in the Technology Management Department
summary: Studies the communicative constitution of organizations and workplace interaction, including newcomer socialization, emotion management, work-life balance, and organizational identification.
summary_zh: 研究组织的传播构成与职场互动，包括新员工社会化、情绪管理、工作与生活平衡以及组织认同。

name: Robin Nabi
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of emotion in media processes and effects, focusing on emotional persuasive messages and how media use relates to stress, coping, and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究情绪在媒体过程与效果中的作用，聚焦情绪化说服信息以及媒体使用与压力、应对和福祉的关系。

name: Prateekshit "Kanu" Pandey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how political humor and satire affect democratic participation and news sharing in the U.S. and South Asia, using survey experiments, network analysis, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究政治幽默与讽刺如何影响美国和南亚的民主参与与新闻分享，采用调查实验、网络分析和神经影像方法。

name: Casey Randazzo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communities and AI agents organize collective action in disaster response and recovery, using network analysis, generative agent-based modeling, and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究社区与人工智能代理如何在灾害应对与恢复中组织集体行动，采用网络分析、生成式智能体建模和话语分析。

name: Scott Reid
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in group processes and intergroup relations through social identity and evolutionary theories, such as voice pitch shifts as honest signals of aggression.
summary_zh: 从社会认同与进化理论视角研究群体过程与群际关系中的沟通，例如音调变化作为攻击意图的诚实信号。

name: Ronald E. Rice
title: Distinguished Professor, Arthur N. Rupe Endowed Professor in the Social Effects of Mass Communication, Affliate in the Technology Management Department
summary: Studies the social uses and effects of new media, organizational communication, environmental and public communication campaigns, and social networks, including bibliometric methods.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体的社会使用与影响、组织传播、环境与公共传播运动以及社会网络，并运用文献计量方法。

name: Muniba Saleem
title: Professor
summary: Studies how media portrayals affect intergroup relations among racial, ethnic, and religious groups and how minorities use and cope with media, applying social psychological theory.
summary_zh: 运用社会心理学理论，研究媒体呈现如何影响种族、族裔与宗教群体间的关系，以及少数族裔如何使用和应对媒体环境。

name: Shaunak Sastry
title: Professor
summary: Studies global health communication through culture-centered, community-partnered interventions, addressing pandemic governance and the health impacts of climate change.
summary_zh: 以文化中心路径和社区合作干预研究全球健康传播，关注疫情治理及气候变化对健康的影响。

name: Joe Walther
title: Distinguished Professor, Bertelsen Presidential Chair in Technology and Society
summary: Develops theories of computer-mediated communication and tests how interpersonal and intergroup dynamics shape attitudes, relationships, and online hate in mediated interaction.
summary_zh: 构建计算机中介传播理论，并检验人际与群际动力如何在中介互动中影响态度、关系与网络仇恨。

name: René Weber
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of responses to media narratives, including moral conflict, persuasion, media violence, and flow, and analyzes moral narratives in news and entertainment.
summary_zh: 研究受众对媒介叙事反应的神经机制，包括道德冲突、说服、媒体暴力和心流体验，并分析新闻与娱乐中的道德叙事。

name: Alenda Y. Chang
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Merges ecocritical theory with analysis of contemporary media, developing ecological frameworks for understanding and designing video games.
summary_zh: 将生态批评理论与当代媒介分析相结合，为理解和设计电子游戏发展生态学框架。

name: Althea Wasow
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies silent cinema and precinematic visual culture, analyzing the entanglement of police power and motion pictures through historical research, Black studies, and essay filmmaking.
summary_zh: 研究默片与前电影视觉文化，结合历史研究、黑人研究与散文电影创作，分析警察权力与电影之间的纠缠。

name: Bhaskar Sarkar
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies global and Indian media through critical cultural analysis, examining piracy and informal media of the global South, populism, risk and securitization, and queer subcultures.
summary_zh: 以批判文化分析研究全球与印度媒介，考察全球南方的盗版与非正式媒介、民粹主义、风险与安全化以及酷儿亚文化。

name: Cristina Venegas
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history, theory, and criticism of Latin American film and digital media, including Cuban cinema, the state and digital culture, and digital activism.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁美洲电影与数字媒介的历史、理论与批评，包括古巴电影、国家与数字文化以及数字行动主义。

name: Greg Siegel
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies media history and theory, science and technology studies, and sound studies, using cultural and critical history to examine forensic media, accidents, and unexplained sounds.
summary_zh: 研究媒介历史与理论、科学技术研究和声音研究，以文化与批判史路径考察法证媒介、事故与无法解释的声音。

name: Jason Ludwig
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the history of computing and politics in the postwar U.S., tracing how computing was deployed against the urban crisis and reshaped racial politics and policy.
summary_zh: 研究战后美国计算技术与政治的历史，追溯计算技术如何被用于应对城市危机并重塑种族政治与政策。

name: Jennifer Holt
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies media industries and digital media policy, tracing the history of regulating pipelines, platforms, data, and cloud infrastructures.
summary_zh: 研究媒介产业与数字媒介政策，追溯管道、平台、数据及云基础设施监管的历史。

name: Laila Shereen Sakr
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor, Department Chair
summary: Merges digital art practice, feminist decolonial thought, and critical AI to study Arab digital cultures, data, and archives, building media systems such as R-Shief.
summary_zh: 融合数字艺术实践、女性主义去殖民思想与批判性人工智能，研究阿拉伯数字文化、数据与档案，并构建R-Shief等媒介系统。

name: Lisa Parks
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies satellite technologies, media infrastructures, and media globalization, along with militarization, surveillance, and AI, through media history and critical theory.
summary_zh: 以媒介史和批判理论研究卫星技术、媒介基础设施与媒介全球化，并关注军事化、监控与人工智能。

name: Mona Damluji
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies underrepresented media histories of energy, cities, and infrastructure in the Middle East, especially oil-industry documentary films in Iran and Iraq.
summary_zh: 研究中东能源、城市与基础设施中被忽视的媒介史，尤其是伊朗和伊拉克石油工业纪录片。

name: Naoki Yamamoto
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies film theory and Japanese cinema, tracing Japan's role in the global circulation of film theory through Marxist criticism and cultural history.
summary_zh: 研究电影理论与日本电影，通过马克思主义批评与文化史考察日本在电影理论全球流通中的角色。

name: Patrice Petro
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies film and media history and historiography from a feminist perspective, including cinema and gender, 1920s movie stars, and media and global security.
summary_zh: 从女性主义视角研究电影与媒介史及史学，包括电影与性别、1920年代电影明星以及媒介与全球安全。

name: Peter Bloom
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies British, French, and Belgian colonial media, focusing on documentary, radio, and cinema in West Africa and Southeast Asia, through historical and archival research.
summary_zh: 以历史与档案研究考察英、法、比殖民媒介，聚焦西非和东南亚的纪录片、广播与电影。

name: Ross Melnick
dept: Department of Film and Media Studies
title: Professor, Director of Carsey-Wolf Center
summary: Studies film history and the entertainment industry, especially film exhibition and how Hollywood movie theaters projected American power worldwide, using archival research.
summary_zh: 运用档案研究考察电影史与娱乐产业，尤其是电影放映业以及好莱坞影院如何在全球投射美国影响力。

name: Bo Feng
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies supportive communication, how people seek, give, and respond to comfort and advice across cultures, genders, close relationships, online communities, and doctor-patient visits.
summary_zh: 研究支持性传播，考察人们如何在不同文化、性别、亲密关系、网络社群及医患互动中寻求、提供和回应安慰与建议。

name: Jaeho Cho
title: Professor
summary: Studies how campaign media, news use, and everyday political discussion shape citizens' political understanding and decisions, drawing on information-processing concepts such as priming.
summary_zh: 研究竞选媒体、新闻使用和日常政治讨论如何影响公民的政治理解与决策，借鉴启动效应等信息加工概念。

name: Drew Cingel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how child and adolescent development shapes media use and effects, including social media and teen mental health, learning from media, and moral reasoning, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究儿童与青少年发展如何影响媒介使用及效果，包括社交媒体与青少年心理健康、从媒介中学习和道德推理，主要采用实验和调查方法。

name: Seth Frey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies self-governance and common-pool resource institutions, treating online communities and games as models, using computational modeling, large datasets, and web-based experiments.
summary_zh: 研究自治与公共池塘资源治理制度，将网络社群和游戏作为治理模型，采用计算建模、大规模数据和网络实验方法。

name: Martin Hilbert
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of digital information and algorithms in complex social systems, from measuring the world's information capacity to digital development policy, using computational social science.
summary_zh: 研究数字信息与算法在复杂社会系统中的作用，涵盖测量全球信息容量到数字发展政策，运用计算社会科学方法。

name: Junwen Hu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication and media design shape the pursuit of compatible relationships, such as online dating, using online experiments, large-scale content analysis, and multilevel surveys.
summary_zh: 研究传播与媒介设计如何影响人们追求“相配”关系（如网络约会），采用线上实验、大规模内容分析和多层次调查数据。

name: Richard Huskey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes motivationally relevant information in persuasion, media selection, and decision-making, combining fMRI, EEG, computational modeling, and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何在说服、媒介选择和决策中加工具有动机意义的信息，结合fMRI、EEG、计算建模和行为实验。

name: Soojong Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies inequality, disparity, and risk in health, environment, and governance, and how people perceive and share information online, using computational and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究健康、环境与治理中的不平等、差距与风险，以及人们如何在线感知和分享信息，采用计算与定量方法。

name: Jorge Peña
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognition, affect, and behavior in video games, virtual environments, and online groups, including priming and impression formation, using experiments, content analysis, and text analysis.
summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、虚拟环境和网络群体中的认知、情感与行为，包括启动效应和印象形成，采用实验、内容分析和自动化语言分析。

name: Cuihua (Cindy) Shen
title: Professor
summary: Studies multimodal misinformation in AI-mediated environments and the structure and impact of social networks on online platforms, using computational social science and network analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能中介环境下的多模态（虚假）信息，以及在线平台社会网络的结构与影响，采用计算社会科学与网络分析方法。

name: Laramie Taylor
title: Professor
summary: Studies uses and effects of entertainment media on relationship beliefs, gender stereotypes, body perceptions, and health, and the motives of fans of fiction, celebrities, and sports teams.
summary_zh: 研究娱乐媒介对恋爱关系观念、性别刻板印象、身体认知和健康的使用与效果，以及虚构作品、名人和体育队伍粉丝的动机。

name: Magdalena Wojcieszak
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people select political information online, media effects on polarization and misperceptions, and interventions targeting users and platform algorithms, including YouTube algorithm audits.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在线选择政治信息、媒体对极化与错误认知的影响，以及针对用户和平台算法的干预，包括YouTube算法审计。

name: Narine Yegiyan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and memory interact in information processing under cognitive and emotional overload, using self-report, behavioral, and physiological measures to inform message design.
summary_zh: 研究在认知与情绪超载情境下情绪与记忆如何在信息加工中相互作用，采用自我报告、行为和生理测量以指导讯息设计。

name: Jingwen Zhang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how persuasive technologies such as social media, mobile apps, and conversational AI chatbots change health attitudes and behaviors, designing and testing them in clinical trials.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体、移动应用和对话式AI聊天机器人等说服性技术如何改变健康态度与行为，并通过临床试验设计和检验这些技术。

name: Megan Ankerson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies web history, software, AI and visual culture, historicizing big data systems alongside time-travel media through historical and critical-interpretive analysis.
summary_zh: 以历史与批判阐释方法研究网络史、软件、人工智能与视觉文化，并将大数据系统与时间旅行媒介并置进行历史化考察。

name: Kyla Brathwaite
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how race and gender shape people's interactions with communication technologies, self-presentation and body image, mainly through quantitative experiments.
summary_zh: 主要通过定量实验研究种族与性别如何影响人们与传播技术及其他用户的互动、自我呈现与身体意象。

name: Sonya Dal Cin
title: Professor
summary: Studies how stories and identification with characters change beliefs and behavior, applying social-cognitive media effects research to health, stereotyping and development.
summary_zh: 研究叙事与角色认同如何改变信念与行为，并将社会认知取向的媒介效果研究应用于健康、刻板印象与人生发展阶段。

name: Susan Douglas
title: Catharine Neafie Kellogg Professorship, Arthur F. Thurnau Professor
summary: Writes critical histories of American media and gender, from early broadcasting and radio to celebrity, motherhood myths and representations of women.
summary_zh: 以批判史视角研究美国媒介与性别，涵盖早期广播与电台、名人文化、母职神话及女性再现。

name: Hollis Griffin
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes the cultural politics of television, cinema and social media around sexuality, affect and urban space using archival research, fieldwork and close reading.
summary_zh: 运用档案研究、田野观察与文本细读，分析电视、电影和社交媒体在性向、情感与城市空间方面的文化政治。

name: Germaine Halegoua
title: John D. Evans Development Professor & Associate Professor of Communication and Media
summary: Studies how people, place and digital media intersect, including smart cities, digital placemaking, neighborhood social media and inequities of digital infrastructure.
summary_zh: 研究人、地方与数字媒介的交织，包括智慧城市、数字地方营造、社区社交媒体以及数字基础设施的不平等。

name: Sol Hart
title: Professor
summary: Studies strategic communication about environmental, science and risk issues, examining how media and messages can engage publics and bridge ideological divides.
summary_zh: 研究环境、科学与风险议题的战略传播，考察媒介与信息如何动员公众并跨越意识形态分歧。

name: Ariel Hasell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses quantitative methods to study how media choices and social media influencers shape knowledge, trust and engagement with science, journalism and politics.
summary_zh: 运用定量方法研究媒介选择与社交媒体网红如何影响公众对科学、新闻与政治的认知、信任与参与。

name: Yanna Krupnikov
title: Professor of Communication and Media
summary: Studies attention to political news, political expression and partisan polarization in American politics, as well as how journalists cover polarization and democracy.
summary_zh: 研究美国政治中的政治新闻关注、政治表达与党派极化，以及记者如何报道极化与民主。

name: Hang Lu
title: Associate Professor; Associate Chair for Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how audiences process science, health and risk messages and AI-generated or manipulated visuals, combining experiments with analysis of social media content.
summary_zh: 结合实验与社交媒体内容分析，研究受众如何处理科学、健康与风险信息以及AI生成或篡改的视觉内容。

name: Pranav Malhotra
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social and mobile media affordances interact with cultural and relational norms, including credibility judgments in private messaging spaces in understudied contexts.
summary_zh: 研究社交与移动媒介的可供性如何与文化及关系规范互动，包括在研究较少地区的私密通讯空间中的信息可信度判断。

name: Colten Meisner
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study work in media and tech industries, especially social media creators, influencers, journalists and subscription platforms like Substack.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究媒体与科技产业中的劳动，尤其是社交媒体创作者、网红、记者以及Substack等订阅平台。

name: Josh Pasek
title: Professor
summary: Studies how new media and psychological processes shape public opinion and voting in US elections, and develops survey methods to reduce measurement error.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体与心理过程如何影响美国选举中的舆论与投票，并发展降低测量误差的调查方法。

name: Devon Powers
title: Pris Rogers Professor of Strategic Communications; Professor of Communication and Media
summary: Examines consumer and promotional culture, including trend forecasting, branding and popular music criticism, through critical cultural and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 以批判文化与历史分析考察消费与推广文化，包括趋势预测、品牌营销与流行音乐评论。

name: John Barry Ryan
title: Associate Professor Communication and Media; Political Science
summary: Studies campaign communication, social influence and news coverage of expertise and polarization in American politics, often using experiments.
summary_zh: 研究美国政治中的竞选传播、社会影响以及新闻对专业知识与极化的报道，常采用实验方法。

name: Derek W. Vaillant
title: Professor
areas: Historical Approaches to Media and Technology
summary: Writes histories of radio broadcasting in the US and France, sound studies and American popular music, including the gendered and racialized formation of US broadcasting.
summary_zh: 研究美国与法国的广播电台史、声音研究和美国流行音乐，包括美国广播业的性别化与种族化形成过程。

name: Jan Van den Bulck
title: Professor
summary: Studies incidental media effects, including cultivation of beliefs about violence, policing and medicine, and the health effects of media use on sleep, eating and exercise.
summary_zh: 研究非自愿与偶发的媒介效果，包括对暴力、执法与医疗认知的涵化，以及媒介使用对睡眠、饮食和运动的健康影响。

name: Cara Wallis
title: Professor
summary: Studies mobile and social media use among marginalized groups in China, especially rural and migrant women, through intersectional feminist and critical technology lenses.
summary_zh: 以交叉性女性主义与批判技术视角，研究中国边缘群体（尤其农村与流动女性）的移动与社交媒体使用。

name: Brian Weeks
title: Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and partisan media shape political misperceptions, news use and digital media behavior, as well as online sports betting.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与党派媒体如何影响政治误知、新闻使用与数字媒介行为，以及网络体育博彩。

name: Apryl Williams
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies race and gender in digital spaces and algorithmic technocultures, including sexual racism in online dating, reparative technology and human-AI intimacy.
summary_zh: 研究数字空间与算法技术文化中的种族与性别，包括网络约会中的性种族主义、修复性技术与人机亲密关系。

name: Matthew Koschmann
title: Department Chair • Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication and collaboration in the civil society sector, focusing on how nonprofit organizations communicate and work together.
summary_zh: 研究公民社会部门中的组织传播与协作，关注非营利组织如何沟通与合作。

name: Karen Ashcraft
title: Professor
areas: gender, race and sexuality in work and organization
summary: Theorizes how gender, race, and sexuality shape work and organization, and how affect and viral masculinity fuel populism and the far right.
summary_zh: 从理论上探讨性别、种族与性向如何塑造工作与组织，以及情感与“病毒式男子气概”如何推动民粹主义和极右翼。

name: Lamiyah (LB) Bahrainwala
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Analyzes rhetorics of gender and race in mediated texts, examining transnational anti-Muslim sentiment, anti-Blackness, and feminist surveillance.
summary_zh: 分析媒介文本中的性别与种族修辞，考察跨国反穆斯林情绪、反黑人主义与女性主义监控研究。

name: David Boromisza-Habashi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses ethnography of communication to study how speech genres such as public speaking and 'hate speech' circulate and gain value across cultures, including in the US and China.
summary_zh: 运用传播民族志研究公共演讲、“仇恨言论”等言语体裁如何跨文化流动并被赋予价值，包括美国与中国的案例。

name: Joelle Cruz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies postcolonial approaches to organizational communication, studying indigenous, women's, LGBTQ, and grassroots organizing in Liberia and Cote d'Ivoire.
summary_zh: 以后殖民视角研究组织传播，考察利比里亚和科特迪瓦的原住民、女性、LGBTQ及草根组织化实践。

name: Shiv Ganesh
title: Professor
summary: Studies the global, organizational, and technological dimensions of public goods, including digital social movements, environmental justice, volunteering, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究公共物品在全球、组织与技术层面的建构与争夺，涵盖数字社会运动、环境正义、志愿服务与人工智能。

name: Danielle Hodge
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses critical race theory and discourse analysis to examine how oppression and resistance shape African American identities, language, and communication.
summary_zh: 运用批判种族理论与话语分析，考察压迫与抵抗如何塑造非裔美国人的身份、语言与传播实践。

name: José "Joe" Izaguirre
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public rhetoric and rhetorical history, analyzing how race, coloniality, and political power shape Latinx political identities such as in the Chicano movement.
summary_zh: 研究公共修辞与修辞史，分析种族、殖民性与政治权力如何塑造拉丁裔政治身份，如奇卡诺运动。

name: Jody Jahn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses mixed methods to study how members of hazardous organizations, such as wildland firefighting crews, communicate about action and safety policies.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究高风险组织（如野外消防队）成员如何围绕行动与安全规章进行沟通。

name: Amber Kelsie
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Analyzes rhetoric and argument at the intersection of Black studies, gender and sexuality, and science and technology, including rhetorics of genetic genealogy.
summary_zh: 在黑人研究、性别与性向以及科技研究的交汇处分析修辞与论辩，包括基因谱系技术的修辞。

name: Timothy Kuhn
title: Associate Dean of Faculty Development • Professor
areas: authority and agency in organizational practice
knowledge, identity and value in organizations
summary: Theorizes how authority, agency, knowledge, and identity are constituted in sociomaterial, power-laden communication practices within organizations.
summary_zh: 从理论上探讨组织中权威、能动性、知识与身份如何在社会物质性且充满权力的传播实践中被建构。

name: Kristella Montiegel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses conversation analysis and ethnography to examine micro-level communicative practices in educational and political settings.
summary_zh: 运用会话分析与民族志方法，考察教育与政治场景中的微观传播实践。

name: Omedi Ochieng
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops rhetorical theory and comparative intellectual history drawing on Africana philosophy, addressing ethics, politics, aesthetics, and radical imagination.
summary_zh: 借鉴非洲哲学发展修辞理论与比较思想史，探讨伦理、政治、美学与激进想象。

name: Phaedra C. Pezzullo
title: Professor • Kleiman Faculty Scholar in Communication
summary: Studies environmental and climate justice and the rhetoric of social movements, analyzing advocacy around toxic pollution, plastics, and cultures of care.
summary_zh: 研究环境与气候正义及社会运动修辞，分析围绕有毒污染、塑料与关怀文化的倡导实践。

name: Alicen (Ali) Rushevics
title: Assistant Professor
areas: rhetorics of trauma, wounding and grief
summary: Analyzes rhetorics of apology, reparation, and trauma in US imperialism in the Pacific, using rhetorical criticism and historiography of Indigenous human rights.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评与修辞史学，分析美国在太平洋地区帝国主义中的道歉、补偿与创伤修辞及原住民人权问题。

name: Natasha Shrikant
title: Associate Professor • Associate Chair for Graduate Studies
summary: Uses ethnography and discourse analysis to study how interaction constitutes race and identity, including misinformation among Asian American communities online.
summary_zh: 运用民族志与话语分析研究互动如何建构种族与身份，包括亚裔美国人社群在社交媒体上的虚假信息传播。

name: Leah Sprain
title: Associate Professor • Faculty Director, Center of Communication and Democratic Engagement
summary: Studies how communication practices enable or inhibit democratic engagement, deliberation, and environmental activism through ethnographic fieldwork in the US and Nicaragua.
summary_zh: 通过在美国和尼加拉瓜的民族志田野研究，探讨传播实践如何促进或阻碍民主参与、公共协商与环境行动。

name: Bryan C. Taylor
title: Professor
summary: Uses qualitative and interpretive methods to study security, media, and organizational communication, including post-9/11 media and the US nuclear weapons complex.
summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释方法研究安全、媒介与组织传播，包括“9·11”后的媒介与美国核武器体系。

name: Cindy H. White
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies interaction patterns in personal relationships, including deception, relational loss, social support, and family communication about money.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的互动模式，包括欺骗、关系丧失、社会支持以及家庭中关于金钱的沟通。

name: Ted Striphas
title: Department Chair • Professor
areas: history, culture and politics of technology
summary: Studies the history, culture, and politics of technology through cultural studies and historical research, focusing on algorithmic culture and book publishing.
summary_zh: 以文化研究与历史研究方法探讨技术的历史、文化与政治，聚焦算法文化与图书出版。

name: Ian J. Alexander
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines media technologies in US prisons and jails as terrains of repression and resistance, using media history and critical prison studies.
summary_zh: 运用媒介史与批判监狱研究，考察美国监狱中的媒介技术如何成为压制与抵抗的场域。

name: Nabil Echchaibi
title: Associate Dean of Scholarly and Creative Work • Professor
areas: politics and poetics of Muslim visibility
summary: Studies media and religion, the politics of Muslim visibility, and diaspora media, including ethnic radio in Europe and digital religion.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与宗教、穆斯林可见性政治及离散媒介，包括欧洲的族裔广播与数字宗教。

name: Lori Emerson
title: Professor • Associate Chair for Graduate Studies, Media Studies
summary: Studies media poetics, media archaeology, and the history of computing and telecommunications networks that existed before or outside the internet.
summary_zh: 研究媒介诗学、媒介考古学，以及互联网之前或之外的计算与电信网络历史。

name: Steven Frost
title: Assistant Professor • Co-Associate Director, Media & Public Engagement MA Program
areas: community development in DIY spaces and libraries
summary: Studies textiles, memes, queer history, and pop culture through fiber art practice and community building in DIY spaces and libraries.
summary_zh: 通过纤维艺术创作与DIY空间、图书馆中的社群营造，研究纺织品、网络迷因、酷儿历史与流行文化。

name: Polly E. Bugros McLean
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies intersectionality, racialized representation, and Africana women's history, with a focus on media and globalization in Southern Africa.
summary_zh: 研究交叉性、种族化再现与非洲裔女性历史，聚焦南部非洲的媒介与全球化。

name: Colette Perold
title: Assistant Professor
areas: media technologies, labor and U.S. foreign policy
multinational IT companies in Latin America
summary: Uses archival history to study how media technologies, labor, and multinational IT firms such as IBM shaped US foreign policy in Latin America, especially Brazil.
summary_zh: 运用档案史研究方法，探讨媒介技术、劳动与IBM等跨国IT企业如何影响美国在拉美（尤其巴西）的外交政策。

name: Samira Rajabi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people use digital and tactical media to make meaning of trauma and suffering, attending to the body, race, gender, and disability.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何借助数字媒介与战术媒介理解创伤与苦难，关注身体、种族、性别与残障议题。

name: Sandra Ristovska
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how images and video shape the pursuit of justice and human rights in legal and institutional contexts, including video activism and visual evidence.
summary_zh: 研究图像与视频如何在法律和制度情境中影响正义与人权的追求，包括视频行动主义与视觉证据。

name: Mehak Sawhney
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies environmental media, sound, and surveillance, including underwater acoustic sensing in the Indian Ocean and the environmental costs of AI data centers.
summary_zh: 研究环境媒介、声音与监控，包括印度洋水下声学传感以及AI数据中心的环境代价。

name: Nathan Schneider
title: Associate Professor • Co-Associate Director, Media & Public Engagement MA Program
areas: democratic ownership and governance of online platforms
summary: Studies technology, democracy, and religion, designing and theorizing models of democratic ownership and governance for online platforms and cooperative economies.
summary_zh: 研究技术、民主与宗教，设计并理论化在线平台与合作经济的民主所有权与治理模式。

name: Josh Shepperd
title: Associate Chair of Undergraduate Studies • Associate Professor • Faculty Advisor, KVCU Student Radio
summary: Uses historical and political-economic methods to study media theory, public broadcasting policy, and sound preservation in the United States.
summary_zh: 以历史与政治经济学方法研究美国的媒介理论、公共广播政策与声音档案保存。

name: J. Richard Stevens
title: Associate Dean of Undergraduate Education • Associate Professor
areas: ideological formation and media message dissemination
summary: Studies how ideology spreads through popular culture and technology platforms, including privacy norms, copyright, and science in American public discourse.
summary_zh: 研究意识形态如何通过流行文化与技术平台传播，涉及美国公共话语中的隐私规范、版权与科学传播。

name: Patrick Ferrucci
title: Department Chair • Professor
summary: Studies how organizational factors and market models of journalism shape news production and journalists' work practices, from a media sociology perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介社会学视角研究组织因素与新闻业市场模式如何影响新闻生产和记者的工作实践。

name: Angie Chuang
title: Associate Chair for Undergraduate Studies • Associate Professor
areas: race, identity and representations of Otherness in journalism
news media constructions of identity and belonging
summary: Studies how news media represent race, identity, and Otherness, analyzing journalistic constructions of belonging in American journalism.
summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体如何再现种族、身份与“他者性”，分析美国新闻业对归属感的建构。

name: Meghan Cohen
title: Associate Professor
areas: decolonizing global media theories and methods
media, human rights and humanitarian crises
summary: Studies press freedom and media systems in non-democratic contexts, decolonizing global media research and examining media in human rights crises, especially in East Africa.
summary_zh: 研究非民主语境中的新闻自由与媒介体制，推动全球媒介研究的去殖民化，并考察人权危机中的媒体，尤其聚焦东非。

name: Meagan Doll
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies international news production and consumption, media attitudes in strong-state settings, and conflict reporting using surveys, experiments, content analysis, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验、内容分析与访谈，研究国际新闻的生产与消费、强国家环境下的媒介态度及冲突报道。

name: Ever Figueroa
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies media representations, media sociology, and sports communication using textual analysis, critical discourse analysis, ethnography, and in-depth interviews.
summary_zh: 运用文本分析、批判话语分析、民族志与深度访谈，研究媒介再现、媒介社会学与体育传播。

name: Hun Shik Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies broadcast journalism, war and conflict reporting, international communication, and telecommunication systems and policy.
summary_zh: 研究广播电视新闻、战争与冲突报道、国际传播以及电信系统与政策。

name: Christine Larson
title: Associate Chair for Graduate Studies • Associate Professor
summary: Studies how technology reshapes the book industry, journalism, and media work, drawing on fieldwork with newsrooms and romance writers, publishers, and readers.
summary_zh: 研究技术如何重塑图书产业、新闻业与媒介劳动，基于对新闻编辑室及言情小说作者、出版商和读者的田野研究。

name: Dinfin K. Mulupi
title: Assistant Professor
areas: women journalists in the Global South
summary: Studies journalists' experiences, ethics, and newsroom policies using feminist theory, focusing on women journalists in the Global South and coverage of sexual violence.
summary_zh: 运用女性主义理论研究记者的经验、伦理与编辑部政策，聚焦全球南方女性记者及性暴力报道。

name: Ross Taylor
title: Associate Professor • Faculty Director, CMDI in D.C.
summary: Practices and teaches photojournalism and documentary photography, with a focus on visual storytelling in journalism.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授新闻摄影与纪实摄影，关注新闻中的视觉叙事。

name: Hong Vu
title: Professor • Faculty Director, Center for Environmental Journalism
summary: Studies how journalism and nonprofit practices address climate change, environmental degradation, information disorder, and social inequality amid technological change.
summary_zh: 研究新闻业与非营利实践如何在技术变革中应对气候变化、环境退化、信息失序与社会不平等。

name: Kay Weaver
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Department Chair • Professor
areas: corporate, government, non-profit and activist communication
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study the social-cultural role of public relations and strategic communication, including media representations of violence against women.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究公共关系与战略传播的社会文化作用，包括媒体对针对女性暴力的再现。

name: Bridget Barrett
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor
areas: campaign merchandise and political identity brands
summary: Studies the intersection of digital marketing and political communication, including how platform affordances and policies shape campaign strategies and merchandise.
summary_zh: 研究数字营销与政治传播的交叉，包括平台功能与政策如何影响竞选策略与竞选周边商品。

name: Jolene Fisher
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Associate Chair for Undergraduate Studies • Associate Professor
areas: new media, gender and strategic communication
communication for development and social change
summary: Studies new media, gender, and strategic communication for development and social change, including digital games for social change and organizational transparency.
summary_zh: 研究面向发展与社会变革的新媒体、性别与战略传播，包括社会变革类数字游戏与组织透明度。

name: Toby Hopp
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Faculty Director, Masters of Corporate Communication Program • Associate Professor
areas: uses and effects of digital and interactive media
summary: Studies the uses and effects of digital and interactive media, the motivations behind uncivil online communication, and organizational transparency.
summary_zh: 研究数字与互动媒介的使用与效果、网络不文明传播背后的动机以及组织透明度。

name: Pooja Iyer
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses mixed methods to study big data, privacy regulation, and personalization in advertising, and how platform politics shape consumer behavior.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究广告中的大数据、隐私监管与个性化，以及平台政治如何影响消费者行为。

name: HS Jin
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how advertising language and messaging affect consumer attitudes, engagement, well-being, and prosocial and environmental behavior.
summary_zh: 研究广告语言与信息如何影响消费者态度、参与、幸福感以及亲社会与环保行为。

name: WooJin Kim
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor • DeLuca Faculty Scholar
areas: AI technologies in advertising and marketing
summary: Studies how AI technologies such as chatbots, personalized ads, and AI influencers shape consumer responses, and how AI agents can promote prosocial behavior.
summary_zh: 研究聊天机器人、个性化广告与AI网红等人工智能技术如何影响消费者反应，以及AI如何促进亲社会行为。

name: Sangwook Lee
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor
areas: psychological effects of AI, VR and AR
summary: Studies AI-driven strategic communication and its ethics, and the psychological effects of AI, VR, and AR technologies on advertising effectiveness.
summary_zh: 研究AI驱动的战略传播及其伦理问题，以及AI、VR和AR技术对广告效果的心理影响。

name: Seow Ting Lee
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Associate Dean of Graduate Programs • Professor
summary: Studies public relations and health communication, focusing on organization-stakeholder communication strategies and practices in new media.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与健康传播，聚焦新媒体环境下组织与利益相关者的沟通策略与实践。

name: Jordan Morehouse
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how nonprofit and religious organizations practice public relations, engagement, and crisis communication using interviews, observation, surveys, and network analysis.
summary_zh: 运用访谈、参与观察、调查与社会网络分析，研究非营利及宗教组织的公共关系、关系参与和危机传播。

name: Erin Schauster
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Associate Chair for Graduate Studies • Associate Professor
summary: Studies the moral psychology of advertising and PR practitioners and students, and the organizational influences on ethics in strategic communication.
summary_zh: 研究广告与公关从业者及学生的道德心理，以及组织因素对战略传播伦理实践的影响。

name: Krishnamurthy Sriramesh
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Professor
summary: Studies global public relations, including the role of culture in PR and crisis communication, corporate social responsibility, and PR for development.
summary_zh: 研究全球公共关系，包括文化在公关与危机传播中的作用、企业社会责任及发展型公关。

name: Burton St. John
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Professor
summary: Studies public relations and the management of risk and crisis, including the history of PR and the rise of the corporate persona.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与风险及危机管理，包括公关史与企业人格的兴起。

name: Chris Vargo
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Associate Professor
areas: social media, news and advertising data
large language models and generative AI
summary: Applies computational social science and machine learning, including LLMs, to analyze social media, news, and advertising data.
summary_zh: 运用计算社会科学与机器学习（包括大语言模型）分析社交媒体、新闻与广告数据。

name: Mia Wang
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Assistant Professor
areas: virtual reality and augmented reality effects
summary: Studies how VR and AR immersive media shape cognitive and emotional processes, attitudes, and behaviors in consumer, social issue, and health contexts.
summary_zh: 研究VR与AR沉浸式媒介如何在消费、社会议题和健康情境中影响认知与情绪过程、态度与行为。

name: Erin Willis
dept: Department of Advertising, Public Relations and Design
title: Professor
summary: Studies how health message design and everyday information technologies influence people's health understanding and behavior for health promotion.
summary_zh: 研究健康信息设计与日常信息技术如何影响人们的健康认知与行为，以促进健康。

name: Jeanne Abbott
title: Professor
summary: Teaches newspaper editing and reporting as managing editor of a student-staffed community newsroom, drawing on long metro newspaper experience.
summary_zh: 以学生运营社区报纸的执行主编身份教授新闻编辑与报道，借鉴其长期的都市报从业经验。

name: Brad Best
title: Professor
summary: Teaches digital advertising and media sales, focusing on media buying, planning, and analytics that help news publishers grow revenue and engagement.
summary_zh: 教授数字广告与媒体销售，关注媒体购买、媒介策划以及帮助新闻出版商提升收入与用户参与的数据分析。

name: Pete Bland
title: Sports Editor; Assistant Professor
summary: Supervises sports coverage at a student-staffed community newspaper and teaches sports journalism and digital news editing, including tests of pay models and social media practice.
summary_zh: 在学生运营的社区报纸主管体育报道，教授体育新闻与数字新闻编辑，并参与付费模式与社交媒体实践的测试。

name: Elizabeth Brixey
title: Professor
summary: Teaches reporting and editing as a teaching editor at a student-staffed community newspaper, with an emphasis on mentoring journalism students.
summary_zh: 在学生运营的社区报纸担任教学编辑，教授采访与编辑，注重指导新闻专业学生。

name: Frank Corridori
title: Professor
summary: Teaches strategic design and visual communication for advertising, drawing on professional work in art direction, branding, and package design.
summary_zh: 教授广告中的战略设计与视觉传播，借鉴其在艺术指导、品牌塑造和包装设计方面的职业经验。

name: Gordon Dickson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Edits news at a student-staffed community newspaper, bringing long experience in transportation, business, and investigative reporting and multimedia storytelling.
summary_zh: 在学生运营的社区报纸担任新闻编辑，具有交通、商业与调查报道及多媒体叙事方面的长期经验。

name: Tracy Draksler Brown
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Teaches advertising campaigns and audience persuasion, drawing on agency experience leading integrated marketing, brand launches, and repositioning efforts.
summary_zh: 教授广告活动与受众说服，借鉴其在广告公司主导整合营销、品牌发布与品牌重新定位的经验。

name: Margaret Duffy
title: Professor; Novak Leadership Institute Executive Director
summary: Studies leadership, organizational communication, visual communication, narrative, and persuasion in strategic communication and advertising.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播与广告中的领导力、组织传播、视觉传播、叙事与说服。

name: David Estrada Orúe
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces and teaches television news, drawing on bilingual reporting experience in Costa Rican and U.S. broadcast newsrooms.
summary_zh: 从事并教授电视新闻制作，借鉴其在哥斯达黎加与美国电视新闻编辑室的双语报道经验。

name: Jamie Flink
title: Professor
summary: Teaches advertising account management, strategic planning, and audience research, drawing on brand strategy work for national retail and restaurant clients.
summary_zh: 教授广告客户管理、战略策划与受众研究，借鉴其为全国零售与餐饮品牌制定品牌战略的经验。

name: Elizabeth W. Frogge
title: Professor; Assistant News Director, KOMU-TV
summary: Teaches television reporting and helps lead a university-run commercial TV newsroom, drawing on experience covering disasters such as Hurricane Katrina.
summary_zh: 教授电视报道并协助领导一家大学运营的商业电视台新闻部，借鉴其报道卡特里娜飓风等灾难的经验。

name: Robert Greene
title: Professor
summary: Makes and teaches documentary film, creating hybrid nonfiction features that explore performance, reenactment, and documentary journalism.
summary_zh: 从事并教授纪录片创作，制作探索表演、重演与纪录新闻的混合型非虚构长片。

name: Keith Greenwood
title: Associate Professor; Faculty Group Chair, Journalism Studies
summary: Studies the history of photojournalism and the influences that shape how subjects are depicted in news photographs, using historical research.
summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影史以及影响新闻照片中人物呈现方式的因素，采用历史研究方法。

name: Andrea Heiss
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies modern American art, cultural history, new journalism, and contemporary literature, and teaches arts and cultural reporting for magazines.
summary_zh: 研究美国现代艺术、文化史、新新闻主义与当代文学，并教授杂志的艺术与文化报道。

name: David Herzog
title: Professor
summary: Teaches and practices investigative and data journalism, including computer-assisted reporting, data literacy, and mapping for stories.
summary_zh: 教授并从事调查与数据新闻，包括计算机辅助报道、数据素养和新闻地图制作。

name: Brittany Hilderbrand
title: Community News Editor, Columbia Missourian; Assistant Professor
summary: Edits community news and draws on experience in statehouse reporting, public health communications, public relations, and speech writing.
summary_zh: 担任社区新闻编辑，具有州议会报道、公共卫生传播、公共关系与演讲撰稿方面的经验。

name: Amanda Hinnant
title: Professor
summary: Studies health journalism, science communication, and narrative persuasion from a media sociology perspective, including national surveys of health journalists.
summary_zh: 从媒介社会学视角研究健康新闻、科学传播与叙事说服，包括对全国健康记者的调查。

name: Mark Horvit
title: Professor; Faculty Group Chair, Journalism Professions
summary: Teaches investigative reporting and directs a state government reporting program, drawing on training work in investigative and data journalism.
summary_zh: 教授调查报道并主持州政府报道项目，借鉴其在调查与数据新闻培训方面的经验。

name: Beverly Horvit
title: Professor
summary: Studies international news coverage and foreign policy, analyzing how U.S. news organizations cover other regions of the world.
summary_zh: 研究国际新闻报道与外交政策，分析美国新闻机构如何报道世界其他地区。

name: Stan Jastrzebski
title: News Director, KBIA; Assistant Professor
summary: Directs a public radio newsroom and teaches broadcast journalism, drawing on experience leading public media coverage of state politics.
summary_zh: 主持公共广播电台新闻部并教授广播新闻，借鉴其领导公共媒体州政治报道的经验。

name: Joy Jenkins
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational identities and practices in local newsrooms and gender and media, using a sociological approach to journalism's digital transition.
summary_zh: 以社会学视角研究地方新闻编辑室的组织身份与实践以及性别与媒介，关注新闻业的数字化转型。

name: Laura Johnston
title: Professor; Associate Chair, Journalism Professions
summary: Teaches news writing and cross-platform editing, serves as opinion editor of a student-staffed community newspaper, and works with high school journalism workshops.
summary_zh: 教授新闻写作与跨平台编辑，担任学生运营社区报纸的评论版编辑，并参与高中新闻夏令营。

name: Damon Kiesow
title: Professor
summary: Works on news product management and business strategy for sustainable local journalism, aligning community information needs with digital products.
summary_zh: 研究新闻产品管理与可持续地方新闻的商业策略，将社区信息需求与数字产品相结合。

name: Brian Kratzer
title: Professor; Director of Photography, Columbia Missourian
summary: Teaches photojournalism and visual editing and leads documentary video projects, including work on rural Missouri families and youth.
summary_zh: 教授新闻摄影与视觉编辑并主持纪录视频项目，包括关于密苏里乡村家庭与青年的作品。

name: Lynda Kraxberger
title: Associate Dean for Undergraduate Studies and Administration; Professor
summary: Leads undergraduate journalism education, focusing on curriculum design, accreditation, assessment, and faculty development.
summary_zh: 主管本科新闻教育，关注课程设计、专业认证、教学评估与教师发展。

name: David Kurpius
title: Dean of Journalism; Professor
summary: Leads a journalism school as dean, focusing on journalism education, experiential learning, strategic planning, and industry partnerships.
summary_zh: 以院长身份领导新闻学院，关注新闻教育、体验式学习、战略规划与业界合作。

name: Lorah Lackland
title: Director of Marketing; Assistant Professor
summary: Directs marketing for a student-staffed business news outlet, drawing on freelance graphic design and strategic communication experience.
summary_zh: 为学生运营的商业新闻媒体主管市场营销，具有自由职业平面设计与战略传播经验。

name: Sungkyoung Lee
title: Professor
summary: Designs and tests health and science messages, using online and lab experiments to study cognitive and emotional processing, e.g., for clinical trial recruitment.
summary_zh: 设计并检验健康与科学信息，通过线上和实验室实验研究认知与情绪加工过程，如用于临床试验招募。

name: Dominick Lee
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Teaches video production and drone journalism, drawing on experience as a television photojournalist and editor.
summary_zh: 教授视频制作与无人机新闻，借鉴其担任电视新闻摄影记者与剪辑师的经验。

name: Kathryn Lucchesi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Teaches audience strategy and engagement, guiding newsroom social media strategy with a background in sports storytelling and digital marketing.
summary_zh: 教授受众策略与互动，借助体育叙事与数字营销背景指导新闻编辑室的社交媒体策略。

name: Monique Luisi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how identity shapes health attitudes and communication about disease prevention, science accessibility, and marginalized groups in entertainment media, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究身份如何影响健康态度，以及疾病预防、科学可及性和娱乐媒介中边缘群体的传播，采用混合方法。

name: Haijing Ma
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies science, risk, and health communication, especially theory-based interventions and persuasive messaging about addiction and tobacco to inform behavior change and regulation.
summary_zh: 研究科学、风险与健康传播，尤其是关于成瘾与烟草的理论驱动干预与说服信息，以促进行为改变并服务监管。

name: Sebastián Martínez Valdivia
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces documentary journalism and public health reporting, with interest in immigrant life in the rural Midwest.
summary_zh: 从事纪录新闻与公共卫生报道，关注美国中西部乡村的移民生活。

name: Nick Mathews
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies rural and local news and information ecosystems, centering audiences' lived experiences to improve news organizations' viability in their communities.
summary_zh: 研究乡村与地方新闻及信息生态，以受众的生活经验为中心，帮助新闻机构在社区中维持生存。

name: Cristina Mislán
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media history and how alternative media shape national and transnational dialogues on race, class, and gender, using critical/cultural approaches.
summary_zh: 运用批判/文化研究方法，研究媒介史以及另类媒体如何塑造关于种族、阶级与性别的国内与跨国对话。

name: Jeimmie Nevalga
title: Professor; News Director, KOMU
summary: Directs a university-run commercial TV newsroom and teaches newscast producing, drawing on experience producing local and election news coverage.
summary_zh: 主管一家大学运营的商业电视台新闻部并教授新闻节目制作，具有地方新闻与选举报道制作经验。

name: Earnest L. Perry
title: Associate Dean for Graduate Studies and Research; Professor
summary: Studies African American press history, especially the Black Press in the early 20th century, and media management and newsroom diversity, using historical research.
summary_zh: 运用历史研究方法研究非裔美国人报刊史（尤其是20世纪上半叶的黑人报刊）以及媒介管理与新闻编辑室多元化。

name: Jeannette H. Porter
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies African American communication about mental health and mental illness, aiming to increase mental health help-seeking.
summary_zh: 研究非裔美国人关于心理健康与精神疾病的传播，旨在提高心理健康求助行为。

name: Randy Reeves
title: Professor
summary: Teaches broadcast reporting, drawing on experience producing television newscasts and directing small-market radio news and sports.
summary_zh: 教授广播电视报道，借鉴其制作电视新闻节目及主管小市场电台新闻与体育报道的经验。

name: Susan Dixon Renoe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the broader societal impacts of research, institutional capacity for research engagement, and belonging in academia, linking science communication and research management.
summary_zh: 研究科研的更广泛社会影响、机构的科研参与能力以及学术界的归属感，连接科学传播与科研管理。

name: Shelly Rodgers
title: Professor
areas: Psychological Processing of Digital Health Messages
summary: Studies advertising and health communication, including artificial intelligence in advertising and the psychological processing of digital health messages.
summary_zh: 研究广告与健康传播，包括广告中的人工智能以及数字健康信息的心理加工。

name: Kathleen Rose
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies science and risk communication, including scientists' public engagement and public attitudes toward controversial scientific and environmental issues.
summary_zh: 研究科学与风险传播，包括科学家的公众参与以及公众对争议性科学与环境议题的态度。

name: Jennifer Rowe
title: Professor
summary: Teaches magazine journalism and edits a student city magazine, with interests in feature, service, and travel writing.
summary_zh: 教授杂志新闻并指导学生城市杂志的编辑，关注特稿、服务类与旅行写作。

name: Janet Saidi
title: Long-form audio producer; Associate Professor
summary: Produces long-form audio journalism and podcasts that build community, combining oral history with public radio reporting.
summary_zh: 制作长篇音频新闻与播客，以口述史与公共广播报道相结合的方式建立社区联结。

name: David Salisbury
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Teaches advertising copywriting and branding, drawing on agency experience building integrated campaigns and internal communication strategies.
summary_zh: 教授广告文案与品牌塑造，借鉴其在广告公司策划整合传播活动与内部传播策略的经验。

name: Jared Schroeder
title: Professor
summary: Studies First Amendment theory and law and press freedom, examining historical contexts and how AI, deepfakes, and social media challenge free expression.
summary_zh: 研究美国第一修正案理论与法律及新闻自由，考察历史背景以及人工智能、深度伪造与社交媒体对言论自由的挑战。

name: Amy Simons
title: Professor
summary: Teaches news literacy, multimedia journalism, and social media strategy, with expertise in online teaching and international training for journalists.
summary_zh: 教授新闻素养、多媒体新闻与社交媒体策略，擅长在线教学和面向记者的国际培训。

name: Kellie Stanfield
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies broadcast journalism education, developing a model for teaching skills, ethics, and theory to improve learning and self-efficacy, and also studies local and mobile news.
summary_zh: 研究广播新闻教育，构建教授技能、伦理与理论的教学模式以提升学习成效与自我效能，并研究地方与移动新闻。

name: Jon Stemmle
title: Professor
summary: Studies tailored health communication and community-based participatory research, including photovoice, along with employee and corporate communication.
summary_zh: 研究定制化健康传播与社区参与式研究（包括影像发声法），以及员工与企业传播。

name: Elizabeth Stephens
title: Professor
summary: Leads a student-staffed community newspaper as executive editor, focusing on community newspaper management and digital news practice.
summary_zh: 以执行总编身份领导学生运营的社区报纸，关注社区报纸管理与数字新闻实践。

name: Ron Stodghill
title: Professor
summary: Writes narrative nonfiction and service journalism, including books on Black colleges and culture, and teaches magazine and travel journalism.
summary_zh: 从事叙事性非虚构写作与服务类新闻，著有关于黑人大学与文化的著作，并教授杂志与旅行新闻。

name: Chau Tong
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Search Engines, Algorithms and Computational Social Science
summary: Studies how search engines, social platforms, and AI systems shape health and political information, using algorithm audits, NLP, surveys, and digital trace data.
summary_zh: 研究搜索引擎、社交平台与人工智能系统如何塑造健康与政治信息，采用算法审计、自然语言处理、调查与数字痕迹数据。

name: Yong Volz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalists as an occupational group in the U.S. and China, using historical and comparative sociology to trace gender, race, and social movements in journalistic identity.
summary_zh: 以历史与比较社会学方法研究中美记者作为职业群体的形成，考察性别、种族与社会运动对新闻职业身份的影响。

name: Tom Warhover
title: Associate Professor
summary: Teaches news reporting and editing, drawing on leadership of a community newspaper and early practice in public (civic) journalism.
summary_zh: 教授新闻采访与编辑，借鉴其领导社区报纸及早期践行公共（公民）新闻的经验。

name: Elizabeth Behm-Morawitz
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies how people process and respond to mediated messages across video games, VR, social media, and AI, focusing on identity, cognition, and behavior through effects studies.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何加工和回应电子游戏、虚拟现实、社交媒体与人工智能中的媒介信息，关注身份、认知与行为效果。

name: Debbie S. Dougherty
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between power and organizing, especially organizational culture and sexual harassment and social class.
summary_zh: 研究权力与组织过程的关系，尤其是组织文化与性骚扰以及社会阶层问题。

name: Rachael Hernandez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies communication about sensitive and stigmatized health topics, such as vaping and urinary tract infections, using interpretive qualitative methods informed by bioethics.
summary_zh: 以受生命伦理学启发的阐释性质性方法，研究关于电子烟、尿路感染等敏感和污名化健康话题的传播。

name: Haley Horstman
title: Professor, Director of International Programs
summary: Studies how families communicate to make sense of adversity and diversity, using narrative theory and methods in contexts such as miscarriage, adoption, and international families.
summary_zh: 运用叙事理论与方法，研究家庭如何通过沟通理解逆境与多样性，涉及流产、收养与跨国家庭等情境。

name: Brian Houston
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication across all phases of disasters and the mental health and political consequences of community crises, including media coverage of terrorism and resilience.
summary_zh: 研究灾害各阶段的传播以及社区危机带来的心理健康与政治后果，包括恐怖主义媒体报道与社区韧性。

name: Rebecca Meisenbach
title: Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies (DUGS)
summary: Studies marginalized identity and ethics in organizational life, including identity negotiation and her theory of stigma management communication.
summary_zh: 研究组织生活中的边缘化身份与伦理，包括身份协商及其提出的污名管理传播理论。

name: Yerina Ranjit
title: Associate Professor, Director of International Programs
summary: Works in health and crisis communication; the department profile gives no further detail on research focus or methods.
summary_zh: 从事健康与危机传播研究；院系简介未提供关于研究重点或方法的更多信息。

name: Julius M. Riles
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the interplay of media use and social relationships, including how portrayals of social groups shape perceptions and how parasocial relationships form, from a psychological view.
summary_zh: 从心理学视角研究媒介使用与社会关系的互动，包括社会群体的媒介呈现如何影响认知以及拟社会关系的形成。

name: Astrid Villamil
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication about diversity, equity, and inclusion using critical and interpretive perspectives, including transnational and intersectional organizing.
summary_zh: 运用批判与阐释视角研究多元、公平与包容的组织传播，包括跨国与交叉性的组织过程。

name: Ben Warner
title: Professor, Director of Faculty Awards, Director of Graduate Studies, Director of the Political Communication Institute
summary: Studies the effects of partisan media, presidential debates, campaign ads, and political humor, focusing on the causes, consequences, and remedies of political polarization.
summary_zh: 研究党派媒体、总统辩论、竞选广告与政治幽默的效果，聚焦政治极化的成因、后果与缓解途径。

name: Colleen Warner
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in diverse modern families, especially adoptive families and children's perceptions, and links family communication to religious and political identities.
summary_zh: 研究多样化现代家庭中的沟通，尤其是收养家庭与儿童的认知，并探讨家庭沟通与宗教和政治身份的关联。

name: Meryl Alper
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how disabled and autistic young people and their families use mobile and digital media, examining the social, cultural, and health implications of communication technologies.
summary_zh: 研究残障与自闭症青少年及其家庭如何使用移动与数字媒介，考察传播技术的社会、文化与健康影响。

name: Sangah Bae
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how people use and misuse social cues in the workplace and how these cues shape managerial decision-making, technology adoption, and equity in organizations.
summary_zh: 考察人们在职场中如何使用与误用社会线索，以及这些线索如何影响管理决策、技术采纳与组织公平。

name: Donathan Brown
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes the rhetoric of race and public policy in the US, including immigration reform, policing, voting rights, and the civil rights legacy, with a focus on political rhetoric and policy debates.
summary_zh: 分析美国种族与公共政策的修辞，涵盖移民改革、警务、投票权与民权遗产，聚焦政治修辞与政策辩论。

name: Patricia Davis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public memory, race, gender, and representation at the nexus of rhetoric and media, including African American cultural memory in the US South and rhetorics of respectability.
summary_zh: 在修辞与媒介研究的交汇处研究公共记忆、种族、性别与再现，包括美国南方的非裔美国人文化记忆与体面政治修辞。

name: Adriana de Souza e Silva
title: Professor, Director of the Center for Transformative Media
summary: Investigates how mobile and locative media, location-based games, and mobile media art shape urban mobility and interaction with public spaces, primarily in the Global South.
summary_zh: 研究移动与位置媒介、基于位置的游戏和移动媒体艺术如何塑造城市流动与公共空间互动，主要聚焦全球南方。

name: Smit Desai
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people understand, trust, and collaborate with conversational AI, using metaphor analysis and persona design to build voice and LLM agents for healthcare and aging.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何理解、信任并与对话式AI协作，运用隐喻分析与人设设计为医疗与老龄场景构建语音及大模型智能体。

name: Michael Ann Devito
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how trans and neurodivergent communities understand and adapt to algorithmic curation and content moderation, using grounded theory and participatory, community-centered design.
summary_zh: 研究跨性别与神经多样性社群如何理解并适应算法推荐与内容审核，采用扎根理论与参与式、以社群为中心的设计方法。

name: Ryan Ellis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication law and policy, infrastructure politics, and cybersecurity governance, tracing how infrastructure security and markets such as bug bounties are governed.
summary_zh: 研究传播法律与政策、基础设施政治与网络安全治理，追溯基础设施安全及漏洞赏金等市场如何被治理。

name: Laura Forlano
title: Professor
summary: Examines the politics of design and emerging technologies such as smart cities, automation, and wearable medical devices through participatory workshops and speculative prototypes.
summary_zh: 通过参与式工作坊与思辨原型，考察智慧城市、自动化与可穿戴医疗设备等设计与新兴技术的政治。

name: Brooke Foucault Welles
title: Senior Associate Dean for Academic Affairs, Professor
summary: Studies how online communication networks enable individual, team, and collective goals, including networked counterpublics and online activism, using network science and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用网络科学与计算方法，研究在线传播网络如何促成个人、团队与集体目标，包括网络化反公众与网络行动主义。

name: Diane Francis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how traditional and digital communication can reduce health disparities among Black populations, including social media and mental health and digital tools for Black maternal health.
summary_zh: 研究传统与数字传播策略如何减少黑人群体的健康差距，涉及社交媒体与心理健康以及服务黑人孕产健康的数字工具。

name: Katherine Haenschen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies digital media and politics, using experiments to test effects of digital communication on voter turnout and digital trace data to measure online political behavior.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒体与政治，运用实验检验数字传播对投票率的影响，并利用数字痕迹数据测量线上政治行为。

name: Heidi Kevoe-Feldman
title: Professor
summary: Uses conversation analysis of recorded calls to study how people manage action and crisis talk in 911 emergency dispatch, police negotiations, and customer service call centers.
summary_zh: 运用会话分析研究录音通话，考察人们在911紧急调度、警方危机谈判与客服呼叫中心中如何组织行动与危机对话。

name: Brennan Klein
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops network and complex-systems tools to study information and emergence in networks, applying them to data justice in the US criminal-legal system and to team coordination in elite sports.
summary_zh: 开发网络与复杂系统工具研究网络中的信息与涌现，并将其应用于美国刑事司法系统中的数据正义及精英体育的团队协作。

name: Catherine Lambert
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies science, risk, and environmental communication, examining how place-based relationships shape public responses to renewable and geothermal energy, natural hazards, and climate change.
summary_zh: 研究科学、风险与环境传播，考察基于地方的关系如何影响公众对可再生能源与地热开发、自然灾害及气候变化的反应。

name: Chuncheng Liu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the politics of data and classification in sociotechnical systems, using ethnography of China's social credit system, contact tracing, generative AI, and public health classification.
summary_zh: 研究社会技术系统中数据与分类的政治，以民族志考察中国社会信用体系、接触者追踪、生成式AI与公共卫生分类。

name: Amy Shirong Lu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychological, physiological, and behavioral effects of narrative games, XR, and apps as digital health interventions, especially for child obesity and physical activity.
summary_zh: 研究叙事游戏、XR与应用程序作为数字健康干预的心理、生理与行为效果，尤其关注儿童肥胖与身体活动。

name: Alina Ionica Lungeanu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Combines social and network science to study how team networks enable collaboration and innovation, including NASA simulated space-mission crews and cross-boundary science teams.
summary_zh: 结合社会科学与网络科学，研究团队网络如何促进协作与创新，包括NASA模拟太空任务团队与跨界科学团队。

name: Eileen McGivney
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Conducts design-based research on how people learn with virtual reality, examining how design features shape learners' agency, emotions, identities, and learning outcomes.
summary_zh: 开展基于设计的研究，探讨人们如何借助虚拟现实学习，考察设计特征如何影响学习者的能动性、情绪、身份与学习成效。

name: Susan Mello
title: Associate Professor, Interim Department Chair
summary: Studies how exposure to media risk information about COVID-19, environmental toxins, and cancer shapes risk perceptions and protective health behaviors, using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量方法，研究媒体中有关新冠、环境毒素与癌症的风险信息接触如何影响风险感知与健康防护行为。

name: Hristina Nikolova
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies dyadic and joint decision-making between partners and its influence on consumer behavior, along with data-driven consumer welfare interventions, using quantitative and qualitative research.
summary_zh: 运用定量与质性研究，探讨伴侣间的双人与共同决策如何影响消费行为，以及数据驱动的消费者福祉干预。

name: Matthew Nisbet
title: Professor
summary: Studies how publics and decision-makers come to understand complex science and technology issues such as climate change, analyzing the influence of ideas, expertise, journalism, and philanthropy.
summary_zh: 研究公众与决策者如何理解气候变化等复杂科技议题，分析观念、专业知识、新闻报道与慈善资助的影响。

name: Carey Noland
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational, interpersonal, and health communication.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播、人际传播与健康传播。

name: Beth Noveck
title: Director, Burnes Center for Social Change; Professor
summary: Studies institutional innovation and the responsible design of collective intelligence and AI to strengthen democratic institutions, open government, and public problem-solving.
summary_zh: 研究制度创新以及如何负责任地设计集体智慧与AI，以加强民主制度、开放政府与公共问题解决。

name: Joseph Reagle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies online culture and digital communities, including Wikipedia collaboration, online comments, life hacking, and geek feminism.
summary_zh: 研究网络文化与数字社群，包括维基百科协作、网络评论、生活黑客与极客女性主义。

name: Craig Robertson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history of information, tracing how paper technologies such as the filing cabinet shaped information, work, and organization, alongside DIY independent music culture.
summary_zh: 研究信息史，追溯文件柜等纸质技术如何塑造信息、工作与组织，同时关注DIY独立音乐文化。

name: Maria Elena Villar
title: Professor and Associate Director of CTM
summary: Studies strategic, health, and science communication with under-represented communities, co-creating fotonovelas, radio stories, and games on mental health stigma, violence, and vaccines.
summary_zh: 研究面向弱势社群的战略、健康与科学传播，与社区共创图片小说、广播故事与游戏，议题涉及心理健康污名、暴力与疫苗。

name: Lucas Wright
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies online trust and safety professionals and compliance vendors for content moderation and AI safety, using interviews, discourse analysis, and online field experiments.
summary_zh: 研究在线信任与安全从业者及内容审核、AI安全合规服务商，运用访谈、话语分析与在线田野实验。

name: Chunyan Wu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies digital communication, international and intercultural dynamics, and digital activism, using affective-discursive social media analysis of cases such as China's digital manosphere.
summary_zh: 研究数字传播、国际与跨文化动态及数字行动主义，运用情感-话语取向的社交媒体分析，如中国网络男性圈。

name: Seo Eun Yang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops deep learning, computer vision, NLP, and network methods to analyze visual and verbal political framing in news and photojournalism, and studies political neuroscience.
summary_zh: 开发深度学习、计算机视觉、自然语言处理与网络方法，分析新闻与新闻摄影中的视觉及语言政治框架，并研究政治神经科学。

name: Alan Zaremba
title: Associate Professor
areas: Critical analysis of theories supporting strategic ambiguity
Communications related to the May 1970 Kent State tragedy
summary: Studies organizational and crisis communication, critiques theories of strategic ambiguity, and examines sports fan subculture and communication surrounding the 1970 Kent State shootings.
summary_zh: 研究组织与危机传播，批判战略模糊理论，并考察体育迷亚文化及1970年肯特州立大学事件相关传播。

name: Rahul Bhargava
title: Associate Professor
summary: Builds creative data storytelling and computational journalism tools for social justice, including community data murals, AI civic technologies, and computational analyses of news coverage.
summary_zh: 为社会正义构建创意数据叙事与计算新闻工具，包括社区数据壁画、AI公民科技以及新闻报道的计算分析。

name: Myojung Chung
title: Associate Professor, Interim Associate Dean of Graduate Programs
summary: Studies the spread and consequences of misinformation on digital media and develops countermeasures, especially the role of AI and algorithmic literacy, from a media psychology perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介心理学视角研究数字媒体中虚假信息的传播与后果，并开发应对策略，尤其关注AI与算法素养的作用。

name: Caleb Gayle
title: Associate Professor, Associate Director
summary: Writes narrative journalism on the history of race and identity, drawing on reporting and oral histories with elders across the country.
summary_zh: 撰写关于种族与身份历史的叙事性新闻作品，依托实地报道与全国各地长者的口述史。

name: Meg Heckman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies feminist journalism history, recovering women's overlooked contributions with archival and computational methods, and researches solutions to local news deserts.
summary_zh: 研究女性主义新闻史，运用档案与计算方法挖掘女性被忽视的贡献，并探索应对本地新闻荒漠的解决方案。

name: Jeff Howe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes about crowdsourcing and massive online collaboration and how networked technologies are reshaping business and society.
summary_zh: 撰写关于众包与大规模在线协作的作品，探讨网络技术如何重塑商业与社会。

name: Chenyan Jia
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how emerging media technologies shape attitudes and behavior, how to align social media AI with democratic values, and how to mitigate misinformation, bridging mass communication and HCI.
summary_zh: 融合大众传播与人机交互，研究新兴媒介技术如何影响态度与行为、如何使社交媒体AI契合民主价值，以及如何遏制虚假信息。

name: Jonathan Kaufman
title: Director, Professor
areas: The Changing State of the News Media
summary: Focuses on the changing state of the news media, China, and race and class in America, drawing on a career in business and international journalism.
summary_zh: 关注新闻媒体的变迁、中国以及美国的种族与阶层问题，借鉴其商业与国际新闻从业经验。

name: Dan Kennedy
title: Professor
summary: Studies the future of local and community news, including media startups and news deserts, alongside media criticism, ethics, and the First Amendment.
summary_zh: 研究本地与社区新闻的未来，包括媒体初创与新闻荒漠，并关注媒介批评、伦理与第一修正案。

name: John P. Wihbey
title: Professor, Lab Director, Institute Co-Founder
summary: Studies AI and media, social media platform governance and free speech, and news and knowledge in networked environments, and builds AI literacy tools.
summary_zh: 研究AI与媒体、社交媒体平台治理与言论自由以及网络化环境中的新闻与知识，并开发AI素养工具。

name: Laura M. Arpan
title: Professor; Affiliated faculty member, Department of Environment and Sustainability; Faculty Affiliate, RENEW Institute
areas: responses to pro-environmental and health messages
adoption of sustainable energy sources and technologies related to energy use and sustainability
