summary: Studies attitudes, persuasion, and motivated reasoning in how people respond to pro-environmental and health messages and adopt sustainable energy technologies.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何回应环保与健康信息、如何采纳可持续能源技术，关注态度、说服与动机性推理。

name: Thomas Feeley
title: Associate Dean for Arts and Humanities; SUNY Distinguished Professor
summary: Measures and tests social influence processes in health and organizational contexts, including campaign effects on attitudes, organ donation education, and bibliometrics of academia.
summary_zh: 在健康与组织情境中测量和检验社会影响过程，包括传播运动对态度的效果、器官捐献教育以及学术界的文献计量研究。

name: Mark Frank
title: Professor
summary: Studies nonverbal communication, especially facial expressions, emotion, and deception detection in real-world settings, using the Facial Action Coding System.
summary_zh: 研究非语言传播，尤其是现实情境中的面部表情、情绪与欺骗识别，采用面部动作编码系统（FACS）。

name: Melanie Green
title: SUNY Distinguished Professor; Chair
areas: Media effects and media psychology (entertainment media)
summary: Develops transportation theory to explain how narratives and fiction shape real-world attitudes and behavior, applying it to health, prosocial outcomes, and women in STEM.
summary_zh: 发展叙事传输理论，解释叙事与虚构故事如何影响现实中的态度和行为，并应用于健康、亲社会结果及STEM领域女性议题。

name: Lindsay Hahn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how morally laden entertainment media affect children's social attitudes and examines moral appeals in extremist propaganda and mass shooter statements via content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究富含道德内容的娱乐媒介如何影响儿童的社会态度，并通过内容分析考察极端主义宣传和大规模枪击者陈述中的道德诉求。

name: Nojin Kwak
title: Professor
areas: Role of communication media in civic and political engagement
summary: Examines how social media, mobile phones, and other digital platforms shape civic engagement, deliberative openness, political persuasion, and political participation.
summary_zh: 考察社交媒体、移动电话等数字平台如何影响公民参与、协商开放性、政治说服与政治参与。

name: David Lee
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how everyday social interactions, social support, relationship construals, and social media use influence well-being and health, drawing on social psychology.
summary_zh: 借助社会心理学视角，研究日常社会互动、社会支持、关系认知与社交媒体使用如何影响幸福感与健康。

name: Yotam Ophir
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies misinformation, conspiracy theories, extremism, and public perceptions of science using surveys, experiments, and computational and network-based content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究虚假信息、阴谋论、极端主义与公众对科学的认知，采用调查、实验以及计算与网络分析驱动的内容分析。

name: Arthur A. Raney
title: Professor; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies why audiences enjoy and appreciate entertainment, the role of morality and moral emotions, and how eudaimonic, self-transcendent media experiences foster well-being.
summary_zh: 研究受众为何享受和欣赏娱乐内容、道德与道德情绪的作用，以及意义型与自我超越型媒介体验如何促进幸福感。

name: Lance Rintamaki
title: Associate Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies stigma management, social support in chronic illness, and sexual communication between partners, linking communication theory to health behavior outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究污名管理、慢性病中的社会支持以及伴侣间的性沟通，将传播理论与健康行为结果相联系。

name: Robin Schulze
title: Professor
summary: Studies strategic storytelling and the structures of effective narrative, drawing on textual scholarship and American literature, with attention to storytelling in an age of AI.
summary_zh: 研究战略性讲故事与有效叙事结构，借鉴文本学与美国文学研究，并关注人工智能时代的叙事。

name: Michael A. Stefanone
title: Professor; Director, Singapore Program
summary: Studies computer-mediated communication and social media use, examining effects on relationships, social capital, network awareness, selfie behavior, and online grieving.
summary_zh: 研究计算机中介传播与社交媒体使用，考察其对人际关系、社会资本、网络感知、自拍行为与网络哀悼的影响。

name: Kelly Tenzek
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study difficult dialogues in health and interpersonal contexts, especially end-of-life communication, aging, and medication safety in local communities.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究健康与人际情境中的艰难对话，尤其是临终沟通、老龄化以及社区中的用药安全。

name: Frank Tutzauer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies game theory, social network analysis, and mathematical modeling to strategic dynamics in conflict resolution, bargaining, and negotiation.
summary_zh: 运用博弈论、社会网络分析和数学建模研究冲突解决、讨价还价与谈判中的策略动态。

name: Hua "Helen" Wang
title: Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates entertainment-education and storytelling interventions for health promotion and social change with underserved communities around the world.
summary_zh: 与全球各地的弱势群体合作，设计并评估用于健康促进与社会变革的娱乐教育和讲故事干预项目。

name: Janet Yang
title: Professor; Editor, Science Communication
summary: Studies how risk perception shapes communication behavior and decisions on climate change, PFAS pollution, vaccination, and recycling, using surveys and survey experiments.
summary_zh: 研究风险感知如何影响人们在气候变化、PFAS污染、疫苗接种和回收等议题上的传播行为与决策，采用调查与调查实验。

name: Yini Zhang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political discourse on social media and public trust in AI, using computational and experimental methods to analyze how platforms and AI shape the information ecology.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上的政治话语及公众对人工智能的信任，运用计算与实验方法分析平台和人工智能如何塑造信息生态。

name: Yanmengqian (Alison) Zhou
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies persuasive health and risk messages and social support, especially how conflicting advice and recommendations affect attitudes, decisions, and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究健康与风险说服信息及社会支持，尤其关注相互矛盾的建议和推荐如何影响态度、决策与行为。

name: Doris Acheme
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies language attitudes toward non-U.S. accents and how African immigrants negotiate racial identity in the U.S., using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们对非美国口音的语言态度，以及非洲移民在美国如何协商种族身份，采用定量与质性方法。

name: Maryam Ahmadi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies rhetorical theory and historiography of empire and colonialism, political rhetoric, and social movements, including semicolonial rhetoric, through historical rhetorical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过历史修辞分析研究帝国与殖民主义的修辞理论与修辞史、政治修辞与社会运动，包括半殖民修辞。

name: Analisa Arroyo
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how communication in close and family relationships relates to body image, disordered eating, intergenerational mental health, and intergroup attitudes such as sexism and weightism.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系与家庭中的沟通如何关联身体意象、饮食失调、心理健康的代际传递，以及性别歧视、体重歧视等群际态度。

name: Barbara Biesecker
title: Professor, Affiliate Faculty, Institute for Women's Studies
summary: Theorizes rhetorical agency and social change by bringing rhetorical criticism into dialogue with continental philosophy, psychoanalysis, feminist theory, and visual and public memory studies.
summary_zh: 将修辞批评与欧陆哲学、精神分析、女性主义理论以及视觉与公共记忆研究对话，探讨修辞能动性与社会变革。

name: Jessica Chaplain
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies climate justice advocacy and transnational feminist and anti-colonial rhetorics, using critical rhetorical field methods at UN climate (UNFCCC) conferences.
summary_zh: 运用批判修辞田野方法，在联合国气候大会（UNFCCC）中研究气候正义倡导及跨国女性主义与反殖民修辞。

name: Hoda Fakhari
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how complex and uncertain health, risk, and science information is communicated to and processed by different audiences, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 采用混合方法，研究复杂且不确定的健康、风险与科学信息如何传达给不同受众并被其理解和处理。

name: Kelly Happe
title: Professor, Core Faculty, Institute for Women's and Gender Studies
summary: Develops rhetorical and critical theory of science and medicine, examining how genetics, epigenetics, and biopolitics produce meanings of race, gender, and difference under capitalism.
summary_zh: 发展关于科学与医学的修辞与批判理论，考察遗传学、表观遗传学与生命政治如何在资本主义下生产种族、性别与差异的意义。

name: Soroya Mcfarlane
title: Associate Professor, Associate Head of Department
summary: Designs and evaluates culturally targeted, community-engaged interventions to reduce health disparities, focusing on women's sexual and reproductive health and clinical trial communication.
summary_zh: 设计并评估具有文化针对性、社区参与式的传播干预以减少健康差距，聚焦女性性与生殖健康及临床试验传播。

name: Mackensie Minniear
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses critical and intergroup theories to study how family communication, including ethnic-racial socialization, shapes marginalized families and health disparities for women of color.
summary_zh: 运用批判与群际理论，研究包括族裔-种族社会化在内的家庭沟通如何塑造边缘化家庭及有色人种女性的健康差距。

name: Chelsea Ratcliff
title: Associate Professor, Undergraduate Coordinator
areas: Communicating uncertain science to the public
summary: Examines how to communicate complex and uncertain scientific evidence on health, genetics, vaccines, and climate to diverse publics, using quantitative message-effects research.
summary_zh: 通过定量的信息效果研究，考察如何向多元公众传达关于健康、基因、疫苗与气候的复杂且不确定的科学证据。

name: Roger Stahl
title: Professor
summary: Studies propaganda, militainment, and the visual culture of war and state violence through critical rhetorical and media analysis and documentary filmmaking.
summary_zh: 通过批判修辞与媒介分析以及纪录片创作，研究宣传、军事娱乐化以及战争与国家暴力的视觉文化。

name: Anna Stenport
title: Dean of the Franklin College of Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies Arctic and Nordic cinema, media, and culture, including media sovereignty and the climate crisis in new Arctic cinemas, through humanistic film and cultural analysis.
summary_zh: 通过人文的电影与文化分析，研究北极与北欧电影、媒介与文化，包括新北极电影中的媒介主权与气候危机。

name: Belinda Stillion Southard
title: Professor, Department Head
summary: Studies women's agency, belonging, transnationalism, and social movements such as the Greenham Common peace camp through feminist rhetorical criticism and public address.
summary_zh: 以女性主义修辞批评与公共演说研究，考察女性能动性、归属、跨国主义以及格林汉姆公地和平营等社会运动。

name: Bjørn Stillion Southard
title: Associate Professor, Director of Debate
summary: Studies early U.S. public address on race, slavery, and law, including the African colonization movement and Frederick Douglass, through historical rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 通过历史修辞批评研究美国早期关于种族、奴隶制与法律的公共演说，包括非洲殖民运动与弗雷德里克·道格拉斯。

name: Ye Sun
title: Professor
summary: Examines the social-psychological processes that shape how people engage with scientific evidence in public health, environmental risk, and science communication.
summary_zh: 考察影响人们如何对待科学证据的社会心理过程，涉及公共卫生、环境风险与科学传播。

name: Sachiko Terui
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language and culture shape health messages, illness experiences, and patient-provider and family health interactions, using mixed methods to address health literacy and disparities.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法，研究语言与文化如何影响健康信息、疾病经验以及医患与家庭中的健康互动，以应对健康素养与健康差距问题。

name: Carolina Acosta-Alzuru
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies telenovelas, Turkish dramas, and the ties between melodrama, culture, and society, especially in Venezuela, through critical cultural studies and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 通过批判文化研究与质性方法，研究拉美电视剧、土耳其剧集以及情节剧与文化和社会的关联，尤其关注委内瑞拉。

name: Sun Joo (Grace) Ahn
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Director of the CACHE Lab; Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies how virtual reality, video games, social media, and virtual agents shape attitudes and behaviors in health, consumer, conservation, and education contexts.
summary_zh: 研究虚拟现实、电子游戏、社交媒体与虚拟代理如何在健康、消费、环保与教育情境中塑造人们的态度与行为。

name: Karin Assmann
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Journalism
summary: Studies news production and how journalists respond to change, including newsroom unionization, attacks on the press, and local news deserts in the rural U.S. and Germany, using qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究新闻生产及记者如何应对变化，包括新闻编辑室工会化、针对新闻界的攻击，以及美国乡村与德国的本地新闻荒漠。

name: Laurena Bernabo
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies television and media industries, including industry responses to Black Lives Matter and AI's role in global media flows, through interviews with media professionals and textual analysis.
summary_zh: 通过访谈媒体从业者与文本分析，研究电视与媒介产业，包括行业对“黑人的命也是命”运动的回应以及AI在全球媒介流动中的作用。

name: Michael Cacciatore
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Co-Director, Center for Health & Risk Communication; Professor; Assistant Department Head, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies science and risk communication, tracking media and social media coverage of issues like nanotechnology, food safety, and climate change and how values shape public opinion.
summary_zh: 研究科学与风险传播，追踪纳米技术、食品安全、气候变化等议题的媒体与社交媒体报道，以及价值观如何影响舆论形成。

name: Zifei “Fay” Chen
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies corporate communication, including corporate social responsibility and advocacy, startup and entrepreneurial PR, AI in public relations, and prosocial communication.
summary_zh: 研究企业传播，包括企业社会责任与企业倡导、初创企业与创业公关、AI在公共关系中的应用以及亲社会传播。

name: Shira Chess
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies historical and contemporary digital culture, including magical thinking about technology, 1990s cyberculture, women's video game play, and internet folklore like Slender Man.
summary_zh: 研究历史与当代数字文化，包括对技术的魔幻思维、1990年代赛博文化、女性的电子游戏休闲以及“瘦长鬼影”等网络传说。

name: David Clementson
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Runs experiments on whether audiences detect politicians and spokespersons dodging questions and deceiving in media interviews, including during corporate crises.
summary_zh: 通过实验研究受众能否察觉政治人物与企业发言人在媒体采访中回避问题和欺骗，包括企业危机情境。

name: Joshua Cloudy
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies how digital media fuel intergroup hate and distrust, examining online group communication, mediated intergroup contact, and interventions to reduce polarization.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒介如何加剧群体间仇恨与不信任，考察网络群体传播、媒介化群际接触以及减少极化的干预措施。

name: Charles N. Davis
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Grady College Dean, Professor, Journalism
summary: Focuses on freedom of information and press access, drawing on a journalism career and leadership of the National Freedom of Information Coalition.
summary_zh: 关注信息自由与新闻采访权，其背景包括新闻从业经历及曾领导全国信息自由联盟。

name: Nathaniel J. Evans
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Extends persuasion and information-processing theories to how consumers recognize covert advertising such as native ads, influencer ads, and advergames, with regulatory implications.
summary_zh: 将说服与信息处理理论拓展到消费者如何识别原生广告、网红广告、广告游戏等隐性广告，并探讨其监管意义。

name: Matthew Nolte Evans
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Writes and develops film and television screenplays as a creative practitioner, with teaching centered on screenwriting.
summary_zh: 作为创作实践者撰写并开发电影与电视剧本，教学以编剧为核心。

name: Jay Hamilton
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Department Head; Professor; Jim Kennedy New Media Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies the history, theory, and practice of alternative media and democratic communication, developing historicizing critiques for the digital era.
summary_zh: 研究另类媒介与民主传播的历史、理论与实践，为数字时代发展历史化的批判。

name: Jeong-Yeob Han
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor; Director of Strategic Health & Risk Communication Program; Director of Analytics, Insights, & Measurement (AIM) Club, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies strategic health communication campaigns and how communication technologies affect audience engagement and health outcomes, emphasizing message testing and health disparities.
summary_zh: 研究策略性健康传播运动，以及传播技术如何影响受众参与和健康结果，重视信息测试与健康差距。

name: Itai Himelboim
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Thomas C. Dowden Professor of Media Analytics; Director of the SEE Suite: Social media Engagement & Evaluation; Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Applies network analysis to social media to study political talk, information flow, news, and international communication, identifying hubs and information-source patterns.
summary_zh: 运用网络分析研究社交媒体上的政治讨论、信息流动、新闻与国际传播，识别枢纽用户与信息来源模式。

name: Yan Jin
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: C. Richard Yarbrough Professor in Crisis Communication Leadership; Professor of Public Relations; Director of Crisis Communication Think Tank; Associate Director of Center for Health & Risk Communication, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Develops crisis and risk communication theory, examining the role of emotions and social media in organizational crises, disasters, and public health emergencies.
summary_zh: 发展危机与风险传播理论，考察情绪与社交媒体在组织危机、灾害及公共卫生突发事件中的作用。

name: Jeffrey P. Jones
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Executive Director Peabody Awards, Lambdin Kay Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies television, political satire, and parody, examining how entertainment television shapes popular politics and civic engagement.
summary_zh: 研究电视、政治讽刺与戏仿，考察娱乐电视如何塑造大众政治与公民参与。

name: Anandam Kavoori
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Works in transnational cultural studies on global media, television, and Bollywood, and now pursues autoethnographic and narrative nonfiction writing.
summary_zh: 从事跨国文化研究，关注全球媒介、电视与宝莱坞，目前从事自我民族志与叙事非虚构写作。

name: Jooyoung Kim
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Executive Director, James M. Cox Jr. Center for International Mass Communication Training and Research; Dan Magill Georgia Athletic Association Professor in Sports Communications; Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies advertising and branding in digitally networked, AI-driven environments, developing the Connectism framework linking individual user experience to collective brand experience.
summary_zh: 研究数字网络化与AI驱动环境中的广告与品牌，提出“连接主义”框架，将个体用户体验与集体品牌体验相连。

name: Nathaniel H. Kohn
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor; Director, Cannes Lions Program, Entertainment and Media StudiesMaster of Fine Arts in Film, Television and Digital Media
summary: Studies celebrity, screenwriting, autobiography, and critical tourism through cultural studies, critical theory, and new ethnography, while producing film and television.
summary_zh: 通过文化研究、批判理论与新民族志研究名人、编剧、自传与批判旅游，同时制作电影与电视作品。

name: Neil Landau
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor; MFA in Film, Television and Digital Media, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Writes and produces film, television, and animated feature screenplays as a creative practitioner and teaches screenwriting.
summary_zh: 作为创作实践者撰写并制作电影、电视与动画长片剧本，并教授编剧。

name: Mengqi Liao
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychological effects of AI systems, social media, mobile devices, and VR on persuasion, privacy, misinformation susceptibility, and trust using experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验与计算方法，研究AI系统、社交媒体、移动设备和VR对说服、隐私、虚假信息易感性与信任的心理影响。

name: Kyser Lough
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor; Director, News Literacy Certificate, Journalism
summary: Studies photojournalism and visual communication, including how news images are made, selected, and interpreted, and how solutions journalism is conceptualized and practiced.
summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影与视觉传播，包括新闻图片如何被制作、选择与解读，以及解困式新闻如何被概念化与实践。

name: Jessica Maddox
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies content creators, influencers, and social media platforms, examining pop culture, creator labor, virality and scandal, and animal images in digital life.
summary_zh: 研究内容创作者、网红与社交媒体平台，考察流行文化、创作者劳动、走红与丑闻以及数字生活中的动物图像。

name: Booker T. Mattison
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Writes and directs feature films, streaming television movies, and documentaries as a screenwriter, director, and novelist.
summary_zh: 作为编剧、导演与小说家，创作并执导剧情长片、流媒体电视电影与纪录片。

name: Juan Meng
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: UGA Athletic Association Endowed Professor; Department Head; Professor; Director, Cannes Lions Program, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies public relations leadership and leadership development, diversity in PR leadership, PR measurement, reputation management, and global communication.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系领导力及其培养、公关领导层多元化、公关效果测量、声誉管理与全球传播。

name: Lauren Musgrove
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Creates documentary and narrative films exploring vulnerability and inspiration, often involving scientific research and fantastical imagery, with attention to sustainable production.
summary_zh: 创作纪录片与剧情片，探讨人的脆弱与灵感，常融入科学研究与奇幻意象，并关注可持续的制作方式。

name: Susan Noh
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Studies global media and digital platforms, including how streaming services reshape Japanese anime production and U.S. consumption and how marginalized communities build belonging online.
summary_zh: 研究全球媒介与数字平台，包括流媒体服务如何重塑日本动画的生产及其在美国的消费，以及边缘群体如何在网上建立归属感。

name: Glen Nowak
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Jim Kennedy New Media Professor; Associate Dean for Research and Graduate Studies; Co-Director of Center for Health & Risk Communication; Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies health and risk communication, including immunization campaigns, health messaging, news media, and provider-patient communication, informed by long CDC experience.
summary_zh: 研究健康与风险传播，包括免疫接种宣传、健康信息、新闻媒体与医患沟通，并借鉴在美国疾控中心的长期经验。

name: Jonathan Peters
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Dean for Academic Affairs, Carolyn McKenzie and Don E. Carter Chair for Excellence in Journalism, Professor, Journalism
summary: Studies media law and policy, examining how technological and political forces reshape press and free expression law, including international and comparative work on media freedom.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法律与政策，考察技术与政治力量如何重塑新闻与言论自由法律，并开展媒介自由的国际与比较研究。

name: Ivanka Pjesivac
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Head, Department of Journalism; Director, James M. Cox Jr. Center for International Mass Communication Training and Research; Professor, Journalism
summary: Studies international and cross-cultural journalism, news trust and credibility across countries, and the cognitive and emotional effects of digital and immersive news content.
summary_zh: 研究国际与跨文化新闻、跨国新闻信任与可信度，以及数字与沉浸式新闻内容的认知和情绪效果。

name: Lance Porter
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Karen W. and Daniel J. King Distinguished Professor in Advertising, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies emerging and social media, brand activism, and power, drawing on digital marketing practice to evaluate creative brand strategies.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒介与社交媒体、品牌行动主义与权力，并借鉴数字营销实践评估创意品牌策略。

name: Glenna Read
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor of Advertising, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Uses psychophysiological and neuroscience methods to study cognitive and emotional processing of mediated representations of identity and prosocial health messaging.
summary_zh: 运用心理生理与神经科学方法，研究人们对媒介中身份再现与亲社会健康信息的认知与情绪加工。

name: Welch Suggs
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Journalism
summary: Studies the intersection of education, media, policy, and sport, focusing on college athletics policy, women's sports and Title IX, and how sports media work with sources.
summary_zh: 研究教育、媒介、政策与体育的交叉，聚焦大学体育政策、女子体育与第九条法案，以及体育媒体如何与信源打交道。

name: Ruoyu Sun
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies corporate communication and stakeholder relationships, including CSR and advocacy, crisis-induced organizational change, misinformation sharing on social media, and AI in marketing.
summary_zh: 研究企业传播与利益相关者关系，包括企业社会责任与倡导、危机引发的组织变革、社交媒体上的虚假信息分享以及营销中的AI。

name: LaTonya Taylor
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Uses qualitative and critical rhetorical methods to study public relations history, the Civil Rights Movement, public memory, higher education PR, and crisis communication.
summary_zh: 运用质性与批判修辞方法，研究公共关系史、民权运动、公共记忆、高校公关与危机传播。

name: Denetra Walker
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Journalism
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study race and media, especially the experiences of Black and underrepresented journalists, social justice coverage, and racialized mis/disinformation.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究种族与媒介，尤其关注黑人及代表性不足记者的经历、社会正义报道以及种族化的虚假信息。

name: Carla White
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies internal and leadership communication, employee engagement, and organization-stakeholder relationships in contemporary workplaces.
summary_zh: 研究当代职场中的内部传播与领导沟通、员工敬业度以及组织与利益相关者的关系。

name: Keith Wilson
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Entertainment and Media Studies
summary: Produces and directs documentary films and live documentary performances that screen at international festivals and museums.
summary_zh: 制作并执导在国际电影节与博物馆放映的纪录片和现场纪录表演。

name: Bartosz Wojdynski
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Jim Kennedy New Media Professor; Director of the Digital Media Attention and Cognition (DMAC) Lab; Professor, Journalism
summary: Runs experiments with eye-tracking and response-time measures to study how digital media design, interactivity, and navigability affect attention, cognition, and recall.
summary_zh: 运用眼动追踪与反应时测量开展实验，研究数字媒介的设计、交互性与可导航性如何影响注意、认知与记忆。

name: Hye Jin Yoon
dept: Grady College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Jim Kennedy New Media Professor; Professor, Advertising, Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies humor effects and schema incongruity processing in advertising, plus health, environmental, and digital advertising, also using network and sentiment analysis.
summary_zh: 研究广告中的幽默效果与图式不一致加工，以及健康、环境与数字广告，并运用网络分析与情感分析。

name: Marcia DiStaso
title: Associate Dean for Graduate Studies and Research; Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies corporate purpose, investor relations and financial communication, and how companies use digital and social media to engage stakeholders.
summary_zh: 研究企业使命、投资者关系与金融传播，以及企业如何利用数字与社交媒体与利益相关者沟通。

name: Matthew Barnidge
title: Associate Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies how media technologies and online platforms shape political information flows and the emergence of new ideas and ideologies.
summary_zh: 研究媒介技术与网络平台如何塑造政治信息流动以及新观念和意识形态的兴起。

name: Lindita Camaj
title: Associate Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies journalism, technology and politics in emerging democracies of Southeast Europe, focusing on citizen engagement with quality news and civic behavior.
summary_zh: 研究东南欧等新兴民主国家中的新闻、技术与政治，关注公民对优质新闻的参与及其公民行为。

name: Huan Chen
title: Chair and Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies AI in advertising, cultural and social media dynamics, consumer behavior and digital marketing, and AI in education and learning.
summary_zh: 研究广告中的人工智能、文化与社交媒体动态、消费者行为与数字营销，以及人工智能在教育与学习中的应用。

name: Haoran “Chris” Chu
title: Associate Professor - Department of Public Relations; Graduate Coordinator - Science and Health Communication; Affiliate Scholar - Internal Communication Research Hub
summary: Studies how people perceive and act on health and environmental risks, including infectious disease prevention and sustainability, and how AI may shape public health messaging.
summary_zh: 研究公众如何感知并应对健康与环境风险（如传染病防控与可持续发展），以及人工智能如何影响公共卫生传播。

name: Roxane Coche
title: Chair and Associate Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies sports journalism and media coverage of international sporting events, including press conferences and newspaper coverage of women's sports.
summary_zh: 研究体育新闻与国际体育赛事报道，包括新闻发布会以及报纸对女子体育的报道。

name: Francis Dalisay
title: Associate Professor - Department of Public Relations, STEM Translational Communication Center
summary: Studies youth substance use prevention, health and cancer disparities, and community engagement in the U.S.-Affiliated Pacific Islands through formative and intervention research.
summary_zh: 研究美国附属太平洋岛屿地区的青少年物质使用预防、健康与癌症差异及社区参与，开展形成性研究与干预研究。

name: Juliana Fernandes
title: Associate Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies the uses and effects of negative information in persuasive messages and how social and traditional media serve as strategic tools in political campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究负面信息在说服性信息中的使用与效果，以及社交媒体和传统媒体如何作为政治竞选的战略工具。

name: Rebecca Frazer
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies how people process and respond to narrative media, from entertainment TV to terrorist propaganda, using experiments informed by moral psychology.
summary_zh: 运用以道德心理学为视角的实验，研究人们如何加工和回应叙事性媒介，涵盖娱乐电视到恐怖主义宣传。

name: J. Robyn Goodman
title: Associate Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Works in advertising, health and visual communication; her dissertation examined how media images of ultra-thin women shape body image and eating disorder-related behaviors.
summary_zh: 从事广告、健康与视觉传播研究；其博士论文考察了媒体中极瘦女性形象如何影响女性的身体意象及与进食障碍相关的行为。

name: Rachel Grant
title: Associate Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies race, gender and class in media, Black feminism and social movements through critical and historical analysis of news, TV and Black Twitter activism.
summary_zh: 通过对新闻、电视和黑人推特行动主义的批判与历史分析，研究媒介中的种族、性别与阶级、黑人女性主义及社会运动。

name: Jeongmin Ham
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies new media advertising and human-computer interaction, especially how AI- and human-driven virtual humans use storytelling to shape brand perceptions.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体广告与人机交互，尤其关注由AI或真人驱动的虚拟人如何借助叙事提升品牌认知。

name: Eugy Han
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies social interaction in immersive virtual and mixed reality environments and how physical, virtual and social context shapes these interactions.
summary_zh: 研究沉浸式虚拟现实与混合现实环境中的社会互动，以及物理、虚拟与社会情境如何塑造这些互动。

name: Antoine Haywood
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies how communities use local media infrastructure such as community video, radio and press to build identity and civic life, via community-engaged participatory research.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究，考察社区如何利用社区视频、电台和报刊等本地媒介基础设施建构地方认同与公民生活。

name: Jay Hmielowski
title: Associate Professor - Department of Public Relations; Graduate Coordinator - Public Relations
summary: Studies why messages succeed or fail at changing attitudes on environmental, science and political issues, and how attitudes drive information seeking and media avoidance.
summary_zh: 研究信息为何能或不能改变人们在环境、科学与政治议题上的态度，以及态度如何影响信息寻求与媒体回避。

name: Austin Hubner
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies how communicator cues shape perceived expertise, credibility and trust in scientists and medical authorities, including science-related populism.
summary_zh: 研究传播者线索如何影响公众对科学家与医疗权威的专业性、可信度与信任判断，包括科学民粹主义。

name: Myiah Hutchens
title: Chair and Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies how communication helps or hinders democratic processes, focusing on why people seek out disagreeing views and how they process political disagreement.
summary_zh: 研究传播如何促进或阻碍民主进程，关注人们为何寻求不同意见以及如何处理政治分歧。

name: Bobi Ivanov
title: Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies persuasion and resistance to persuasion, developing inoculation theory and message design across commercial, health, political and crisis contexts.
summary_zh: 研究说服与抵制说服，在商业、健康、政治与危机等情境中发展免疫理论与信息设计。

name: Benjamin Johnson
title: Director - STEM Translational Communication Center; Associate Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies why and how people select and share persuasive messages on new media, focusing on impression management, social comparison and self-regulation.
summary_zh: 研究人们为何以及如何在新媒体上选择与分享说服性信息，关注印象管理、社会比较与自我调节。

name: Tom Kelleher
title: Professor - Department of Advertising; Associate Dean for Academic Affairs - UF Graduate School
summary: Studies public relations and advertising communication by organizations, including consumer responses to chatbots and the perceived humanness of online organizational agents.
summary_zh: 研究组织的公共关系与广告传播，包括消费者对聊天机器人的反应及线上组织代理的拟人感知。

name: Spiro K. Kiousis
title: Executive Associate Dean; Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies political public relations and the interplay among public relations efforts, news media content and public opinion in domestic and global contexts.
summary_zh: 研究政治公共关系，以及公关活动、新闻媒体内容与公众舆论在国内及全球情境中的相互作用。

name: Yu-Hao Lee
title: Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies the effects and design of immersive media such as video games, streaming and VR to promote better decisions and prosocial behavior.
summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、网络直播和虚拟现实等沉浸式媒介的效果与设计，以促进更好的决策与亲社会行为。

name: Jiawei Liu
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Advertising, STEM Translational Communication Center
summary: Studies health communication and disease prevention by examining the content and effects of mass media, social media and AI-mediated public health messages.
summary_zh: 通过考察大众媒体、社交媒体及AI中介的公共卫生信息的内容与效果，研究健康传播与疾病预防。

name: Wenlin Liu
title: Associate Professor - Department of Public Relations
summary: Studies multiethnic community building, organization-public relationships, public agencies' social media disaster communication, and COVID-19 vaccine acceptance.
summary_zh: 研究多族裔社区建设、组织与公众关系、公共机构借助社交媒体开展的灾害传播，以及新冠疫苗接受度。

name: Jasmine McNealy
title: Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology; Director - Infrastructure for Communities, Ecology for Data (ICED) Hub
summary: Studies information, communication and technology with a view toward law and policy, focusing on privacy, online media and communities.
summary_zh: 研究信息、传播与技术以影响法律和政策，聚焦隐私、网络媒体与社区。

name: Linjuan Rita Men
title: Professor - Department of Public Relations; Director - Internal Communication Research Hub
summary: Studies internal communication, leadership communication, emerging technologies and entrepreneurial communication in corporations and startups.
summary_zh: 研究企业与初创公司中的内部传播、领导力传播、新兴技术与创业传播。

name: Won-Ki Moon
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies how people and institutions judge the trustworthiness and legitimacy of AI and algorithmic communication, including responsible AI and AI-driven advertising.
summary_zh: 研究个人与机构如何评判人工智能与算法传播的可信度和正当性，包括负责任AI与AI驱动的广告。

name: Cynthia R. Morton Padovano
title: Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies cognitive processing, communication effects and message persuasion in social issue advocacy, health communication and cross-cultural audiences.
summary_zh: 研究社会议题倡导、健康传播及跨文化受众情境中的认知加工、传播效果与信息说服。

name: Seungahn Nah
title: Dianne Snedaker Chair in Media Trust and Research Director - Consortium on Trust in Media and Technology; Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies how digital and AI-enabled communication and media credibility shape community storytelling, news trust and civic engagement across diverse communities.
summary_zh: 研究数字与AI传播技术及媒体可信度如何影响多元社群中的社区叙事、新闻信任与公民参与。

name: David H. Ostroff
title: Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies the historical and contemporary telecommunications policy process and how policy actors respond to emerging technologies, including in the European Union.
summary_zh: 研究历史与当代的电信政策过程及政策参与者如何应对新兴技术，包括欧盟的情况。

name: Jieun Shin
title: Associate Professor - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies social media dynamics, especially how misinformation spreads online and the role of fact-checking.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体动态，尤其是虚假信息如何在网上传播以及事实核查的作用。

name: Yuan Sun
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies how AI reshapes advertising and human-technology interaction, focusing on how people calibrate trust in conversational and agentic AI.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能如何重塑广告与人机互动，关注人们如何校准对对话式与智能体AI的信任。

name: Frank Waddell
title: Associate Professor and Associate Chair - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies the psychology of new technology and online storytelling, including automated news, online comments and social television.
summary_zh: 研究新技术与网络叙事的心理学，包括自动化新闻、网络评论与社交电视。

name: Kim Walsh-Childers
title: Professor - Department of Journalism
summary: Studies how news media cover health, how audiences use health news, its influence on health policy, and media effects on adolescent sexual health.
summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体如何报道健康议题、公众如何使用健康新闻、其对健康政策的影响，以及媒介对青少年性健康的影响。

name: Jinping Wang
title: Assistant Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies how affordances of new media technologies shape communication behaviors and the effectiveness of persuasive messages, including health and social media persuasion.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体技术的可供性如何塑造传播行为与说服效果，包括健康传播与社交媒体中的说服。

name: Kasey Windels
title: Associate Professor - Department of Advertising
summary: Studies the advertising industry, especially creativity inside agencies and practitioner perspectives on how advertising works.
summary_zh: 研究广告行业，尤其是广告公司内部的创意以及从业者对广告运作方式的看法。

name: Kun Xu
title: Director - CJC Research Lab and Media Effects and Technology Lab (METL); Associate Professor in Emerging Technologies - Department of Media Production, Management, and Technology
summary: Studies how people perceive and interact with social robots, virtual agents and VR/AR, using lab experiments, psychophysiology and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验室实验、心理生理测量和计算方法，研究人们如何感知并与社交机器人、虚拟代理及VR/AR互动。

name: Leila Bighash
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how information visibility in organizations shapes uncertainty, privacy, and expertise recognition using experiments, surveys, network analysis, and digital trace data.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的信息可见性如何影响不确定性、隐私与专长识别，采用实验、调查、社会网络分析和数字痕迹数据。

name: Joseph Bonito
title: Professor
areas: Research methods related to the study of small groups
Machine learning applications to small group interaction
summary: Studies participation and interaction processes in small groups, developing multilevel measurement models and applying machine learning to group interaction data.
summary_zh: 研究小群体中的参与与互动过程，发展多层测量模型，并将机器学习应用于群体互动数据。

name: Jake Harwood
title: Professor; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies intergroup communication, especially across age groups and through music, and uses LLM-based text coding and agent-based modeling of communication processes.
summary_zh: 研究群际传播，尤其关注年龄群体之间以及音乐在群际关系中的作用，并使用大语言模型文本编码和基于主体的建模。

name: Kate Kenski
title: Professor
summary: Studies political communication, public opinion, and election campaigns, including social media incivility and gender and politics, using large-scale election surveys and platform development.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、舆论与选举竞选，包括社交媒体不文明言论及性别与政治，采用大规模选举调查并开发在线平台。

name: Matthew A. Lapierre
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media effects on the health and well-being of children and families, including advertising and persuasion awareness, parental mediation, and media influences on gun attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对儿童与家庭健康和福祉的影响，包括广告与说服认知、父母对子女媒介使用的介导以及媒介对枪支态度的影响。

name: Rain Wuyu Liu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies persuasion and social norm messaging in health and environmental behavior change, including cultural values and campaign design; contributed to an NSF-funded study among Tibetan herders.
summary_zh: 研究健康与环境行为改变中的说服与社会规范信息，关注文化价值观与传播运动设计，并参与过多项资助项目，如一项针对藏族牧民的NSF研究。

name: Tae Joon Moon
title: Assistant Professor; Endowed Professorship in Alcohol Studies and Communication
summary: Designs, develops, and implements technology-enhanced interventions, such as remote biosensors and mobile health apps, for people affected by alcohol and substance use disorders.
summary_zh: 设计、开发并实施面向酒精与物质使用障碍人群的技术增强干预，如远程生物传感器和移动健康应用。

name: Margaret J. Pitts
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study positive communication, such as savoring, that enhances relational wellbeing in interpersonal, intercultural, and aging contexts.
summary_zh: 运用质性方法研究促进关系福祉的积极传播（如传播回味），关注人际、跨文化及老龄化情境。

name: Steve Rains
title: Professor
summary: Studies how messages influence people in health and technology contexts, focusing on social support, digital coping, incivility, and persuasion resistance with computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究信息在健康与技术情境中如何影响人们，聚焦社会支持、数字应对、不文明言论和说服抵抗，并运用计算社会科学方法。

name: Chris Segrin
title: Regents Professor; Steve and Nancy Lynn Professor of Communication
summary: Studies interpersonal relationships and mental health, examining social skills, relationship satisfaction, and problems such as depression, loneliness, and marital distress.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系与心理健康，考察社交技能、关系满意度以及抑郁、孤独和婚姻困扰等问题。

name: Jennifer Stevens Aubrey
title: Department Head; Professor
summary: Studies media effects on young people's emotional, mental, and physical health, focusing on gender, sexuality, and body image, including content analyses of TikTok and Instagram.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对青少年情绪、心理与身体健康的影响，聚焦性别、性与身体意象，包括对TikTok和Instagram的内容分析。

name: Rita Tang
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Studies how people encounter, evaluate, and correct misinformation on social media and develop AI literacy, using experiments, surveys, computational methods, and interviews.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社交媒体上接触、评估和纠正虚假信息以及形成AI素养，采用实验、调查、计算方法和访谈。

name: Mark Aakhus
title: Professor of Communication
areas: AI, Data Science, and Social Computing
summary: Studies argumentation and communication design in digital society, including AI and accountable algorithmic systems, using discourse analysis, digital ethnography, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用话语分析、数字民族志与计算方法，研究数字社会中的论辩与传播设计，包括人工智能与可问责的算法系统。

name: Galina Bolden
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how speakers build mutual understanding and relationships in Russian and English talk-in-interaction using conversation analysis.
summary_zh: 运用会话分析方法，研究俄语与英语日常及机构互动中人们如何达成相互理解并建构人际关系。

name: Marya L. Doerfel
title: Professor of Communication and Chair of Communication
summary: Studies community resilience by analyzing how interorganizational network relationships respond to disruptions, using social network analysis and theory building.
summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与理论建构，研究组织间网络关系如何应对冲击并塑造社区韧性。

name: J. Sophia Fu
title: Associate Professor of Communication
areas: AI, Data Science, and Social Computing
summary: Studies hybrid organizing, examining how nonprofits and social actors integrate competing goals, platforms, and institutional logics, using network and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用网络与计算方法，研究非营利组织等社会行动者如何整合相互竞争的目标、平台与制度逻辑的混合式组织过程。

name: Kathryn Greene
title: Distinguished Professor of Communication
summary: Builds and tests theory on health information disclosure and message engagement to promote prevention behaviors, including youth substance-use prevention programs.
summary_zh: 建构并检验关于健康信息披露与讯息参与的理论，以促进预防行为，包括青少年物质滥用预防项目。

name: Shawnika Hull
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how communication can reduce HIV-related health inequities, developing community-engaged prevention interventions and campaigns, including PrEP for Black women.
summary_zh: 研究传播如何减少与HIV相关的健康不平等，与社区合作开发预防干预和宣传活动，包括面向黑人女性的PrEP推广。

name: William Klein
title: Dean and Distinguished Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how people perceive, avoid, and respond to health risk information, drawing on social psychology to improve risk communication and health decision-making.
summary_zh: 借助社会心理学研究人们如何感知、回避和回应健康风险信息，以改进风险传播与健康决策。

name: Jeffrey Lane
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies technology use in urban life, youth culture, and criminal justice using urban and digital ethnography alongside surveys and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用城市与数字民族志以及调查和混合方法，研究城市生活、青年文化与刑事司法中的技术使用。

name: Eu Gene Lee
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how AI-driven algorithmic management and AI agents shape workers' perceptions, relationships, and well-being in organizations and the gig economy.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能驱动的算法管理与AI代理如何影响组织和零工经济中员工的认知、关系与福祉。

name: Jianing Li
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how people seek, evaluate, and discuss information in digital media, focusing on credibility, misinformation, and media literacy, using computational, quantitative, and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用计算、定量与混合方法，研究人们在数字媒体中如何寻求、评估和讨论信息，关注可信度、虚假信息与媒介素养。

name: Matthew Matsaganis
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how communities, clinics, and institutions build communication infrastructure for health, equity, and resilience in U.S. and Greek settings, including ethnic media.
summary_zh: 研究美国与希腊的社区、诊所和机构如何构建支撑健康、公平与韧性的传播基础设施，包括族裔媒体。

name: Lisa Mikesell
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies patient engagement and patient-clinician interaction in mental health and clinical care by analyzing everyday interactional practices in community and clinic settings.
summary_zh: 通过分析社区与诊所中的日常互动实践，研究心理健康和临床照护中的患者参与及医患互动。

name: Nitzan Navick
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how communication technologies and changing workplace norms affect digital workers' well-being and belonging, and how organizations foster inclusion.
summary_zh: 研究传播技术与不断变化的职场规范如何影响数字工作者的福祉与归属感，以及组织如何促进包容。

name: Katherine (Katya) Ognyanova
title: Professor of Communication and Director of the Rutgers Computational Social Science Lab
summary: Studies misinformation, trust in institutions, public opinion, and attitudes toward AI using large-scale surveys, network science, and computational social science.
summary_zh: 运用大规模调查、网络科学与计算社会科学，研究虚假信息、机构信任、舆论以及公众对人工智能的态度。

name: Yonaira Rivera
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies health communication for Latino/a/x and underserved communities, including social media health information, multilingual interventions, and LLM-delivered health information.
summary_zh: 研究面向拉丁裔及弱势社群的健康传播，包括社交媒体健康信息、多语种干预以及大语言模型传递的健康信息。

name: Kristina Scharp
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies marginalization, resilience, and relational distancing in families and health contexts, building communication theory and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究家庭与健康情境中的边缘化、韧性与关系疏离，并发展传播理论与质性研究方法。

name: Sarah Shugars
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
areas: AI, Data Science, and Social Computing
summary: Studies how everyday people talk about and shape public life, developing computational text and network methods grounded in deliberative democracy.
summary_zh: 立足协商民主理论，开发计算文本与网络方法，研究普通人如何讨论并塑造公共生活。

name: Jennifer Theiss
title: Director of the Ph.D. Program and Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how communication shapes romantic and family relationships during transitions, advancing relational turbulence theory with longitudinal and dyadic designs.
summary_zh: 运用纵向与二元数据设计，研究转型期恋爱与家庭关系中的沟通，并发展关系动荡理论。

name: Maria Venetis
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how patients, clinicians, couples, and families communicate about health issues and how dyadic communication supports well-being and resilience.
summary_zh: 研究患者、医生、伴侣与家庭如何就健康问题进行沟通，以及二元沟通如何促进福祉与韧性。

name: Matthew Weber
title: Professor of Communication
summary: Studies organizational change and local news ecosystems using network analysis, archival research, interviews, and AI-driven large-scale data methods.
summary_zh: 运用网络分析、档案研究、访谈和人工智能驱动的大规模数据方法，研究组织变革与地方新闻生态系统。

name: DaJung (DJ) Woo
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies organizational socialization, interprofessional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement, including generative AI's role, using primarily qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 主要运用质性方法，研究组织社会化、跨专业协作与利益相关者参与，以及生成式人工智能在其中的作用。

name: Itzhak Yanovitzky
title: Professor of Communication and Chair of the SC&I Health and Wellness Faculty Cluster
summary: Studies behavior change communication and how knowledge brokers help evidence inform health policy and practice, using mixed methods and program evaluation.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法与项目评估，研究行为改变传播以及知识中介如何推动证据进入健康政策与实践。

name: Melissa Aronczyk
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
summary: Critically examines organized persuasion, public relations, and promotional culture, including the politics of environmentalism and nation branding.
summary_zh: 以批判视角研究有组织的说服、公共关系与推广文化，包括环保主义政治与国家品牌塑造。

name: Jack Bratich
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Gender, Race, and Class in Media
summary: Applies social and political theory to popular and political culture, studying social movements, conspiracy culture, microfascism, and far-right digital cultures.
summary_zh: 运用社会与政治理论研究流行文化与政治文化，关注社会运动、阴谋论文化、微观法西斯主义与极右翼数字文化。

name: Lauren Feldman
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Chair and Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
summary: Studies media effects on public knowledge and opinion about climate change, partisan media and misinformation, and the role of comedy in social change.
summary_zh: 研究媒体对公众关于气候变化的知识与态度的影响、党派媒体与虚假信息，以及喜剧在社会变革中的作用。

name: Brooklyne Gipson
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
summary: Studies racialized disinformation and anti-Black discourse in Black social media spaces through Black feminist technology studies, digital ethnography, and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 从黑人女性主义技术研究视角，运用数字民族志与话语分析，研究黑人社交媒体空间中的种族化虚假信息与反黑人话语。

name: David Greenberg
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor of Journalism and Media Studies and of History
summary: Studies the history of American politics, the presidency, political spin, and journalism since 1900 through historical research and biography.
summary_zh: 通过历史研究与传记写作，研究1900年以来的美国政治史、总统制、政治公关与新闻业。

name: Amy Jordan
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
summary: Studies how media shape children's and adolescents' development, family life, and health, and designs and tests culturally sensitive health media campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究媒介如何影响儿童与青少年的发展、家庭生活与健康，并设计和测试具文化敏感性的健康媒体宣传活动。

name: Susan Keith
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Associate Dean for Programs and Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Social, Critical Informatics, and Information Policy
summary: Studies journalism in transition and conflict, including visual coverage of war, journalistic norms, media law, and journalism education, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与定量方法，研究转型与冲突中的新闻业，包括战争视觉报道、新闻规范、媒体法与新闻教育。

name: Youngrim Kim
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Social, Critical Informatics, and Information Policy
summary: Studies the politics of datafication, digital infrastructures, and platform governance from global perspectives, using qualitative and interpretive methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释方法，从全球与跨国视角研究数据化政治、数字基础设施与平台治理。

name: Deepa Kumar
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Gender, Race, and Class in Media
summary: Studies anti-Muslim racism, Islamophobia, and the politics of empire, with attention to race, gender, and media, through critical analysis.
summary_zh: 以批判分析方法研究反穆斯林种族主义、伊斯兰恐惧症与帝国政治，关注种族、性别与媒介。

name: Dafna Lemish
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor of Journalism and Media Studies Former Interim Dean
areas: Gender, Race, and Class in Media
summary: Studies the role of media in children's lives and gender identity formation from global, cross-cultural, and multi-method perspectives.
summary_zh: 从全球、跨文化和多方法视角，研究媒介在儿童生活及性别认同形成中的作用。

name: Regina Marchi
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
summary: Studies alternative and activist media and civic engagement among marginalized communities and youth, including Latinx public art and media activism in Ireland.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化社群与青年中的另类媒体、行动主义媒体和公民参与，包括拉丁裔公共艺术与爱尔兰的媒体行动主义。

name: John V. Pavlik
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Distinguished Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: AI, Data Science, and Social Computing
summary: Studies how emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, transform journalism content, newsroom practices, media organization, and media-public relations.
summary_zh: 研究新兴技术，尤其是人工智能，如何改变新闻内容、新闻编辑室实践、媒体组织以及媒体与公众的关系。

name: Celeste Wagner
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Gender, Race, and Class in Media
summary: Studies why people embrace or resist feminist and social change and how audiences engage news and misinformation, using cross-national surveys, experiments, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用跨国调查、实验与访谈，研究人们为何接受或抵制女性主义等社会变革，以及受众如何接触新闻与虚假信息。

name: Khadijah Costley White
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor of Journalism and Media Studies
areas: Gender, Race, and Class in Media
summary: Studies race, gender, and social change in news and popular media, analyzing how journalism shapes understandings of activism and democracy through cultural studies.
summary_zh: 以文化研究视角，研究新闻与流行媒介中的种族、性别与社会变革，分析新闻业如何塑造对行动主义和民主的理解。

name: Todd Wolfson
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor of Journalism and Media Studies – On leave from 2025 to 2027
summary: Conducts traditional and cyber-based ethnographic research, drawing on training in anthropology; specific topical focus is not described in the profile.
summary_zh: 基于人类学训练开展传统与网络民族志研究；个人简介未说明具体研究主题。

name: LaRisa Anderson-Horne
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
Communication technology and digital media studies
summary: Studies relationships among religion, media, race, and technoculture, using interviews, textual analysis, digital ethnography, and text mining.
summary_zh: 研究宗教、媒介、种族与技术文化之间的关系，采用访谈、文本分析、数字民族志和文本挖掘方法。

name: Mark Bergstrom
title: Associate Professor, Director of the Taft Nicholson Center for Environmental Humanities
summary: Works in health and science communication, research methods and ethics, and rhetoric and communication theory, alongside environmental humanities leadership.
summary_zh: 从事健康与科学传播、研究方法与伦理以及修辞与传播理论研究，并主持环境人文学科工作。

name: Suhi Choi
title: Professor
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Studies collective memory, trauma, and mourning around the Korean War by critically analyzing memorials, media narratives, and rituals at memorial sites.
summary_zh: 通过批判性分析纪念碑、媒介叙事和纪念场所的仪式，研究围绕朝鲜战争的集体记忆、创伤与哀悼。

name: Kevin Coe
title: Professor, Director of the Communication Institute
summary: Studies political communication, news media, and public opinion, including presidential communication, religion in politics, and online incivility, mainly through content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、新闻媒体与舆论，包括总统传播、政治中的宗教与网络不文明言论，主要采用内容分析方法。

name: Kevin M. DeLuca
title: Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies mediate relations with nature, analyzing visual rhetoric, image events, and environmental activism in the U.S. and China.
summary_zh: 研究传播技术如何中介人与自然的关系，分析美国与中国环境运动中的视觉修辞、图像事件与行动主义。

name: Danielle Endres
title: Professor, Director of the Environmental Humanities Program
areas: Global Indigenous studies environmental knowledges and management
Sociology and social studies of science and technology
summary: Studies the rhetoric of environmental and science controversies such as nuclear waste siting and energy transitions, centering Indigenous advocacy through participatory critical rhetoric.
summary_zh: 研究核废料选址与能源转型等环境和科学争议中的修辞，以参与式批判修辞关注原住民的倡导实践。

name: Glen M. Feighery
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the historical relationship between newspapers and communities in the American West, including Japanese American incarceration camp newspapers, through archival research.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究探讨美国西部报纸与社区之间的历史关系，包括日裔美国人拘留营中的报纸。

name: Isabelle Freiling
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Communication technology and digital media studies
summary: Studies media use and effects in science and political communication, focusing on social media misinformation, public perceptions of science, AI, and open science.
summary_zh: 研究科学与政治传播中的媒介使用与效果，聚焦社交媒体虚假信息、公众对科学的认知、人工智能与开放科学。

name: Logan Gomez
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Works in critical race, feminist, and cultural studies, rhetoric, and social movements, including reflections on critical pedagogy and classroom tension.
summary_zh: 从事批判种族、女性主义与文化研究、修辞及社会运动研究，并反思批判教学与课堂张力。

name: Rachel Alicia Griffin
title: Associate Professor
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Studies race, gender, and mediated culture through Black feminist critique and autoethnography, examining popular music, film, and gendered violence.
summary_zh: 通过黑人女性主义批判与自我民族志研究种族、性别与媒介文化，考察流行音乐、电影与性别暴力。

name: Jun Heo
title: Associate Professor, Director of the UAC Master's Program in Communication
summary: Studies advertising effectiveness, including native ads, social media ad personalization, sponsorship, and CSR messages, including eye-tracking research on ad perception.
summary_zh: 研究广告效果，包括原生广告、社交媒体广告个性化、赞助与企业社会责任信息，并包含关于广告感知的眼动追踪研究。

name: Leandra Hernandez
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Studies Latina/o/x/e health experiences and media representations of reproductive justice and gendered violence using Chicana feminist and qualitative approaches.
summary_zh: 运用奇卡纳女性主义与质性方法，研究拉丁裔群体的健康经验以及生殖正义与性别暴力的媒介再现。

name: Daniel Hernandez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies global Indigeneities, kava, popular music, and eco/food justice through Indigenous relational ethics, community research, and critical cultural theory.
summary_zh: 以原住民关系伦理、社区研究与批判文化理论，研究全球原住民性、卡瓦、流行音乐与生态/食物正义。

name: Avery Holton
title: Department Chair, Professor
areas: Communication technology and digital media studies
summary: Works in journalism studies and health communication, including digital and screen media and mental health contexts.
summary_zh: 从事新闻学与健康传播研究，涉及数字与屏幕媒介以及心理健康情境。

name: Chris Ingraham
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, affect theory, and media theory, examining ecological thinking, mobile and streaming media, and immersive VR storytelling through humanistic theorizing.
summary_zh: 以人文理论路径研究修辞、情动理论与媒介理论，考察生态思维、移动与流媒体以及沉浸式VR叙事。

name: Jakob D. Jensen
title: Professor, Associate Vice President for Research for the University
summary: Studies strategic communication of health information to the public, especially cancer, designing and evaluating screening campaigns and interventions with public health departments.
summary_zh: 研究面向公众的健康信息战略传播，尤其是癌症领域，与公共卫生部门合作设计和评估筛查宣传与干预项目。

name: Robin E. Jensen
title: Professor, Associate Dean for Research in the College of Humanities
summary: Studies historical and contemporary rhetoric of health, science, sex, and gender, especially reproductive health, infertility, and sex education, through rhetorical and archival analysis.
summary_zh: 通过修辞与档案分析，研究有关健康、科学、性与性别的历史和当代话语，尤其是生殖健康、不孕与性教育。

name: Kimberly Kaphingst
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies cancer genetic risk communication, health literacy, and informed consent, developing and testing digital health tools such as chatbots for patients.
summary_zh: 研究癌症遗传风险传播、健康素养与知情同意，开发并测试面向患者的聊天机器人等数字健康工具。

name: Andy King
title: Professor
summary: Studies cancer and public health communication, including treatment misinformation, generative AI imagery, LLM-based interventions, and decision aids tested in randomized studies.
summary_zh: 研究癌症与公共卫生传播，包括治疗相关虚假信息、生成式AI图像、基于大语言模型的干预以及经随机研究检验的决策辅助工具。

name: Sean T. Lawson
title: Professor
summary: Studies cybersecurity discourse and the history of cyberwarfare, analyzing cyber-doom rhetoric, influence operations, and fears of technology out of control.
summary_zh: 研究网络安全话语与网络战的历史，分析“网络末日”修辞、影响力行动以及对技术失控的恐惧。

name: Tae Kyoung Lee
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health message processing and persuasion, including message framing, narrative persuasion, HPV and COVID-19 vaccination, and online peer support among cancer survivors.
summary_zh: 研究健康信息加工与说服，包括信息框架、叙事说服、HPV与新冠疫苗接种以及癌症幸存者的线上同伴互动。

name: Rachel Lim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how persuasive strategic communication, including AI-generated content, virtual influencers, and brand advocacy, shapes trust, attitudes, and behavior, drawing on consumer psychology.
summary_zh: 借鉴消费者心理学，研究AI生成内容、虚拟网红与品牌倡导等说服性战略传播如何影响信任、态度与行为。

name: Crystal Lumpkins
title: Professor
summary: Studies community-engaged health communication, including sharing hereditary cancer risk information in African American communities and patient-centered outcomes research.
summary_zh: 研究社区参与式健康传播，包括在非裔美国人社区中传播遗传性癌症风险信息以及以患者为中心的结局研究。

name: Benjamin Lyons
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies misinformation, overconfidence, and public understanding of science and politics, including older adults' exposure to low-credibility online content and climate beliefs.
summary_zh: 研究虚假信息、过度自信以及公众对科学与政治的理解，包括老年人接触低可信度网络内容以及气候信念。

name: Michael Middleton
title: Associate Dean of Academic Affairs, Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, argumentation, and public discourse in political advocacy and social movements, including homeless communities' democratic participation and academic freedom.
summary_zh: 研究政治倡导与社会运动中的修辞、论辩与公共话语，包括无家可归群体的民主参与以及学术自由。

name: Jacob Nelson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between journalism and the public, including how journalists imagine audiences, audience engagement strategies, and transparency in news organizations.
summary_zh: 研究新闻业与公众的关系，包括记者如何想象受众、受众参与策略以及新闻机构的透明度。

name: Kent Alan Ono
title: Distinguished Professor, UAC Communication Officer
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Studies representations of race, gender, sexuality, class, and nation in print, film, and television, including Asian American media and immigration rhetoric, through critical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判分析研究印刷、电影与电视中对种族、性别、性向、阶级与国族的再现，包括亚裔美国人媒介与移民修辞。

name: Helene Shugart
title: Professor, Associate Dean for the Graduate School
summary: Studies cultural discourses of health, especially obesity, combining rhetorical, media, and cultural studies to critique health campaigns and neoliberal discourse.
summary_zh: 结合修辞、媒介与文化研究，探讨健康尤其是肥胖相关的文化话语，批判健康宣传与新自由主义话语。

name: Liahnna Stanley
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Critical Race, Feminist, and Cultural Studies
summary: Studies Indigenous queer and feminist thought, Black-Indigenous relations, and speculative media and futurisms, analyzing Indigenous storytelling through rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 研究原住民酷儿与女性主义思想、黑人与原住民关系以及思辨媒介与未来主义，以修辞批评分析原住民叙事。

name: David J. Vergobbi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mass communication law, freedom of expression, media ethics, and journalism history.
summary_zh: 研究大众传播法、表达自由、媒介伦理与新闻史。

name: Haoning Xue
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health and AI-mediated communication, including chatbots that correct contraceptive misinformation, computational modeling of short-video features, and trust in AI.
summary_zh: 研究健康与AI中介传播，包括纠正避孕虚假信息的聊天机器人、短视频特征的计算建模以及对AI的信任。

name: Sara K. Yeo
title: Professor, Associate Chair and STEMAP Director
areas: Sociology and social studies of science and technology
Applications in social sciences and education
summary: Studies strategic science and risk communication, public opinion on STEM issues, and information seeking and processing, including AI, climate anxiety, and the deficit model.
summary_zh: 研究战略性科学与风险传播、公众对STEM议题的看法以及信息寻求与加工，涉及人工智能、气候焦虑与缺失模型。

name: Michelle A. Amazeen
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Dean, Research
summary: Studies the persuasive effects of misinformation, native advertising, and climate disinformation and efforts to correct them, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与量化方法，研究虚假信息、原生广告与气候虚假信息的说服效果及其纠正策略。

name: Joshua Baldwin
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies why audiences enjoy and appreciate entertainment, narratives, and games and how media shape well-being, using experiments, physiological measures, and computational visual analysis.
summary_zh: 运用实验、生理测量与计算视觉分析，研究受众为何享受和欣赏娱乐、叙事与游戏，以及媒介如何影响幸福感。

name: Christopher Beaudoin
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Department of Mass Communication, Advertising and Public Relations
areas: mediated communication and social and health outcomes
summary: Studies how mediated communication shapes social capital and health outcomes, building media-effects theory and designing and evaluating health campaigns, including in Africa.
summary_zh: 研究媒介传播如何影响社会资本与健康结果，构建媒介效果理论，并设计与评估健康传播运动（包括在非洲）。

name: Bill Braudis
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Film & TV
summary: Practices and teaches screenwriting and comedy writing for television and animation, drawing on a career in stand-up comedy and animated sitcoms.
summary_zh: 从事并教授电视与动画的编剧及喜剧写作，其经验来自单口喜剧与动画情景喜剧创作生涯。

name: Raymond Carney
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Film
summary: Studies American independent cinema and film criticism, especially John Cassavetes, through critical and historical analysis connecting film to pragmatist philosophy and American art.
summary_zh: 通过批判与历史分析研究美国独立电影与电影批评（尤其是约翰·卡萨维蒂），并将电影与实用主义哲学及美国艺术相联系。

name: Kathryn Coduto
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies how people use social media and dating apps to connect, including compulsive social media use during news events and privacy management, bridging mass and interpersonal communication.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何借助社交媒体和约会软件建立联系，包括重大新闻事件中的强迫性社交媒体使用与隐私管理，连接大众传播与人际传播。

name: James Cummings
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies psychological processing of media and human-computer interaction, including multitasking, task-switching, and presence and empathy in immersive VR, using physiological measures.
summary_zh: 运用生理测量研究媒介心理加工与人机交互，包括多任务处理、任务切换，以及沉浸式VR中的临场感与共情。

name: Debbie Danielpour
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Practices and teaches screenwriting and fiction writing for film, television, and opera, and writes on the craft of screenwriting.
summary_zh: 从事并教授电影、电视与歌剧的编剧与小说写作，并撰写关于编剧技艺的文章。

name: Joan Donovan
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism and Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies media manipulation, disinformation, and networked social movements, including how meme culture became a political communication strategy reshaping US politics.
summary_zh: 研究媒体操纵、虚假信息与网络化社会运动，包括表情包文化如何成为重塑美国政治的政治传播策略。

name: Edward Downes
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: PhD, Associate Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies public relations education and the politics and public relations of congressional press secretaries, promoting interdisciplinary scholarship.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系教育以及美国国会新闻秘书的政治与公关实践，倡导跨学科研究。

name: Michael G. Elasmar
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mass Communication, Advertising and Public Relations
summary: Studies how communication forms and changes belief systems such as brand beliefs, country images, and intergroup perceptions, using psychometric and mathematical models.
summary_zh: 运用心理测量与数学模型，研究传播如何形成和改变品牌信念、国家形象与群际认知等信念系统。

name: Amy Geller
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Film & Television
summary: Produces and directs documentary and fiction films and audio documentaries, including work on American film criticism and Jewish life.
summary_zh: 制作与执导纪录片、剧情片和音频纪录片，作品涉及美国电影批评与犹太人生活。

name: Maria Elizabeth (Betsi) Grabe
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Dalton Family Professor
summary: Studies informed and misinformed citizenship, using experiments on how news reception varies across demographic groups, modalities, packaging styles, and visual framing of elections.
summary_zh: 研究知情与误知公民身份，以实验考察新闻接收如何因人口群体、模态、包装风格及选举视觉框架而异。

name: Roy Grundmann
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Film Studies
areas: gay and lesbian film history and queer theory
summary: Studies American and European narrative and avant-garde cinema, film and cultural theory, and gay and lesbian film history through critical and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判与历史分析研究美国与欧洲叙事电影和先锋电影、电影与文化理论，以及同性恋电影史与酷儿理论。

name: Traci Hong
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies how health messaging, social norms, and peer influence in new media promote healthy behavior, using AI, machine learning, and social media analytics on vaping and vaccines.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体中的健康信息、社会规范与同伴影响如何促进健康行为，运用AI、机器学习与社交媒体分析研究电子烟和疫苗议题。

name: Charlotte E. Howell
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Film & Television
summary: Studies television industries, genre, and fandom, including how US TV production negotiated Christianity in prime-time dramas, through industry and textual analysis.
summary_zh: 通过产业与文本分析研究电视产业、类型与粉丝文化，包括美国电视制作如何在黄金时段剧集中处理基督教题材。

name: Juwon Hwang
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies how new media technologies shape health behavior and mental well-being, designing vaccination campaign messages and exploring VR to ease distress with conventional and computational methods.
summary_zh: 结合传统与计算方法，研究新媒体技术如何影响健康行为与心理健康，设计疫苗接种宣传信息，并探索VR缓解心理困扰的潜力。

name: Hayes Jackson
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Film and Television
summary: Practices and teaches screenwriting and television production, especially situation comedy, drawing on a long career writing for network and streaming TV.
summary_zh: 从事并教授编剧与电视制作，尤其是情景喜剧，其经验来自长期为电视网和流媒体撰稿的职业生涯。

name: Deborah L. Jaramillo
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Film and Television Studies Program
summary: Studies US television history, censorship and industry self-regulation, and the construction of death in radio, podcasting, and TV, through historical and critical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过历史与批判分析，研究美国电视史、审查与行业自律，以及广播、播客和电视中对死亡的建构。

name: Yi Grace Ji
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mass Communication, Advertising, and Public Relations
summary: Studies how organizations use strategic communication and emerging media, including generative AI, to engage stakeholders on sociopolitical issues via surveys, experiments, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验与计算方法，研究组织如何借助战略传播与新兴媒体（包括生成式AI）在社会政治议题上与利益相关者互动。

name: Xiaoya Jiang
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Media Science
areas: public opinion on contentious societal issues
summary: Studies public opinion on contentious issues such as vaccination, immigration, and AI, using NLP, time series, and network analysis of news and social media plus surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究疫苗、移民与人工智能等争议议题的舆论，运用自然语言处理、时间序列和网络分析新闻与社交媒体数据，并结合调查与实验。

name: James Katz
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Feld Professor of Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies the social and ethical implications of AI, social media, and human-robot interaction, examining how new communication technologies shape society and perceptions of the future.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能、社交媒体与人机器人交互的社会与伦理意涵，考察新传播技术如何塑造社会及人们对未来的认知。

name: Arunima Krishna
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: PhD, Associate Professor, Public Relations
areas: public perceptions of controversial social issues
summary: Studies how publics perceive and communicate about controversial issues such as vaccine hesitancy, climate denial, and corporate misconduct, extending the situational theory of problem solving.
summary_zh: 研究公众如何认知和讨论疫苗犹豫、气候变化否认与企业不当行为等争议议题，并拓展问题解决情境理论（STOPS）。

name: Adam Lapidus
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Film and Television
summary: Practices and teaches television and comedy writing, drawing on decades of writing and producing sitcoms for network TV, Disney Channel, and Netflix.
summary_zh: 从事并教授电视与喜剧写作，其经验来自数十年为电视网、迪士尼频道和Netflix编写与制作情景喜剧。

name: Ejae Lee
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: PhD, Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies how organizations communicate authentically with stakeholders to build trust, focusing on prosocial corporate communication and corporate social advocacy in the AI era across global contexts.
summary_zh: 研究组织如何与利益相关者进行真诚沟通以建立信任，聚焦AI时代全球语境下的亲社会企业传播与企业社会倡导。

name: Susanna S. Lee
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies persuasion in social media marketing, including how influencers, virtual influencers, and message strategies shape ad avoidance and credibility, and effects of immersive media and AI.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体营销中的说服，包括网红、虚拟网红及信息策略如何影响广告回避与可信度，以及沉浸式媒介与AI的效果。

name: Richard Lehr
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Journalism
summary: Practices and teaches narrative nonfiction and investigative journalism, writing books and podcasts on crime, policing, race, and civil rights history.
summary_zh: 从事并教授叙事非虚构写作与调查新闻，撰写关于犯罪、警务、种族与民权历史的书籍和播客。

name: Ayse Lokmanoglu
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies how state and non-state actors propagate supremacist ideologies online, attending to race, gender, and religion, using automated text and visual analysis and network analysis.
summary_zh: 研究国家与非国家行为体如何在网上传播至上主义意识形态，关注种族、性别与宗教，运用自动化文本与视觉分析及网络分析。

name: AnneMarie K. McClain
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies children's media, representation, and identity socialization, including how US Black families use media to socialize children about identity and after experiences of racism.
summary_zh: 研究儿童媒介、媒介再现与身份社会化，包括美国黑人家庭如何利用媒介在身份及遭遇种族主义后对孩子进行社会化。

name: William McKeen
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Department of Journalism
summary: Studies journalism history and literary journalism and writes biographies of writers and musicians, such as Hunter S. Thompson and the Key West arts scene.
summary_zh: 研究新闻史与文学新闻，并为作家和音乐人撰写传记，如亨特·S·汤普森及基韦斯特艺术群体。

name: Patrice Oppliger
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies how media and popular culture shape adolescent development, focusing on gender, sexualization, and humor in TV and comedy, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与量化方法，研究媒介与流行文化如何影响青少年发展，聚焦电视与喜剧中的性别、性化与幽默。

name: Geoffrey Poister
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Director of Film Production Programs; Associate Professor, Television
summary: Produces and directs documentaries for public television on cultural and social issues, including AIDS in South Africa and the legacy of Hiroshima.
summary_zh: 为公共电视制作和执导关于文化与社会议题的纪录片，包括南非的艾滋病问题与广岛的遗产。

name: Chris Chao Su
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies how online media audiences form in a fragmented digital environment, using computational methods, network analysis, and passively measured audience data.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法、网络分析与被动测量的受众数据，研究碎片化数字环境中网络媒介受众如何形成。

name: Scott Thompson
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Director, Screenwriting Program; Assistant Professor
summary: Practices and teaches screenwriting and film adaptation, adapting memoirs and developing feature, television, and short film scripts.
summary_zh: 从事并教授编剧与电影改编，改编回忆录并开发长片、电视及短片剧本。

name: Tammy R. Vigil
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Associate Professor, Media Science
summary: Studies US presidential campaigns, nominating conventions, and the rhetoric of presidential spouses through rhetorical analysis of public address.
summary_zh: 通过对公共演说的修辞分析，研究美国总统竞选、党代会以及总统配偶的修辞。

name: Morgan N. Weiland
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Mass Communication, Advertising and Public Relations
summary: Studies how the internet was socially constructed as a First Amendment speech system, taking a critical historical approach to the legal regulation of platforms and AI.
summary_zh: 研究互联网如何被社会性地建构为受第一修正案保护的言论体系，以批判性历史视角审视平台与AI的法律规制。

name: Christopher Wells
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Emerging Media Studies
summary: Studies how news coverage takes shape and how citizens learn about and participate in politics, using conventional and computational methods to examine interactive media systems.
summary_zh: 结合传统与计算方法，研究新闻报道如何形成、公民如何了解政治并参与其中，考察互动的媒介系统。

name: Alan Wu
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Film and Television
summary: Practices film editing and directing for narrative features and short films screened at major international festivals.
summary_zh: 从事剧情长片与短片的剪辑和导演工作，作品入选多个重要国际电影节。

name: Denis Wu
