dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Department of Mass Communication, Advertising and Public Relations
areas: image and emotion in voter decisions
summary: Studies international communication and how emotional and image-based reactions to political figures shape voter decisions and perceptions of other nations.
summary_zh: 研究国际传播，以及对政治人物的情绪与形象反应如何影响选民决策和对他国的认知。

name: Jing Yang
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising
areas: authenticity and transparency in digital advertising
artificial intelligence for advertising effectiveness and ethics
consumer responses to emerging advertising technologies
summary: Studies authenticity and transparency in digital advertising and consumer responses to AI and emerging ad technologies, including human-AI interaction and advertising ethics.
summary_zh: 研究数字广告中的真实性与透明度，以及消费者对AI和新兴广告技术的反应，包括人机交互与广告伦理。

name: Sung-Un Yang
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies strategic communication management and how AI reshapes public-organization relationships, employee communication, and organizational change, including professionals' AI adoption.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播管理，以及AI如何重塑组织—公众关系、员工沟通与组织变革，包括传播从业者对AI的采纳。

name: April Yue
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: PhD, Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies internal public relations, leadership communication, organizational change management, and corporate social responsibility and irresponsibility, including AI in public relations.
summary_zh: 研究内部公共关系、领导力沟通、组织变革管理以及企业社会责任与不负责任行为，包括公关中的AI应用。

name: Mitchell Zuckoff
dept: College of Communication (Division of Emerging Media Studies)
title: Sumner M. Redstone Professor in Narrative Studies; Director, The Power of Narrative conference
summary: Practices and teaches narrative nonfiction and investigative journalism, writing bestselling books on events such as 9/11 and Benghazi.
summary_zh: 从事并教授叙事非虚构写作与调查新闻，撰写关于9·11和班加西事件等的畅销书。

name: Dominic Balog-Way
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how societies communicate, interpret, and govern environmental, technological, and health risks, focusing on risk perception, trust, uncertainty, and public engagement.
summary_zh: 研究社会如何沟通、理解和治理环境、技术与健康风险，关注风险感知、信任、不确定性与公众参与。

name: Natalie Bazarova
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people use social media affordances and designs and evaluates interventions for online privacy, safety, digital and AI literacy, and prosocial behavior among youth and vulnerable groups.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用社交媒体的功能可供性，并设计和评估面向青少年及弱势群体的在线隐私、安全、数字与AI素养及亲社会行为干预。

name: danah boyd
title: Geri Gay Professor
summary: Studies how structural inequities shape and are shaped by technology, using ethnography of data infrastructures such as the US Census, networked teens, and algorithmic accountability.
summary_zh: 研究结构性不平等如何与技术相互塑造，以民族志方法考察美国人口普查等数据基础设施、网络化青少年与算法问责。

name: Monica Cornejo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication among migrants affected by US immigration detention and how anti-migrant messages affect their health, using interviews and longitudinal surveys.
summary_zh: 研究受美国移民拘留系统影响的移民的人际与家庭传播，以及反移民信息如何影响其健康，采用访谈与纵向调查。

name: Brooke Duffy
title: Professor
summary: Studies social media and creative industries, gender and inequality, and digital labor, using qualitative research with bloggers, YouTubers, and Instagram creators.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与创意产业、性别与不平等以及数字劳动，通过对博主、YouTube与Instagram创作者的质性研究展开。

name: Susan Fussell
title: Professor
summary: Studies computer-mediated communication and collaboration, including effects of culture and native language, virtual teams, and human-robot interaction, and builds tools such as energy-saving and telepresence systems.
summary_zh: 研究计算机中介传播与协作，包括文化和母语的影响、虚拟团队及人机（机器人）交互，并开发节能激励与远程临场机器人等工具。

name: Lee Humphreys
title: Professor and Chair
areas: social uses and effects of communication technology
summary: Studies the social uses of mobile and social media in everyday life, including privacy and surveillance in location-based services, using qualitative field and historical methods.
summary_zh: 研究移动与社交媒体在日常生活中的社会使用，包括位置服务中的隐私与监控，采用质性田野与历史方法。

name: Bruce Lewenstein
title: Professor
areas: history and evaluation of public communication of science and technology
documentation and history of contemporary science
summary: Studies the history and models of public communication of science and technology, using historical case studies and evaluation of citizen science and informal science education.
summary_zh: 研究科学技术公共传播的历史与模式，运用历史个案研究并评估公民科学与非正式科学教育项目。

name: Neil Lewis, Jr.
title: Associate Professor
areas: motivation and goal pursuit processes, particularly as they relate to disparities in education, health, and the environment
summary: Studies how social contexts and identities shape motivation and goal pursuit, and how interventions and policies can reduce disparities in education, health, and the environment.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境与身份如何影响动机与目标追求，以及干预和政策如何减少教育、健康与环境领域的不平等。

name: Drew Margolin
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how accountability, credibility, and social networks shape online discourse and misinformation, using computational analysis of large-scale observational data and natural experiments.
summary_zh: 研究问责、可信度与社会网络如何塑造线上话语与虚假信息，采用大规模观察数据的计算分析与自然实验。

name: J. Nathan Matias
title: Associate Professor
areas: behavior changes in groups and networks shaped by algorithms
pervasive experimentation in society with a special focus on citizen behavioral science and behavioral consume protection
summary: Studies how algorithms and platform governance shape group behavior online, running large-scale field experiments with online communities, platforms, and news organizations.
summary_zh: 研究算法与平台治理如何塑造线上群体行为，与网络社群、平台和新闻机构合作开展大规模田野实验。

name: Katherine McComas
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication about scientific, technological, and environmental risks, including One Health messaging and public acceptance of new energy technologies, through community-engaged research.
summary_zh: 研究科学、技术与环境风险的传播，包括“同一健康”信息设计和公众对新能源技术的接受度，采用社区参与式研究。

name: Poppy McLeod
title: Kenneth J. Bissett ’89 Senior Professor
summary: Studies communication and decision making in task-oriented and virtual groups, social influence, minority influence, and intergroup dynamics, including interagency coordination in social services.
summary_zh: 研究任务型群体与虚拟团队中的沟通与决策、社会影响、少数派影响与群际动态，包括社会服务机构间协作。

name: Wunpini Mohammed
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decolonization, African feminisms, indigenous language media, and social movements in Ghana and the diaspora, using critical-historical and community-engaged activist scholarship.
summary_zh: 研究加纳及离散群体中的去殖民化、非洲女性主义、本土语言媒体与社会运动，采用批判历史与社区参与的行动学术方法。

name: Jeff Niederdeppe
title: Liberty Hyde Bailey Professor
summary: Studies the content and effects of mass media campaigns, strategic messages, and news coverage on health behavior and social policy, aiming to advance health equity.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒体运动、策略性信息与新闻报道的内容及其对健康行为和社会政策的影响，致力于促进健康公平。

name: Danny Parker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication ecologies reproduce poverty and shape political identity, using immersive ethnography and participant observation in rural and urban poor communities.
summary_zh: 研究传播生态如何再生产贫困并塑造政治身份，在城乡贫困社区开展沉浸式民族志与参与观察。

name: Jonathon Schuldt
title: Professor
summary: Studies the social psychology of public opinion on environment, health, and US politics, examining message framing, social identity, and food labeling.
summary_zh: 研究环境、健康与美国政治领域舆论的社会心理机制，关注信息框架、社会身份与食品标签。

name: Katherine Sender
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies gender, sexuality, and LGBTQ media across television, audiences, consumer culture, and globalization, using critical cultural analysis, audience research, and documentary production.
summary_zh: 研究电视、受众、消费文化与全球化中的性别、性向与LGBTQ媒介，采用批判文化分析、受众研究与纪录片创作。

name: Claire Wardle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies misinformation, verification, and user-generated content in the information ecosystem, co-designing interventions with communities to meet information needs and build resilience.
summary_zh: 研究信息生态中的虚假信息、核实与用户生成内容，与社区共同设计干预以满足信息需求并增强抵御能力。

name: Andrea Stevenson Won
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how immersive mediated experiences change perception, including virtual reality avatars, nonverbal behavior and synchrony in collaboration, and clinical uses of VR.
summary_zh: 研究沉浸式中介体验如何改变感知，包括虚拟现实化身、协作中的非语言行为与同步性，以及VR的临床应用。

name: Y. Connie Yuan
title: Professor
summary: Studies organizational and intercultural communication, including knowledge management, expertise sharing, and social networks, and US-China differences in climate and health information behavior.
summary_zh: 研究组织与跨文化传播，包括知识管理、专长共享与社会网络，以及中美在气候与健康信息行为上的差异。

name: Anthony Adornato
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Chair, Broadcast and Digital Journalism; Associate Professor, Broadcast and Digital Journalism
summary: Studies how journalists and newsrooms use social media and mobile devices, including newsroom social media policies and the influence of user-generated content on editorial decisions.
summary_zh: 研究记者与新闻机构如何使用社交媒体和移动设备，包括新闻编辑室的社交媒体政策以及用户生成内容对编辑决策的影响。

name: Claire Bai
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising
summary: Examines the integration of artificial intelligence and data science into advertising and business marketing, drawing on industry experience in campaign and media analytics.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能与数据科学在广告和商业营销中的融合应用，并借鉴其在广告活动与媒介分析方面的业界经验。

name: G Douglas Barrett
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Examines how contemporary art, experimental music, and sound address political economy, technology, race, gender, and sexuality using critical and interpretive humanities methods.
summary_zh: 运用人文学科的批判与阐释方法，研究当代艺术、实验音乐与声音如何回应政治经济、科技、种族、性别与性向等问题。

name: Jennifer Billinson
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Bandier Program for Recording and Entertainment Industries
summary: Studies popular music, emotion, and digital culture, especially how popular music is used in responses to disaster and collective trauma, along with media representation and music history.
summary_zh: 研究流行音乐、情感与数字文化，尤其关注流行音乐在灾难与集体创伤应对中的作用，并涉及媒介再现与流行音乐史。

name: Nick Bowman
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Doctoral Program; Director, Media Studies; Professor, Communications
summary: Studies the cognitive, emotional, physical, and social demands of interactive media such as video games, social media, and extended reality, and their roles in learning and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、社交媒体和扩展现实等互动媒介对认知、情绪、身体与社交的要求，以及其在非正式学习与心理健康中的作用。

name: Harriet Brown
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Graduate Program Director, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Co-director, Fashion and Beauty Communications Milestone
summary: Practices and teaches magazine and health journalism, writing memoir and science journalism on food, eating disorders, body image, and family estrangement.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授杂志与健康新闻写作，撰写关于饮食、进食障碍、身体意象和家庭疏离的回忆录与科学新闻作品。

name: Nina Iacono Brown
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications
summary: Studies the intersection of media law and technology, including First Amendment, intellectual property, internet, and social media law.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法与技术的交叉领域，包括第一修正案、知识产权、互联网法与社交媒体法。

name: Makana Chock
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Communications; Director, Extended Reality Lab
summary: Studies how people process and respond to persuasive health and risk messages in mass media, social media, and virtual, augmented, and mixed reality, often using experiments.
summary_zh: 常以实验方法研究人们如何处理和回应大众媒体、社交媒体及虚拟、增强与混合现实中的健康与风险说服信息。

name: Keonte Coleman
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Assessment and Program Review; Assistant Professor, Broadcast and Digital Journalism
summary: Examines intersections of journalism, newsroom leadership, media representation, sports communication, and journalism education, with a focus on television news production.
summary_zh: 研究新闻业、新闻编辑室领导力、媒介再现、体育传播与新闻教育之间的交叉，关注电视新闻制作。

name: Joshua P. Darr
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications
summary: Studies campaign strategy, political knowledge, partisan polarization, and local news, including how changes in local newspaper coverage can slow polarization and rebuild trust.
summary_zh: 研究竞选策略、政治知识、党派极化与地方新闻，包括地方报纸报道的变化如何减缓极化并重建信任。

name: Beth Egan
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Advertising; Co-director, Weiss Center
summary: Applies machine learning to predict television audience retention and uses psychophysiological measures to study implicit responses to branded content.
summary_zh: 运用机器学习预测电视观众留存，并借助心理生理测量研究受众对品牌内容的内隐反应。

name: Imraan Farukhi
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Bandier Music Business Master’s Program; Director, Bandier Music Business Master’s Program; Associate Professor, Bandier Program for Recording and Entertainment Industries; Associate Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on entertainment law and transactional practice in the film, music, and new media industries, including intellectual property and clearance.
summary_zh: 关注电影、音乐与新媒体产业中的娱乐法与交易实务，包括知识产权与版权清理。

name: Joshua Foust
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies how governments use video games for strategic communication, discourses of AI, and executive communication, using interviews, grounded theory, and critical analysis.
summary_zh: 运用深度访谈、扎根理论与批判分析，研究政府如何利用电子游戏进行战略传播，以及人工智能话语与高管传播实践。

name: Ben Frahm
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on screenwriting craft and practice for film and television, drawing on professional experience selling and developing feature scripts.
summary_zh: 关注电影与电视剧本创作的技艺与实践，借鉴其出售与开发长片剧本的职业经验。

name: Aileen Gallagher
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Associate Dean, Academic Affairs
summary: Studies digital magazines and journalism education, drawing on experience as a magazine editor and expertise on the journalism industry.
summary_zh: 研究数字杂志与新闻教育，借鉴其杂志编辑经验及对新闻行业的专业认识。

name: Keith Giglio
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on screenwriting and producing, writing practical books on comedy blockbusters, video game narrative writing, and short scripts.
summary_zh: 关注剧本创作与制片，撰写关于喜剧大片、电子游戏叙事写作和短片剧本的实务著作。

name: Seth Gitner
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Interim Chair, Visual Communications; Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Associate Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Focuses on visual journalism, photography, video, and multimedia and interactive storytelling, and develops new tools for visual education and professional media workflows.
summary_zh: 关注视觉新闻、摄影、视频及多媒体与互动叙事，并开发用于视觉教育和专业媒体工作流程的新工具。

name: Tula Goenka
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Chair, Television, Radio and Film; Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Produces documentaries and studies Indian cinema and human rights media, with a focus on South Asian storytelling and diaspora communities.
summary_zh: 制作纪录片并研究印度电影与人权媒体，关注南亚叙事与离散社群。

name: Brad Gorham
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications; Global Partnerships Liaison
summary: Studies how media shape implicit biases and stereotypes of social groups, especially how language reveals cognition about difference, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 结合定量与质性方法，研究媒介如何塑造对不同群体的内隐偏见与刻板印象，尤其关注语言如何揭示对差异的认知。

name: Eric Grode
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Associate Professor, Goldring Arts Journalism and Communications
areas: Media Coverage of Arts and Culture
summary: Focuses on arts and cultural journalism and criticism, especially theater criticism and the history of Broadway musicals.
summary_zh: 关注艺术与文化新闻及评论，尤其是戏剧评论与百老汇音乐剧历史。

name: Jennifer Grygiel
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications
summary: Draws on social media management and social listening experience to study social media and digital advocacy, including virtual gay-straight alliances.
summary_zh: 借鉴社交媒体管理与社交聆听经验，研究社交媒体与数字倡导，包括虚拟同性恋-异性恋联盟。

name: Roy Gutterman
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Tully Center for Free Speech; Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Professor, Communications
summary: Studies communications law and the First Amendment, including free speech, freedom of information, student speech, and relations between courts and journalists.
summary_zh: 研究传播法与第一修正案，包括言论自由、信息自由、学生言论以及法院与记者之间的关系。

name: J. Christopher Hamilton
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Studies monetization, distribution, and financing of content across the television, film, and streaming industries, drawing on entertainment law and business practice.
summary_zh: 借鉴娱乐法与商业实务，研究电视、电影和流媒体产业中内容的变现、发行与融资。

name: Ken Harper
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Graduate Program Director, Multimedia, Photography and Design; Associate Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Designs interactive and visual communication projects on global development, human rights, and atrocities through long-term collaborations in Liberia, South Africa, Israel, and Palestine.
summary_zh: 通过在利比里亚、南非、以色列和巴勒斯坦的长期合作，设计关于全球发展、人权与暴行议题的互动与视觉传播项目。

name: Gregory Heisler
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Distinguished Professor of Photography, Visual Communications
summary: Practices and teaches photographic portraiture and image-making across editorial, documentary, and commercial photography.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授跨越编辑、纪实与商业摄影的肖像摄影与影像创作。

name: Keren Henderson
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Broadcast and Digital Journalism
summary: Studies the sociology of U.S. newsrooms and the business and craft of news, using annual surveys of local TV newsrooms and audience research on short-form video news.
summary_zh: 通过地方电视新闻编辑室年度调查及短视频新闻受众研究，探讨美国新闻编辑室的社会学以及新闻的商业与技艺。

name: Shaina Holmes
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Graduate Program Director, Television, Radio and Film; Associate Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on visual effects and post-production practice for film and television, including VFX workflows and mentorship of artists.
summary_zh: 关注电影与电视的视觉特效与后期制作实践，包括特效工作流程与艺术人才培养。

name: Nausheen Husain
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Studies news coverage of post-9/11 War on Terror infrastructures and their effects on young Muslims, drawing on data- and documents-based investigative reporting.
summary_zh: 借助数据与文件驱动的调查报道，研究9·11后“反恐战争”体系的新闻报道及其对年轻穆斯林的影响。

name: Alexis Shore Ingber
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Communications
summary: Bridges privacy law and media psychology, experimentally testing regulatory and design solutions for protecting privacy in emerging technologies such as emotion AI.
summary_zh: 融合隐私法与媒介心理学，通过实验检验在情感人工智能等新兴技术中保护隐私的监管与设计方案。

name: Hua Jiang
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Dean, Community, Culture and Engagement; Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies public relations management, internal communication, CSR and corporate social advocacy campaigns, and the role of AI and social media in public relations.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系管理、内部传播、企业社会责任与企业社会倡导活动，以及人工智能与社交媒体在公关中的作用。

name: Rawiya Kameir
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Writes cultural criticism and journalism on music and popular culture, with interests in identity, diaspora, and queer Muslim communities.
summary_zh: 撰写关于音乐与流行文化的文化评论和新闻作品，关注身份认同、离散以及酷儿穆斯林社群。

name: Joel Kaplan
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Goldring Arts, Style and Culture Journalism; Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Focuses on investigative and political journalism, communications law, and standards of fairness and transparency in public media.
summary_zh: 关注调查与政治新闻、传播法，以及公共媒体中的公正与透明标准。

name: Faren Karimkhan
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising
summary: Studies social media influencer marketing, how influencer source factors shape consumer attitudes in fashion, and multicultural marketing among ethnic consumers.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体网红营销、网红来源因素如何影响时尚消费者的态度与行为意图，以及面向少数族裔消费者的多元文化营销。

name: Jordan Kligerman
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on sports documentary and sports content production for social platforms, drawing on professional work with NFL Films and college athletics.
summary_zh: 关注体育纪录片和面向社交平台的体育内容制作，借鉴其在NFL Films与大学体育部门的职业经验。

name: Charisse L'Pree
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications
summary: Examines how media affect identity, attitudes, and behaviors and how people use media to express themselves and connect, combining social psychology and critical media studies.
summary_zh: 融合社会心理学与批判媒介研究，探讨媒介如何影响身份认同、态度与行为，以及人们如何借助媒介表达自我与建立联系。

name: Taylor Vaughn Lasley
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on screenwriting and series development for television and streaming, drawing on professional writing experience.
summary_zh: 关注电视与流媒体剧集的剧本创作与开发，借鉴其职业编剧经验。

name: Kelly Leahy
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Applies educational research and a cultural and developmental lens to children's media, educational technology, digital games and toys, and media literacy.
summary_zh: 以教育研究及文化与发展视角研究儿童媒介、教育技术、数字游戏与玩具以及媒介素养。

name: Moon Lee
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies communication technology development and evaluation, health communication, media processes and effects, public relations, and cognition in decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究传播技术的开发与评估、健康传播、媒介过程与效果、公共关系以及决策中的认知过程。

name: Joon Soo Lim
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Public Relations; Chair, Communications
summary: Studies CSR and corporate social advocacy communication, authenticity, and ethical issues in campaigns that use social media and AI, from fake news to brand safety and health risks.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任与企业社会倡导传播、真实性，以及利用社交媒体和人工智能的传播活动中的伦理问题，涵盖假新闻、品牌安全与健康风险。

name: Regina Luttrell
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Senior Associate Dean; Professor, Public Relations; Co-Director, Newhouse Synthetic Media Lab
summary: Studies the impact and responsible use of artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies in media and public relations, co-directing a synthetic media lab.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能等新兴技术在媒体与公共关系中的影响及负责任使用，并共同主持合成媒体实验室。

name: Colleen McEdwards
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Broadcast and Digital Journalism
summary: Focuses on broadcast and digital storytelling and international news reporting, with academic training in education and technology management.
summary_zh: 关注广播与数字叙事及国际新闻报道，并具有教育与技术管理的学术背景。

name: Tim Mirabito
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Broadcast and Digital Journalism
summary: Studies television newsroom dynamics, including newsgathering routines, burnout, mentorship, and leadership, as well as sports media coverage.
summary_zh: 研究电视新闻编辑室的运作，包括采集新闻的常规、职业倦怠、指导与领导力，以及体育媒体报道。

name: Daniela Molta
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Advertising
summary: Advocates for community-wide digital literacy and more accountable digital advertising, drawing on industry experience in media planning and social media marketing.
summary_zh: 借鉴其媒介策划与社交媒体营销的业界经验，倡导社区层面的数字素养与更负责任的数字广告。

name: Greg Munno
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Chair, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Focuses on civic and participatory journalism, data journalism, government reporting, and public records, with listed expertise in Q methodology.
summary_zh: 关注公民与参与式新闻、数据新闻、政府报道与公共记录，并列有Q方法方面的研究专长。

name: David Oh
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Communications; Director of Assessment and Program Review
summary: Studies Asian American representation and identity in popular and digital culture, othering in Korean media, and diasporic reception of Korean popular culture.
summary_zh: 研究流行与数字文化中的亚裔美国人再现与身份认同、韩国媒体中的他者化，以及离散群体对韩国流行文化的接受。

name: Rebecca Ortiz
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Advertising; Endowed Chair of Public Communications
summary: Studies how media and communication can improve the health and well-being of teens and young adults, developing and evaluating campaigns on sexual health, HPV vaccination, and sexual violence.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与传播如何促进青少年与年轻人的健康与福祉，开发并评估关于性健康、HPV疫苗接种与性暴力的传播活动。

name: Anne Osborne
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Communications
summary: Examines how entertainment and sports media reinforce and challenge power, focusing on gender, sport fandom, and media discourses about intersex and transgender athletes.
summary_zh: 研究娱乐与体育媒体如何强化或挑战权力结构，聚焦性别、体育粉丝文化以及关于间性与跨性别运动员的媒体话语。

name: Adam Peruta
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Director, Advanced Media Management; Interim Chair, Advertising; Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Studies how generative AI is reshaping the media business and professional practice, and how colleges and universities use social media for branding and recruitment.
summary_zh: 研究生成式人工智能如何重塑媒体商业与专业实践，以及高校如何利用社交媒体进行品牌建设与招生。

name: Steven Pike
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Public Relations and Public Diplomacy; Director, Public Diplomacy and Global Communications
areas: Writing for Public Administration and Government
summary: Studies public diplomacy practice, diplomatic identity, and place branding, using Q methodology to examine U.S. citizens' views of diplomacy and how practitioners from different nations perceive the profession.
summary_zh: 运用Q方法研究公共外交实践、外交身份与地方品牌，考察美国公民对外交工作的看法，以及不同国家的公共外交从业者如何看待这一职业。

name: Srividya Ramasubramanian
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Newhouse Professor, Communications
summary: Studies race and media, media literacy, implicit bias reduction, data justice, and intersectionality through critical media effects research and community-engaged scholar-activism.
summary_zh: 通过批判性媒介效果研究与社区参与式学者行动主义，研究种族与媒介、媒介素养、内隐偏见消减、数据正义与交叉性。

name: Alex Richards
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Focuses on data and investigative journalism, public records, and accountability reporting on government, crime, and the courts.
summary_zh: 关注数据与调查新闻、公共记录，以及针对政府、犯罪与法院的问责报道。

name: Milton Santiago
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Visual Communications; Director, Military Visual Journalism
summary: Explores how emerging technologies such as generative AI and virtual production are changing how visual stories are conceived, created, and taught in cinematography.
summary_zh: 探讨生成式人工智能和虚拟制片等新兴技术如何改变电影摄影中视觉故事的构思、创作与教学。

name: Erika Schneider
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies the purpose and effects of crisis communication, using experiments to test how message strategies shape stakeholder trust and emotions, including during disinformation crises.
summary_zh: 研究危机传播的目的与效果，通过实验检验信息策略如何影响利益相关者的信任与情绪，包括虚假信息危机情境。

name: Michael Schoonmaker
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Television, Radio and Film
summary: Focuses on media production in K-12 education, using filmmaking with teachers and students to support visual storytelling and urban school reform.
summary_zh: 关注中小学教育中的媒体制作，通过与师生合作拍片推动视觉叙事与城市学校教育改革。

name: Youngji Seo
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Takes a psychological approach to strategic communication, studying resilience, crisis recovery, and information processing in public relations and health risk communication.
summary_zh: 以心理学视角研究战略传播，关注公共关系与健康风险传播中的韧性、危机恢复与信息处理。

name: Michael O. Snyder
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Uses documentary photography and film to explore cultural heritage, environmental change, and human resilience, including how heritage sites adapt to climate change.
summary_zh: 以纪实摄影与电影探讨文化遗产、环境变化与人类韧性，包括文化遗产地如何适应气候变化。

name: Renée Stevens
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Designs motion graphics and augmented reality experiences, exploring how AR can help overcome learning disabilities and how design can serve social good.
summary_zh: 设计动态图形与增强现实体验，探索增强现实如何帮助克服学习障碍以及设计如何服务社会公益。

name: Bruce Strong
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: The Alexia Endowed Chair; Associate Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Practices and teaches photo, video, and multimedia documentary storytelling, drawing on international photojournalism across nearly 80 countries.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授图片、视频与多媒体纪实叙事，借鉴其在近80个国家的国际摄影新闻经验。

name: Emily Sydnor
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Syracuse University Institute for Democracy Journalism and Citizenship; Associate Professor, Newhouse DC
summary: Studies the political implications of incivility in mediated and interpersonal discourse and how people's attachments to U.S. states shape their political behavior.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与人际话语中不文明言论的政治影响，以及人们对美国各州的归属感如何塑造其政治行为。

name: Corey Takahashi
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Associate Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism; Associate Professor, Communications; Associate Professor, M.S. in Communications
summary: Researches generational change in media and culture and how technology reshapes storytelling for creators and audiences across text, audio, and video.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与文化中的代际变迁，以及技术如何在文字、音频与视频中为创作者与受众重塑叙事。

name: Robert Thompson
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Trustee Professor, Television, Radio and Film; Director, Bleier Center for Television and Popular Culture
summary: Studies television and popular culture, including the history of prime-time television series.
summary_zh: 研究电视与流行文化，包括黄金时段电视剧的历史。

name: Jodi Upton
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Knight Chair in Data and Explanatory Journalism; Professor, Magazine, News and Digital Journalism
summary: Focuses on data and investigative journalism, using databases and public records for accountability reporting.
summary_zh: 关注数据与调查新闻，运用数据库与公共记录开展问责报道。

name: Jason Webb
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Assistant Professor, Visual Communications
summary: Studies extended reality in education, creating XR learning content and examining remote instruction and how technology fosters student creativity.
summary_zh: 研究扩展现实在教育中的应用，开发XR学习内容，并探讨远程教学以及技术如何激发学生创造力。

name: Lars Willnat
dept: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications
title: Professor, Communications; John Ben Snow Endowed Research Chair
summary: Studies global journalism, political media effects, and public perceptions of news media in democracy through cross-national surveys and the American Journalist survey of U.S. journalists.
summary_zh: 通过跨国调查与“美国记者”全国调查，研究全球新闻业、媒介的政治效果以及公众对新闻媒体在民主中作用的认知。

name: Eulàlia P. Abril
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies persuasion and campaigns involving social media in health and political communication, including humor as a reaction to fear appeals.
summary_zh: 研究健康传播与政治传播中涉及社交媒体的说服与宣传运动，包括以幽默作为对恐惧诉求的反应。

name: Tanja Aitamurto
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people use media to express themselves and participate in democratic life, combining social science with engineering and design perspectives.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何借助媒介表达自我并参与民主生活，融合社会科学与工程及设计视角。

name: John A. Jones
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies persuasion, credibility, and conflict management in public, business, and intercultural settings, along with nonverbal communication and humor.
summary_zh: 研究公共、商业与跨文化情境中的说服、可信度与冲突管理，以及非语言传播与幽默。

name: Steve Jones
title: UIC Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the social and commercial uses of the internet and new and mobile media, and the social changes they bring.
summary_zh: 研究互联网及新媒体、移动媒体的社会与商业用途及其带来的社会变迁。

name: Do Own Donna Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies playful digital cultures and mediated social interaction across physical, virtual, and hybrid places, plus Korean digital feminism and popular media.
summary_zh: 研究跨越实体、虚拟与混合空间的游戏性数字文化与中介化社会互动，并关注韩国数字女性主义与流行媒介。

name: Jeehyun Jenny Lee
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the sociocultural and ethical implications of algorithmic social media, AI, and creator culture, focusing on power, inequity, and identity expression.
summary_zh: 研究算法化社交媒体、人工智能与创作者文化的社会文化及伦理影响，关注权力、不平等与身份表达。

name: Elena Maris
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies tensions between media and tech industries and their audiences, including audience measurement, platform politics, digital fandom, and LGBTQ+ users.
summary_zh: 研究媒体与科技产业和其受众之间的互动与张力，包括受众测量、平台政治、数字粉丝文化及LGBTQ+用户。

name: Zachary McDowell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies access and advocacy in digital peer production spaces such as Wikipedia, including digital literacy, video games, data ethics, and media manipulation.
summary_zh: 研究维基百科等数字同侪生产空间中的接入与倡导，涉及数字素养、电子游戏、数据伦理与媒介操纵。

name: Sharon Meraz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political communication and networked journalism on social media, using network analysis, automated content analysis, and NLP to test agenda setting and framing.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上的政治传播与网络化新闻，运用社会网络分析、自动内容分析与自然语言处理检验议程设置与框架理论。

name: Zizi Papacharissi
title: Department Head and UIC Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the social and political consequences of online and social media, with recent books on democracy's political future, connective AI, and digital media and democracy.
summary_zh: 研究网络媒体与社交媒体的社会和政治后果，近期著作涉及民主的政治未来、“连接型AI”以及数字媒介与民主。

name: Andrew Rojecki
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in political movements, racial politics, and globalization in American politics, increasingly using NLP-based textual analysis.
summary_zh: 研究政治运动、种族政治与全球化背景下美国政治中的传播，近来采用基于自然语言处理的文本分析。

name: Samuel Hardman Taylor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social media, AI, and mobile technologies affect personal relationships and mental health, and designs tools supporting connection and social media analytics.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体、人工智能与移动技术如何影响人际关系与心理健康，并设计支持社会联结的技术与社交媒体分析工具。

name: Cindy Tekobbe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the digital lives, identities, and activism of Indigenous and other underserved communities, Indigenous rhetorics, AI ethics, and gender and sexuality online.
summary_zh: 研究原住民及其他弱势社群的数字生活、身份与行动主义，原住民修辞，以及人工智能伦理和网络中的性别与性。

name: Jingyan Elaine Yuan
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how the internet and digital platforms mediate cultural practices and social change in China, and disinformation among Chinese Americans.
summary_zh: 研究互联网与数字平台如何中介中国的文化实践与社会变迁，以及虚假信息对美国华人的影响。

name: Leah Ceccarelli
title: Professor
summary: Studies the rhetoric of science and American public address through rhetorical criticism and theory, including scientific argument and public controversy.
summary_zh: 以修辞批评与修辞理论研究科学修辞与美国公共演说，关注科学论证与公共争议。

name: Amanda Friz
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines rhetorical-scientific constructions of women's sexual health and vernacular bioethics using rhetorical criticism, field methods, and queer feminist STS.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评、修辞田野方法与酷儿女性主义科技研究视角，考察女性性健康的修辞—科学建构与民间生命伦理。

name: Carmen Gonzalez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies digital equity and health communication, such as telemedicine, language access, and immigrant family information access, through community-based research.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究探讨数字公平与健康传播，包括远程医疗、医疗语言可及性以及移民家庭的信息获取。

name: Christine Harold
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes the rhetoric of consumer capitalism, branding, and popular culture, and the possibilities for political action and resistance within market logic.
summary_zh: 分析消费资本主义、品牌与流行文化的修辞，以及在市场逻辑下开展政治行动与抵抗的可能性。

name: Benjamin Mako Hill
title: Associate Professor
areas: peer production of digital public goods
summary: Studies the social dynamics of online communities engaged in peer production, like Wikipedia and free/open source software, using community data science.
summary_zh: 运用社区数据科学方法研究维基百科、自由与开源软件等同侪生产型网络社群的社会动态。

name: Jisoo Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication environments shape democracy, including perceived polarization and political expression, using experiments, surveys, and computational text analysis.
summary_zh: 运用实验、问卷调查与计算文本分析，研究传播环境如何塑造民主，包括感知极化与政治表达。

name: Wang Liao
title: Assistant Professor
areas: solidarity and hierarchy in everyday interaction
summary: Studies interpersonal and group interaction, social influence, and human-AI relationships using experiments, surveys, and computational analysis of behavioral traces.
summary_zh: 运用实验、问卷与行为痕迹的计算分析，研究人际与群体互动、社会影响以及人与AI的关系。

name: Patricia Moy
title: Professor
summary: Studies how mediated and interpersonal communication shape public opinion, political trust, and citizen behavior across issues and multiple continents.
summary_zh: 探讨媒介与人际传播如何在多个议题和多个大洲塑造舆论、政治信任与公民行为。

name: LeiLani Nishime
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes representations of multiracial and Asian American people in film, visual culture, and popular media, focusing on race, gender, and ecology.
summary_zh: 分析电影、视觉文化与流行媒体中混血族裔与亚裔美国人的再现，关注种族、性别与生态议题。

name: Katy Pearce
title: Associate Professor
areas: ICT affordances for social and opposition movements
summary: Studies social and political uses of digital technologies in authoritarian former Soviet states, including digital inequalities, opposition movements, and misinformation correction.
summary_zh: 研究前苏联威权国家中数字技术的社会与政治使用，涉及数字不平等、反对派运动与虚假信息纠正。

name: Matthew Powers
title: Professor
areas: comparative media (France and the United States)
sociology of journalism and cultural production
summary: Studies journalism as a profession and NGOs as newsmakers in international news, through comparative research in France and the United States.
summary_zh: 通过对法国与美国的比较研究，探讨新闻职业以及非政府组织在国际新闻中作为新闻生产者的角色。

name: Adrienne Russell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how journalism, activism, and technology companies shape publics around climate and other social problems, including networked journalism and surveillance.
summary_zh: 研究新闻、行动主义与科技公司如何围绕气候等社会问题塑造公众，涉及网络化新闻与监控。

name: Timeka Tounsel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines media narratives about and by Black women, including the commercial branding of Black women's empowerment, through feminist media and audience studies.
summary_zh: 从女性主义媒介研究与受众研究视角，考察关于黑人女性及由其创作的媒介叙事，包括黑人女性赋权的商业化品牌建构。

name: Doug Underwood
title: Professor
summary: Studies literary journalism, journalism and fiction, media ethics and management, and media and religion through historical and literary analysis of Anglo-American prose.
summary_zh: 通过对英美散文的历史与文学分析，研究文学新闻、新闻与小说、媒介伦理与管理以及媒介与宗教。

name: Savaughn Williams
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies identity and race in interpersonal relationships such as interracial friendships and families, using critical qualitative methods like interviews, photovoice, and ethnography.
summary_zh: 运用访谈、影像发声与民族志等批判质性方法，研究跨种族友谊、家庭等人际关系中的身份与种族问题。

name: Rodney Benson
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies how media ownership and the political economy of news shape journalism, comparing news production and immigration coverage across France, the US, and other countries.
summary_zh: 研究媒体所有权与新闻政治经济如何塑造新闻业，比较法国、美国等国的新闻生产与移民报道。

name: Deborah J. Borisoff
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies gender and communication, conflict management, listening, and organizational and cross-cultural communication in everyday and workplace life.
summary_zh: 研究性别与传播、冲突管理、倾听，以及日常与职场中的组织传播和跨文化传播。

name: Paula Chakravartty
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: James Weldon Johnson Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies the comparative political economy of media, race, empire, migration, and labor, combining critical analysis with field-based research on migrant debt in India.
summary_zh: 研究媒介、种族、帝国、移民与劳动的比较政治经济学，结合批判分析与印度移民债务的田野研究。

name: Lily Hope Chumley
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies art education, creative labor, design, and aesthetic value in postsocialist China through anthropological and semiotic analysis.
summary_zh: 通过人类学与符号学分析，考察后社会主义中国的艺术教育、创意劳动、设计与审美价值。

name: Yuchen Chen
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies China's data-driven governance and global outreach via digital platforms, using multi-sited ethnography of Chinese immigrant real estate and EB-5 brokerages in New York.
summary_zh: 研究中国的数据驱动治理及其借助数字平台的全球拓展，以多地点民族志考察纽约华人移民房地产与EB-5中介。

name: Stephen Duncombe
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication (Steinhardt and Gallatin)
summary: Studies the history and politics of media, cultural resistance, and creative activism, from zines and punk to utopian politics, and builds open digital activism resources.
summary_zh: 研究媒介的历史与政治、文化抵抗与创意行动主义，从地下杂志、朋克到乌托邦政治，并建设开放的数字行动主义资源。

name: Allen Feldman
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies violence, the body, the senses, and visual politics through ethnography in Northern Ireland, South Africa, and the global war on terror.
summary_zh: 通过在北爱尔兰、南非及全球反恐战争中的民族志，研究暴力、身体、感官与视觉政治。

name: Nicole R. Fleetwood
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Paulette Goddard Professor in Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies Black art and cultural history, photography, documentary, and art made under mass incarceration through critical, curatorial, and art-historical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判、策展与艺术史分析，研究黑人艺术与文化史、摄影、纪录片以及大规模监禁下的艺术创作。

name: Alexander Galloway
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies philosophy, technology, and theories of mediation, developing critical theory of digital media, interfaces, and software alongside software art projects.
summary_zh: 研究哲学、技术与中介理论，发展关于数字媒介、界面与软件的批判理论，并开展软件艺术项目。

name: Lisa Gitelman
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; Professor of English
summary: Studies media history, American book history, and techniques of inscription, tracing how new media and documents become meaningful against older media.
summary_zh: 研究媒介史、美国书籍史与书写技术，追溯新媒介与文献如何在旧媒介语境中获得意义。

name: Radha S. Hegde
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; MA Director
summary: Studies migration, media flows, globalization, and transnational feminism, including ethnographies of gender, violence, and motherhood in south India and the Indian diaspora.
summary_zh: 研究移民、媒介流动、全球化与跨国女性主义，包括对南印度及印度离散社群中性别、暴力与母职的民族志。

name: Edward B. Kang
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Assistant Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies how AI and machine listening systems formalize voice, emotion, and intelligence, drawing on science and technology studies, sound studies, and history of science.
summary_zh: 借助科学技术研究、声音研究与科学史，考察人工智能与机器听觉系统如何形式化声音、情绪与智能。

name: Jordan Kinder
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cultural politics of energy, infrastructure, and environment, analyzing pro-oil social media campaigns and pipeline archives through materialist media and Indigenous studies lenses.
summary_zh: 研究能源、基础设施与环境的文化政治，以物质主义媒介研究与原住民研究视角分析亲石油社交媒体运动与管道档案。

name: Kendra Kintzi
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decarbonization, digitalization, and development, examining how energy infrastructures and environmental media reshape landscapes and livelihoods in Southwest Asia.
summary_zh: 研究脱碳、数字化与发展，考察能源基础设施与环境媒介如何重塑西南亚的地景与生计。

name: Ted Magder
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Special Advisor for Policy, Strategy, and Innovation; Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies the legal and regulatory regimes governing cross-border flows of media and culture, including trade agreements, UNESCO cultural diversity policy, and national film policy.
summary_zh: 研究规制媒介与文化跨境流动的法律与监管制度，包括贸易协定、联合国教科文组织文化多样性政策与国家电影政策。

name: Charlton McIlwain
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Vice Provost for Faculty Engagement and Development; Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies race, digital media, and racial justice activism, including histories of Black internet use and how US political candidates invoke race in campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究种族、数字媒介与种族正义行动，包括黑人互联网使用的历史以及美国政治候选人如何在竞选中诉诸种族。

name: Mara Mills
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies (PhD); Director, NYU Center for Disability Studies; Director, Disability Studies Minor
summary: Studies disability and media, tracing the history, politics, and cultures of electronics, sound technologies, and digital media through disability studies and STS.
summary_zh: 以残障研究与科学技术研究视角，追溯电子技术、声音技术与数字媒介的历史、政治与文化。

name: Nicholas Mirzoeff
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; Department Chair
summary: Studies visual culture, visuality, and visual activism, analyzing whiteness, Black Lives Matter, and Palestine through critical image analysis.
summary_zh: 研究视觉文化、视觉性与视觉行动主义，通过批判性图像分析考察白人性、“黑人的命也是命”运动与巴勒斯坦。

name: Kelli Moore
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies how media and technology produce legal and political knowledge, analyzing domestic violence imagery, courtroom evidence, and race in US legal history.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与技术如何生产法律与政治知识，分析家庭暴力影像、法庭证据以及美国法律史中的种族问题。

name: Susan Murray
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies the history of television and post-war US technology, design, and industry, including color TV and closed-circuit television as infrastructure, as a media historian.
summary_zh: 作为媒介史学者，考察电视史及战后美国的技术、设计与产业，包括彩色电视以及作为基础设施的闭路电视。

name: Laine Nooney
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies the history and economics of the video game and personal computer industries, such as the Apple II and Sierra On-Line, through historical and cultural analysis.
summary_zh: 通过历史与文化分析，研究电子游戏与个人电脑产业的历史与经济，如Apple II与Sierra On-Line。

name: Whit Pow
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Assistant Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies trans and queer of color media history, examining how the state mediates trans lives through archives and bureaucratic documents, alongside electronic art and game history.
summary_zh: 研究跨性别与有色酷儿的媒介史，考察国家如何通过档案与官僚文件中介跨性别者的生活，并涉及电子艺术与游戏史。

name: Juan Pinon
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies Latin American transnational media corporations, US Latino television, and Latino representation, with comparative research on Ibero-American television fiction.
summary_zh: 研究拉美跨国媒体企业、美国拉丁裔电视与拉丁裔再现，并开展伊比利亚美洲电视剧的比较研究。

name: Arvind Rajagopal
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies television, Hindu nationalism, and the transformation of the public sphere in India, examining media, urban space, and political violence.
summary_zh: 研究电视、印度教民族主义与印度公共领域的转型，考察媒介、城市空间与政治暴力。

name: Erica Robles-Anderson
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies how media technologies produce space and collective experience, such as mediated megachurch worship and PowerPoint, using cultural history and psychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究媒介技术如何生产空间与集体体验，如媒介化的超大教会礼拜与PowerPoint，运用文化史与心理学方法。

name: Martin Scherzinger
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies sound, music, media, and politics, examining digital sound technologies, copyright, censorship, and global circulation of music across Europe, Africa, and America.
summary_zh: 研究声音、音乐、媒介与政治，考察数字声音技术、版权、审查以及音乐在欧洲、非洲与美洲的全球流通。

name: Natasha Schüll
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies the psychic life of technology, including addiction, gambling machine design, and self-tracking devices, through ethnography and documentary film.
summary_zh: 通过民族志与纪录片研究技术的心理生活，包括成瘾、赌博机设计与自我追踪设备。

name: Marita Sturken
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication
summary: Studies cultural memory, visual culture, and consumerism, analyzing memorials, museums, and media of the Vietnam War, AIDS, and post-9/11 American memory.
summary_zh: 研究文化记忆、视觉文化与消费主义，分析越战、艾滋病与9·11后美国记忆中的纪念碑、博物馆与媒介。

name: Helga Tawil-Souri
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; Associate Professor of Middle East and Islamic Studies
summary: Studies technology, media, territory, and politics in the Middle East, especially Palestine, examining borders, checkpoints, telecom infrastructure, and surveillance.
summary_zh: 研究中东尤其是巴勒斯坦的技术、媒介、领土与政治，考察边界、检查站、电信基础设施与监控。

name: Angela Xiao Wu
dept: Department of Media, Culture, and Communication
title: Associate Professor of Media, Culture, and Communication; Director of Graduate Studies (MA)
summary: Studies the politics of platforms, data, and knowledge infrastructures in China, using genealogical and STS approaches to platform governance and critical data studies.
summary_zh: 以谱系学与科学技术研究方法，研究中国平台、数据与知识基础设施的政治，关注平台治理与批判数据研究。

name: Jeremy Bailenson
title: Thomas More Storke Professor, Senior Fellow at the Woods Institute for the Environment and Professor, by courtesy, of Education
summary: Studies the psychology of virtual and augmented reality, building and studying VR systems that change social interaction and can transform education, environmental conservation, empathy, and health.
summary_zh: 研究虚拟现实与增强现实的心理机制，通过构建并研究VR系统，考察虚拟体验如何改变社会互动，以及如何变革教育、环境保护、同理心与健康。

name: Angèle Christin
title: Associate Professor of Communication, by courtesy, of Sociology and Senior Fellow at the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI
summary: Studies the social and cultural impact of algorithms and AI, using ethnography to examine web journalism metrics, influencers and algorithmic labor, predictive tools in courts, and AI ethics.
summary_zh: 研究算法与人工智能的社会文化影响，运用民族志考察网络新闻的流量指标、网红与算法劳动、法院中的预测工具以及AI伦理话语。

name: James S. Fishkin
title: Janet M. Peck Professor of International Communication, Senior Fellow at the Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies and Professor, by courtesy, of Political Science
summary: Studies deliberative democracy, developing Deliberative Polling, which uses random citizen samples to explore how opinions would change if people were more informed, with polls held in 28 countries.
summary_zh: 研究协商民主，开创“协商式民意调查”，以随机抽取的公民样本探究公众在更知情时观点会如何变化，已在28个国家开展。

name: James T. Hamilton
title: Freeman-Thornton Chair for the Vice Provost for Undergraduate Education, Hearst Professor and Senior Fellow at the Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research
summary: Studies the economics of news and media markets, including investigative journalism, regulation through disclosure, and computational journalism tools that lower the cost of story discovery.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与媒介市场的经济学，包括调查性新闻、以信息披露为手段的规制，以及降低新闻线索发现成本的计算新闻工具。

name: Jeff Hancock
title: Harry and Norman Chandler Professor of Communication and Senior Fellow at the Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies
summary: Studies psychological and interpersonal processes in social media and AI-mediated communication, including misinformation, deception and trust, and technology's effects on well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与AI中介传播中的心理与人际过程，涵盖虚假信息、欺骗与信任，以及技术对幸福感的影响。

name: Gabriella Harari
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how personality is expressed and shaped in physical and digital everyday contexts, using mobile sensing, experience sampling, longitudinal field studies, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究人格如何在日常的物理与数字情境中表达和被塑造，采用移动感知、经验取样、纵向田野研究与机器学习方法。

name: Shanto Iyengar
title: William Robertson Coe Professor and Professor of Political Science and of Communication
summary: Studies the role of mass media in democratic societies, including news effects on public opinion, negative campaigning, and political psychology.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒体在民主社会中的作用，包括新闻对舆论的影响、负面竞选广告与政治心理学。

name: Jon A. Krosnick
title: Frederic O. Glover Professor of Humanities and Social Sciences, Professor of Communication and of Political Science, of Environmental Social Sciences and, by courtesy, of Psychology
summary: Studies attitude formation, strength, and change, the psychology of political behavior, and questionnaire design and survey methodology, including American public opinion on climate change.
summary_zh: 研究态度的形成、强度与改变、政治行为心理学以及问卷设计与调查方法，包括美国公众对气候变化的看法。

name: Xiaochang Li
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies the history of information technology and knowledge production, tracing how speech recognition and natural language processing shaped AI and algorithmic culture.
summary_zh: 研究信息技术与知识生产的历史，追溯语音识别与自然语言处理如何塑造人工智能与算法文化。

name: Jennifer Pan
title: Sir Robert Ho Tung Professor of Chinese Studies, Professor of Communication, Senior Fellow at the Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies and Professor, by courtesy, of Political Science and of Sociology
summary: Studies political communication and authoritarian politics in China, using experimental and computational methods with large-scale data to examine censorship, propaganda, and information manipulation.
summary_zh: 研究中国的政治传播与威权政治，运用实验与计算方法及大规模数据，考察审查、宣传与信息操纵。

name: Nilam Ram
title: Professor of Communication and of Psychology
summary: Studies moment-to-moment and lifespan change in psychological and media processes such as emotion regulation, using intensive longitudinal designs and smartphone, sensor, and social media data.
summary_zh: 研究心理与媒介过程（如情绪调节）在瞬时与毕生尺度上的变化，采用密集纵向设计以及手机、传感器和社交媒体数据流。

name: Byron Reeves
title: Paul C. Edwards Professor of Communication and Professor, by courtesy, of Education
summary: Studies psychological processing of media, including attention, memory, and emotion, through experiments on interactive technologies and moment-by-moment screen data from the Human Screenome Project.
summary_zh: 研究媒介的心理加工过程，包括注意、记忆与情绪，通过对交互技术的实验以及“人类屏幕组计划”的逐刻屏幕使用数据开展研究。

name: Fred Turner
title: Chair, Department of Communication Harry and Norman Chandler Professor of Communication Director, Undergraduate Studies in Communication Akiko Yamazaki and Jerry Yang University Fellow in Undergraduate Education Professor, by courtesy, of Art and Art History and of History
summary: Studies media technology and cultural change in American life since World War II, tracing through historical research how counterculture, art, and Silicon Valley shaped digital utopianism.
summary_zh: 研究二战以来美国社会中的媒介技术与文化变迁，通过历史研究追溯反文化、艺术与硅谷如何塑造数字乌托邦主义。

name: Robyn B. Adams
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds an assistant professorship in media and communication; the department profile provides no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于媒体与传播学院助理教授；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Maggie Bennett-Brown
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies affectionate communication in romantic relationships and its links to sexual satisfaction, mental and physical health, and underlying biological correlates.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的情感表达传播，及其与性满足、身心健康和相关生物学指标之间的联系。

name: Shannon Bichard
title: Professor & Chairperson
summary: Studies the social impact of new and social media on groups such as children and older adults, plus advertising framing and persuasion, via content analysis and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体与社交媒体对儿童、老年人等群体的社会影响，以及广告框架与说服，主要采用内容分析与问卷调查。

name: Erik P. Bucy
title: Marshall and Sharleen Formby Regents Professor of Strategic Communication
summary: Studies visual and nonverbal dimensions of news and politics, user engagement with media technologies, and normative theories of media and democracy.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与政治中的视觉和非语言维度、用户对媒介技术的参与，以及媒介与民主的规范理论。

name: Coy Callison
title: Professor & Associate Dean for Research and Graduate Affairs
summary: Studies how source and message factors interact with audience cognition, with funded work on science, extreme weather, and water-scarcity communication for agricultural producers.
summary_zh: 研究信源与信息因素如何与受众认知相互作用，并主持关于科学、极端天气及面向农业生产者的水资源短缺传播的资助项目。

name: Seung Woo Chae
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies digital journalism and communication on video-based platforms such as YouTube and Twitch, informed by industry experience in Korean broadcasting.
summary_zh: 研究数字新闻以及YouTube、Twitch等视频平台上的传播，并结合其在韩国广播电视业的从业经验。

name: Todd Chambers
title: Associate Professor & Area Coordinator
summary: Studies media management and economics, including ownership, radio market structure and programming, Spanish-language radio, media sales, and sports media.
summary_zh: 研究媒介管理与媒介经济，包括所有权、广播市场结构与节目编排、西班牙语广播、媒体销售及体育媒体。

name: Minhee Choi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines the effects of advocacy messages and communication strategies on public health issues, drawing on prior nonprofit public relations work.
summary_zh: 考察倡导性信息与传播策略在公共卫生议题上的效果，并借鉴其非营利组织公关工作经验。

name: Ioana Coman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how individuals, organizations, media, and officials interact in risk and crisis communication around outbreaks, vaccines, terrorism, disasters, and climate change.
summary_zh: 研究个人、组织、媒体与官员在疫情、疫苗、恐怖袭击、灾害和气候变化等风险与危机传播中的互动。

name: Megan Condis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how games and technologies come to signify racialized, gendered, and sexualized identities, through cultural critique and historical study of gaming culture.
summary_zh: 通过文化批判与历史研究，考察游戏与技术如何被解读为种族化、性别化和性向化的身份符号。

name: Glenn Cummins
title: Professor and Associate Dean for Faculty and Academic Affairs
summary: Studies media psychology in sports and entertainment media using psychophysiology, eye tracking, and continuous response measurement.
summary_zh: 运用心理生理测量、眼动追踪与连续反应测量，研究体育与娱乐媒介中的媒介心理。

name: Lyombe Eko
title: William S. Morris Professor in Innovation, Journalism, and Information
areas: Comparative and international communication law and ethics
summary: Studies comparative and international communication law, ethics, and new media policy, along with collective memory and postcolonial politics in Africa, France, and the US.
summary_zh: 研究比较与国际传播法、传播伦理与新媒体政策，以及非洲、法国与美国的集体记忆和后殖民政治。

name: Sherice Gearhart
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how people use traditional and social media to form and express opinions, applying spiral of silence theory online with quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量方法考察人们如何借助传统媒体与社交媒体形成并表达意见，并将沉默的螺旋理论应用于网络环境。

name: Melissa Gotlieb
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emergent citizenship practices such as political consumerism and digital political expression, and how they shape young citizens' political participation.
summary_zh: 研究政治消费主义与数字政治表达等新兴公民实践，及其如何塑造年轻公民的政治参与。

name: Mark A. Gring
title: Associate Professor
summary: Researches rhetoric and political communication, with further interests in religion and classical pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与政治传播，并关注宗教与古典教学法。

name: Amy N. Heuman
title: Professor
summary: Studies cultural identity negotiation, intercultural relationships, and community mobilization for social justice through critical and feminist lenses, notably in Texas Latinx colonias.
summary_zh: 以批判与女性主义视角研究文化身份协商、跨文化关系及社区为社会正义的动员，尤其关注德州拉丁裔聚居区。

name: William T. Howe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication in high-reliability organizations, focusing on military and veteran identity, reintegration, and communication under risk.
summary_zh: 研究高可靠性组织中的组织传播，聚焦军人与退伍军人身份、重新融入社会以及风险情境下的传播。

name: Patrick Hughes
title: Professor and Department Chair
areas: Family Businesses, Legacy, and Succession Communication
summary: Examines how communication shapes learning, relationships, and adaptation, including communication competence, instructional communication, and family business succession.
summary_zh: 考察传播如何影响学习、关系与适应，涵盖传播能力、教学传播及家族企业传承。

name: Kulsawasd "Bo" Jitkajornwanich
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Applies computational and data science methods such as spatio-temporal data mining and GIS to environmental monitoring, disaster management, and social media.
summary_zh: 将时空数据挖掘、地理信息系统等计算与数据科学方法应用于环境监测、灾害管理和社交媒体。

name: Kerk F. Kee
title: Virginia and Choc Hutcheson Professor in Mass Communication
summary: Studies the diffusion of innovations such as big data cyberinfrastructure and AI in scientific organizations, and the spread of health and pro-environmental behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究大数据网络基础设施、人工智能等创新在科学组织中的扩散，以及健康与亲环境行为的传播。

name: Jenna LaFreniere
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication, focusing on conflict and its impacts, including divorce, emotion work, and privacy in health disclosure.
summary_zh: 研究人际与家庭传播，聚焦冲突及其影响，包括离婚、情绪劳动以及健康信息披露中的隐私。

name: Catherine "Katie" Langford
title: Associate Professor
summary: Researches rhetoric and political communication, with a specialization in legal rhetoric.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与政治传播，专长为法律修辞。

name: S. Austin Lee
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Public perceptions of AI and automation
AI and robotics in health and high-stakes contexts
summary: Studies how people communicate with, trust, and respond to AI and robots, including health uses and misinformation, using experiments, surveys, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验、调查与计算方法，研究人们如何与人工智能和机器人交流、信任并作出反应，包括健康应用与虚假信息。

name: Bryan McLaughlin
title: Professor & Director of Ph.D. Program
summary: Studies how citizens process political narratives and how problematic news consumption relates to political hostility, deliberation, and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究公民如何处理政治叙事，以及问题性新闻消费与政治敌意、协商和身心健康之间的关系。

name: Charles "Chas" Monge
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the social and moral psychology of online interaction, including toxicity in gaming and computer-mediated communication, using lab, survey, and field experiments.
summary_zh: 运用实验室、调查与田野实验，研究网络互动的社会与道德心理，包括游戏与计算机中介传播中的恶意行为。

name: Robert Peaslee
title: Associate Professor & Associate Dean of the Honors College
summary: Studies fan cultures, film, superheroes, and media and place, including screen tourism sites such as Hobbiton, through cultural and media-anthropological lenses.
summary_zh: 以文化研究与媒介人类学视角研究粉丝文化、电影、超级英雄以及媒介与地方，包括霍比屯等影视旅游地。

name: David D. Perlmutter
title: Professor
areas: Media, Public Policy, and Public Affairs
summary: Researches visual, political, and health communication and media and public policy, and writes widely on academic careers and higher education.
summary_zh: 研究视觉传播、政治传播、健康传播以及媒介与公共政策，并广泛撰写学术职业与高等教育相关文章。

name: Narissra M. Punyanunt-Carter
title: Professor
summary: Examines how romantic relationships, digital intimacy, deception, and identity evolve in technology-saturated settings, integrating interpersonal and media effects theory.
summary_zh: 融合人际传播与媒介效果理论，考察恋爱关系、数字亲密、欺骗与身份在技术高度渗透环境中的演变。

name: Melissa Santillana
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies international media flows, feminist activism and protest movements, and digital inequality, with a focus on Mexico and Latin American television.
summary_zh: 研究国际媒介流动、女性主义行动与抗议运动以及数字不平等，聚焦墨西哥与拉丁美洲电视。

name: Trent Seltzer
title: Professor & Chair
summary: Studies organization-public relationship management in political, health, and consumer contexts, and strategic communication that promotes adolescent mental health.
summary_zh: 研究政治、健康与消费情境中的组织—公众关系管理，以及促进青少年心理健康的战略传播。

name: Prerna Shah
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health and environmental risk communication, including secondary risk theory, diet-related messaging, climate anxiety, and virtual reality and emerging technology.
summary_zh: 研究健康与环境风险传播，包括次级风险理论、饮食相关信息、气候焦虑以及虚拟现实与新兴技术。

name: Maria Shpeer
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Identity, culture, and politics in media
summary: Studies the intersection of identity, culture, and politics in media in international contexts, using qualitative and quantitative social scientific methods.
summary_zh: 运用定性与定量社会科学方法，研究国际语境下媒介中身份、文化与政治的交织。

name: Miglena Sternadori
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies frames and stereotypes in media content, gender and sexuality in media, and how implicit biases shape media processing, using experiments among other methods.
summary_zh: 研究媒介内容中的框架与刻板印象、媒介中的性别与性，以及内隐偏见如何影响媒介信息加工，主要采用实验等方法。

name: Robert Stewart
title: Professor
summary: Researches interpersonal and instructional communication, communication and religion, and public speaking and professional presentations.
summary_zh: 研究人际传播与教学传播、传播与宗教，以及公共演讲与职业演示。

name: Anastasia A Vishnevskaya
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media narratives and visual primes about marginalized groups, such as Muslim women, shape public opinion, using qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用定性、定量与混合方法，研究关于穆斯林女性等边缘群体的媒介叙事和视觉启动如何影响公众舆论。

name: Buduo Wang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how people process and resist health messages online, including those from social media influencers and AI, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用实验与调查，考察人们如何在网络环境中加工并抵制健康信息，包括来自社交媒体网红和人工智能的信息。

name: Kent Wilkinson
title: Professor & Director, Harris Institute for Hispanic and International Communication
summary: Studies international communication and U.S. Hispanic/Latinx media, including Spanish-language television history, language in media markets, and Hispanic health communication.
summary_zh: 研究国际传播与美国西语裔/拉丁裔媒体，包括西班牙语电视史、媒介市场中的语言问题以及西语裔健康传播。

name: Luna Wu
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Primarily quantitative methods (survey, experiments, secondary data analysis)
summary: Studies patient-provider communication, telehealth, and digital health interventions that shape health decisions, using surveys, experiments, and statistical modeling.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验与统计建模，研究医患沟通、远程医疗以及影响健康决策的数字健康干预。

name: Shan Xu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the reciprocal, dynamic effects of AI, social media, and media multitasking on health, well-being, and productivity using longitudinal, EMA, and machine learning methods.
summary_zh: 运用纵向研究、生态瞬时评估和机器学习方法，研究人工智能、社交媒体与媒介多任务对健康、幸福感和生产力的动态互惠影响。

name: Michael J. Faris
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Department Chair; Professor
summary: Studies digital rhetoric and literacy practices, feminist and queer rhetorics, soundwriting, and composition and technical communication pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究数字修辞与读写实践、女性主义与酷儿修辞、声音写作，以及写作与技术传播教学。

name: Priyanka (Priya) Ganguly
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines rhetorics of health and medicine in transnational communication design on issues like menstruation, maternal nutrition, and abortion, using interviews and focus groups.
summary_zh: 运用访谈与焦点小组，考察跨国传播设计中的健康与医学修辞，涉及月经、孕产妇营养与堕胎等议题。

name: T J Geiger II
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Director of Undergraduate Studies for the BA in WDTC; Associate Professor
summary: Studies religious, feminist, and scientific rhetorics and deliberation, including evangelicalism and #MeToo, through rhetorical history and analysis.
summary_zh: 通过修辞史与修辞分析，研究宗教、女性主义与科学修辞及公共协商，包括福音派与#MeToo。

name: Kellie M. Gray
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: ENGL 2311 Coordinator; Assistant Professor
summary: Studies visual and digital rhetoric and technical communication pedagogy, including critical text mining of emoji use in #BlackLivesMatter.
summary_zh: 研究视觉修辞、数字修辞与技术传播教学，包括对#BlackLivesMatter中表情符号使用的批判性文本挖掘。

name: Steve Holmes
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Professor
summary: Applies material rhetoric and embodiment to digital texts like videogames and social media, and studies ethics of content moderation through qualitative research.
summary_zh: 将物质修辞与具身理论应用于电子游戏、社交媒体等数字文本，并通过质性研究探讨内容审核伦理。

name: Lisa L. Phillips
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Associate Professor
areas: Socio-environmental issues in the public sphere
summary: Studies environmental, Indigenous, and feminist rhetorics of sensation and embodiment, focusing on public protests over environmental injustice in marginalized communities.
summary_zh: 研究环境、原住民与女性主义修辞中的感官与具身，聚焦边缘社群针对环境不正义的公共抗议。

name: Beau S. Pihlaja
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Director of Graduate Studies for Technical Communication & Rhetoric; Associate Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies shape intercultural collaboration in global technical communication, using activity theory, actor-network theory, observation, and interviews.
summary_zh: 运用活动理论、行动者网络理论、观察与访谈，研究传播技术如何影响全球技术传播中的跨文化协作。

name: Rich Rice
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Professor
summary: Researches composition and rhetoric, new media, online writing instruction, and intercultural communication, with current work on generative AI and grant writing.
summary_zh: 研究写作与修辞、新媒体、在线写作教学与跨文化传播，目前关注生成式人工智能与基金申请写作。

name: Geoffrey Sauer
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of publishing through cultural and rhetorical theory, alongside usability, user experience, usable genres, and learning management systems as material rhetoric.
summary_zh: 以文化与修辞理论研究出版史，并关注可用性、用户体验、可用文类以及作为物质修辞的学习管理系统。

name: Brian Still
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Vice Provost, TTU Online
summary: Focuses on usability and eye-tracking research, including development of affordable and assistive eye-tracking hardware and software.
summary_zh: 专注于可用性与眼动追踪研究，包括开发低成本及辅助性的眼动追踪软硬件。

name: Imari Cheyne Tetu
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies disability, accessibility, and UX research in learning experience design, focusing on belonging for disabled and nontraditional students in hybrid courses.
summary_zh: 研究学习体验设计中的残障、无障碍与用户体验，关注残障及非传统学生在混合式课程中的归属感。

name: Jason Tham
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Assistant Chair; Associate Professor
summary: Studies design thinking, UX and usability, collaborative writing including in virtual reality, and AI user experience within technical communication pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究设计思维、用户体验与可用性、协作写作（包括虚拟现实中的协作写作）以及技术传播教学中的人工智能用户体验。

name: Scott Weedon
dept: Department of English (Technical Communication & Rhetoric program)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies writing in engineering disciplines, rhetorical genre studies, and rhetorics of science and medicine, including gender-inclusive research writing and informed consent.
summary_zh: 研究工程学科写作、修辞文类研究以及科学与医学修辞，包括性别包容的科研写作与知情同意。

name: Noor Ghazal Aswad
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how refugees and diasporic communities use rhetoric to negotiate identity, power and belonging, drawing on rhetorical, postcolonial and social movement theory.
summary_zh: 研究难民与离散社群如何运用修辞协商身份、权力与归属，借鉴修辞学、后殖民理论与社会运动理论。

name: Meredith Bagley
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses critical/cultural and rhetorical theory to study athlete voice, public memory of campus desegregation, and LGBTQ+ advocacy in sport and public spaces.
summary_zh: 运用批判/文化与修辞理论研究运动员的发声、校园种族隔离废除的公共记忆，以及体育与公共空间中的LGBTQ+倡导。

name: Mark Barry
title: Associate Professor, Director of Minerva
summary: Studies the environmental conditions, social dynamics and leadership strategies that build and sustain creative cultures in advertising.
summary_zh: 研究广告领域中构建并维系创意文化的环境条件、社会动态与领导策略。

name: A.J. Bauer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines right-wing media, press criticism and ideological journalism in the United States through archival and ethnographic research.
summary_zh: 通过档案与民族志研究，考察美国的右翼媒体、新闻批评与意识形态化新闻。

name: Andrew Billings
title: Professor, Associate Dean for Faculty, Initiative Director (Beyond Sports Initiative)
summary: Studies how sports media content and consumption shape public understanding of gender, race and identity, including Native American mascots and athlete mental health.
summary_zh: 研究体育媒体内容与消费如何塑造公众对性别、种族与身份的理解，包括美洲原住民吉祥物与运动员心理健康议题。

name: Anneliese Bolland
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies risk and protective factors for adolescents in economically disadvantaged communities and designs and evaluates community-based health interventions.
summary_zh: 研究经济弱势社区青少年面临的风险与保护因素，并设计和评估社区健康干预项目。

name: Courtney Boman
title: Associate Professor, Initiative Director (Media Literacy and MIS/Disinformation)
summary: Studies crisis and risk communication and information resilience, examining how organizations build trust and counter mis- and disinformation during crises.
summary_zh: 研究危机与风险传播及信息韧性，考察组织如何在危机中建立信任并应对错误信息与虚假信息。

name: Laurie Bonnici
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies information seeking and exchange via social media during crises and in everyday interaction, using natural language analysis.
summary_zh: 研究危机情境下及日常互动中人们如何通过社交媒体寻求与交换信息，采用自然语言分析方法。

name: Robin Boylorn
title: Distinguished Research Professor, Holle Endowed Chair and Director
summary: Uses autoethnography and personal narrative to study the lived experiences and identities of Black women, especially those from the rural U.S. South.
summary_zh: 运用自我民族志与个人叙事研究黑人女性（尤其是美国南方乡村黑人女性）的生活经验与身份。

name: Dianne Bragg
title: Professor, Associate Chair Dept. of Journalism and Creative Media
summary: Focuses on journalism practice and storytelling, including journalism education, media credibility and the professional and ethical norms of reporting.
summary_zh: 关注新闻实践与叙事，包括新闻教育、媒体可信度以及新闻报道的职业与伦理规范。

name: Rick Bragg
title: Professor
summary: Writes long-form journalism and narrative nonfiction about the people of the American South, drawing on a Pulitzer-winning reporting career.
summary_zh: 基于获普利策奖的记者生涯，撰写关于美国南方民众的长篇新闻与叙事性非虚构作品。

name: Josh Bramlett
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how campaigns, elected officials and brands use social media, advertising and strategic messaging to persuade and build relationships with voters and consumers.
summary_zh: 研究竞选团队、民选官员与品牌如何利用社交媒体、广告与战略信息说服选民和消费者并与之建立关系。

name: Nancy Brinson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how algorithmic personalized advertising shapes consumer decisions, privacy concerns, trust and perceived autonomy, with implications for regulation.
summary_zh: 考察算法驱动的个性化广告如何影响消费者决策、隐私担忧、信任与自主感，并探讨其规制意涵。

name: Brian Britt
title: Professor
summary: Applies computational and novel statistical methods to large-scale data to study how the communicative structures of online organizations emerge and evolve.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法与新型统计方法分析大规模数据，研究在线组织的传播结构如何形成与演化。

name: Adam Brooks
title: Associate Professor, Director of the Speaking Studio
summary: Focuses on public speaking instruction, helping scientists and engineers communicate technical expertise by combining rhetorical theory with practical coaching.
summary_zh: 专注于公共演讲教学，结合修辞理论与实践辅导，帮助科学家和工程师传达技术专业知识。

name: Kenon Brown
title: Professor, Director of the Institute for Communication and Information Research
summary: Studies image and reputation management, crisis response and fandom in sports media, examining how communication shapes audience perceptions and trust.
summary_zh: 研究体育媒体中的形象与声誉管理、危机应对与粉丝文化，考察传播如何塑造受众认知与信任。

name: Michael Bruce
title: Associate Professor, Director of Digital Media Center
summary: Studies risk and crisis communication with an emphasis on Arab media and international contexts, alongside documentary and live television production.
summary_zh: 研究风险与危机传播，侧重阿拉伯媒体与国际语境，同时从事纪录片与电视直播制作。

name: Sarah Bryant
title: Associate Professor, Book Arts Coordinator
summary: Creates artist books exploring archives, self-representation, population mapping and urban planning, examining how information is organized and displayed visually.
summary_zh: 创作艺术家书籍，探讨档案、自我呈现、人口地图与城市规划，考察信息如何被组织与视觉化呈现。

name: John Burgess
title: Associate Professor, Teaching Excellence Coordinator, Initiative Director (Information Policy and Ethics)
summary: Develops information and sustainability ethics frameworks to guide library and information professionals in building just and resilient communities.
summary_zh: 构建信息伦理与可持续性伦理框架，指导图书馆与信息专业人员建设公正且有韧性的社区。

name: Brian S. Butler
title: Dean, Professor
