summary: Studies online communities, social media dynamics and organizational resilience, including early computational analysis of large-scale social media.
summary_zh: 研究网络社群、社交媒体动态与组织韧性，包括对大规模社交媒体的早期计算分析。

name: Sim Butler
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses critical cultural, rhetorical and community-based participatory approaches to examine health communication and media representation affecting transgender communities.
summary_zh: 运用批判文化、修辞与社区参与式研究方法，考察影响跨性别社群的健康传播与媒体再现。

name: Ramona Caponegro
title: Professor, Associate Director of Graduate Programs
summary: Studies representation and social justice in children's and young adult literature, children's book awards, and the history of U.S. children's publishing and librarianship.
summary_zh: 研究儿童与青少年文学中的再现与社会正义、儿童图书奖，以及美国儿童出版与儿童图书馆事业的历史。

name: Chandra Clark
title: Associate Professor
summary: Produces documentary and multimedia work on broadcast coverage of U.S. natural disasters and partners with Central Alabama organizations on media messaging.
summary_zh: 制作关于美国自然灾害广播报道的纪录片和多媒体作品，并与阿拉巴马州中部社区组织合作开展媒体传播。

name: Kyle Clark
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the history of the book and bookbinding through close material analysis of physical books, from medieval manuscripts to artists' books.
summary_zh: 通过对实体书籍的细致物质分析研究书籍史与装订工艺，涵盖中世纪手稿到艺术家书籍。

name: Brandon Colvin
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes, directs and produces independent narrative feature films exploring character, place and human experience.
summary_zh: 编剧、导演并制作独立叙事长片，探讨人物、地方与人类经验。

name: George L. Daniels
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines media diversity, representation and newsroom practices, including community-centered journalism that amplifies underrepresented voices.
summary_zh: 考察媒体多元性、再现与新闻编辑室实践，包括放大弱势群体声音的社区导向新闻。

name: Trevor Diehl
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social media, podcasts and memes shape news engagement, political participation and public opinion, combining computational data with surveys.
summary_zh: 结合计算数据与问卷调查，研究社交媒体、播客与表情包如何影响新闻参与、政治参与和舆论。

name: Enzhu Dong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how organizations communicate CSR and prosocial values to employees and publics, and how these messages shape organization-public relationships.
summary_zh: 研究组织如何向员工与公众传达企业社会责任和亲社会价值，以及这些信息如何影响组织与公众关系。

name: Ch’Ree Essary
title: Assistant Professor of Science Communication
summary: Studies how experts and institutions communicate science, environmental and health information to publics, including science PR and social media strategy.
summary_zh: 研究专家与机构如何向公众传播科学、环境与健康信息，包括科学公关与社交媒体策略。

name: Kylie Falcione
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Combines communication, neuroscience and psychology to study problematic media use and how technology affects the mental health and brains of teens and young adults.
summary_zh: 结合传播学、神经科学与心理学，研究问题性媒介使用以及科技如何影响青少年与青年的心理健康和大脑功能。

name: Greg Gondwe
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies AI in journalism, misinformation and digital influence operations, focusing on how technology shapes information access and credibility in the Global South.
summary_zh: 研究新闻业中的人工智能、虚假信息与数字影响行动，聚焦技术如何塑造全球南方的信息获取与可信度。

name: Karla Gower
title: Professor
summary: Examines public relations history, law and crisis communication strategy, and studies leadership and ethics in the PR profession.
summary_zh: 考察公共关系的历史、法律与危机传播策略，并研究公关行业中的领导力与伦理。

name: Thomas Grant
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces investigative reporting and documentary films on justice, conflict and global issues, drawing on three decades in print and television journalism.
summary_zh: 基于三十年纸媒与电视新闻经验，制作关于正义、冲突与全球议题的调查报道和纪录片。

name: Darrin Griffin
title: Professor
summary: Studies nonverbal and deceptive communication, and communication in Deaf culture and sign language contexts.
summary_zh: 研究非语言传播与欺骗性传播，以及聋人文化和手语情境中的传播。

name: John Haley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Makes observational documentary films examining how social policies such as the death penalty and electoral politics shape individual lives and American identity.
summary_zh: 拍摄观察式纪录片，考察死刑、选举政治等社会政策如何塑造个人生活与美国身份认同。

name: Brandon Harris
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cultural production in livestreaming, esports and the creator economy, examining relations among creators, platforms, audiences and commercial interests.
summary_zh: 研究直播、电子竞技与创作者经济中的文化生产，考察创作者、平台、受众与商业利益之间的关系。

name: Heather Ashley Hayes
title: Associate Professor, Associate Dean for Graduate Studies
summary: Integrates rhetoric and neuroscience to study how public discourse, accessibility and learning models foster resilience, inclusion and social change.
summary_zh: 融合修辞学与神经科学，研究公共话语、无障碍与学习模式如何促进韧性、包容与社会变革。

name: Steven Holiday
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses biometric methods such as facial expression analysis and attention tracking to study how children and parents process advertising, including influencer marketing.
summary_zh: 运用面部表情分析与注意力追踪等生物计量方法，研究儿童与家长如何加工广告信息，包括网红营销。

name: Suzanne Horsley
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how government agencies and organizations craft and deliver crisis and emergency communication to maintain credibility and support disaster response.
summary_zh: 研究政府机构与组织如何制定和发布危机及应急信息，以维持公信力并支持灾害应对。

name: Rebecca K. Ivic
title: Associate Dean of Research, Scholarship, and Creative Activity; Professor, Health Communication
summary: Studies the quality, trustworthiness and integrity of health information across digital platforms and institutions, developing evidence-based quality indicators.
summary_zh: 研究数字平台与机构中健康信息的质量、可信度与完整性，并开发循证的信息质量指标。

name: Ginger Jolly
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces personal documentaries on racial and economic disparity, otherness and social isolation, centering lived experiences of marginalized communities.
summary_zh: 制作个人纪录片，聚焦种族与经济不平等、他者化与社会孤立，以边缘化社群的生活经验为中心。

name: Allison Jordan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces independent feature films and brings industry experience in film development, production and distribution to creative media teaching.
summary_zh: 制作独立剧情长片，并将电影开发、制作与发行的行业经验带入创意媒体教学。

name: Shaheen Kanthawala
title: Associate Professor, Initiative Director (information Policy and Ethics)
summary: Studies how people use health apps, social media and online communities to manage health, and how platform governance and influencers shape information.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何利用健康应用、社交媒体与网络社群管理健康，以及平台治理与网红如何影响信息环境。

name: Hyoungkoo Khang
title: Professor
summary: Draws on evolutionary psychology to explain engagement with persuasive media, social media and AI, including excessive use, well-being and youth identity formation.
summary_zh: 借鉴进化心理学解释人们对说服性媒介、社交媒体与AI的使用，包括过度使用、幸福感与青年身份形成。

name: Eyun-Jung Ki
title: Professor
summary: Studies organization-public relationships, crisis management and AI adoption in strategic communication using cross-cultural and computational approaches.
summary_zh: 运用跨文化与计算方法，研究组织与公众关系、危机管理以及人工智能在战略传播中的应用。

name: Jenna Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds an assistant professor post in library and information studies; the directory listing gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于图书馆与信息研究学院的助理教授；学院名录未提供研究方向说明。

name: Jihoon (Jay) Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how AI, human-computer interaction and immersive VR shape brand communication, attention, emotion and trust, including VR for intergenerational empathy.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能、人机交互与沉浸式VR如何影响品牌传播、注意力、情绪与信任，包括利用VR促进代际共情。

name: Dimitrios Latsis
title: Associate Professor, Ebsco Scholars Program Lead
summary: Studies American visual culture, early cinema historiography and audiovisual archiving, applying digital humanities methods to film archives.
summary_zh: 研究美国视觉文化、早期电影史学与视听档案保存，并将数字人文方法应用于电影档案。

name: Leah E. LeFebvre
title: Professor
summary: Studies relationship dissolution, mediated communication and the evolving relationship lexicon (e.g., ghosting), as well as small group and instructional communication.
summary_zh: 研究关系解体、中介化传播以及不断演变的关系词汇（如“鬼魂式分手”），并涉及小群体与教学传播。

name: Laura Lemon
title: Associate Professor, Initiative Director (Internal Communication and Engagement)
summary: Studies internal communication, employee engagement and mindfulness in strategic public relations, and their role in workplace culture and wellbeing.
summary_zh: 研究战略公关中的内部传播、员工敬业度与正念，及其在职场文化与福祉中的作用。

name: Yuan Li
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how users interact with search engines and generative AI, and designs information assistant tools to support learning and task completion.
summary_zh: 研究用户如何与搜索引擎和生成式AI交互，并设计信息助手工具以支持学习与任务完成。

name: Dongjae (Jay) Lim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies advertising literacy, sustainability public service announcements and the psychological factors shaping consumer responses to persuasive messages.
summary_zh: 研究广告素养、倡导可持续发展的公益广告，以及影响消费者回应说服性信息的心理因素。

name: Travis Loof
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people interpret risk and scientific forecasts and use AI decision support, co-designing hydrology and hazard communication tools with public agencies.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何理解风险与科学预报并使用AI决策支持，与公共机构共同设计水文与灾害传播工具。

name: Wilson Lowrey
title: Professor
summary: Studies the sociology of news organizations and media institutions, examining how routines, norms and new media forms evolve across local and global contexts.
summary_zh: 研究新闻组织与媒体机构的社会学，考察常规、规范与新媒体形态如何在地方与全球语境中演变。

name: Kun Lu
title: Associate Professor, Associate Director of Undergraduate Programs
summary: Applies natural language processing, text mining and large language models to information problems in science, health, education and the humanities.
summary_zh: 将自然语言处理、文本挖掘与大语言模型应用于科学、健康、教育与人文领域的信息问题。

name: Stefania Marghitu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies television genres, gender and screen culture, including teen TV and women showrunners in U.S. network television.
summary_zh: 研究电视类型、性别与银幕文化，包括青少年剧集以及美国电视网的女性制作人。

name: Brooke McKeever
title: Professor, Department Chair of Advertising & Public Relations
summary: Studies nonprofit public relations, advocacy, fundraising and health messaging, examining which campaigns and stories mobilize supporters and build trust.
summary_zh: 研究非营利公关、倡导、募款与健康信息传播，考察哪些运动和叙事能动员支持者并建立信任。

name: Robert McKeever
title: Professor
summary: Uses quantitative methods to study media effects, persuasion and campaign messaging in health communication and prosocial advocacy.
summary_zh: 运用量化方法研究健康传播与亲社会倡导中的媒介效果、说服与运动信息。

name: Mary Meares
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses qualitative and narrative analysis to study intercultural communication, including intercultural friendship, cultural risk perceptions and workplace mistreatment.
summary_zh: 运用质性与叙事分析研究跨文化传播，包括跨文化友谊、风险认知的文化差异与职场不当对待。

name: Bharat Mehra
title: Professor, Ebsco Endowed Chair in Social Justice
summary: Uses action research and community engagement to study social justice in library and information science and community informatics for underserved populations.
summary_zh: 通过行动研究与社区参与，研究图书馆与信息科学中的社会正义，以及服务弱势群体的社区信息学。

name: Kaitlin Miller
title: Associate Professor
summary: Draws on sociological perspectives to study harassment of journalists, media ownership, political pressure and the conditions of contemporary news work.
summary_zh: 借鉴社会学视角，研究记者遭受的骚扰、媒体所有权、政治压力以及当代新闻工作的条件。

name: Jamie Campbell Naidoo
title: Pauline Foster-EBSCO Endowed Professor
summary: Studies library services to diverse populations and diversity in print and digital children's and young adult media, including service to Latino communities.
summary_zh: 研究面向多元人群的图书馆服务，以及纸质与数字儿童及青少年媒介中的多元性，包括对拉丁裔社群的服务。

name: Jeonghyun Oh
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how verbal, visual and sensory cues shape group decision-making and persuasion, and how metacognition informs everyday use of communication theory.
summary_zh: 研究言语、视觉与感官线索如何影响群体决策与说服，以及元认知如何影响人们对传播理论的日常运用。

name: Jessy Ohl
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how visual and verbal rhetoric enables violence, focusing on war propaganda, public memory and democratic engagement.
summary_zh: 考察视觉与言语修辞如何促成暴力，聚焦战争宣传、公共记忆与民主参与。

name: Landon Palmer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of film's relationships with music and other industries in the late twentieth century, including cinematic rock stardom and Motown Productions.
summary_zh: 研究二十世纪后半叶电影与音乐及其他产业关系的历史，包括电影中的摇滚明星现象与摩城制作公司。

name: Elliot Panek
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses interviews, surveys and experiments to study uses and effects of entertainment and social media, including narcissism, parental restriction and self-control.
summary_zh: 运用访谈、问卷与实验研究娱乐媒介与社交媒体的使用及效果，包括自恋、家长限制与自我控制。

name: Caroline Parsons
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication pedagogy and experiential education, including internships, advising and mentoring that prepare students for professional work.
summary_zh: 研究传播教学法与体验式教育，包括帮助学生为职业做准备的实习、学业指导与导师制。

name: Cynthia Peacock
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people form, express and avoid political opinions in their social networks, and how disagreement and media exposure shape deliberation and civic engagement.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社交网络中形成、表达或回避政治观点，以及分歧与媒体接触如何影响协商与公民参与。

name: Joshua Pederson
title: Associate Professor, Department Chair of Communication Studies
summary: Studies relational communication under stress, including communal coping, supportive communication, transgressions and repair, and the role of personal networks.
summary_zh: 研究压力情境下的关系传播，包括共同应对、支持性传播、关系越轨与修复，以及个人网络的作用。

name: Gregory Perreault
title: Professor and Department Chair of Journalism & Creative Media
summary: Uses interviews with journalists to study digital journalism, lifestyle journalism and how the profession adapts to change.
summary_zh: 通过对记者的访谈研究数字新闻、生活方式新闻以及新闻职业如何适应变革。

name: Mimi Perreault
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies crisis communication and disaster journalism, including local news in recovery, misinformation and social media in rural and underserved communities.
summary_zh: 研究危机传播与灾害新闻，包括灾后恢复中的地方新闻、虚假信息，以及乡村和弱势社区中的社交媒体。

name: Ben Pyle
title: Associate Professor, Director of Alabama Forensic Council
summary: Focuses on competitive speech and debate, argumentation and public address, examining how advocacy shapes public discourse and democratic participation.
summary_zh: 专注于竞技演讲与辩论、论辩与公共演说，考察倡导如何影响公共话语与民主参与。

name: Bob Riter
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies archival and library history, archival research methods, and the publication of original historical sources and book arts collections.
summary_zh: 研究档案与图书馆史、档案研究方法，以及原始历史文献与书籍艺术藏品的出版。

name: Chris Roberts
title: Associate Professor
summary: Focuses on journalism ethics, professional responsibility and journalism education, including work revising the SPJ Code of Ethics.
summary_zh: 关注新闻伦理、职业责任与新闻教育，包括参与修订美国职业记者协会伦理准则。

name: Sean Sadri
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies sports journalism, sports fan identity, social media and news credibility, focusing on how audiences engage with sports content across platforms.
summary_zh: 研究体育新闻、体育迷身份、社交媒体与新闻可信度，聚焦受众如何跨平台参与体育内容。

name: Abdullah Salehuddin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies family communication, relational maintenance and wellbeing, including marital resilience and the impostor phenomenon among graduate students.
summary_zh: 研究家庭传播、关系维系与福祉，包括婚姻韧性以及研究生中的冒名顶替现象。

name: Ja Kyung Seo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how human-machine communication and AI-driven interactive campaigns shape cognitive and emotional processing of social marketing messages.
summary_zh: 研究人机传播与AI驱动的互动营销活动如何影响人们对社会营销信息的认知与情绪加工。

name: Jaclyn Shetterly
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social support for sexual assault survivors, inclusive classroom practices and intergenerational communication.
summary_zh: 研究对性侵幸存者的社会支持、包容性课堂实践与代际传播。

name: Sooyoung Shin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds an assistant professor post in journalism and creative media; the directory listing gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于新闻与创意媒体系的助理教授；学院名录未提供研究方向说明。

name: Miriam Sweeney
title: Professor, Director of SLIS
summary: Takes a critical digital media approach to voice assistants, chatbots and conversational AI, examining labor, power and human-machine relationships.
summary_zh: 以批判数字媒介视角研究语音助手、聊天机器人与对话式AI，考察劳动、权力与人机关系。

name: Jack Lipei Tang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses computational methods, network analysis and experiments to study advocacy on contentious social issues, information flow, AI and countering misinformation.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法、网络分析与实验研究争议性社会议题上的倡导、信息流动、人工智能与虚假信息应对。

name: Martina Topić-Rutherford
title: Associate Professor
summary: Draws on sociology to study how legitimacy, leadership and recognition are produced through communication in advertising, public relations and creative industries.
summary_zh: 借鉴社会学研究广告、公关与创意产业中合法性、领导力与认可如何通过传播被生产。

name: Matt VanDyke
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how science, environmental and risk information is communicated to publics and how media framing and science PR shape public perception.
summary_zh: 研究科学、环境与风险信息如何传达给公众，以及媒体框架与科学公关如何影响公众认知。

name: Alyxandra Vesey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Takes a feminist approach to musicians' creative labor across media industries, including merchandise, brand partnerships and digital self-presentation.
summary_zh: 以女性主义视角研究音乐人在媒体产业中的创意劳动，包括周边商品、品牌合作与数字自我呈现。

name: Jeff Weddle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes literary scholarship, poetry and prose on cultural history, place and outsider communities, including Bohemian New Orleans and Loujon Press.
summary_zh: 撰写关于文化史、地方与边缘群体的文学研究、诗歌与散文，包括新奥尔良波西米亚文化与Loujon出版社。

name: Mizuki Wyant
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how expatriate managers and host-national employees navigate cultural differences and build trust and collaboration in multicultural workplaces.
summary_zh: 研究外派管理者与东道国员工如何应对文化差异，并在多元文化职场中建立信任与协作。

name: Steven Yates
title: Professor, Associate Dean for Undergraduate Studies
summary: Focuses on school librarianship and educational leadership, preparing school library media specialists as instructional leaders and advocates.
summary_zh: 关注学校图书馆事业与教育领导力，培养作为教学领导者与倡导者的学校图书馆媒体专家。

name: Qin Zhu
title: Associate Professor, Dean’s Distinguished Research Fellow, Director of the Human-Centered Intelligent Systems Initiative
summary: Studies human-centered AI, AI and information ethics, human-robot interaction and AI literacy, examining how intelligent systems can support human flourishing.
summary_zh: 研究以人为中心的AI、AI与信息伦理、人机器人交互及AI素养，探讨智能系统如何促进人类福祉。

name: Danford Zirugo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies journalistic cultures in the Global South, including media capture, professional roles and political-economic pressures, through comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 通过比较分析研究全球南方的新闻文化，包括媒体俘获、职业角色以及政治经济压力。

name: Kirstie Farrar
title: Associate Professor
areas: Contextual features of violent video game play and aggression
Television’s impact on family communication patterns
summary: Studies psychological effects of mass media, especially violent video games and aggression, sex on television, and children's media use, using media effects experiments.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒介的心理效果，尤其是暴力电子游戏与攻击性、电视中的性内容以及儿童媒介使用，主要采用媒介效果实验。

name: Anne Oeldorf-Hirsch
title: Associate Professor
areas: Information sharing in online social networks
summary: Studies how people share information and build community on social media, focusing on algorithmic literacy on apps like TikTok and Instagram, misinformation, and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社交媒体上分享信息、建立社群，重点关注TikTok和Instagram等应用中的算法素养、虚假信息与用户福祉。

name: David Atkin
title: Professor
summary: Studies the adoption, use, and regulation of new communication technologies, telecommunications policy, and television audiences.
summary_zh: 研究新传播技术的采纳、使用与规制，以及电信政策和电视受众。

name: Saraswathi Bellur
title: Associate Professor
areas: the concept of interactivity and its effect on users’ evaluation of media interfaces, mediated content and user engagement
the effect of interactive health technologies and their influence on attitudes toward preventive and proactive health behaviors
the role of psychophysiological responses [heart-rate (ECG), skin conductance (EDA), and brain-wave (EEG)] in understanding user responses to different forms of media and mediated content
summary: Studies the psychological and physiological effects of interactive media and health technologies, using psychophysiological measures (ECG, EDA, EEG) and theory building.
summary_zh: 研究交互式媒介与健康技术的心理和生理效果，采用心电、皮电、脑电等心理生理测量并进行理论建构。

name: John Christensen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social dynamics between humans and artificial intelligence, including algorithm aversion, identity threat, and AI anxiety, drawing on social psychology.
summary_zh: 借助社会心理学视角研究人类与人工智能之间的社会互动，包括算法厌恶、身份威胁与AI焦虑。

name: Amanda Cooper
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Communication at the End of Life
summary: Studies how everyday family and relational communication shapes relationship quality and health, especially in dementia caregiving and aging, often using qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究日常家庭与关系传播如何影响关系质量和健康，尤其关注失智症照护与老龄化，常采用质性方法。

name: Shardé M. Davis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how Black women communicate with close others and in groups to manage marginalization, developing the Strong Black Woman Collective theory with quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究黑人女性如何与亲密他人及群体沟通以应对边缘化处境，提出“强大黑人女性集体”理论，并结合定量与质性方法。

name: Amanda Denes
title: Professor
areas: Social Support, Relational Maintenance, and Infidelity
summary: Studies communication in close relationships, including sexual communication and couples facing cancer, and its links to health, using biosocial approaches.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的传播，包括性沟通以及面对癌症的伴侣沟通，并以生物社会取向考察其与健康的关联。

name: Mark Hamilton
title: Professor
summary: Studies social influence across marketing and persuasion, including message production, language intensity effects, source credibility, chronemics, and national culture in marketing content.
summary_zh: 研究营销与说服中的社会影响，包括讯息生产、语言强度效果、信源可信度、时间传播学以及国家文化对营销内容的影响。

name: Elizabeth Hintz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate difficult conversations about stigmatized and poorly understood health conditions in families and relationships, using qualitative and feminist approaches.
summary_zh: 研究人们在家庭与关系中如何就受污名化、难以理解的健康状况进行艰难对话，采用质性与女性主义取向。

name: Kenneth Lachlan
title: Professor
summary: Studies crisis, emergency, and risk communication, including media dependency during disasters, community risk mitigation, and cognitive processing of emergency messages.
summary_zh: 研究危机、应急与风险传播，包括灾害期间的媒介依赖、社区风险缓解干预以及对应急讯息的认知加工。

name: Carolyn A. Lin
title: Professor
areas: Advertising, public relations, marketing, intercultural, and political communication
Online media, social media, mobile media, augmented reality, and generated AI
Risk, crisis, health, science, and environmental communication
Biometric responses to information, message, and visual stimuli (via the CASE lab)
summary: Studies persuasive communication in advertising, PR, health, and environmental risk, building games and mobile apps for risk prevention and measuring biometric responses to messages.
summary_zh: 研究广告、公关、健康与环境风险中的说服传播，开发用于风险预防的游戏和移动应用，并测量受众对讯息的生物计量反应。

name: Zexin “Marsha” Ma
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health message design and effects, including narrative persuasion, defensive responses to risk information, health misinformation correction, and AI chatbots for health communication.
summary_zh: 研究健康讯息的设计与效果，包括叙事说服、对风险信息的防御性反应、健康虚假信息纠正以及用于健康传播的AI聊天机器人。

name: Rory McGloin
title: Associate Professor
areas: Predictors and outcomes of organizational communication training and development
Entrepreneurial mindset, self-efficacy, and business communication skills
Characteristics of effective communication amongst leaders
Perceptions of online source expertise and credibility
summary: Studies organizational communication training and development, entrepreneurial and leadership communication skills, and perceptions of online source credibility.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播培训与发展、创业者及领导者的沟通技能，以及对网络信源可信度的感知。

name: Kristine Nowak
title: Professor
summary: Studies how mediated technologies such as avatars and social media shape person perception, identity, persuasion, and learning, evaluating system design for communication goals.
summary_zh: 研究头像化身与社交媒体等中介技术如何影响人物感知、身份认同、说服与学习，并评估面向不同传播目标的系统设计。

name: Tyler Page
title: Associate Professor and Stamford Faculty Coordinator
summary: Studies public relations and crisis perception through moral foundations theory, historical work on PR's moral roots, computational analysis of PR scholarship, and stakeholder theory.
summary_zh: 从道德基础理论研究公共关系与危机感知，并开展公关道德根源的历史研究、公关学术的计算分析以及利益相关者理论建构。

name: Diana Rios
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mass media and intercultural communication processes through Chicana/o-Latina/o studies, ethnicity, race, and gender perspectives.
summary_zh: 从奇卡诺/拉丁裔研究、族裔、种族与性别视角研究大众媒介与跨文化传播过程。

name: Jocelyn Steinke
title: Professor
areas: Broadening STEM participation through media intervention
summary: Studies media images of STEM professionals and their effects on adolescent girls' STEM interest and identity, including women in STEM on TikTok, to broaden STEM participation.
summary_zh: 研究STEM从业者的媒介形象及其对青春期女孩STEM兴趣与身份认同的影响，包括TikTok上的STEM女性，以扩大STEM参与。

name: Jiyoun Suk
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cross-platform, multimodal communication shapes misinformation, activism, and polarization for marginalized groups, using NLP, network analysis, computer vision, and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究跨平台、多模态传播如何影响虚假信息、社会行动与政治极化及其对边缘群体的冲击，结合NLP、网络分析、计算机视觉与调查和访谈。

name: Alan DeSantis
title: Professor
summary: Studies college fraternity culture, nonprescribed stimulant use, and cigar smoking, including qualitative analyses of alcohol and persuasion in popular fraternity films.
summary_zh: 研究大学兄弟会文化、非处方兴奋剂使用与雪茄吸食，并对兄弟会题材流行电影中的饮酒描绘与说服叙事进行质性分析。

name: Jess Dominguez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people maintain friendships, family ties, and well-being through texting, group chats, memes, and chatbots, including queer friendships and loneliness.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过短信、家庭群聊、表情包和聊天机器人维系友谊与家庭关系及个人幸福感，包括酷儿友谊与孤独感。

name: Marko Dragojevic
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies language attitudes, accent bias, and linguistic stereotypes, examining how processing fluency and social categorization shape listeners' evaluations of speakers.
summary_zh: 研究语言态度、口音偏见与语言刻板印象，探讨加工流畅性和社会分类如何影响听者对说话者的评价。

name: Allison Gordon
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in medical decision making, from ICU family meetings and advance care planning to genetic risk disclosure and cancer survivorship, mainly through qualitative and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究医疗决策中的沟通，包括ICU家庭会议、预立医疗照护计划、遗传风险告知与癌症幸存者经历，主要采用质性与混合方法。

name: Rebecca Greer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication among foreign and migrant workers, including acculturation, stigma, upward dissent, defensive silence, and workplace gossip, with attention to Japan and the US.
summary_zh: 研究外籍与移民劳动者的组织传播，包括文化适应、污名、向上异议、防御性沉默与职场八卦，关注日本和美国情境。

name: Sitong Guo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sport communication and athlete social media self-presentation across Chinese and US contexts, comparing cultural values in fan and audience responses.
summary_zh: 研究体育传播与运动员社交媒体自我呈现，比较中美情境下球迷与受众反应中的文化价值观差异。

name: Nancy Harrington
title: Professor
summary: Studies persuasive health message design and interventions, including sensation seeking, substance use prevention, and randomized trials of HIV/HCV screening messages in emergency departments.
summary_zh: 研究说服性健康信息设计与干预，包括感觉寻求、物质滥用预防，以及在急诊科开展的HIV/HCV筛查信息随机对照试验。

name: Don Helme
title: Professor, Associate Dean of Research
areas: RA0421 Public health. Hygiene. Preventive Medicine
summary: Studies and evaluates large-scale health communication campaigns on opioids, tobacco, and HPV vaccination, using formative focus groups and randomized message trials in Kentucky communities.
summary_zh: 研究并评估针对阿片类药物、烟草与HPV疫苗的大型健康传播运动，在肯塔基社区中采用形成性焦点小组与随机信息试验。

name: Hannah Jones
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies family communication under stress, such as bereavement, infertility, and political conflict, using longitudinal dyadic surveys to test relational turbulence and communal coping.
summary_zh: 研究压力情境下的家庭沟通，如丧亲、不孕与政治冲突，采用纵向二元调查检验关系动荡理论与共同应对。

name: Callie Kalny
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in the Department of Communication; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于传播学系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Derek Lane
title: Professor
summary: Studies instructional and risk communication, examining how hazard and weather warning messages shape risk perception and how students communicate in team-based and online learning.
summary_zh: 研究教学传播与风险传播，探讨灾害与天气预警信息如何影响风险感知，以及学生在团队学习和在线学习中的沟通。

name: Danni Liao
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies patient-provider communication and social support, especially international medical graduates' verbal and nonverbal strategies and migrants' coping, drawing on qualitative methods and scoping reviews.
summary_zh: 研究医患沟通与社会支持，尤其是国际医学毕业生的言语与非言语策略及移民群体的应对，运用质性方法与范围综述。

name: Anthony Limperos
title: Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies the uses and effects of video games, exergames, and sports media, including audience responses to portrayals of athlete intimate partner violence, including experimental and content-analytic work.
summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、体感运动游戏与体育媒体的使用和效果，包括受众对运动员亲密伴侣暴力报道的反应，研究涉及实验与内容分析。

name: Chandler Marr
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how organizational discourses shape employees' emotions, compassion, resilience, and dirty work, using interviews and ethnography to surface organizational contradictions.
summary_zh: 研究组织话语如何塑造员工的情绪体验、同情、韧性与“肮脏工作”，借助访谈和民族志揭示组织中的矛盾与悖论。

name: Kelly McAninch
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies how people manage difficult conversations, including romantic partners discussing relationship problems and families and peers talking about health, coping, and social support.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对困难对话，包括恋人讨论关系问题，以及家人和同伴之间关于健康、应对与社会支持的交流。

name: Aurora Occa
title: Associate Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates persuasive messages and interventions for complex or stigmatized health issues such as clinical trials, cancer screening, and mental health, across media and countries.
summary_zh: 设计并评估针对复杂或污名化健康议题（如临床试验、癌症筛查与心理健康）的说服性信息与干预，涉及多种媒介与国家。

name: Andrew Pilny
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication and interorganizational networks with social network analysis and machine learning, including AI coding of small group interaction and corporate control networks.
summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与机器学习研究传播网络和组织间网络，包括用人工智能编码小群体互动以及企业控制网络。

name: Kevin Real
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in healthcare organizations, linking hospital built environments, care teams, and patient safety through observation, behavior mapping, and focus groups.
summary_zh: 研究医疗组织中的沟通，通过观察、行为映射与焦点小组，将医院建成环境、医护团队与患者安全联系起来。

name: Jennifer Scarduzio
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the dark side of interpersonal, health, and organizational communication, including workplace and online sexual harassment, burnout, and intimate partner violence, through qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究人际、健康与组织传播的阴暗面，包括职场与网络性骚扰、职业倦怠和亲密伴侣暴力，主要采用质性方法。

name: Amber Lynn Scott
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies team communication in high reliability organizations and the military, including grief and embodied trauma after organizational failure, using qualitative and content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究高可靠性组织与军队中的团队沟通，包括组织失败后的哀伤与具身创伤，采用质性研究与内容分析。

name: Qingru Xu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies athlete and influencer self-branding and social media self-presentation, comparing Chinese and US sport audiences and examining how branding cues shape trust and authenticity.
summary_zh: 研究运动员与网红的自我品牌塑造及社交媒体自我呈现，比较中美体育受众，并探讨品牌线索如何影响信任与真实性感知。

name: Xun Zhu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies intergroup prejudice, stereotypes, and identity in health and narrative messages, plus deception and neighborhood storytelling networks, using experiments, network analysis, and meta-analysis.
summary_zh: 研究健康与叙事信息中的群际偏见、刻板印象与身份认同，以及欺骗信息和社区叙事网络，采用实验、网络分析与元分析。

name: Deborah Chung
title: Professor, Associate Dean for Undergraduate Programs
summary: Studies online and citizen journalism and journalists' role conceptions, along with how brands' humanlike social media presence drives consumer engagement, in US and South Korean contexts.
summary_zh: 研究网络新闻与公民新闻及记者角色认知，并研究品牌在社交媒体上的拟人化呈现如何驱动消费者参与，涉及美国与韩国情境。

name: Erika Engstrom
title: Director, Professor
summary: Studies television and film through critical textual analysis of religion, gender, and sexuality, from Catholic horror and Mad Men to queer comedy.
summary_zh: 通过批判性文本分析研究电视与电影中的宗教、性别与性向议题，涵盖天主教恐怖剧、《广告狂人》与酷儿喜剧。

name: Carey Higgins-Dobney
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies labor, technology, ownership, and burnout in US local television newsrooms, including unionization and the working conditions of digital journalists.
summary_zh: 研究美国地方电视新闻编辑室中的劳动、技术、所有权与职业倦怠，包括工会化及数字记者的工作条件。

name: Kyra Hunting
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies television, children's media, and fandom, analyzing gender representation and industrial intertextuality in franchises such as Disney, Barbie, and My Little Pony.
summary_zh: 研究电视、儿童媒介与粉丝文化，分析迪士尼、芭比、小马宝莉等媒介系列中的性别再现与产业互文性。

name: Yung Soo Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies photojournalism and visual journalism, examining ethical dilemmas, professional versus citizen roles, and framing through content analysis of news images and television.
summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影与视觉新闻，通过对新闻图片和电视的内容分析考察伦理困境、职业与公民记者角色以及框架。

name: Kathryn Montalbano
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how US communication law and policy have shaped speech, press, assembly, and religious expression since the nineteenth century, using historical research on media law and surveillance.
summary_zh: 研究十九世纪以来美国传播法律与政策如何塑造言论、新闻、集会与宗教表达，以历史方法研究媒介法与监控。

name: Beecher Reuning
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Jennifer Smith
title: Assistant Professor, Journalism Sequence and Internship Coordinator
summary: Studies media law and public records, analyzing tensions between open records laws, privacy, and college athletes' name, image, and likeness agreements.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法与公共记录，分析公开记录法、隐私权与大学运动员姓名、形象和肖像权协议之间的张力。

name: David Stephenson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Zixue Tai
title: Professor, Media Arts and Studies Sequence Coordinator
summary: Studies digital media use and mental health among Chinese students, including problematic smartphone use, gaming, and pandemic coping, mainly through surveys and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究中国学生的数字媒介使用与心理健康，包括问题性智能手机使用、游戏和疫情期间的应对，主要采用调查与混合方法。

name: Kakie Urch
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cultural studies, modernism, typography, and rhetorical delivery, using critical and textual analysis of popular and literary texts such as self-help books.
summary_zh: 研究文化研究、现代主义、字体排印与修辞表达，以批判与文本分析方法解读自助书等通俗及文学文本。

name: Alyvia Walters
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in the School of Journalism and Media; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于新闻与媒体学院；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Alyssa Eckman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the boundary between journalism and advertising, using ethnographic case studies of organizational conflict over advertorials in news organizations.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与广告之间的边界，以民族志个案研究考察新闻机构中围绕“软文广告”产生的组织冲突。

name: Sarah Geegan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in integrated strategic communication; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于整合战略传播系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Adriane Grumbein
title: Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies advertising creativity, visual communication, and advertising careers and diversity, including content analysis of graphic and design elements.
summary_zh: 研究广告创意、视觉传播以及广告职业发展与多元化，包括对图形与设计元素的内容分析。

name: Erin Hester
title: Assistant Professor
areas: The Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia
summary: Studies public interest communication and social marketing, designing campaigns on health and risk issues such as lung cancer screening and opioid abatement with community partners and focus groups.
summary_zh: 研究公共利益传播与社会营销，与社区伙伴合作并借助焦点小组，为肺癌筛查、阿片类药物治理等健康与风险议题设计传播活动。

name: Hyun Ju Jeong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility, cause-related marketing, and green advertising, testing through experiments how messages drive consumers' and Gen Z's pro-environmental behavior.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任、善因营销与绿色广告，通过实验检验信息如何推动消费者及Z世代的亲环境行为。

name: Mengtian “Montina” Jiang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how consumers process branded content in digital spaces, including influencer marketing, native advertising, live-streaming commerce, and AI influencers, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究消费者如何处理数字空间中的品牌内容，包括网红营销、原生广告、直播电商与AI网红，采用混合方法。

name: Hanyoung Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Holds a faculty post in integrated strategic communication; the department profile gives no research description.
summary_zh: 任职于整合战略传播系；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

name: Jihye Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cause-related marketing, CSR, and digital consumer engagement, including virtual influencers, ChatGPT adoption, and Korean media-driven tourism.
summary_zh: 研究善因营销、企业社会责任与数字消费者参与，包括虚拟网红、ChatGPT采纳及韩国媒介驱动的旅游。

name: Leigh Moscowitz
title: Professor, Chair
summary: Studies media framing of LGBTQ+ issues, especially gay and trans athletes, and lifestyle advertorials, using framing and discourse analysis of US news and digital media.
summary_zh: 研究媒体对LGBTQ+议题（尤其是同性恋和跨性别运动员）及生活方式软文的框架呈现，对美国新闻与数字媒体开展框架与话语分析。

name: Kimberly Parker
title: Professor
summary: Studies health and social marketing campaigns and inoculation messaging, testing message length and modality in experiments on vaccine uptake and college students' mental health.
summary_zh: 研究健康与社会营销运动及免疫（预防接种）信息，通过实验检验信息长度与模态对疫苗接种和大学生心理健康的影响。

name: Elizabeth Spencer
title: Assistant Professor
areas: N Visual arts (General) For photography, see TR
summary: Studies visual communication, digital media, and health contexts, especially media messages about people living with dementia and their caregivers, plus medical tourism websites.
summary_zh: 研究视觉传播、数字媒体与健康情境，尤其是关于失智症患者及其照护者的媒介信息，以及医疗旅游网站。

name: Weilu Zhang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies AI and human influencers, chatbots, and brand engagement on social media, using deep learning text analysis of platform data.
summary_zh: 研究AI与真人网红、聊天机器人以及社交媒体上的品牌互动，采用基于深度学习的平台文本分析。

name: Kelsey Brod
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Creates open-world games and machinima with game engines to explore an aesthetics of computational performance, with interests in media studies, gender, feminism, and sexuality.
summary_zh: 利用游戏引擎创作开放世界游戏与机器电影，探索计算表演的美学，研究兴趣涉及媒介研究、性别、女性主义与性存在。

name: Lisa Calvente
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines anti-Black and brown racism, Black diaspora experience, and coloniality through performance and cultural studies, focusing on storytelling, surveillance, and liberation.
summary_zh: 从表演研究与文化研究视角考察反黑人与棕色人种的种族主义、黑人离散经验与殖民性，关注叙事、监控与解放。

name: E. Chebrolu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Works in rhetorical studies; the department profile gives no further detail on specific research topics or methods.
summary_zh: 从事修辞学研究；院系主页未提供具体研究主题或方法的更多信息。

name: Renee Alexander Craft
title: Professor/Director, Southern Oral History Program/Bowman and Gordon Gray Distinguished Term Professor
summary: Studies the Congo carnival performance tradition of an Afro-Latin community in Portobelo, Panama as a Black feminist performance studies scholar, through scholarship, digital humanities, and fiction.
summary_zh: 以黑人女性主义表演研究学者的身份，通过学术写作、数字人文项目与小说创作，研究巴拿马波托韦洛非裔拉丁社区的“Congo”狂欢节表演传统。

name: Sarah Dempsey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizing for social change, nonprofit accountability, meaningful work, and labor politics in the U.S. food system from critical organizational and feminist perspectives.
summary_zh: 从批判组织传播与女性主义视角，研究社会变革中的组织化、非营利部门问责、有意义的工作以及美国食品体系中的劳动政治。

name: David Dooling
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses (auto)ethnographic methods to study identity, sexuality, shame, and economic insecurity in organizations, social movements, and food assistance programs.
summary_zh: 运用（自我）民族志方法，研究组织、社会运动和食物援助项目中的身份、性向、羞耻感与经济不安全感。

name: Julia Haslett
title: Associate Professor
summary: Makes expressionistic documentary films on empathy, attention, and bearing witness, including a series on U.S. healthcare inequities and a poetic film on plants and their caretakers.
summary_zh: 创作表现主义纪录片，探讨共情、注意与见证，包括关于美国医疗不平等的系列片和一部关于植物及其照料者的诗意影片。

name: Sun-ha Hong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies belief, doubt, and speculation around AI, prediction, surveillance, and self-tracking, tracing the historical styles of reasoning behind claims about data-driven technologies.
summary_zh: 研究围绕人工智能、预测、监控与自我追踪的信念、怀疑与推测，追溯数据驱动技术相关论述背后的历史推理风格。

name: Burç Köstem
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cultural politics of infrastructure, economic nationalism, and green capitalism in Turkey, drawing on critiques of political economy, affect theory, and environmental humanities.
summary_zh: 借助政治经济学批判、情动理论与环境人文学，研究土耳其基础设施的文化政治、经济民族主义与绿色资本主义。

name: Christian O. Lundberg
title: Associate Professor
summary: Theorizes publics and public discourse through rhetorical theory and Lacanian psychoanalysis, including religious discourse in Islam and Evangelical Christianity.
summary_zh: 借助修辞理论与拉康精神分析理论化公众与公共话语，包括伊斯兰教与福音派基督教中的宗教话语。

name: Steve May
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational ethics, corporate social responsibility, and the relationship between work and identity using interpretive, critical, and post-structuralist perspectives.
summary_zh: 运用阐释、批判与后结构主义视角，研究组织伦理、企业社会责任以及工作与身份之间的关系。

name: Torin Monahan
title: Professor
summary: Studies the social and cultural dimensions of surveillance systems, focusing on racial and gender inequalities, including AI surveillance in higher education.
summary_zh: 研究监控系统的社会与文化维度，聚焦种族与性别不平等，包括高等教育中的人工智能监控。

name: Michael Palm
title: Associate Professor/Director of Cultural Studies
summary: Studies the political economy of popular culture and everyday technology, including labor ethnography of the vinyl record supply chain after digitization.
summary_zh: 研究流行文化与日常技术的政治经济学，包括对数字化之后黑胶唱片供应链的劳动民族志研究。

name: Patricia Parker
title: Professor/Director, Institute for the Arts & Humanities/Ruel W. Tyson, Jr. Distinguished Professor
summary: Conducts community-based participatory research on communication for social justice, examining race, gender, power, and catalytic leadership in communities and organizations.
summary_zh: 开展社区参与式研究，探讨促进社会正义的传播，考察社区与组织中的种族、性别、权力与催化型领导力。

name: Tony Perucci
title: Professor
summary: Studies experimental performance and the aesthetics of political intervention, including Mary Overlie's Six Viewpoints and Paul Robeson's Cold War performance, as scholar and artist.
summary_zh: 以学者兼艺术家身份研究实验表演与政治介入的美学，包括玛丽·奥弗利的“六视点”与保罗·罗伯逊的冷战时期表演。

name: Joyce Rudinsky
title: Professor
summary: Creates electronic and interactive media artworks that investigate how information technology shapes lived experience, cognition, and sensory perception.
summary_zh: 创作电子与交互媒体艺术作品，探究信息技术如何塑造生活经验、认知与感官知觉。

name: Avi Santo
title: Professor
summary: Studies media industries and transmedia brand licensing, examining how licensing professionals extend entertainment franchises into consumer products for children and fans.
summary_zh: 研究媒介产业与跨媒介品牌授权，考察授权从业者如何把娱乐系列延伸为面向儿童与粉丝的消费品。

name: Haley Schneider
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses critical rhetorical analysis to study how communities renegotiate collective identity and futures in response to environmental crises, sustainability debates, and urban planning.
summary_zh: 运用批判修辞分析，研究社区如何在环境危机、可持续性争论与城市规划中重新协商集体身份与未来。

name: Lior Shamriz
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Makes experimental, narrative, and essay films that challenge reductive narratives about immigration, nationality, and sexuality, often centered on the MENA region and its diasporas.
summary_zh: 创作实验、叙事与散文电影，挑战关于移民、国族与性向的简化叙事，常聚焦中东北非地区及其离散群体。

name: Aaron Shapiro
title: Associate Professor/Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how smart-city technologies, algorithms, and infrastructure intersect with urban governance, policing, inequality, and the financialization of everyday life.
summary_zh: 研究智慧城市技术、算法与基础设施如何与城市治理、警务、不平等以及日常生活金融化相互交织。

name: Kumi Silva
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies identity, postcolonial politics, and popular culture, examining how racialized identification and affective appeals shape the security state, migration, and belonging.
summary_zh: 研究身份、后殖民政治与流行文化，考察种族化的认同与情感诉求如何塑造安全国家、移民与归属。

name: Michael Waltman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the social and political functions of hate speech, including its role in hate crime, ethnoviolence, and White privilege, and the features of anti-hate discourse.
summary_zh: 研究仇恨言论的社会与政治功能，包括其在仇恨犯罪、族群暴力与白人特权中的作用，以及反仇恨话语的特征。

name: Deb Aikat
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Theorizes how media platforms in India and the United States empower civic protest and expression, integrating agenda-setting and agenda-melding concepts.
summary_zh: 整合议程设置与议程融合概念，理论化印度与美国的媒体平台如何赋能公民抗议与表达。

name: Shaun Anderson
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Knight Chair in Sports, Race and Media
summary: Studies sports, race, and media, focusing on Black athlete activism and the sport justice movement in the era of #BlackLivesMatter.
summary_zh: 研究体育、种族与媒介，聚焦#BlackLivesMatter时代的黑人运动员行动主义与体育正义运动。

name: Lucinda Austin
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor / Associate Dean for Graduate Studies and Research
summary: Studies how social media shapes strategic communication, especially health and crisis communication, and how publics view corporate social responsibility and organization-public relationships.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体如何影响战略传播（尤其是健康与危机传播），以及公众如何看待企业社会责任和组织—公众关系。

name: Spencer Ryan Barnes
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor / Associate Dean of Undergraduate Curricula and Enrollment Management / Provost Distinguished Faculty Leader
summary: Studies how journalists produce and use dynamic visual communication such as information graphics and animation to help audiences comprehend complex news.
summary_zh: 研究记者如何制作和运用信息图表、动画等动态视觉传播产品，帮助受众理解复杂新闻。

name: Andy Bechtel
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor / Director, Graduate Certificate Programs
summary: Focuses on news editing, reporting, and writing practice and journalism education, drawing on newspaper copy-editing experience and work on AP style guidance.
summary_zh: 关注新闻编辑、采写实践与新闻教育，借鉴报纸文字编辑经验及美联社写作规范方面的工作。

name: Lois Boynton
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ethical decision-making by public relations practitioners and journalists, along with professionalism, social responsibility, and the impact of DEI initiatives.
summary_zh: 研究公关从业者与记者的伦理决策，以及职业主义、社会责任和多元、公平与包容（DEI）举措的影响。

name: Lorra M. Brown
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor / Director, Master of Arts in Digital Communication Program
summary: Focuses on the future of leadership communication, disruption in public relations and integrated marketing communication, stakeholder trust, and digital influence.
summary_zh: 关注领导力传播的未来、公共关系与整合营销传播中的变革、利益相关者信任以及数字影响力。

name: Joshua Carlton
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Brings practitioner expertise in brand strategy, account planning, and data-driven consumer insights to advertising and strategic communication teaching.
summary_zh: 将品牌策略、客户策划与数据驱动的消费者洞察等业界经验带入广告与战略传播教学。

name: Francesca Renee Dillman Carpentier
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Interim Senior Associate Dean for Academic and Faculty Affairs / W. Horace Carter Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how subtle features of media messages and media-choice motivations shape thoughts and behavior, including food marketing to children and young adults' sexual health.
summary_zh: 研究媒介信息的细微特征与媒介选择动机如何影响思想与行为，包括针对儿童的食品营销与年轻人的性健康。

name: Meredith D. Clark
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor of Race and Political Communication
summary: Studies race and political communication, focusing on Black Twitter and the rise of digital counternarratives.
summary_zh: 研究种族与政治传播，聚焦“黑人推特”（Black Twitter）与数字反叙事的兴起。

name: Nori Comello
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor / Associate Dean of ABIDE
summary: Studies how identity shapes health communication and behavior-change efforts, testing digital health interventions for underserved populations and linking health messaging to workplace inclusion.
summary_zh: 研究身份如何影响健康传播与行为改变干预，检验面向弱势群体的数字健康干预，并将健康信息与职场包容相联系。

name: Paul Cuadros
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Reports and writes on race, poverty, and Latino immigration in rural Southern U.S. towns as an investigative journalist and author.
summary_zh: 作为调查记者与作家，报道和书写美国南方乡村小镇中的种族、贫困与拉丁裔移民问题。

name: Lightning Czabovsky
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines PR, advertising, and strategic communication measurement, focusing on audience segmentation and niche audiences in a fragmented media environment.
summary_zh: 研究公关、广告与战略传播的效果测量，关注碎片化媒介环境中的受众细分与小众受众。

name: Patrick Davison
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Practices and teaches photojournalism, video, and documentary multimedia storytelling, leading international student documentary projects.
summary_zh: 从事并教授新闻摄影、视频与纪录式多媒体叙事，带领学生开展国际纪录项目。

name: Tori Ekstrand
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Studies First Amendment law, media and technology policy, and comparative U.S.-EU approaches to academic freedom, free expression, and AI regulation.
summary_zh: 研究美国宪法第一修正案、媒介与技术政策，以及美国与欧盟在学术自由、言论自由和人工智能监管方面的比较。

name: Valerie “VK” Fields
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Brings public relations agency and corporate practice to teaching public relations, crisis communication, and strategic writing.
summary_zh: 将公关代理与企业实务经验带入公共关系、危机传播与战略写作教学。

name: Livis Freeman
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Distinguished Associate Professor of Sports Communication
summary: Brings practitioner experience in sports public and community relations for professional athletes to teaching sports communication.
summary_zh: 将为职业运动员提供公共与社区关系服务的实务经验带入体育传播教学。

name: Barbara Friedman
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Studies representations of gender, race, sexuality, and class in historical and contemporary media, including news coverage of sex trafficking and oral histories of journalists.
summary_zh: 研究历史与当代媒体中的性别、种族、性向与阶级再现，包括性交易的新闻报道以及新闻从业者的口述历史。

name: Harsha Gangadharbatla
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Interim Dean / Hugh Morton Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the role of technology in advertising, advertising's place in society, and environmental communication.
summary_zh: 研究技术在广告中的作用、广告在社会中的角色以及环境传播。

name: Scott Geier
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Works on front-end web development, data visualization, augmented reality, photogrammetry, and generative art, drawing on investigative reporting experience.
summary_zh: 从事前端网页开发、数据可视化、增强现实、摄影测量与生成艺术，并借鉴调查报道经验。

name: Rhonda Gibson
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor / Director, M.A. in Media and Communication in Journalism
summary: Studies how exemplification in journalism shapes issue perceptions and the effects of media images of sexual minorities, including public opinion on same-sex marriage.
summary_zh: 研究新闻中的例证如何影响议题认知，以及媒体中性少数群体形象的效果，包括关于同性婚姻的舆论。

name: Kristen Harrison
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Richard Cole Eminent Professor
summary: Studies media content, uses, and effects among children, adolescents, and families, focusing on body image, eating, health, and neurodivergent children's media use.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、青少年与家庭的媒介内容、使用与效果，聚焦身体意象、饮食、健康以及神经多样性儿童的媒介使用。

name: Chad Heartwood
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Makes documentary films and teaches photojournalism and documentary storytelling, including films on environmental and farming subjects broadcast on public television.
summary_zh: 拍摄纪录片并教授新闻摄影与纪录叙事，作品包括在公共电视播出的环境与农耕题材影片。

name: Joe Bob Hester
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies advertising, interactive media, and media agenda setting, publishing in journalism and mass communication journals.
summary_zh: 研究广告、交互媒体与媒介议程设置，成果发表于新闻与大众传播期刊。

name: Gary Kayye
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Brings technology branding and marketing industry experience to teaching new media's impact on advertising, marketing, PR, and personal branding.
summary_zh: 将科技品牌与营销行业经验带入关于新媒体对广告、营销、公关及个人品牌影响的教学。

name: Carl William Kenney
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Practices and teaches community journalism and storytelling on faith, identity, and the Black experience, editing a community-based Durham news publication.
summary_zh: 从事并教授社区新闻，书写信仰、身份与黑人经验，并主编达勒姆的一份社区新闻刊物。

name: Steven King
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Prototypes and deploys AI, computer vision, robotics, and immersive technologies, exploring how they reshape organizations, industries, and higher education.
summary_zh: 开发并部署人工智能、计算机视觉、机器人与沉浸式技术原型，探讨它们如何重塑组织、产业与高等教育。

name: Nazanin Knudsen
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor / ABIDE Committee Chair
summary: Produces documentary, immersive, and cross-platform stories for journalism, advocacy, and nonprofits, and writes nonfiction on identity, memory, and immigration.
summary_zh: 为新闻、倡导与非营利机构制作纪录、沉浸式与跨平台故事，并撰写关于身份、记忆与移民的非虚构作品。

name: Daniel Kreiss
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Edgar Thomas Cato Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies political communication, digital platforms, and democracy, including media and the January 6 attack and the political strategies of leaders such as Trump and Orbán.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、数字平台与民主，包括媒体与1月6日国会冲击事件，以及特朗普、欧尔班等政治领袖的传播策略。

name: Allison Lazard
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates visual and social media health messages and campaigns for cancer prevention, cancer support, and wellness promotion, drawing on media effects research.
summary_zh: 基于媒介效果研究，设计并评估面向癌症预防、癌症支持与健康促进的视觉及社交媒体健康信息与运动。

name: Suman Lee
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor / Director, M.A. in Media and Communication in Strategic Communication / Director of Visiting International Scholars (VIS) Program
summary: Studies international public relations and public diplomacy, including foreign governments' PR spending in the U.S. and its news effects, and Japanese and Korean diplomacy.
summary_zh: 研究国际公共关系与公共外交，包括外国政府在美国的公关投入及其对新闻的影响，以及日本与韩国的公共外交。

name: Trevy McDonald
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media socialization, audiences, race, and gender, and collects oral histories of Black journalists who covered the Civil Rights Movement.
summary_zh: 研究媒介社会化、受众、种族与性别，并收集报道民权运动的黑人记者的口述历史。

name: Shannon C. McGregor
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of media and social media in political processes, focusing on interplay among politicians, journalists, and the public, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究媒体与社交媒体在政治过程中的作用，聚焦政治人物、记者与公众之间的互动。

name: Lee McGuigan
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor / Director, Ph.D. program / Director, M.A. Theory and Research program
summary: Studies the history and political economy of advertising and adtech, tracing how efforts to predict consumer behavior and sell audience attention fueled data-driven surveillance.
summary_zh: 研究广告与广告技术的历史及政治经济学，追溯预测消费者行为、售卖受众注意力的努力如何推动数据驱动的监控。

name: Renee Mitson
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies internal public relations, focusing on leader-employee communication, emerging technology, and well-being in authentic, ethical workplaces.
summary_zh: 研究内部公共关系，聚焦领导与员工的沟通、新兴技术以及真诚、合乎伦理的职场中的员工福祉。

name: Torod Neptune
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Brings corporate communications leadership experience to questions of the chief communications officer role, data-driven communication strategy, and stakeholder capitalism.
summary_zh: 将企业传播高管经验用于探讨首席传播官角色、数据驱动的传播策略与利益相关者资本主义。

name: Seth M. Noar
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: James Howard and Hallie McLean Parker Distinguished Professor
summary: Designs, implements, and evaluates health messages and campaigns, focusing on cancer prevention and tobacco control, in grant-funded studies testing communication strategies.
summary_zh: 在受资助研究中设计、实施并评估健康信息与运动，检验传播策略，聚焦癌症预防与控烟。

name: Terence Oliver
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Walter Spearman Distinguished Professor
summary: Produces motion graphics and explanatory videos and pioneered collegiate courses in motion graphics journalism and visual communication.
summary_zh: 制作动态图形与解释性视频，并开创了大学动态图形新闻与视觉传播课程。

name: Marisa Porto
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Knight Chair in Local News and Sustainability
summary: Focuses on local news sustainability and the digital transformation of news organizations, drawing on newsroom executive experience and international consulting.
summary_zh: 关注地方新闻的可持续性与新闻机构的数字化转型，借鉴新闻编辑室管理经验与国际咨询工作。

name: Amanda Reid
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of law, technology, and society, focusing on freedom of expression, intellectual property, privacy, and technology governance.
summary_zh: 研究法律、技术与社会的交叉，聚焦言论自由、知识产权、隐私与技术治理。

name: Raul Reis
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: John T. Kerr Distinguished Professor
summary: Focuses on journalism and digital media education amid technological change, drawing on experience as a journalist and dean; no specific research agenda is described.
summary_zh: 以记者与院长经历关注技术变革中的新闻与数字媒体教育；主页未描述具体研究议程。

name: Laura Ruel
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Conducts applied user experience and design research, using eye tracking in usability studies to understand user behavior with digital interfaces and news design.
summary_zh: 开展应用型用户体验与设计研究，在可用性研究中运用眼动追踪，理解用户与数字界面及新闻设计的互动行为。

name: Erin Siegal McIntyre
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Practices investigative journalism and photojournalism exposing corruption, fraud, and human rights abuses in Latin America and along the U.S.-Mexico border.
summary_zh: 从事调查新闻与新闻摄影，揭露拉丁美洲及美墨边境的腐败、欺诈与人权侵害。

name: Ryan Thornburg
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Associate Professor
summary: Teaches journalism drawing on a decade of online newsroom leadership; the profile lists no specific research focus.
summary_zh: 依托十年网络新闻编辑室管理经验教授新闻学；主页未列出具体研究方向。

name: C.A. Tuggle
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: John H. Stembler Jr. Distinguished Professor
summary: Trains broadcast journalists in storytelling and cross-platform sports and news coverage, drawing on a career in local television news.
summary_zh: 依托地方电视新闻从业经历，培养广播电视记者的叙事能力与跨平台体育及新闻报道能力。

name: Xinyan (Eva) Zhao
dept: Hussman School of Journalism and Media
title: Professor
summary: Studies crisis, disaster, and health communication on social media among diverse cultural groups using computational methods including LLMs, machine learning, and network analysis.
summary_zh: 运用大语言模型、机器学习与网络分析等计算方法，研究不同文化群体在社交媒体上的危机、灾难与健康传播。

name: Jesse Abdenour
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies investigative news quality, ownership, and audience trust in local TV news using content analysis, experiments, and surveys.
summary_zh: 通过内容分析、实验和调查研究美国地方电视调查报道的新闻质量、所有权结构与受众信任。

name: Jakki Bailey
title: Assistant Professor of Media Studies
summary: Studies how immersive virtual reality and interactive technology shape children's cognition, social responses, and connection in remote learning.
summary_zh: 研究沉浸式虚拟现实与交互技术如何影响儿童的认知、社会反应以及远程学习中的社会联结。

name: Thomas Bivins
title: Professor
summary: Studies mass media ethics, especially public relations ethics, alongside communication history.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒介伦理，尤其是公共关系伦理，并关注传播史。

name: Christopher Chávez
title: Carolyn Silva Chambers Distinguished Professor of Advertising
summary: Studies how global media and advertising industries construct Latinx identity and audiences, using critical cultural analysis of industry practices.
summary_zh: 以批判文化分析考察全球媒体与广告产业如何建构拉丁裔身份与受众，以及边缘群体在市场中的赋权。

name: Alex Segrè Cohen
title: Assistant Professor of Science and Risk Communication
summary: Studies how people perceive and communicate about emerging environmental and health risks and how information sources shape public judgments.
summary_zh: 研究公众如何感知和沟通新兴环境与健康风险，以及信息来源如何塑造公众判断。

name: Diego Cortés
title: Assistant Professor of Media Studies
summary: Studies Andean indigenous media, community radio, and evangelical media practices in Colombia, Ecuador, and Bolivia through ethnography, archives, and oral history.
summary_zh: 通过民族志、档案与口述史研究哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和玻利维亚安第斯原住民媒体、社区广播与福音派媒体实践。

name: Nicole Dahmen
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual journalism, media ethics, and solutions and contextual reporting from a normative perspective on public-interest journalism.
summary_zh: 从规范视角研究视觉新闻、媒介伦理以及解决方案式与语境化报道，倡导公共利益新闻。

name: Donna Davis
title: Professor, Endowed Chair in Public Relations
summary: Studies embodied identity and community in virtual worlds and XR, especially among people with disabilities, through ethnography; also strategic communication.
summary_zh: 通过民族志研究虚拟世界与XR中的具身身份与社群，尤其关注残障人群，同时研究战略传播。

name: Troy Elias
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media effects, diversity and equity in advertising, and how to communicate climate change to communities of color.
summary_zh: 研究媒介效果、广告中的多元与公平，以及如何向有色人种社群传播气候变化。

name: Maxwell Foxman
title: Associate Professor of Game and Media Studies
summary: Studies games and play in non-game contexts, including game journalism, esports, and immersive XR media, and their media professions.
summary_zh: 研究游戏与玩在非游戏情境中的作用，包括游戏新闻、电子竞技、沉浸式XR媒体及相关媒介职业。

name: Saima Kazmi
title: Assistant Professor of Advertising
summary: Studies consumer psychology in green advertising and how organizations communicate sustainability initiatives and climate activism.
summary_zh: 研究绿色广告中的消费者心理，以及组织如何传播其可持续发展举措与气候行动。

name: Peter Laufer
title: Professor, James N. Wallace Chair of Journalism
summary: Writes book-length narrative journalism on borders, migration, identity, and animal rights, and studies talk radio and conflict-sensitive reporting.
summary_zh: 以长篇叙事新闻书写边界、移民、身份与动物权利，并研究谈话广播与冲突敏感报道。

name: Regina Lawrence
title: Edwin L. Artzt Dean
areas: Political communication: campaign communication, media coverage/social media and elections
Civic engagement: political participation, voter behavior
Media coverage of politics and policy
summary: Studies media coverage of politics and policy, gender and campaign social media strategies, and engaged journalism in newsrooms.
summary_zh: 研究政治与政策的媒体报道、性别与竞选社交媒体策略，以及新闻编辑室中的参与式新闻。

name: Hayoung Sally Lim
title: Assistant Professor of Advertising and Brand Responsibility
summary: Studies AI in advertising, brand crisis communication, and corporate social advocacy, including social media content analysis of consumer reactions.
summary_zh: 研究广告中的人工智能、品牌危机传播与企业社会倡导，包括对消费者反应的社交媒体内容分析。

name: Ed Madison
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how journalistic, project-based storytelling methods improve student achievement in K-12 education, especially for underserved youth.
summary_zh: 研究新闻式、项目制叙事学习方法如何提升K-12学生（尤其是弱势青少年）的学业表现。

name: Gabriela Martínez
title: Professor and Jon Anderson Chair in Journalism and Communication
summary: Studies the political economy of media and telecom in Latin America, media and human rights, and social movements, alongside ethnographic documentary filmmaking.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁美洲媒体与电信的政治经济学、媒体与人权及社会运动，并从事民族志纪录片创作。

name: Nikki McClaran
title: Assistant Professor, Public Relations Program
summary: Studies cognitive and social determinants of health behavior and how to design persuasive mediated health messages using theory-driven message research.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为的认知与社会决定因素，以及如何以理论为基础设计具有说服力的媒介健康信息。

name: Karen McIntyre
title: Associate Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies the processes and effects of solutions and constructive journalism, and press freedom in East Africa through fieldwork with journalists.
summary_zh: 研究解决方案新闻与建设性新闻的过程与效果，并通过对记者的田野调查研究东非的新闻自由。

name: Dan Miller
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of documentary film and photojournalism about war and conflict through archival research and filmmaking.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究与纪录片创作研究关于战争与冲突的纪录片和新闻摄影史。

name: Deb Morrison
title: Distinguished Professor of Advertising
summary: Studies advertising creativity and the creative process and how brand messaging can drive social change and climate action.
summary_zh: 研究广告创意与创作过程，以及品牌传播如何推动社会变革与气候行动。

name: Bryce Newell
title: Associate Professor and Shirley Papé Chair in Emerging Media
areas: Legal and social implications of emerging media and information technologies; law
and society; surveillance studies; information science/studies (social informatics
information ethics);  privacy and data protection law; cybercrime; policing; criminal procedure; immigration
summary: Studies surveillance, privacy, policing, and the regulation of information technologies through socio-legal research such as on police body-worn cameras.
summary_zh: 以社会-法律研究方法探讨监控、隐私、警务与信息技术规制，如警用随身摄像头。

name: Julianne Newton
title: Professor of Visual Communication
summary: Studies visual communication and photojournalism by applying ethics and cognitive theory to visual behavior.
summary_zh: 将伦理学与认知理论应用于视觉行为，研究视觉传播与新闻摄影。

name: S. Senyo Ofori-Parku
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies environmental health risk sense-making, corporate sustainability discourse, and green consumer behavior using discourse analysis, in national and international contexts.
summary_zh: 运用话语分析研究环境健康风险的意义建构、企业可持续发展话语与绿色消费行为，涵盖国内与国际情境。

name: Ellen Peters
title: Philip H. Knight Chair and Professor
summary: Studies judgment and decision making, numeracy, and affect, and how evidence-based communication can improve health, financial, and environmental decisions.
summary_zh: 研究判断与决策、数字素养与情感，以及基于证据的传播如何改善健康、财务与环境决策。

name: Whitney Phillips
title: Associate Professor of Information Politics and Media Ethics
summary: Studies the politics and ethics of information, conspiracy belief, and the 'liberal devil' in US religious media using participant observation and rhetorical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过参与观察与修辞分析研究信息的政治与伦理、阴谋论信念以及美国宗教媒体中的“自由派魔鬼”叙事。

name: Daniel Pimentel
title: Assistant Professor of Immersive Psychology
summary: Conducts experiments on how XR storytelling (VR, AR, MR) drives prosocial attitudes and behavior for climate action, conservation, and well-being.
summary_zh: 通过实验研究XR叙事（VR、AR、MR）如何促进与气候行动、野生动物保护和身心健康相关的亲社会态度与行为。

name: Donnalyn Pompper
title: Professor
summary: Studies public relations, corporate social responsibility, and intersecting social identities at work and in media through critical and historical approaches.
summary_zh: 以批判与历史方法研究公共关系、企业社会责任以及职场与媒介中的交叉社会身份。

name: Wes Pope
title: Associate Professor
areas: Post-production Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, SpeedGrade, Final Cut Pro, Avid
Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, SpeedGrade, Final Cut Pro, Avid
Audio production & post-production Adobe Audition, ProTools
summary: Practices multimedia and cinematic photo and video journalism, including drone, 360 video, and photogrammetry storytelling.
summary_zh: 从事多媒体与电影化的图片和视频新闻实践，包括无人机、360度视频与摄影测量叙事。

name: Bish Sen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Indian television, popular culture, and the spread of digital culture in India within globalization and new media.
summary_zh: 在全球化与新媒体视角下研究印度电视、流行文化以及数字文化在印度的扩散。

name: Autumn Shafer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Designs and evaluates theory-based health campaigns and studies message processing and narrative persuasion on topics like cancer screening and vaccines.
summary_zh: 设计并评估基于理论的健康传播运动，研究癌症筛查、疫苗等议题中的信息加工与叙事说服。

name: Hollie Smith
title: Associate Professor of Science and Environmental Communication
summary: Studies science and environmental communication about natural hazards and wildfire preparedness in the Pacific Northwest.
summary_zh: 研究太平洋西北地区自然灾害与野火防备相关的科学与环境传播。

name: Gretchen Soderlund
title: Professor of Media History
summary: Studies journalism history, including sensationalism, scandal, and sex-trafficking coverage, and conspiracy narratives in American TV, via historical methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史方法研究新闻史，包括煽情主义、丑闻与性贩运报道，以及美国电视中的阴谋叙事。

name: Leslie Steeves
title: Senior Associate Dean for Academic Affairs, Professor
summary: Studies communication for development, gender and media, and media and globalization in Africa, particularly Ghana.
summary_zh: 研究发展传播、性别与媒介，以及非洲（尤其是加纳）的媒介与全球化。

name: John Sutter
title: Assistant Professor of Environmental Media
summary: Studies and practices environmental and climate journalism, environmental cinema, and the history of climate storytelling through investigative and documentary work.
summary_zh: 通过调查报道与纪录片创作研究并实践环境与气候新闻、环境电影及气候叙事史。

name: Brent Walth
title: Associate Professor
summary: Practices and teaches investigative, data, and solutions journalism, with long-form reporting on Oregon politics and government.
summary_zh: 从事并教授调查、数据与解决方案新闻，长期报道俄勒冈州政治与政府。

name: Daniel Zweifach
title: Assistant Professor of Advertising
summary: Studies advertising and transmedia storytelling in film and TV, social media marketing of global entertainment franchises, fan cultures, representation, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究影视领域的广告与跨媒体叙事、全球娱乐品牌的社交媒体营销、粉丝文化、广告中的再现与企业社会责任以及人工智能对广告的影响。

name: Josh Boyd
title: Interim School Head
summary: Studies sports communication, sponsorship and naming, corporate advocacy, and organizational rhetoric, with attention to legitimacy, trust, and communication pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究体育传播、赞助与冠名、企业倡导与组织修辞，关注合法性、信任与传播教学。

name: Robert X. Browning
title: Professor, Director of C-SPAN Archives, & Faculty Director of Center for C-SPAN Scholarship & Engagement
summary: Studies congressional floor behavior and the intersection of media and politics using the C-SPAN video archives of televised U.S. congressional proceedings.
summary_zh: 利用C-SPAN电视转播国会影像档案，研究美国国会议场行为以及媒体与政治的交叉问题。

name: Emily Buehler
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how personal and social media shape supportive communication in interpersonal relationships and the mechanisms driving outcomes of mediated support.
summary_zh: 研究个人媒体与社交媒体如何影响人际关系中的支持性传播，以及技术中介互动产生效果的机制。

name: Gabrielle Byrd
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how societal norms and stereotypes about (dis)ability and identity shape intergroup and interpersonal communication and their links to health outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究社会规范与刻板印象如何围绕残障与身份影响群际与人际传播，以及这些过程与健康结果的关系。

name: Hyesun Choung
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the lay psychology of AI: how people make sense of, trust, and judge the fairness and morality of AI systems and algorithmic decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究人们对人工智能的常识心理：人们如何理解、信任AI系统，并评判其与算法决策的公平性与道德性。

name: Jessica R. Collier
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social media exposure to fact checks, misinformation, and political memes affects belief accuracy, polarization, and unfriending, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用实验与调查方法，研究社交媒体上的事实核查、虚假信息与政治表情包如何影响信念准确性、极化与拉黑/删好友行为。

name: Stacey Connaughton
title: Professor
summary: Studies leadership, identification, and distributed organizing in peacebuilding and political violence prevention, linking engaged scholarship to policy.
summary_zh: 研究和平建设与政治暴力预防中的领导力、认同与分布式组织形式，并将参与式学术研究与政策相连接。

name: Jeremy Foote
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how online communities function as organizations and shape collective belief, using large-scale data analysis, simulation, and social network analysis.
summary_zh: 运用大规模数据分析、仿真模拟与社会网络分析，研究网络社群如何作为组织运作并影响集体信念形成。

name: John O. Greene
title: Professor
summary: Develops cognitive theories of message production, communication skill, and nonverbal behavior, including how aging affects communication.
summary_zh: 从认知取向建构讯息生成、传播技能与非语言行为的理论，并研究衰老如何影响传播行为。

name: Chantel Haughton
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Well-being of Black and Latinx families
summary: Studies how compounding stressors affect Black and Latinx families and the family communication that helps or hurts mental and relational health, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法，研究叠加压力如何影响黑人与拉丁裔家庭，以及有助或有损心理与关系健康的家庭传播过程。

name: Jennifer Hoewe
title: Associate Professor University Faculty Scholar
summary: Studies why people consume media, how they cognitively process it, and its effects, particularly news and political content, from a media psychology perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介心理学视角，研究人们为何消费媒介内容、如何认知加工这些内容及其效果，尤其聚焦新闻与政治内容。

name: Ilwoo Ju
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how consumers cope with persuasion in AI-driven advertising, dark patterns in data consent, health messaging, and advertising and privacy regulation.
summary_zh: 研究消费者如何应对说服尝试，涉及AI驱动广告、数据同意中的暗黑模式、健康讯息以及广告与隐私规制。

name: Seungyoon Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies how communication and collaboration networks in and across organizations evolve, including network ties in disaster recovery, using social network analysis.
summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析，研究组织内外的传播、知识与协作网络如何演化，包括灾后恢复中的网络关系。

name: Sue Lim
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Examining interpersonal dynamics underlying human-AI interaction
Extended reality (XR) and other emerging technologies
summary: Studies interpersonal dynamics of human-AI interaction in extended reality and designs XR/AI interventions, combining physiological, computational, and interview methods.
summary_zh: 结合生理测量、计算方法与访谈等手段，研究扩展现实中人机互动的人际动态，并设计基于XR与AI的干预。

name: Sorin Adam Matei
title: Professor
summary: Studies human interaction with digital and AI technologies, international communication, and the role of emerging technologies in strategy, security, and defense.
summary_zh: 研究人与数字及AI技术的互动、国际传播，以及新兴技术在战略、安全与国防中的作用。

name: Marifran Mattson
title: Professor
summary: Designs, implements, and evaluates health communication campaigns and health advocacy initiatives, integrating engaged scholarship and service-learning pedagogy.
summary_zh: 设计、实施并评估健康传播运动与健康倡导项目，并融合参与式学术与服务学习教学法。

name: Evan Perrault
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies health campaign message design and healthcare marketing, such as physician biography videos, and evaluates campus interventions using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法，研究健康运动讯息设计与医疗营销（如医生简介视频），并评估校园干预项目的效果。

name: Torsten Reimer
title: Professor and Director of College of Liberal Arts Research Academy
summary: Studies the interplay of communication and decision making with AI, including LLM-agent and human-agent teams, using experiments and agent-based simulations.
summary_zh: 运用实验与基于主体的仿真，研究传播与决策在AI情境中的相互作用，包括大语言模型智能体团队与人机混合团队。

name: Brett Sherrick
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies video games, entertainment media, and positive media psychology, along with media industries, from a social scientific perspective.
summary_zh: 从社会科学视角研究电子游戏、娱乐媒介与积极媒介心理，以及媒介产业。

name: Hwanseok Song
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social cognitive processes in risk and science communication, especially judgments of trust and fairness toward authorities, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用实验与调查方法，研究风险与科学传播中的社会认知过程，尤其是公众对权威机构的信任与公平判断。

name: Diana Zulli
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how political elites communicate strategically online and offline, how news portrays them, and how digital technology shapes political processes and scandal.
summary_zh: 研究政治精英如何在线上线下进行策略性传播、新闻如何呈现他们，以及数字技术如何影响政治过程与丑闻。

name: Osei Alleyne
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies reggae, Rastafari, Afrobeat and hip-hop performance cultures across the African diaspora, especially Jamaica and Ghana, through multimodal ethnography.
summary_zh: 以多模态民族志研究非洲离散群体中的雷鬼、拉斯塔法里、非洲节拍与嘻哈表演文化，重点关注牙买加与加纳。

name: Jillian Bauer-Reese
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how community-driven local journalism built with human-centered design and harm-reduction frameworks affects quality of life in low-income neighborhoods.
summary_zh: 研究以人本设计与减害框架打造的社区驱动型地方新闻如何影响低收入社区的生活质量。

name: Christen L. Buckley
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies public relations ethics, corporate social advocacy and stakeholder response, and nonprofit and public interest communication in digital and emerging media environments.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系伦理、企业社会倡导与利益相关者反应，以及数字和新兴媒体环境中的非营利与公共利益传播。

name: Deborah Cai
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies intercultural communication, negotiation and conflict management, and social influence, comparing China with Western cultures using quantitative statistical methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量统计方法研究跨文化传播、谈判与冲突管理以及社会影响，比较中国与西方文化。

name: Jessica Castonguay
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines child-targeted advertising and its ethical and legal implications, including children's responses to food ads and links between youth media use and well-being.
summary_zh: 考察面向儿童的广告及其伦理与法律意涵，包括儿童对食品广告的反应以及青少年媒介使用与幸福感的关系。

name: Fabienne Darling-Wolf
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies global media flows and the local negotiation of transnational popular culture, especially in Japan, through ethnography and critical textual analysis of gender, race and class.
summary_zh: 通过民族志与批判文本分析研究全球媒介流动及跨国流行文化的在地协商（尤其是日本），关注性别、种族与阶级。

name: Jan Fernback
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
areas: and Surveillance Online and in Mobile Technologies The Impact of Information/Communication Technologies on Urban Revitalization Efforts Institutional Uses of ICTs The Meaning of Virtual Community in Contemporary Culture
