summary: Examines online and mobile privacy, security and surveillance, institutional uses of ICTs, ICTs in urban revitalization, and the cultural meaning of virtual community.
summary_zh: 考察网络与移动技术中的隐私、安全与监控，信息传播技术的机构化使用、其在城市复兴中的作用以及虚拟社区的文化意义。

name: Bruce W. Hardy
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political, science and health communication, knowledge acquisition and opinion formation, and emerging technologies using survey research and advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用调查研究与高级定量方法研究政治、科学与健康传播，知识获取与意见形成，以及新兴技术与社会。

name: Andrew Iliadis
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the social implications of data science, semantic web technologies and tech companies' role in warfare, examining how emerging digital technologies reshape media and governance.
summary_zh: 研究数据科学、语义网技术以及科技公司参与战争的社会影响，考察新兴数字技术如何重塑媒介与治理。

name: Tricia S. Jones
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies conflict resolution intervention and education, alternative dispute resolution and organizational dispute systems, including school violence prevention programs.
summary_zh: 研究冲突解决干预与教育、替代性纠纷解决和组织纠纷系统设计，包括校园暴力预防项目。

name: Linn Washington Jr.
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Focuses on investigative, urban and multimedia reporting and journalism law, drawing on long professional experience as a reporter and editor.
summary_zh: 聚焦调查报道、城市报道、多媒体报道与新闻法，依托其作为记者与编辑的长期从业经验。

name: Carolyn Kitch
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Laura H. Carnell Professor
summary: Studies media history, public memory and gender through historical and cultural analysis of American magazines, journalism and visual stereotypes.
summary_zh: 通过历史与文化分析研究美国杂志、新闻业与视觉刻板印象，关注媒介史、公共记忆与性别。

name: Lauren Kogen
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication for and about social change with underserved communities, including intimate partner violence and trauma, through community-based research and evaluation.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究与项目评估，研究面向弱势社群的“为了社会变革的传播”与“关于社会变革的传播”，涉及亲密伴侣暴力与创伤。

name: Heather LaMarre
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies behavioral science to how media and communication shape attitudes, policy and social change, and develops strategy and leadership tools for purpose-driven organizations.
summary_zh: 运用行为科学研究媒介与传播如何影响态度、政策与社会变革，并为使命驱动型组织开发传播策略与领导力工具。

name: Matthew Lombard
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Chair / Associate Professor
summary: Studies psychological and physiological processing of mediated experiences, especially telepresence, using experimental, survey and content-analytic methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验、调查与内容分析方法研究人们对媒介体验的心理与生理加工，尤其是（远程）临场感。

name: Larisa Mann
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes how law, technology, copyright and sovereignty shape marginalized communities' musical creativity, such as Jamaican popular music, DJ culture and pirate radio.
summary_zh: 分析法律、技术、版权与主权如何影响边缘社群的音乐创作，如牙买加流行音乐、DJ文化与海盗电台。

name: Michael L. Maynard
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Japanese advertising and popular culture, comparing Japanese and U.S. television advertising through cultural and content analysis.
summary_zh: 通过文化分析与内容分析研究日本广告与流行文化，比较日美电视广告。

name: Jennifer Midberry
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ethical news reporting on marginalized groups, visual communication in news and coverage of gun violence, using textual analysis and audience-focused research.
summary_zh: 运用文本分析与受众研究，探讨对边缘群体的伦理化新闻报道、新闻中的视觉传播以及枪支暴力报道。

name: David T.Z. Mindich
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history of American journalism, the rise of objectivity as a norm, and why young Americans disengage from news, through historical and cultural analysis.
summary_zh: 通过历史与文化分析研究美国新闻史、客观性规范的形成，以及美国年轻人为何疏离新闻。

name: Logan Molyneux
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Chair / Professor
summary: Studies how digital and mobile media shape journalistic practice, including journalists' Twitter use, personal branding and learning from mobile news, via surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 通过调查与实验研究数字和移动媒体如何塑造新闻实践，包括记者的推特使用、个人品牌建设与移动新闻学习。

name: Kathy Mueller
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Chair / Associate Professor
summary: Examines how design and advertising shape cultural narratives and public discourse through visual communication design practice, including reproductive-rights projects.
summary_zh: 通过视觉传达设计实践（包括生育权议题项目）考察设计与广告如何塑造文化叙事与公共话语。

name: Patrick Murphy
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
areas: and Latin American media and cultural theory
summary: Studies global and environmental communication and Latin American media and cultural theory, using ethnographic methods and documentary media.
summary_zh: 运用民族志方法与纪录片媒介研究全球传播、环境传播以及拉丁美洲媒介与文化理论。

name: Wazhmah Osman
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the political economy of global media industries and visual representation, especially television in Afghanistan, through feminist media ethnography and documentary film.
summary_zh: 通过女性主义媒介民族志与纪录片创作，研究全球媒介产业的政治经济与视觉表征，尤其是阿富汗电视。

name: Joy Pierce
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Chair / Professor
summary: Studies digital equity and how underrepresented populations come to information technologies, using cultural studies, autoethnography and participatory action research.
summary_zh: 运用文化研究、自我民族志与参与式行动研究，探讨数字公平以及弱势群体如何接触与使用信息传播技术。

name: Tara Pixley
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ethics of care in photojournalism, visual representation of marginalized communities, anti-racism in generative AI imagery, and movement and solutions visual journalism.
summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影中的关怀伦理、边缘社群的视觉再现、生成式AI图像中的反种族主义，以及运动新闻与解决方案式视觉新闻。

name: Hector Postigo
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies digital cultural production, including the free labor of fan and game-modding communities and technology-mediated activism in the digital rights movement, via case studies.
summary_zh: 通过个案研究考察数字文化生产，包括粉丝与游戏模组社群的免费劳动，以及数字权利运动中的技术中介行动主义。

name: Clemencia Rodriguez
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
areas: Representations of Gender, Class, Race in the Media
summary: Studies citizens' and community media in armed-conflict and post-conflict Colombia and in Philadelphia, including grassroots climate communication, through long-term fieldwork.
summary_zh: 通过长期田野调查研究哥伦比亚武装冲突及冲突后地区和费城的公民媒体与社区媒体，包括草根气候传播。

name: Adrienne Shaw
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
areas: The media industry, laws and policies
summary: Studies gender, sexuality and representation in video games and gamer culture and LGBTQ game history, using qualitative and archival research.
summary_zh: 运用质性与档案研究方法，研究电子游戏与玩家文化中的性别、性向与再现，以及LGBTQ游戏史。

name: Jessica Shaw
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how organizations communicate about AI and other emerging technologies in risk and crisis contexts, including risk-benefit framing, privacy fatigue and trust.
summary_zh: 研究组织在风险与危机情境中如何就人工智能等新兴技术进行传播，包括风险—收益框架、隐私疲劳与信任。

name: Nisha Sridharan
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies inclusion, accessibility and community engagement in news media, linking journalism studies with organizational communication through qualitative research.
summary_zh: 通过质性研究探讨新闻媒体中的包容性、无障碍与社区参与，将新闻学研究与组织传播理论相结合。

name: Meghnaa Tallapragada
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
areas: Global media, social change, and activism
summary: Studies science and risk communication, public understanding of science and communication effects, including concussion-reporting interventions and AI and ocean literacy.
summary_zh: 研究科学与风险传播、公众理解科学与传播效果，包括脑震荡报告干预以及AI素养和海洋素养。

name: Betsy Leebron Tutelman
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Professor
summary: Focuses on broadcast journalism, media entrepreneurship and production management, with emphasis on media programming and industry partnerships.
summary_zh: 聚焦广播电视新闻、媒体创业与制作管理，重视媒体节目编排与业界合作。

name: Andrea D. Wenzel
dept: Lew Klein College of Media and Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies community-centered, engaged and antiracist local journalism and how newsrooms build trust with marginalized communities, using community-based qualitative research.
summary_zh: 运用社区参与式质性研究，探讨以社区为中心、参与式与反种族主义的地方新闻，以及新闻编辑室如何与边缘社群建立信任。

name: Jon Hess
title: Professor and Director, School of Communication Studies, John Haas Director’s Chair
areas: Communication strategies for managing difficult relationships
Impact of teacher communication on student engagement and learning
Curriculum design and pedagogy for today’s educational environment and needs
summary: Studies how people maintain relationships and manage closeness and distance, and how teacher communication shapes student engagement and learning, including scale development.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何维系关系、调节亲疏距离，以及教师传播如何影响学生投入与学习，并开展量表开发。

name: Ryan Beaty
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication in nonprofit and religious institutions, including organizational culture, identity, survival, and member abuse.
summary_zh: 研究非营利与宗教机构中的组织传播，包括组织文化、组织认同、组织存续与成员受虐问题。

name: Quinten Bernhold
title: Associate Professor and Undergraduate Program Coordinator for the School of Communication Studies
summary: Studies how family communication patterns and age-related talk predict older adults' successful aging and health, drawing on communication accommodation and affection exchange theories.
summary_zh: 借助传播顺应理论与情感交换理论，研究家庭沟通模式与年龄相关言谈如何预测老年人的成功老化与健康。

name: Elizabeth Carlson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication, with a teaching and professional background in leadership, crisis communication, and training and development.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播，其教学与职业背景涉及领导力、危机传播以及培训与发展。

name: Christopher J. Carpenter
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies persuasion, opinion leaders and social media influencers, and how social media affects close relationships, often using meta-analysis.
summary_zh: 研究说服、意见领袖与社交媒体网红，以及社交媒体如何影响亲密关系，常采用元分析方法。

name: Jenny Crowley
title: Associate Professor and CCI Director for College-Wide Graduate Programs
summary: Studies stigma and supportive communication in interpersonal relationships, including how romantic couples cope with opioid use disorder, plus community work on the opioid crisis in rural Tennessee.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系中的污名与支持性沟通，包括伴侣如何共同应对阿片类物质使用障碍，并在田纳西州东部农村开展应对阿片危机的社区合作。

name: Jessica Frampton
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people communicate about close relationship stressors such as jealousy and break-ups, focusing on technology affordances, using surveys, experiments, content analysis, and interviews.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何就嫉妒、分手等亲密关系压力源进行沟通，关注技术可供性，采用问卷、实验、内容分析与深度访谈。

name: Kody Frey
title: Associate Professor and Director of Public Speaking
summary: Studies instructional communication in higher education classrooms, including instructional assessment, oral communication skill development, policies, and scale development.
summary_zh: 研究高等教育课堂中的教学传播，包括教学评估、口头表达能力培养、课堂政策与量表开发。

name: Michael Kotowski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and tests social influence theory, modeling what makes people influential and how persuasion works in interpersonal and small-group settings, with expertise in measurement.
summary_zh: 发展并检验社会影响理论，探讨影响者的特征与人际及小群体情境中的说服机制，擅长测量方法。

name: Joe Mazer
title: Dean, Faye Julian’s Dean Chair, Professor
summary: Studies communication in teaching and learning, social media and new technologies, and interpersonal relationships.
summary_zh: 研究教学中的传播、社交媒体与新技术，以及人际关系中的沟通。

name: Laura Miller
title: Professor and Director of the Bohan Center for Global Engagement
summary: Studies interpersonal and health communication in clinical and community settings, such as cancer survivorship, oncology teamwork, nurse-physician interaction, and farmer suicide.
summary_zh: 研究临床与社区情境中的人际与健康传播，如癌症幸存者、肿瘤团队协作、护士与医生互动及农民自杀问题。

name: Emily Paskewitz
title: Associate Professor and CCI Associate Dean for Research and Faculty Development
summary: Studies relational issues in groups and organizations, such as conflict, emotion, and relationship building, in natural contexts like family farms and online support groups.
summary_zh: 研究群体与组织中的关系问题，如冲突、情绪与关系建立，关注家庭农场、线上抑郁支持小组等自然情境。

name: Roth Smith
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Sport communication in lifestyle and extreme sports collectives
summary: Studies how communication enables organizing in loosely structured collectives, such as recreation, volunteer, and disaster-response groups, using interviews, observation, and photo-elicitation.
summary_zh: 研究传播如何促成松散集体（如休闲运动、志愿者与灾害应对群体）的组织过程，采用访谈、观察与照片引谈法。

name: Michelle Violanti
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies relationships in organizations, such as leadership, mentoring, and friendship, faculty-student communication, and how culture and social identities shape communication.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的关系（如领导与追随、导师指导与友谊）、师生沟通，以及文化与社会身份如何影响传播过程。

name: Courtney N. Wright
title: Associate Professor & Director of Honors Program
summary: Studies how interpersonal conflict and difficult dialogues affect well-being across relationships, organizations, and classrooms, and translates findings into training and dialogue facilitation.
summary_zh: 研究人际冲突与艰难对话如何影响关系、组织与课堂中的福祉，并将研究成果转化为培训与对话引导实践。

name: Amy Jo Coffey
title: Professor and Director, School of Journalism and Media
areas: Media markets and ownership, strategic competition
summary: Studies media management and economics, including media markets, ownership, strategic competition, linguistic market segmentation, and audience analytics and measurement.
summary_zh: 研究媒介管理与经济，包括媒介市场、所有权、战略竞争、语言市场细分以及受众分析与测量。

name: Stuart N. Brotman
title: Professor
areas: Telecommunications /electronic mass media law and policy
summary: Studies telecommunications and media law and policy, internet governance, digital privacy, and international communications regulation, informed by government and industry advisory work.
summary_zh: 研究电信与媒介法律政策、互联网治理、数字隐私与国际传播规制，并结合其政府与产业咨询经验。

name: Nick Geidner
title: Professor
areas: Effects of Internet technologies on journalism and group formation.
summary: Studies how internet technologies affect journalism and group formation, and produces documentary films through the university's media center.
summary_zh: 研究互联网技术对新闻业与群体形成的影响，并通过学校媒体中心制作纪录片。

name: Mark Harmon
title: Professor
areas: Connections between media and materialistic values
summary: Studies television news gatekeeping and connections between media and materialistic values, with additional interests in political communication and media ethics.
summary_zh: 研究电视新闻把关以及媒介与物质主义价值观之间的关联，并关注政治传播与媒介伦理。

name: Guy Harrison
title: Associate Professor, Director of the Alan & Wendy Wilson Communication & Leadership Academy
summary: Examines gender, race, and diversity in the electronic and sports media industry through feminist and critical cultural lenses, focusing on women sportscasters and Black women newscasters.
summary_zh: 以女性主义和批判文化视角考察电子媒体与体育媒体行业中的性别、种族与多元议题，聚焦女性体育主播与黑人女性新闻主播。

name: Rob Heller
title: CCI Board of Visitors Professor
summary: Studies photojournalism history, newspaper design, and typography, and produces documentary photography such as portraits of Holocaust survivors.
summary_zh: 研究新闻摄影史、报纸版面设计与字体排印，并从事纪实摄影创作，如大屠杀幸存者肖像。

name: Catherine Luther
title: Director of the Information Integrity Institute, Minnie Doty Goddard Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies digital propaganda, disinformation, and digital activism, including media influence in former Soviet countries, along with diversity in U.S. media and national identity in press coverage.
summary_zh: 研究数字宣传、虚假信息与数字行动主义，包括前苏联国家的媒体影响，以及美国媒体多元性与新闻报道中的国家认同。

name: Mustafa Oz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social media shapes political engagement, activism, incivility, and privacy perceptions, with attention to marginalized communities, the MENA region, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体如何影响政治参与、行动主义、网络不文明与隐私认知，关注边缘群体、中东北非地区以及人工智能。

name: Martin Riedl
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies platform governance and content moderation, digital journalism, political influencers, and the spread of false and misleading information on social media.
summary_zh: 研究平台治理与内容审核、数字新闻、政治网红，以及虚假和误导性信息在社交媒体上的传播。

name: Amber Roessner
title: Professor
areas: History of media and mass communication
summary: Writes cultural histories of the U.S. press, examining sports journalism, political campaigns, collective memory, and the construction of race, gender, and class.
summary_zh: 撰写美国新闻界的文化史，考察体育新闻、政治竞选、集体记忆以及种族、性别与阶级的建构。

name: Shannon Scovel
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Representation and self-representation of women athletes in media
College athlete branding, NIL and social media storytelling
summary: Studies the intersections of sports, media, and gender, focusing on representation and self-representation of women athletes, and college athlete branding and NIL storytelling.
summary_zh: 研究体育、媒介与性别的交叉，聚焦女性运动员的媒介再现与自我呈现，以及大学运动员品牌建设与NIL社交媒体叙事。

name: Erin Whiteside
title: Professor, Graduate Programs Coordinator for the School of Journalism and Media
summary: Uses feminist approaches to examine sports media and culture, including workplace diversity and ethics, discourses of gender and sexuality, and audience meaning-making.
summary_zh: 以女性主义方法考察体育媒介与文化，包括从业场所的多元与伦理、性别与性向话语以及受众意义建构。

name: Shiyu Yang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies science and risk communication in algorithmically curated information environments, using computational methods, surveys, experiments, and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究算法策展信息环境中的科学与风险传播，采用计算方法、问卷调查、实验与质性方法。

name: Moonhee Cho
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor and Director of the Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
summary: Studies organization-public relationships and engagement, nonprofit public relations and fundraising, social movements, and strategic use of social and digital media.
summary_zh: 研究组织—公众关系与公众参与、非营利公关与筹款、社会运动，以及社交与数字媒体的战略运用。

name: Oluseyi Adegbola
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategic political campaign messaging and political image repair and their effects on citizens, at the intersection of public relations and political communication.
summary_zh: 研究政治竞选的战略信息与政治形象修复及其对公民的影响，处于公共关系与政治传播的交叉领域。

name: Bugil Chang
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses quantitative methods to study how crises, CSR, and corporate social advocacy spill over to other organizations and industries in for-profit and nonprofit sectors.
summary_zh: 运用定量方法研究危机、企业社会责任与企业社会倡导如何外溢影响营利与非营利部门中的其他组织及整个行业。

name: Courtney Childers
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor and CCI Associate Dean for Academic Affairs and Student Success
summary: Studies advertising and societal issues, including advertising to children, food and beverage marketing, parental responses, and social media and influencer marketing.
summary_zh: 研究广告与社会议题，包括面向儿童的广告、食品饮料营销、家长反应以及社交媒体与网红营销。

name: Elizabeth Avery Foster
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor and Vice Provost for Academic Affairs
summary: Studies health and crisis communication and public health campaigns, including interventions addressing the opioid epidemic in rural Appalachia.
summary_zh: 研究健康与危机传播及公共卫生运动，包括应对阿巴拉契亚农村地区阿片类药物流行的干预项目。

name: María De Moya
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor, Charles Tombras, Sr. Endowed Professorship
summary: Studies messaging, identity, and culture in advocacy, corporate, political, and public diplomacy campaigns, specializing in ethnic public relations.
summary_zh: 研究倡导、企业、政治与公共外交传播活动中的信息、身份与文化，专长于族裔公共关系。

name: Eric Haley
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Professor
summary: Studies advertising and society issues, advocacy advertising, account planning, and advertising agency practice, including health-related advertising.
summary_zh: 研究广告与社会议题、倡导性广告、客户策划与广告代理实践，包括健康相关广告。

name: Sieun Ha
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies consumer information processing, ad clutter and message competition, and policy frameworks for digital advertising, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究消费者信息处理、广告拥挤与信息竞争以及数字广告的政策框架，采用质性与定量方法。

name: Jeannette Iannacone
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
areas: NGO public relations and strategic communication
summary: Studies global public relations and transnationalism through qualitative research on migration, NGOs, and inclusive communication with marginalized publics.
summary_zh: 通过对移民、非政府组织及面向边缘公众的包容性传播的质性研究，探讨全球公共关系与跨国主义。

name: Minjie Li
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies multicultural advertising and prosocial strategic communication around LGBTQ issues, race, health disparities, and brand activism, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究多元文化广告与亲社会战略传播，涉及LGBTQ议题、种族、健康不平等与品牌行动主义，采用定量与质性方法。

name: Sitan “Stan” Li
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies consumer responses to advertising on emerging platforms, including virtual influencers, mixed reality, sonic branding, streaming services, and product placement.
summary_zh: 研究消费者对新兴平台广告的反应，包括虚拟网红、混合现实、声音品牌、流媒体服务与植入式广告。

name: Katie Kim
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility and irresponsibility from an internal communication perspective, emphasizing employees as co-creators, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 从内部传播视角研究企业社会责任与社会失责，强调员工作为共同创造者的角色，采用定量与质性方法。

name: Kyeongwon Kwon
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how brands can use pro-environmental and socially responsible advertising, social marketing, and media effects on health and prosocial consumer behavior.
summary_zh: 研究品牌如何开展环保与社会责任广告、社会营销，以及媒介对健康和亲社会消费行为的影响。

name: Michael Palenchar
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
areas: Community right to know and front groups
summary: Studies risk communication, issues management, and crisis communication, focusing on chemical manufacturing, national security, and community right-to-know issues.
summary_zh: 研究风险传播、议题管理与危机传播，聚焦化工制造、国家安全与社区知情权问题。

name: Matthew Pittman
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social influence and cognition in sustainability campaigns, green advertising, social media, and influencer and viral marketing.
summary_zh: 研究可持续发展运动、绿色广告、社交媒体及网红与病毒式营销中的社会影响与认知。

name: Yufan “Sunny” Qin
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies internal and leadership communication and corporate purpose, examining employee-organization relationships and purpose-driven public relations with mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究内部传播、领导传播与企业使命，运用混合方法考察员工与组织关系及以使命为导向的公共关系。

name: Sifan Xu
dept: Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
title: Associate Professor, DeForrest Jackson Professor, and Graduate Program Coordinator for the Tombras School of Advertising and Public Relations
summary: Studies community-based crisis and risk communication and how social identities shape organization-public relationships, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究社区层面的危机与风险传播，以及社会身份如何影响组织—公众关系，采用质性与定量方法。

name: Mary Banwart
title: Professor; Associate Vice Provost, Office of Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies gender in political campaigns and candidate communication across ads, websites, and news, and evaluates leadership programs for civic engagement.
summary_zh: 研究政治竞选中的性别问题及候选人在广告、网站和新闻中的传播，并评估领导力项目对公民参与的影响。

name: Jay P. Childers
title: Associate Professor; Editor, Rhetoric & Public Affairs
summary: Examines the intersection of rhetoric, politics, and violence, including political tone and changing norms of youth democratic engagement in the United States.
summary_zh: 研究修辞、政治与暴力的交汇，包括政治语调以及美国青年民主参与规范的变化。

name: Angela Gist-Mackey
title: Associate Professor; Associate Chairperson
summary: Studies social class, stigma, and economic mobility in organizational contexts through critical, comparative, community-engaged ethnography.
summary_zh: 通过批判性、比较性和社区参与式民族志，研究组织情境中的社会阶层、污名与经济流动。

name: Jeffrey A. Hall
title: Professor; Chairperson
summary: Studies how people build and maintain relationships through everyday interaction and communication technologies, including the social biome of daily contact.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过日常互动和传播技术建立与维系人际关系，包括日常交往构成的“社会生物群落”。

name: Beth Innocenti
title: Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Theorizes how public and political arguing generates persuasive force, drawing on normative pragmatics, argumentation theory, and the history of rhetoric.
summary_zh: 借助规范语用学、论辩理论与修辞史，阐释公共与政治论辩如何产生说服力。

name: Adrianne Kunkel
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotional support and coping in personal relationships and support groups, romantic relationship redefinition, gender differences, and domestic violence intervention.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系与支持小组中的情感支持与应对、恋爱关系的重新界定、性别差异以及家庭暴力干预。

name: Yue Li
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Uses network analysis, NLP, and machine learning on digital trace and longitudinal survey data to study health and political information processing and misinformation diffusion.
summary_zh: 运用网络分析、自然语言处理和机器学习分析数字痕迹与纵向调查数据，研究健康与政治信息处理及虚假信息扩散。

name: Robert McDonald
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetorical theory and public culture, especially the rhetoric of economics, through psychoanalytic and cultural-studies approaches.
summary_zh: 从精神分析与文化研究视角研究修辞理论与公共文化，尤其关注经济的修辞。

name: Ashley Muddiman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political incivility and its effects online, including citizen perceptions, partisan incivility in news comment sections, and clickbait headlines.
summary_zh: 研究网络政治不文明及其效果，包括公民感知、新闻评论区中的党派不文明以及标题党。

name: Dorthy Pennington
title: Associate Professor
areas: Identity mediation and diunitality in the rhetoric of Barack Obama
Social movements in African American communication and diaspora studies
summary: Studies interracial and intercultural communication and African American rhetoric, analyzing identity, race, and power in figures such as Barack Obama and Condoleezza Rice.
summary_zh: 研究跨种族与跨文化传播及非裔美国人修辞，分析奥巴马、赖斯等人物话语中的身份、种族与权力。

name: Cameron Piercy
title: Associate Professor; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how socio-technical interactions, including human-machine communication and teaming with work technologies, change teams, groups, and work.
summary_zh: 研究人机传播及与工作技术协同等社会技术互动如何改变团队、群体与工作。

name: Rikki Roscoe
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how stigma as a power-laden communication process shapes health inequities in mental, reproductive, and autoimmune health through critical-interpretive research.
summary_zh: 以批判—阐释取向研究污名作为蕴含权力的传播过程如何在心理健康、生殖健康和自身免疫疾病中造成健康不平等。

name: Robert C. Rowland
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes argumentation and political rhetoric through rhetorical criticism, including nationalist populism in Donald Trump's rhetoric and American democracy.
summary_zh: 通过修辞批评研究论辩与政治修辞，包括特朗普话语中的民族主义民粹主义与美国民主。

name: Dave Tell
title: Professor; Co-Director of the Institute for Digital Research in the Humanities
summary: Studies race and public memory, especially the murder of Emmett Till, through historical research and public humanities projects such as apps, exhibits, and markers.
summary_zh: 通过历史研究以及应用程序、展览和纪念标牌等公共人文项目，研究种族与公共记忆，尤其是艾米特·提尔谋杀案。

name: Alcides Velasquez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social identity, stigma, and hostile media perceptions shape political expression and mobilization on social media among Latino communities, using multi-method designs.
summary_zh: 运用多方法设计，研究社会身份、污名与敌意媒体感知如何影响拉丁裔社群在社交媒体上的政治表达与动员。

name: Alesia Woszidlo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies family communication, linking communication processes to mental health, family functioning, and relationship quality, and examines leadership program effectiveness.
summary_zh: 研究家庭传播，探讨传播过程与心理健康、家庭功能和关系质量的关联，并考察领导力项目的成效。

name: Yan Bing Zhang
title: Professor
summary: Studies intergroup and intercultural communication, linking relationships, social cognition, culture, identity, and aging in face-to-face and mediated contexts.
summary_zh: 研究群际与跨文化传播，关注面对面及中介情境中的关系、社会认知、文化、身份与老龄化。

name: Alyssa Appelman
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how journalistic practices such as errors, transparency, and AI use affect audience perceptions of news accuracy and credibility.
summary_zh: 研究新闻差错、透明度和人工智能使用等新闻实践如何影响受众对新闻准确性与可信度的感知。

name: Genelle Belmas
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media law and ethics, including legal issues of satire and parody accounts and press privilege protections for student journalists.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法律与伦理，包括讽刺与恶搞账号的法律问题以及学生记者的新闻特权保护。

name: Steve Bien-Aime
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor; Sports Media & Society Concentration Chair
summary: Researches race and gender issues in media, drawing on a background in sports and business journalism and inclusive-language training.
summary_zh: 研究媒体中的种族与性别问题，其背景包括体育与商业新闻报道以及包容性语言培训。

name: Ann M. Brill
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Holds a journalism and mass communications faculty post after serving as dean; the profile lists teaching and administrative awards but no research focus.
summary_zh: 曾任院长后回归新闻与大众传播学院任教；个人页面仅列出教学与行政奖项，未说明研究方向。

name: Sarah Cavanah
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: News and information in rural communities
summary: Studies access to quality news in rural communities and sustainable local news models, scholastic student media, and science communication on social media.
summary_zh: 研究农村社区获取优质新闻的状况与可持续的地方新闻模式、中学生媒体以及社交媒体上的科学传播。

name: Yvonnes Chen
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor
summary: Designs and tests media and health literacy interventions for adolescents and uses brain measures to study how persuasive health messages work.
summary_zh: 为青少年设计并检验媒介与健康素养干预，并借助脑测量研究说服性健康信息的作用机制。

name: Jeff Conlin
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies persuasive effects of messages, images, and emotions in environmental and public health risk communication and political advertising.
summary_zh: 研究信息、图像与情绪在环境与公共卫生风险传播及政治广告中的说服效果。

name: Elizabeth Cox
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies public relations in sports, focusing on team-fan relationships, name-image-likeness partnerships, crisis communication, and mental health messaging.
summary_zh: 研究体育领域的公共关系，关注球队与球迷关系、姓名形象肖像权（NIL）合作、危机传播与心理健康信息。

name: Megan Denneny
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Critical and cultural approaches to media
summary: Examines the ethics of health marketing in reproductive and maternal care, such as prenatal testing ads, using critical theory and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用批判理论与质性方法，研究生殖与孕产保健中健康营销的伦理问题，例如无创产前检测广告。

name: Vaibhav Diwanji
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies consumer behavior at the intersection of new and emerging media technologies and strategic communication, advertising, and marketing.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒介技术与战略传播、广告和营销交汇处的消费者行为。

name: Christopher Etheridge
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies media representations of crime, community information needs and storytelling, and digital technology adoption in rural communities.
summary_zh: 研究犯罪的媒体呈现、社区信息需求与社区叙事，以及农村社区的数字技术采纳。

name: Teri Finneman
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor
summary: Studies press coverage of U.S. first ladies and women politicians, journalism history, and rural local news, using historical analysis and oral history.
summary_zh: 运用历史分析与口述史方法，研究美国第一夫人与女性政治人物的新闻报道、新闻史以及农村地方新闻。

name: Mugur Geana
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Interim Associate Dean for Research & Faculty Development; Full Professor; Director, Center for Excellence in Health Communication to Underserved Populations
summary: Studies health communication strategies and media interventions for underserved populations, including vaccine uptake, social determinants of health, and AI in consumer health.
summary_zh: 研究面向弱势群体的健康传播策略与媒介干预，包括疫苗接种、健康的社会决定因素以及人工智能对消费者健康传播的影响。

name: Melissa Greene-Blye
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines journalistic representations and negotiations of American Indian identity, past and present, through journalism history research.
summary_zh: 通过新闻史研究，考察新闻报道中美洲原住民身份的呈现与协商，涵盖过去与当下。

name: Carol Holstead
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies magazine design and how students learn, drawing on a professional background in magazine writing and editing.
summary_zh: 研究杂志设计及学生如何学习，其背景为杂志写作与编辑实务。

name: Margarita Orozco
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies political communication, media effects, and deliberation in conflict contexts, including populism and intergroup emotions in the U.S. and Latin America.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播、媒介效果与冲突情境中的协商，包括美国与拉丁美洲的民粹主义和群际情绪。

name: Scott Reinardy
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor; Malcolm Applegate Professor in News Management and Editing
areas: Burnout and life issues of newspaper and television newsroom workers
Organizational adaptation and development of newspaper and television newsrooms
summary: Studies burnout, job change, and organizational adaptation among newspaper and television newsroom workers, along with media ethics and journalism education.
summary_zh: 研究报纸与电视新闻编辑室从业者的职业倦怠、工作变化与组织适应，以及媒体伦理和新闻教育。

name: Judith Rosenbaum-Andre
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Dean
summary: Studies why people use digital and entertainment media and its effects, including spoilers and enjoyment, social media use, and media literacy.
summary_zh: 研究人们为何使用数字与娱乐媒介及其影响，包括剧透与享受、社交媒体使用以及媒介素养。

name: Hyunjin Seo
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: University Distinguished Professor; Director, KU Center for Digital Inclusion; Oscar Stauffer Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies networked communication and its implications for collective action, civic engagement, and digital inclusion, including South Korean protest movements.
summary_zh: 研究网络化传播及其对集体行动、公民参与和数字包容的影响，包括韩国的抗议运动。

name: Yunwen Wang
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health communication, misinformation, and user experience with emerging media, using NLP, computer vision, and mixed methods to serve marginalized communities.
summary_zh: 运用自然语言处理、计算机视觉与混合方法研究健康传播、虚假信息及新兴媒介的用户体验，服务边缘化社群。

name: Doug Ward
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Director, Center for Teaching Excellence; Associate Professor
summary: Studies pedagogy and teaching evaluation in higher education, digital literacy, and data visualization, and builds web, app, and bot tools for teaching.
summary_zh: 研究高等教育中的教学法与教学评估、数字素养和数据可视化，并为教学开发网站、应用与聊天机器人工具。

name: Judy Watts
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies narrative persuasion, health communication, and children's understanding of media, focusing on emotional responses, attitude change, and knowledge across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究叙事说服、健康传播及儿童对媒介的理解，关注毕生发展中的情绪反应、态度改变与知识获取。

name: Tamar Wilner
dept: William Allen White School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies news literacy, media trust, and misinformation, including news skepticism and cynicism and the gap between journalism research and practice.
summary_zh: 研究新闻素养、媒体信任与虚假信息，包括新闻怀疑与犬儒态度，以及新闻学研究与实践之间的鸿沟。

name: Briana Barner
title: Assistant Professor, Communication; Affiliate Faculty , The Harriet Tubman Department of Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies; Affiliate Faculty, American Studies
summary: Studies Black podcasts, digital Black feminism, and Black cultural production and representation through critical and cultural analysis of digital audio media.
summary_zh: 以批判与文化研究视角分析数字音频媒介，研究黑人播客、数字黑人女性主义以及黑人文化生产与再现。

name: Becca Beets
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Studies public perceptions of and engagement with emerging science and scientific uncertainty in new media environments using mixed qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与量化相结合的混合方法，研究新媒体环境中公众对新兴科学与科学不确定性的认知和参与。

name: Andrew Boge
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Examines how anti-brownness and South Asian American racialization are constructed in U.S. public discourse through archival racial rhetorical criticism of news, law, and film.
summary_zh: 通过对新闻、法律话语与电影的档案式种族修辞批评，考察美国公共话语如何建构“反棕色”种族主义与南亚裔美国人的种族化。

name: Grant Bollmer
title: Associate Professor, Communication
summary: Theorizes the history and culture of digital media, including influencer culture, social media economics, the history of emotion measurement, and philosophy of technology.
summary_zh: 从理论与历史角度研究数字文化，包括网红文化、社交媒体经济、情绪测量史以及技术哲学。

name: Ganga Dhanesh
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Co-Director of Graduate Studies, Communication
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility and strategic communication across issues, publics, and cultures, including gender stereotyping in advertising in the UAE.
summary_zh: 研究跨议题、跨公众与跨文化的企业社会责任与战略传播，包括阿联酋广告业中的性别刻板印象问题。

name: Nick Joyce
title: Associate Professor, Communication
summary: Studies how intercultural narratives and intergroup communication foster empathy and stereotype change, and how communication skills and traits predict positive intercultural engagement, using social scientific methods.
summary_zh: 运用社会科学方法，研究跨文化叙事与群际传播如何促进共情并改变刻板印象，以及哪些沟通技能与心理特质预测积极的跨文化交流意愿。

name: Sahar Khamis
title: Professor, Communication
summary: Studies Arab and Muslim media, online Islamic discourse, political blogging and citizen journalism in the Egyptian revolution, and Arab women's activism.
summary_zh: 研究阿拉伯与穆斯林媒体、网络伊斯兰话语、埃及革命中的政治博客与公民新闻，以及阿拉伯女性行动主义。

name: Jiyoun Kim
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Co-Director of Graduate Studies, Communication
summary: Studies public understanding of and engagement with science, environmental, and risk issues on social media and designs persuasive messages to support informed decisions.
summary_zh: 研究公众在社交媒体上对科学、环境与风险议题的理解和参与，并设计有效的说服信息以支持知情决策。

name: Sun Young Lee
title: Associate Professor, Communication
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility and social advocacy messaging, including visual strategies, emotions, and public empowerment, and CSR effects in crisis contexts.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任与企业社会倡导的信息策略，包括视觉策略、情绪与公众赋权，以及危机情境下的企业社会责任效果。

name: Brooke Fisher Liu
title: Professor, Communication
summary: Studies how strategic communication supports organizational and community crisis readiness, including disaster, weather, and pandemic risk communication by government agencies.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播如何提升组织与社区的危机准备能力，包括政府机构在灾害、天气与疫情方面的风险传播。

name: Kristy Maddux
title: Professor, Communication; Affiliate, The Harriet Tubman Department of Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
summary: Analyzes rhetorical practices of democratic citizenship and how gender, disability, religion, and the built environment shape them, using historical rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 运用历史修辞批评，分析民主公民身份的修辞实践，以及性别、残障、宗教与建成环境如何塑造这些实践。

name: Raquel Moreira
title: Assistant Professor, Communication; Affiliate Faculty, Latin American and Caribbean Studies Center
summary: Examines hemispheric constructions of Latinidad, mestizaje, and anti-Blackness in Latin American popular culture and performance through feminist critical analysis.
summary_zh: 以女性主义批判分析方法，考察拉丁美洲流行文化与表演中关于拉丁裔身份、混血论与反黑人主义的半球性建构。

name: Charles Morris III
title: Chair, Communication; Professor, Communication
summary: Studies LGBTQ history and public memory as a queer rhetorical critic, analyzing archives, speeches, and commemorations such as the AIDS Quilt.
summary_zh: 作为酷儿修辞批评学者，通过分析档案、演讲与艾滋病纪念被等纪念实践，研究LGBTQ历史与公共记忆。

name: Kang Namkoong
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Director, Center for Health and Risk Communication
summary: Studies emerging media for health, examining eHealth effects and developing mobile and VR/AR interventions for cancer, mental health, and occupational safety in underserved communities.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒介在健康领域的应用，考察电子健康系统的效果，并为弱势社区开发移动及VR/AR干预，涉及癌症、心理健康与职业安全。

name: Xiaoli Nan
title: Professor, Communication
summary: Studies the science of persuasion and attitude change, applying it to health messages, misinformation, and AI-generated persuasive content on issues like vaccination and cancer.
summary_zh: 研究说服与态度改变的科学机制，并将其应用于健康信息、虚假信息以及AI生成的说服性内容，涉及疫苗接种与癌症等议题。

name: Nana Kwame Osei Fordjour
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Studies political public relations, including politicians' image construction, impression management, and authenticity in governance, elections, and crises, using qualitative and critical methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与批判方法研究政治公关，包括政治人物在治理、选举与危机中的形象建构、印象管理与真实性。

name: Hailey Otis
title: Assistant Professor, Communication; Co-Director, Oral Communication Program, Communication
summary: Analyzes the embodied, intersectional rhetorical tactics of digital fat activism and marginalized groups' worldmaking amid COVID-era health discourses, using feminist and queer theory.
summary_zh: 借助女性主义与酷儿理论，分析数字肥胖行动主义的具身化、交叉性修辞策略，以及边缘群体在新冠健康话语下的世界建构。

name: Shawn Parry-Giles
title: Professor, Communication
summary: Studies rhetoric and politics, including presidential and war rhetoric and women in politics, through historical analysis of public speeches and archives.
summary_zh: 通过对公共演讲与档案的历史分析，研究修辞与政治，包括总统修辞、战争修辞以及女性与政治。

name: Trevor Parry-Giles
title: Associate Dean for Faculty Affairs and Research, College of Arts and Humanities; Professor, Communication
summary: Studies relationships among rhetoric, politics, law, and popular culture, such as Supreme Court confirmations and televised portrayals of the U.S. presidency.
summary_zh: 研究修辞、政治、法律与流行文化之间的关系，例如最高法院大法官确认程序及电视剧对美国总统职位的呈现。

name: Damien Pfister
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Affiliate Faculty, Classics
summary: Studies intersections of rhetoric and digital media, from attention and deliberation in the early blogosphere to ancient rhetoric and the ethos of wearable computers.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与数字媒介的交汇，从早期博客圈中的注意力与公共协商，到古典修辞以及可穿戴计算设备的人格诉求。

name: Yan Qu
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Studies public relations and risk and crisis communication from a personal social network perspective, including how AI reshapes professional identities and networks.
summary_zh: 从个人社会网络视角研究公共关系及风险与危机传播，包括人工智能如何重塑职业身份与人际网络。

name: Anita Atwell Seate
title: Professor, Communication
summary: Studies how social identities and intergroup dynamics shape responses to threat, and how organizations and communities communicate weather and public safety risks equitably.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份与群际动态如何影响人们对威胁的反应，以及组织和社区如何公平地传播天气与公共安全风险。

name: Catherine Knight Steele
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Director, Black Communication and Technology Lab, Communication; Affiliate Associate Professor, The Harriet Tubman Department of Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
summary: Studies race, gender, and media, especially how Black women and Black communities use online technology for resistance and community, through critical and historical analysis.
summary_zh: 以批判与历史分析方法研究种族、性别与媒介，尤其关注黑人女性与黑人社群如何利用网络技术进行抵抗并建立社群。

name: Rianna Walcott
title: Assistant Professor, Communication; Associate Director, Black Communication and Technology Lab, Communication; Affiliate Faculty, Department of African American and Africana Studies,; Affiliate Faculty, Artificial Intelligence Interdisciplinary Institute at Maryland,; Affiliate Faculty, The Harriet Tubman Department of Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies
summary: Studies Black British and Black diasporic communication practices on social media platforms, developing digital humanities methods such as scraping Black Twitter.
summary_zh: 研究黑人英国人及黑人离散群体在社交媒体平台上的传播实践，并开发如抓取黑人推特数据等数字人文方法。

name: Carly Woods
title: Associate Professor, Communication; Affiliate Associate Professor, The Harriet Tubman Department of Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies; Classics
summary: Studies the history of argumentation, debate, and memory, including women's debating and education in the US and UK, using archival rhetorical research.
summary_zh: 运用档案修辞研究方法，研究论辩、辩论与记忆的历史，包括美英两国女性辩论与教育。

name: Carina Zelaya
title: Assistant Professor, Communication
summary: Studies health messaging on cancer prevention, crisis, and sexual health, examining risk perception, information seeking, and decision-making, including among Black women.
summary_zh: 研究癌症预防、危机及性健康方面的健康信息传播，考察风险认知、信息寻求与决策过程，包括黑人女性群体。

name: Linda Steiner
title: Associate Dean, Faculty Affairs and Inclusion; Professor
summary: Studies media ethics, feminist theory, and women's roles in journalism and the media workforce, including alternative media, citizen journalism, and suffrage press history.
summary_zh: 研究媒介伦理、女性主义理论以及女性在新闻业与媒体劳动中的角色，包括另类媒体、公民新闻与妇女选举权运动的新闻史。

name: Krishnan Vasudevan
title: Associate Dean, Research; Associate Professor in Visual Communication
summary: Studies how platform design and Silicon Valley's frictionless ethos affect democracy, journalism, and social movements, using ethnography, critical qualitative analysis, and documentary.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、批判性质性分析与纪录片创作，研究平台设计及硅谷“无摩擦”理念如何影响民主、新闻业与社会运动。

name: DeNeen Brown
title: Professor
summary: Practices and teaches narrative and feature journalism on race, Black history, and social issues, including reporting on the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授叙事与特稿新闻写作，关注种族、黑人历史与社会议题，包括对1921年塔尔萨种族屠杀的报道。

name: Lucy Dalglish
title: Professor
summary: Works on media law, First Amendment protections, and press freedom, drawing on experience leading the Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press.
summary_zh: 依托领导新闻自由记者委员会的经验，关注媒介法、第一修正案保护与新闻自由。

name: Mark Feldstein
title: Richard Eaton Chair of Broadcast Journalism
areas: First Amendment: libel and defamation; censorship and national security; subpoenas of reporters; undercover reporting
summary: Studies the history and ethics of investigative and broadcast journalism, presidents and the press, leaks, and First Amendment issues through archival historical research.
summary_zh: 通过档案历史研究，探讨调查报道与广播新闻的历史和伦理、总统与媒体关系、泄密及第一修正案议题。

name: Christopher Hanson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalism ethics, the role of master narratives and stereotypes in shaping news content, and media-military relations.
summary_zh: 研究新闻伦理、宏大叙事与刻板印象如何塑造新闻内容，以及媒体与军方的关系。

name: Naeemul Hassan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops computational journalism tools using data mining and NLP, including automated fact-checking and algorithms to reduce clickbait harms on social media.
summary_zh: 运用数据挖掘与自然语言处理开发计算新闻工具，包括自动化事实核查系统以及减少社交媒体标题党危害的算法。

name: Shuning Lu
title: Assistant Professor in Media, Democracy and Technology
summary: Studies audience behavior and journalistic practice at the intersection of journalism and social media in the U.S. and China, using experiments, surveys, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验、问卷调查与计算方法，研究美国与中国新闻业和社交媒体交汇处的受众行为与新闻实践。

name: Christoph Mergerson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies journalism history and weather and disaster journalism, including weathercasters' job satisfaction and the history of women in television meteorology in the U.S.
summary_zh: 研究新闻史以及天气与灾害新闻，包括美国电视天气预报员的职业满意度和女性电视气象学家的历史。

name: Susan Moeller
title: Professor of Media and International Affairs; Director of Ph.D. Studies
areas: U.S. and global media and public policy
summary: Studies global media coverage of conflict, terrorism, disasters, and human rights, and develops global media literacy education.
summary_zh: 研究全球媒体对冲突、恐怖主义、灾难与人权的报道，并发展全球媒介素养教育。

name: Deborah Nelson
title: Professor of Investigative Journalism
summary: Practices and teaches investigative journalism on topics such as war crimes, global hunger, pandemics, climate change, and police use of force.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授调查新闻，报道题材涵盖战争罪行、全球饥饿、流行病、气候变化与警察用武等。

name: Sarah Oates
title: Professor; Senior Scholar
summary: Studies how disinformation and propaganda travel through media systems and how media support or subvert democracy, comparing Russia, the United States, and the UK.
summary_zh: 研究虚假信息与宣传如何在媒介系统中传播，以及媒体如何支持或破坏民主，并对俄罗斯、美国与英国进行比较。

name: Dana Priest
title: Knight Chair in Public Affairs Journalism; Professor
summary: Practices and teaches investigative national security journalism on the military and intelligence agencies, and advocates for jailed journalists worldwide.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授关于军方与情报机构的国家安全调查新闻，并关注全球被监禁记者的处境。

name: Daniel Trielli
title: Assistant Professor of Media and Democracy
summary: Studies how algorithmic curation, especially Google search, shapes news and political information, with interests in computational journalism and algorithmic accountability.
summary_zh: 研究算法策展（尤其是谷歌搜索）如何影响新闻与政治信息，关注计算新闻与算法问责。

name: Rob Wells
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of business journalism, including trade reporters and the Kiplinger newsletter, through archival research, alongside data-driven reporting.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究探讨商业新闻史，包括行业记者与基普林格通讯，同时从事数据驱动的新闻报道。

name: Ronald Yaros
title: Associate Professor
areas: Mobile journalism and social media strategies
Blended and virtual teaching and learning
summary: Studies how people seek, select, and share digital information produced by humans or AI, and designs content strategies that capture and sustain audience attention.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何寻求、选择并分享由人类或AI生产的数字信息，并设计能够吸引和维持受众注意力的内容策略。

name: John Banas
title: Professor
summary: Studies persuasion and resistance to misinformation and conspiracy theories, testing inoculation, reactance, and mediated intergroup contact theories with quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究说服以及对虚假信息和阴谋论的抵抗，用定量方法检验免疫理论、心理抗拒理论和中介化群际接触理论。

name: Elena Bessarabova
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and cognition shape persuasion and maladaptive beliefs such as bias, deception, and misinformation, developing reactance and inoculation-based mitigation strategies.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知如何影响说服以及偏见、欺骗和虚假信息等不良信念，并基于心理抗拒与免疫理论开发纠偏策略。

name: Ryan Bisel
title: Professor & MAOL Program Director
summary: Studies leadership communication, organizational culture, and behavioral ethics, theorizing how organizations learn morally through communication and team learning.
summary_zh: 研究领导传播、组织文化与行为伦理，从传播视角理论化组织的道德学习与团队学习。

name: Ioana Cionea
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people argue and manage conflict in interpersonal and intercultural relationships, including online, using quantitative modeling, scale development, and SEM.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在人际与跨文化关系（包括网络上）中争论和处理冲突，采用定量建模、量表开发与结构方程模型。

name: Jill Edy
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how news media construct and maintain collective memory of events such as 1960s social unrest and how this shapes news coverage, public agendas, and politics.
summary_zh: 研究新闻媒体如何建构与维系对1960年代社会动荡等事件的集体记忆，以及这如何影响新闻报道、公共议程与政治。

name: Alice Fanari
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies communication during cross-cultural transitions of sojourners such as students abroad, missionaries, and military families, mainly using qualitative and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究留学生、传教士和军人家庭等旅居者跨文化迁移过程中的传播，主要采用质性与混合方法。

name: Mengfei Guan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how message design and audience characteristics shape risk perception and behavior change in health, risk, and science communication, including analyses of HINTS survey data.
summary_zh: 研究信息设计与受众特征如何影响健康、风险与科学传播中的风险感知和行为改变，包括对HINTS调查数据的分析。

name: Amy Johnson
title: Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal relationships, including long-distance relationships, friendships, stepfamilies, and serial arguments, with attention to computer-mediated communication.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系，包括异地恋、友谊、继亲家庭与反复性争论，并关注计算机中介传播。

name: Timothy Levine
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies deception and lie detection, developing and testing Truth-Default Theory through experiments, and works on persuasion, measurement validation, and research methods.
summary_zh: 研究欺骗与谎言识别，通过实验发展和检验真相默认理论，并涉及说服、测量效度与研究方法。

name: Musa Malik
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how narratives shape understanding of self and others, including morality and representation, using NLP, computer vision, audio processing, and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究叙事如何塑造对自我与他人的理解（包括道德与再现），运用自然语言处理、计算机视觉、音频处理与脑成像。

name: Pat Meirick
title: Professor
summary: Studies why people hold political and health beliefs, examining partisanship, fake news, third-person perceptions, and political advertising effects.
summary_zh: 研究人们为何持有特定的政治与健康信念，考察党派性、假新闻、第三人效果感知与政治广告效果。

name: Gretchen Montgomery-Vestecka
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies intergroup and intercultural communication, including accent stereotyping, ethnolinguistic identity, and attitudes toward Latino immigrants in the US.
summary_zh: 研究群际与跨文化传播，包括口音刻板印象、族群语言认同以及美国对拉丁裔移民的态度。

name: James Olufowote
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health and organizational communication in marginalized communities, including polio vaccine resistance in Nigeria and HIV/AIDS prevention in Tanzania.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化社群中的健康与组织传播，包括尼日利亚北部的脊髓灰质炎疫苗抵制与坦桑尼亚的艾滋病预防。

name: Norman Wong
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how people process theory-based health messages in mass media, designing and testing campaigns on vaping, HPV vaccination, tobacco, and mental illness stigma.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何加工大众媒介中基于理论的健康信息，设计并检验关于电子烟、HPV疫苗、烟草和精神疾病污名的传播活动。

name: Andrea Miller
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Dean
summary: Studies television news and crisis coverage, including media lessons from Hurricane Katrina and the BP oil disaster and the future of the newspaper industry, through case studies.
summary_zh: 研究电视新闻与危机报道，包括卡特里娜飓风和BP漏油事件的媒体经验以及报业的未来，主要采用案例研究。

name: Elanie Steyn
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Dean of Academic Affairs, Associate Professor, Gaylord Family Professor
summary: Studies women in media leadership, media management, and international media, with grant work on media and small business in South Asia and prior research in Africa and Europe.
summary_zh: 研究媒体领导层中的女性、媒体管理与国际媒体，主持南亚媒体与小企业相关项目，并曾在非洲和欧洲开展研究。

name: Doyle Yoon
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies brand experience and digital advertising effects, including VR ads and YouTube pre-roll attention, using surveys and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究品牌体验与数字广告效果，包括VR广告与YouTube贴片广告注意力，采用调查与眼动追踪。

name: Ralph Beliveau
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Creative Media Production and Professional Writing Area Head
summary: Studies media literacy, horror media, documentary, race, and popular culture through rhetorical criticism and cultural studies.
summary_zh: 通过修辞批评与文化研究探讨媒介素养、恐怖类型媒介、纪录片、种族与流行文化。

name: Chang Sup Park
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people engage with news and journalists on social and mobile media and how newsrooms adopt AI and automated journalism.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社交与移动媒体上参与新闻并与记者互动，以及新闻编辑室如何采用人工智能与自动化新闻。

name: Ray Claxton
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Teaches advertising art direction, visual communication, and design thinking; the profile describes creative practice rather than a research program.
summary_zh: 讲授广告艺术指导、视觉传播与设计思维；简介描述的是创意实践而非研究方向。

name: Kyle Bergersen
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works as a commercial director and screenwriter in advertising, television, and independent film; the profile describes creative practice rather than research.
summary_zh: 从事广告、电视与独立电影的商业导演和编剧工作；简介描述的是创作实践而非研究。

name: Scott Hodgson
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Gaylord Family Research Professor
summary: Produces and directs video and television programming, including public broadcasting and international training work; the profile describes production practice rather than research.
summary_zh: 制作和执导视频与电视节目，包括公共广播与国际培训工作；简介描述的是制作实践而非研究。

name: Christine Delp
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how streaming platforms are reshaping the US documentary film industry, examining production cultures and media ethics as a media sociologist and filmmaker.
summary_zh: 以媒介社会学者和纪录片导演身份，研究流媒体平台如何重塑美国纪录片产业，考察制作文化与媒介伦理。

name: Mike Boettcher
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Nicole and Evan H. Katz Endowed Professor of Journalism
summary: Brings decades of network broadcast journalism experience covering war and terrorism; the profile describes professional practice rather than a research program.
summary_zh: 拥有数十年报道战争与恐怖主义的电视网新闻经验；简介描述的是新闻实务而非研究方向。

name: David Craig
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies journalism ethics and excellence in journalistic practice, including online journalism, ethical use of narrative and language, and values in ethical decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究新闻伦理与新闻实践的卓越标准，包括网络新闻、叙事与语言的伦理运用以及伦理决策中的价值。

name: Robert Kerr
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Gaylord Family Professor, Edith Kinney Gaylord Presidential Professor
summary: Studies First Amendment law and policy for a free marketplace of ideas amid corporate and government power, and media narratives in sports-media history.
summary_zh: 研究在企业与政府权力扩张背景下维护思想自由市场的第一修正案法律与政策，以及体育媒体史中的媒介叙事。

name: Glenn Leshner
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Presidential Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional processing of media, especially health messages for communication regulatory science, using psychophysiological measures and eye tracking.
summary_zh: 研究对媒介尤其是健康信息的认知与情绪加工，服务于传播监管科学，采用心理生理测量与眼动追踪。

name: John Schmeltzer
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor, Engleman/Livermore Professor in Community Journalism
summary: Brings a long newspaper career in political and business reporting and community journalism; the profile describes professional practice rather than research.
summary_zh: 拥有长期报纸政治与商业报道及社区新闻经验；简介描述的是新闻实务而非研究。

name: Melanie Wilderman
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor, Executive Director of Oklahoma Scholastic Media
summary: Studies scholastic and collegiate journalism education, service learning, and community journalism.
summary_zh: 研究中学与大学新闻教育、服务学习与社区新闻。

name: Rachel Patterson
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Writes young adult and adult fiction as a bestselling novelist; the profile describes creative writing rather than a research program.
summary_zh: 作为畅销小说家创作青少年与成人小说；简介描述的是创意写作而非研究方向。

name: Tobi Ogundiran
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Writes speculative fiction with an Afrocentric viewpoint, with interests in comparative mythology and culture-specific storytelling.
summary_zh: 创作具有非洲中心视角的推想小说，关注比较神话学与特定文化的叙事。

name: Jensen Moore
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how individuals grieve and seek information on social networking sites after personal loss, natural disasters, and mass shootings, linking crisis, health, and PR.
summary_zh: 研究人们在个人丧失、自然灾害和大规模枪击事件后如何在社交网站上哀悼与寻求信息，连接危机、健康与公关传播。

name: Katerina Tsetsura
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Gaylord Family Professor, Professor
summary: Studies global public relations, media transparency, and PR ethics, including hidden influences in news worldwide and strategic communication in Russia.
summary_zh: 研究全球公共关系、媒体透明度与公关伦理，包括全球新闻中的隐性影响以及俄罗斯的战略传播。

name: Jiun-Yi (Jenny) Tsai
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations and health communication using surveys, field experiments, content analysis, interviews, focus groups, and computational social media analytics.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与健康传播，采用调查、田野实验、内容分析、访谈、焦点小组与计算性社交媒体分析。

name: Xiaochen Angela Zhang
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies crisis and risk communication for disaster resilience, examining how knowledge networks among nonprofits, community groups, and local governments support emergency management.
summary_zh: 研究面向灾害韧性的危机与风险传播，考察非营利组织、社区团体与地方政府之间的知识网络如何支持应急管理。

name: Junho Park
dept: Gaylord College of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive, emotional, and behavioral responses to health and risk messages such as gambling and nicotine ads, combining self-report with psychophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究人们对赌博、尼古丁广告等健康与风险信息的认知、情绪和行为反应，结合自我报告与心理生理测量。

name: Patricia Aufderheide
title: University Professor
summary: Studies documentary film, copyright and fair use, and communications policy in the public interest, including public, community and podcast media.
summary_zh: 研究纪录片、版权与合理使用以及公共利益导向的传播政策，涵盖公共媒体、社区媒体与播客。

name: Caty Borum
title: Professor
summary: Studies and produces entertainment media for social change, including comedy and documentary storytelling that advance social justice and civic power.
summary_zh: 研究并制作推动社会变革的娱乐媒介，包括促进社会正义与公民力量的喜剧和纪录片叙事。

name: Larry Engel
title: Professor
summary: Makes documentary films on science, nature and environmental conservation for public television, and teaches film theory, production and emerging media.
summary_zh: 为公共电视制作关于科学、自然与环境保护的纪录片，并讲授电影理论、制作与新兴媒介。

name: Leena Jayaswal
title: Professor
summary: Creates documentary film and photography on Indian American and mixed-race identity and belonging, and more recently on climate change storytelling.
summary_zh: 创作关于印度裔美国人与混血身份及归属感的纪录片和摄影作品，近期也关注气候变化叙事。

name: Brigid Maher
title: Professor
summary: Makes documentary and fiction films about women, from female religious leaders in the Middle East to midwifery, and writes on film theory and new media.
summary_zh: 制作以女性为主题的纪录片和剧情片，从中东女性宗教领袖到助产士，并撰写电影理论与新媒体相关论述。

name: Adrienne Massanari
title: Professor
summary: Studies digital culture and platform politics, including Reddit communities, toxic technocultures, gaming, and how Silicon Valley culture fed the far right.
summary_zh: 研究数字文化与平台政治，包括 Reddit 社群、有毒技术文化、游戏，以及硅谷文化如何助长极右翼。

name: Aram Sinnreich
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of culture, law and technology, including intellectual property, remix and music, surveillance and privacy, and platform governance.
summary_zh: 研究文化、法律与技术的交叉，包括知识产权、混音与音乐、监控与隐私以及平台治理。

name: Kurt Braddock
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how violent extremist groups use persuasion and propaganda to radicalize audiences, and how communication strategies can counter radicalization.
summary_zh: 研究暴力极端组织如何利用说服与宣传使受众激进化，以及如何借助传播策略对抗激进化。

name: Megan Finn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies data governance, responsible computing and information infrastructures, including how information orders shape what is known after disasters.
summary_zh: 研究数据治理、负责任计算与信息基础设施，包括信息秩序如何塑造灾后的知识生产。

name: Laura Hinson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Makes documentary films about personal journeys, reconciliation and resilience, including women entrepreneurs in post-genocide Rwanda and marginalized DC residents.
summary_zh: 制作关于个人历程、和解与韧性的纪录片，包括种族灭绝后卢旺达的女性创业者和华盛顿特区的边缘社群居民。

name: Natalie Hopkinson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Black and Indigenous art, media and knowledge systems, including go-go music as a public sphere and cultural network in Washington, DC.
summary_zh: 研究黑人与原住民的艺术、媒介和知识体系，包括作为华盛顿特区公共领域与文化网络的 go-go 音乐。

name: Wendy Melillo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how strategic communication and public service advertising, such as Ad Council campaigns, influence society and the news media.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播与公益广告（如 Ad Council 运动）如何影响社会与新闻媒体。

name: Claudia Myers
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes and directs narrative feature films and documentaries, with recurring attention to military families, wounded veterans and the path to US citizenship.
summary_zh: 编剧并执导剧情长片与纪录片，持续关注军人家庭、受伤退伍军人以及取得美国公民身份的历程。

name: Krzysztof Pietroszek
title: Associate Professor
summary: Builds and studies immersive media, including volumetric filmmaking, virtual reality games and interactive storytelling at the junction of film and computer science.
summary_zh: 构建并研究沉浸式媒介，包括体积视频电影、虚拟现实游戏以及电影与计算机科学交汇处的互动叙事。

name: Benjamin Stokes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies and designs civic media and place-based games that strengthen neighborhoods and communities, including local storytelling networks and participatory design.
summary_zh: 研究并设计增强街区与社区联系的公民媒介和基于地点的游戏，包括本地叙事网络与参与式设计。

name: Margot Susca
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media ownership and its consequences for democracy, especially private equity and hedge fund control of newspapers, using critical political economy.
summary_zh: 以批判政治经济学研究媒体所有权及其对民主的影响，尤其是私募股权与对冲基金对报业的控制。

name: John Watson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media law and journalism ethics, including court rulings that shape journalistic practice and the case for professional licensing of journalists.
summary_zh: 研究媒体法与新闻伦理，包括影响新闻实践的法院判决以及新闻从业者职业许可制度的主张。

name: Sherri Williams
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies race, gender and representation in media, including how Black audiences use social media such as Black Twitter to shape television and pursue justice.
summary_zh: 研究媒介中的种族、性别与再现，包括黑人受众如何借助 Black Twitter 等社交媒体影响电视节目并追求社会正义。

name: Sarah Aghazadeh
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies advocacy, activism and community building in public relations, often on taboo or stigmatized issues, using qualitative, rhetorical and community-engaged methods.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系中的倡导、行动主义与社区建设，常聚焦禁忌或污名化议题，采用质性、修辞与社区参与式方法。

name: Chelsea Butkowski
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies digital media and identity, including social media self-representation in unsettled times, selfies and gender stereotyping, and online political discourse.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒介与身份认同，包括动荡时期的社交媒体自我呈现、自拍与性别刻板印象以及网络政治话语。

name: Rosalind Donald
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how climate change is discussed and how environmental injustices shape the climate debate, including a history of climate justice struggles in Miami.
summary_zh: 研究气候变化如何被讨论以及环境不公如何塑造气候争论，包括迈阿密气候正义斗争的历史。

name: Rohan Grover
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media and technology industries translate public values into products, including the implementation of data privacy law in the privacy tech industry.
summary_zh: 研究媒体与科技产业如何将公共价值转化为商业产品，包括数据隐私法在隐私科技行业中的落地实践。

name: Maya Livio
title: Assistant Professor
areas: critical AI, data, and infrastructure studies
summary: Studies the environmental stakes of media and computation, including AI data center development and AI's links to biodiversity loss, through research and media practice.
summary_zh: 通过研究与媒介实践探讨媒介与计算的环境代价，包括 AI 数据中心建设及 AI 与生物多样性丧失的关系。

name: Sarah Menke-Fish
title: Assistant Professor and Senior Director of Experiential Learning
summary: Teaches and produces educational documentary media with students, directing youth programs in environmental communication, video production and journalism.
summary_zh: 与学生一起教授并制作教育类纪录片，主持涵盖环境传播、视频制作与新闻写作的青少年项目。

name: Joe Pirro
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Produces independent narrative feature films that champion diverse and emerging filmmakers, with premieres at Sundance, Berlin, Cannes and Toronto.
summary_zh: 制作扶持多元与新锐导演的独立剧情长片，作品曾在圣丹斯、柏林、戛纳与多伦多首映。

name: Gemma Puglisi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Teaches and practices public relations and media strategy, with expertise in crisis communication, media issues and women in communications.
summary_zh: 教授并从事公共关系与媒体策略工作，专长于危机传播、媒体议题以及传播行业中的女性。

name: Jamie Sisley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Writes and directs narrative and documentary films, including family stories of addiction and the migrant guestworkers who sustain the US carnival industry.
summary_zh: 编剧并执导剧情片与纪录片，包括家庭与成瘾的故事，以及支撑美国游乐场行业的墨西哥外籍劳工。

name: Joe Stephens
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Practices and teaches investigative accountability journalism, leading a nonprofit newsroom whose reporting covers political corruption, government and abuses of power.
summary_zh: 从事并讲授调查性问责新闻，领导一家非营利新闻机构，报道政治腐败、政府与权力滥用。

name: Pauline Cheong
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: President's Professor
areas: Human Dimensions of Science and Technology
summary: Studies how AI, social robotics, and digital media shape community, religious authority, and smart-city governance across cultures, including how extremist narratives and rumors spread online.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能、社交机器人与数字媒体如何跨文化地塑造社区、宗教权威与智慧城市治理，并关注极端主义叙事与谣言在网络上的传播。

name: Laura Guerrero
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: School Director and Professor
summary: Studies emotional and nonverbal communication in close relationships, including intimacy, forgiveness, jealousy, hurt, and conflict, using quantitative relationship-science methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量的关系科学方法，研究亲密关系中的情绪与非语言传播，包括亲密表达、宽恕、嫉妒、伤害与冲突。

name: K. Hazel Kwon
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies how networked publics make sense of news events and how information disorder, misinformation, cyber-rumoring, incivility, and dark web communities reshape public information.
summary_zh: 研究网络化公众如何理解新闻事件，以及信息失序、虚假信息、网络谣言、不文明言论与暗网社群如何重塑公众信息过程。

name: Tony Roberto
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies health communication campaigns, persuasion, and social influence, along with interpersonal communication, with expertise in quantitative research methods.
summary_zh: 研究健康传播运动、说服与社会影响以及人际传播，专长于定量研究方法。

name: Sarah Tracy
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotional labor, compassion, workplace bullying, burnout, and organizational flourishing, and develops qualitative methodology such as phronetic iterative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究情绪劳动、同情、职场霸凌、倦怠与组织繁荣，并发展如实践智慧迭代分析（PIQDA）等质性方法论。

name: Bradley Adame
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor and Director of Stakeholder Engagement and Innovation
summary: Studies risk perception and responses to campaigns that inform decisions about disaster preparedness, concussion reporting, and climate change, aiming to build theories of message design.
summary_zh: 研究风险感知以及公众对灾害防备、脑震荡报告与气候变化等决策类传播运动的反应，致力于构建讯息设计理论。

name: Uttaran Dutta
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies culture-centered design and communication for sustainable development, health, and social change with marginalized indigenous and rural communities in India, using participatory methods.
summary_zh: 运用参与式方法，与印度边缘化的原住民和农村社区合作，研究面向可持续发展、健康与社会变革的文化中心设计与传播。

name: Jenna N. Hanchey
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor, Rhetoric & Critical/Cultural Studies
summary: Studies decolonial possibility in international aid and development and how African speculative fiction imagines futures beyond Western development logics, through rhetorical and critical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过修辞与批判分析，研究国际援助与发展中的去殖民可能性，以及非洲思辨小说如何想象超越西方发展逻辑的未来。

name: Heewon Kim
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational justice, state and legal violence against activists, unions, migrant workers, and survivors, and health inequities in Asia and the Global South through feminist critique.
summary_zh: 从女性主义与反殖民视角，研究组织正义，国家与法律对社运人士、工会、移民工人及性暴力幸存者的暴力，以及亚洲和全球南方的健康不平等。

name: Jonathan Pettigrew
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor and Director of Doctoral Studies
summary: Studies family communication and substance-use prevention by designing, delivering, and evaluating health interventions with communities in the US and Latin America and the Caribbean.
summary_zh: 通过与美国及拉丁美洲和加勒比地区社区合作设计、实施和评估健康干预，研究家庭传播与物质滥用预防。

name: Liesel Sharabi
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how dating apps, algorithms, AI, and AR/VR shape mate selection and relationship development, using multilevel modeling, structural equation modeling, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 运用多层模型、结构方程模型与机器学习，研究约会软件、算法、人工智能与AR/VR如何影响择偶与关系发展。

name: Joris Van Ouytsel
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor and Associate Director
summary: Studies adolescent sexting, cyber dating abuse, image-based sexual abuse, and how digital media and AI shape relationships and sexuality, at the intersection of interpersonal and health communication.
summary_zh: 在人际与健康传播交叉领域，研究青少年色情短信、网络约会暴力、基于图像的性虐待，以及数字媒体和人工智能如何影响亲密关系与性。

name: Alaina Zanin
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies discourse, identity, power, and resistance at the intersection of health and organizational communication in settings such as sports teams and healthcare organizations, using ethnography.
summary_zh: 运用民族志方法，在健康与组织传播交叉领域，研究体育团队、医疗机构等场域中的话语、身份、权力与抵抗。

name: Elissa Adame
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies leadership communication, organizational training and change, and learning processes, including feedback strategies that improve learning outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究领导传播、组织培训与变革以及学习过程，包括提升学习成效的反馈策略。

name: Serap Erincin
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies experimental and transnational social-justice performance as an artist-scholar, creating performances and installations on social justice and environmental concerns.
summary_zh: 作为艺术家学者研究实验性与跨国社会正义表演，并创作关注社会正义与环境议题的表演和装置作品。

name: Tomide Oloruntobi
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies globalization, cultural politics of taste, platformization, and political economy in postcolonial Nigerian visual cultures, including Afrobeats and global Black relationalities.
summary_zh: 研究后殖民尼日利亚视觉文化中的全球化、品味的文化政治、平台化与政治经济，包括非洲节拍音乐与全球黑人关系性。

name: Paul Mongeau
dept: Hugh Downs School of Human Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies early romantic relationship development, such as first dates and friends-with-benefits relationships, and the cognitive processing of persuasive and fear appeal messages.
summary_zh: 研究浪漫关系的早期发展（如初次约会与“炮友”关系），以及对说服讯息与恐惧诉求的认知加工。

name: Craig Allen
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mass media history, including the history of local TV news, Spanish-language television, and presidential media relations, using historical methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史研究方法，研究大众媒介史，包括地方电视新闻史、西班牙语电视以及总统与媒体的关系。

name: Battinto Batts
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Dean and Professor
summary: Leads journalism education as a dean, with background in journalism strategy, philanthropy, nonprofit administration, and media management.
summary_zh: 以院长身份领导新闻教育，背景涵盖新闻战略、慈善、非营利管理与媒体管理。

name: Marcos Colón
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
areas: decolonial theory and epistemologies of the South
summary: Studies how Indigenous and community media, journalism, and documentary film challenge dominant narratives about the Amazon and support decolonial, environmental knowledge.
summary_zh: 研究原住民与社区媒体、新闻与纪录片如何挑战关于亚马逊的主流叙事，并推动去殖民与环境知识生产。

name: Erin Coyle
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies First Amendment, privacy, fair trial, and press access rights, using legal and historical methods to examine conflicts between free press and other rights.
summary_zh: 运用法律与历史研究方法，研究第一修正案、隐私权、公正审判权与新闻采访权，考察新闻自由与其他权利之间的冲突。

name: Dawn Gilpin
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Dean and Associate Professor
summary: Studies interactions among organizations, media, and public policy, focusing on organizational and issue identity and knowledge and power, through narrative and network analysis.
summary_zh: 通过叙事分析与网络分析，研究组织、媒体与公共政策之间的互动，关注组织与议题身份以及知识与权力。

name: Celeste Gonzalez de Bustamante
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Vice Dean and Professor
summary: Focuses on border and global journalism and community-engaged journalism education across the U.S.-Mexico borderlands and Latin America.
summary_zh: 关注边境与全球新闻，以及在美墨边境地区和拉丁美洲开展的社区参与式新闻教育。

name: Rich Johnson
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Center Director and Associate Professor
summary: Studies sports media framing practices that stereotype and marginalize women's athletics and minority athletes.
summary_zh: 研究体育媒体中对女性体育与少数族裔运动员进行刻板化与边缘化的框架实践。

name: Dave Keating
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the design and effects of strategic persuasive messaging, including belief systems, message repetition, and message fatigue, mainly in health and science contexts using experiments.
summary_zh: 运用实验等方法，研究战略性说服讯息的设计与效果，包括信念体系、讯息重复与讯息疲劳，主要聚焦健康与科学情境。

name: Sada Reed
