dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how sports journalists' routines, social media use, source selection, and role conflicts shape content, including comparisons of American and Russian doping coverage.
summary_zh: 研究体育记者的工作惯例、社交媒体使用、信源选择与角色冲突如何塑造报道内容，包括美俄兴奋剂丑闻报道的比较。

name: Chelsea Reynolds
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Center Director and Associate Professor
summary: Studies how media shape and reflect norms about culture, gender, and sexuality, using critical discourse analysis, with work on LGBTQ communication and journalists' workplace wellbeing.
summary_zh: 运用批判话语分析，研究媒介如何塑造和反映关于文化、性别与性向的规范，涉及LGBTQ传播与记者职场福祉。

name: Dennis Russell
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works on media law, media ethics, and the philosophy of mass communication, including press freedom and the treatment of journalists covering protests.
summary_zh: 关注媒介法、媒介伦理与大众传播哲学，包括新闻自由以及采访抗议活动的记者所受对待。

name: Leslie-Jean Thornton
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social media in news communication patterns, including hashtags as a way to uncover online communities, meme circulation, and digital freedom of expression.
summary_zh: 研究新闻传播模式中的社交媒体，包括以话题标签发现网络社群、表情包传播以及数字时代的表达自由。

name: Ali Zain
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategic message features that drive perception and engagement in health, science, and misinformation contexts, using experiments, machine learning, NLP, and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 运用实验、机器学习、自然语言处理与眼动追踪等方法，研究在健康、科学与虚假信息情境中驱动公众感知与参与的战略讯息特征。

name: Asheley R. Landrum
dept: Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how values and worldviews shape audiences' selection and processing of science information and misinformation, and how these processes develop from childhood into adulthood.
summary_zh: 研究价值观与世界观如何影响受众对科学信息与虚假信息的选择和加工，以及这些过程如何从童年发展至成年。

name: Jaye Atkinson
title: Chair/Associate Professor, Communication; Affiliate Faculty Member
summary: Studies how communication sustains or challenges age stereotypes, from patronizing speech and ageist language to portrayals of older adults in film and advertising.
summary_zh: 研究传播如何维系或挑战年龄刻板印象，涵盖对老年人的居高临下式言语、年龄歧视语言，以及电影和广告中的老年人形象。

name: Tim Barouch
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how public argument and rhetoric shape citizenship, political judgment, and law, using rhetorical criticism and theory of legal and democratic discourse.
summary_zh: 研究公共论辩与修辞如何塑造公民身份、政治判断与法律，运用修辞批评及法律与民主话语理论。

name: Mia Bloom
title: Professor
summary: Studies terrorism, propaganda, and political violence, including women and children in terror groups and QAnon, through ethnographic fieldwork in Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia.
summary_zh: 研究恐怖主义、宣传与政治暴力，包括恐怖组织中的女性与儿童以及QAnon，主要通过在欧洲、中东和南亚的民族志田野调查展开。

name: David Cheshier
title: Associate Professor; Director, Creative Media Industries Institute
summary: Works on rhetorical theory and criticism, argumentation, and public deliberation, connecting rhetoric with critical theory and political philosophy.
summary_zh: 从事修辞理论与批评、论证研究和公共审议研究，将修辞学与批判理论及政治哲学相结合。

name: Hue Duong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies persuasion, social influence, and message effects in health communication and social marketing, including violence prevention, tobacco control, and parental mediation in Vietnam.
summary_zh: 研究健康传播与社会营销中的说服、社会影响和信息效果，涉及暴力预防、控烟以及越南家庭中的父母媒介干预。

name: Carrie P. Freeman
title: Professor
areas: strategic communication for social justice movements
media construction of nonhuman animal and environmental issues
summary: Analyzes from a critical/cultural perspective how media construct nonhuman animal and environmental issues, and strategic communication and ethics for animal rights and social justice movements.
summary_zh: 从批判/文化研究视角分析媒体如何建构非人类动物与环境议题，并研究动物权利及社会正义运动的策略传播与媒介伦理。

name: Cynthia Hoffner
title: Professor
summary: Studies psychological aspects of media uses and effects, including media and mental health, parasocial relationships with media figures, presumed media influence, and emotional responses.
summary_zh: 研究媒介使用与效果的心理层面，包括媒介与心理健康、与媒介人物的拟社会关系、假定媒介影响以及情绪反应。

name: Kesha James
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how Black speakers and Black popular culture, especially Black horror, use visual and discursive rhetoric to challenge the white gaze and reshape understandings of race and power.
summary_zh: 研究黑人演说者与黑人流行文化（尤其是黑人恐怖作品）如何运用视觉与话语修辞挑战白人凝视，重塑对种族与权力的理解。

name: Anthony (Tony) Lemieux
title: Founding Co-Director of the Atlanta Global Studies Center
summary: Applies persuasion and health behavior change models to terrorist propaganda and radicalization, using experiments and analysis of extremist magazines, music, images, and videos.
summary_zh: 将说服与健康行为改变模型应用于恐怖组织宣传与激进化研究，采用实验方法并分析极端主义杂志、音乐、图像和视频。

name: Kevin Mudavadi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies journalism, misinformation, and media trust in Kenya and the United States, including journalists' working conditions, AI in news, and audience responses to misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究肯尼亚和美国的新闻业、虚假信息与媒体信任，包括记者工作状况、新闻中的人工智能以及受众对虚假信息的应对。

name: Maria Repnikova
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political persuasion, resistance, and media activism in illiberal contexts, comparing China and Russia through ethnography and in-depth interviews with journalists and officials.
summary_zh: 研究非自由政体中的政治说服、抵抗与媒体行动主义，通过民族志及对记者和官员的深度访谈比较中国与俄罗斯。

name: MaryAnn Romski
title: Regents Professor, Department of Communication (Joint Appointments in Psychology, Communication Sciences & Disorders) Director, Center for Research on Atypical Development and Learning (CRADL)
areas: language development in children with severe communication disorders
summary: Studies language development in children with severe communication disorders and tests augmentative communication interventions, including a caregiver app in South Africa.
summary_zh: 研究重度沟通障碍儿童的语言发展，并检验辅助与替代沟通干预措施的效果，包括在南非开发的照护者应用程序。

name: Dror Walter
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses computational methods such as network analysis and machine learning to study political extremism, health and science misinformation, and framing in online text and visual content.
summary_zh: 运用网络分析和机器学习等计算方法，研究政治极端主义、健康与科学虚假信息，以及网络文本和视觉内容中的框架。

name: Holley Wilkin
title: Associate Professor
summary: Conducts community-engaged health communication research in urban Atlanta and Los Angeles, studying storytelling networks, healthcare access, health media content, and entertainment-education.
summary_zh: 在亚特兰大和洛杉矶城市社区开展社区参与式健康传播研究，关注健康故事讲述网络、医疗可及性、媒体健康内容及娱乐教育。

name: Carol Winkler
title: Professor; Lead Faculty TCV, Editorial Board member, Arab Media & Society journal
summary: Studies communication and conflict through rhetorical analysis of presidential foreign policy rhetoric, argumentation, visual images, and online extremist propaganda.
summary_zh: 通过修辞分析研究传播与冲突，关注总统外交政策修辞、论证、视觉图像以及网络极端主义宣传。

name: Shay Yao
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies users' experiences with video games, social media, virtual reality, and AI and these technologies' potential to promote health and well-being, with interests in gender and quantitative and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究用户对电子游戏、社交媒体、虚拟现实和人工智能的使用体验，以及这些技术促进健康与福祉的潜力，并关注性别议题，擅长定量与混合方法。

name: Kellie Brisini
title: Associate Professor / Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how communication and cognition in marriages and families help partners and parents navigate difficult transitions such as health crises, focusing on social support and conflict.
summary_zh: 研究婚姻与家庭中的沟通和认知如何帮助伴侣与父母应对健康危机等困难转变，聚焦社会支持与冲突。

name: Travis Brisini
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies performance theory and posthuman, multispecies relations between humans and the material world through autoethnographic, performative writing and creative performance.
summary_zh: 通过自我民族志、表演性写作与创作性表演，研究表演理论以及人类与物质世界之间的后人类、多物种关系。

name: Renee Edwards
title: Professor
areas: Message Interpretation and Misunderstanding in Interpersonal Communication
summary: Studies how message and individual factors shape interpretation and misunderstanding in interpersonal communication, and how people communicate about risk from extreme weather and climate events.
summary_zh: 研究讯息与个体因素如何影响人际传播中的讯息解读与误解，以及人们如何就极端天气和气候事件的风险进行沟通与决策。

name: Stephanie Houston Grey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes the rhetoric of science, environmentalism, and food politics and the cultural traumas of consumption in the Anthropocene through rhetorical, discourse, and cultural studies lenses.
summary_zh: 以修辞、话语理论与文化研究视角，分析科学修辞、环境主义与食物政治，以及人类世消费文化中的社会创伤与抵抗。

name: Yuwei Li
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the dynamics of personal relationships by modeling fluctuations in cognition, physiology, and verbal behavior during conflict and supportive conversations with advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用高级量化方法，建模冲突与支持性对话中认知、生理与言语行为的波动，研究亲密关系的动态过程。

name: Ashley Mack
title: Associate Professor / Director of Forensics
summary: Examines how racial, gender, and sexual differences and disparities are communicated and naturalized in contemporary US culture using critical rhetoric, feminist critique, and queer studies.
summary_zh: 运用批判修辞、女性主义批评与酷儿研究，考察种族、性别与性向差异及不平等如何在当代美国文化中被传播并自然化。

name: Bryan J. McCann
title: Professor & Department Chair
summary: Analyzes crime and public culture, the politics of higher education, mental illness, addiction, and social movements through critical rhetorical and cultural studies of texts and archives.
summary_zh: 通过对文本与档案的批判修辞与文化研究，分析犯罪与公共文化、高等教育的文化政治、精神疾病、成瘾与社会运动。

name: Nichole Bauer
title: Associate Professor of Political Communication in the Department of Political Science & the Manship School of Mass Communication
summary: Studies gender and politics, examining how strategic political communication shapes the impressions voters form of women candidates and politicians.
summary_zh: 研究性别与政治，考察战略性政治传播如何影响选民对女性候选人和政治人物的印象形成。

name: Kim Bissell
title: Dean, Manship School of Mass Communication
summary: Studies the social effects of media on health outcomes, including children's food intake tracked through a mobile app, and conducts research on sports communication.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对健康结果的社会影响（包括通过移动应用追踪儿童饮食），并开展体育传播研究。

name: Jinx C. Broussard
title: Professor, Public Relations; Bart R. Swanson Endowed Memorial Professor
summary: Studies public relations and media history, with a long record of historical scholarship on strategic communication and the press.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与媒介史，长期从事战略传播与新闻媒体的历史研究。

name: Catherine Chen
title: Assistant Professor, Political Communication
summary: Studies the antecedents, structure, and consequences of Americans' political attitudes, especially perceptions of science and technology, using survey, experimental, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验与计算方法，研究美国民众政治态度的成因、结构与后果，尤其是对科学与技术的认知。

name: Josh Grimm
title: Professor, Political Communication
summary: Studies how race, gender, and sexuality are portrayed in media and how gay men talk about PrEP, partnering with local clinics to improve HIV-prevention health messaging.
summary_zh: 研究媒介中种族、性别与性向的呈现，以及男同性恋者如何谈论PrEP，并与当地诊所合作改进艾滋病预防健康讯息策略。

name: John Maxwell Hamilton
title: Boyd Professor, Hopkins P. Breazeale Professor of Journalism
summary: Studies journalism history and foreign correspondence, drawing on historical research and long experience as a reporter and public servant to examine how news covers the world.
summary_zh: 结合历史研究与长期记者、公职经验，研究新闻史与驻外报道，考察新闻如何报道世界。

name: Tina M. Harris
title: Professor, Douglas L. Manship Sr.-Dori Maynard Media and Cultural Literacy Endowed Chair, Political Comm.
summary: Studies interracial communication, race and media representations, and racial social justice, with an applied, pedagogy-driven approach.
summary_zh: 以应用与教学导向的方法，研究跨种族传播、种族与媒介再现以及种族社会正义。

name: Michael Henderson
title: Associate Professor, Area Head- Political Communication
summary: Studies how information shapes what US citizens learn about public affairs and how they use it in elections and policy opinions, using poll and panel survey designs.
summary_zh: 运用民调与追踪面板调查设计，研究信息如何影响美国公民对公共事务的认知，以及他们如何在选举与政策意见中运用这些知识。

name: Joshua R. Jackson
title: Assistant Professor, Sports Communication
summary: Studies how sports and social media shape individual and group identity, including media depictions of Black athletes, using both qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与量化方法，研究体育与社交媒体如何塑造个体与群体身份，包括媒体对黑人运动员的呈现。

name: Yongick Jeong
title: Professor, Area Head-Digital Advertising
summary: Studies advertising effectiveness and new media, including racial representation in Super Bowl ads, health and environmental warning labels, and consumer smart-device privacy concerns.
summary_zh: 研究广告效果与新媒体，包括超级碗广告中的种族再现、健康与环境警示标签，以及消费者对智能设备隐私的担忧。

name: Soojin Kim
title: Associate Professor; Darlene and Thomas O. Ryder Professor
summary: Studies visual communication and visual persuasion in advertising, examining the cognitive and affective consumer mechanisms that drive engagement with ads and brands.
summary_zh: 研究广告中的视觉传播与视觉说服，考察驱动消费者与广告及品牌互动的认知与情感机制。

name: Jeonghyun Janice Lee
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Leadership in organizational and corporate communication
summary: Studies leadership in organizational and corporate communication and how AI shapes strategic communication and misinformation, using computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用计算方法，研究组织与企业传播中的领导力，以及人工智能如何影响战略传播与虚假信息。

name: Hyojung Park
title: Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies corporate social responsibility, branding, relationship management, and risk, crisis, and health communication, including network and experimental studies of social media CSR messaging.
summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任、品牌建设、关系管理以及风险、危机与健康传播，包括对社交媒体CSR讯息的网络分析与实验研究。

name: Rachel Peng
title: Assistant Professor, Digital Advertising
summary: Studies digital advertising strategies and health decision-making, analyzing social media health campaigns and online health information with social network analysis and text mining.
summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与文本挖掘，研究数字广告策略与健康决策，分析社交媒体健康运动与网络健康信息。

name: Ray Pingree
title: Professor; Doris Westmoreland Darden Professor
summary: Uses experiments to study dysfunctions in news and political discussion, such as game framing and weak accountability for dishonesty, and how media or media literacy could improve them.
summary_zh: 通过实验研究新闻与政治讨论中的失灵现象（如赛马式框架、对不诚实问责不足），以及媒体或媒介素养如何加以改善。

name: Fanny Ramirez
title: Assistant Professor in Media Law
summary: Studies the use of information and communication technologies in the criminal justice system, such as social media evidence and body cameras, focusing on discrimination, privacy, and surveillance.
summary_zh: 研究信息传播技术在刑事司法系统中的使用（如社交媒体证据与警察执法记录仪），关注歧视、隐私与监控问题。

name: Meghan Sanders
title: Associate Dean, Research and Graduate Studies; Professor; Katheryn Pate Callahan Professor
summary: Studies the psychological effects of entertainment media on well-being, including enjoyment and appreciation, morality and narrative engagement, and positive media psychology.
summary_zh: 研究娱乐媒介对心理与主观幸福感的影响，包括享乐与欣赏、道德与叙事卷入以及积极媒介心理学。

name: Nihar Sreepada
title: Assistant Professor, Public Relations
summary: Studies how identity is constructed through digital media and artificial intelligence, focusing on AI literacy, misinformation, and AI in political and health communication.
summary_zh: 研究身份如何通过数字媒体与人工智能被建构，聚焦AI素养、虚假信息以及AI在政治与健康传播中的作用。

name: Ting-Hao Tsou
title: Assistant Professor, Digital Advertising
summary: Studies how augmented reality, virtual reality, and artificial intelligence shape how audiences process and respond to persuasive advertising and health messages.
summary_zh: 研究增强现实、虚拟现实与人工智能如何影响受众对说服性广告与健康讯息的处理和反应。

name: Ryan Wang
title: Assistant Professor, Political Communication
summary: Studies how digital infrastructure shapes US political behavior and how social media drive public opinion formation, combining computational methods with social media data.
summary_zh: 结合计算方法与社交媒体数据，研究数字基础设施如何影响美国政治行为，以及社交媒体如何推动舆论的形成与传播。

name: Asha S. Winfield
title: Assistant Professor, Political Communication
summary: Explores the narratives, rituals, and practices of Black communities in media and culture, linking reception, memory-making, and health through documentary and arts-based qualitative research.
summary_zh: 通过纪录片与艺术本位的质性研究，探讨黑人社群在媒介与文化中的叙事、仪式与实践，连接受众接收、记忆建构与健康行为。

name: Chun Yang
title: Associate Professor, Public Relations, Director of MEL
summary: Studies the psychological mechanisms underlying communication processes and their effects on attitudes and behavior, particularly in health, science, and risk communication.
summary_zh: 研究传播过程背后的心理机制及其对态度与行为的影响，尤其关注健康、科学与风险传播。

name: J Kevin Barge
title: Associate Dean of Faculty Affairs; Professor of Communication and Journalism
summary: Develops social constructionist theory of leadership, appreciative practice in organizational change, and dialogue practices that help communities deliberate polarizing issues.
summary_zh: 发展领导力的社会建构论视角，研究欣赏式实践与组织变革，以及帮助社区就两极化议题开展对话与协商的实践。

name: Isaac Blacksin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how war journalism and media representation sanction violence, drawing on ethnographic fieldwork with conflict reporters and critical media theory.
summary_zh: 结合对冲突地区记者的民族志田野与批判媒介理论，研究战争新闻与媒介再现如何为暴力提供正当性。

name: Hart Blanton
title: Department Head; Professor
summary: Studies how messages shape health, prejudice, and well-being, using social-psychological experiments, psychological measurement, and immersive virtual reality health messaging.
summary_zh: 运用社会心理学实验、心理测量和沉浸式虚拟现实健康信息，研究传播信息如何影响健康、偏见与幸福感。

name: Heidi A Campbell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how Jewish, Muslim, and Christian communities negotiate digital and mobile media, applying a social shaping of technology approach to digital religion.
summary_zh: 运用技术的社会形塑视角，研究犹太教、伊斯兰教与基督教群体如何协商使用数字与移动媒体，即数字宗教研究。

name: Nathan Crick
title: Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, power, and democratic practice across historical moments, using pragmatist and continental philosophy to analyze propaganda, social movements, and climate rhetoric.
summary_zh: 借助实用主义与欧陆哲学，研究不同历史时期中修辞、权力与民主实践的关系，分析宣传、社会运动与气候修辞。

name: Leroy G Dorsey
title: Senior Associate Dean for Faculty Affairs; The Bush School of Government & Public Service
summary: Analyzes how US presidents from Theodore Roosevelt to Obama use myth and symbolic rhetoric to construct American identity and advance policy agendas.
summary_zh: 分析从西奥多·罗斯福到奥巴马的美国总统如何运用神话叙事与象征修辞建构美国身份并推动政策议程。

name: Tasha N Dubriwny
title: Associate Head for Graduate Studies; Associate Professor
summary: Critiques popular and news discourse on women's health, motherhood, and first ladies through feminist rhetorical analysis at the intersection of health and politics.
summary_zh: 以女性主义修辞分析批判有关女性健康、母职与第一夫人的大众及新闻话语，关注健康与政治的交叉。

name: Kareem El Damanhoury
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual political messaging, wartime and terrorist media strategies, and state digital journalism as soft power, with a focus on Middle Eastern media.
summary_zh: 研究视觉政治信息、战时与恐怖组织的媒介策略，以及国家以数字新闻作为软实力的做法，聚焦中东媒介。

name: Jason Gong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies media selection and information diffusion through communication networks using computational modeling.
summary_zh: 运用计算建模研究媒介选择以及信息在传播网络中的扩散。

name: Bryce Henson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Black life, hip-hop, and African diaspora cultural politics in Brazil through critical ethnography and cultural studies.
summary_zh: 以批判民族志与文化研究方法，研究巴西的黑人生活、嘻哈文化与非洲离散群体的文化政治。

name: Mark Hlavacik
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies education controversies and culture wars, and teaching through controversial issue discussions, using historical, rhetorical, and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用历史、修辞与质性方法，研究教育争议与文化战争，以及以争议议题讨论为方法的课堂教学。

name: Antonio C La Pastina
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how a rural Northeast Brazilian community engages media and new technologies through long-term ethnography, plus textual analysis of media representations of minorities.
summary_zh: 通过长期民族志研究巴西东北部乡村社区如何使用媒介与新技术，并对媒介中少数群体的再现进行文本分析。

name: Will Mari
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the media history of newsroom technology and the analog-to-digital transition in US journalism, along with comparative newsroom history and the First Amendment.
summary_zh: 研究美国新闻业从模拟到数字转型中的新闻编辑室技术媒介史，以及比较新闻编辑室史与第一修正案。

name: Jennifer Mercieca
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history of American political rhetoric, including citizenship, presidential heroism, demagoguery, and propaganda, through historically informed rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 以历史化的修辞批评研究美国政治修辞史，涵盖公民身份、总统英雄化、煽动政治与宣传。

name: Ruth Moon
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalists' production practices and professional identities under extreme power imbalances, notably authoritarian journalism in post-conflict Rwanda.
summary_zh: 研究极端权力失衡情境下记者的新闻生产实践与职业身份，尤其是冲突后卢旺达的威权新闻业。

name: Mariela Morales
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies transnational media flows and platformized popular culture in Latin American and Caribbean diasporas, especially Cuban digital comedy, using qualitative and humanistic methods.
summary_zh: 运用质性与人文方法，研究拉美与加勒比及其离散群体中的跨国媒介流动与平台化流行文化，尤其是古巴数字喜剧。

name: Kristan Poirot
title: Executive Associate Head; Associate Professor
summary: Examines the rhetorical circulation of sex, gender, and race in US social movement rhetoric and public memory of resistance through feminist rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 以女性主义修辞批评考察美国社会运动修辞与抵抗的公共记忆中性、性别与种族认同的流通。

name: Richard L. Street Jr
title: Professor
summary: Studies clinician-patient communication, the pathways linking communication to health outcomes, and strategies to increase patient involvement in care.
summary_zh: 研究医患沟通、传播影响健康结果的路径，以及提高患者参与医疗决策的策略。

name: George Allen O Villanueva
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how communities of color use communication, organizing, media, and expressive culture for place-based advocacy and social change in cities, via engaged critical research.
summary_zh: 以参与式批判研究，探讨城市有色人种社区如何运用传播、组织、媒介与表达文化开展在地倡导与社会变革。

name: Darrel Wanzer-Serrano
title: Director of Race and Ethnic Studies Institute; Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, race, and Latinx social movements, crafting critical rhetorical histories such as of the New York Young Lords to build decolonial theory.
summary_zh: 研究修辞、种族与拉丁裔社会运动，撰写批判修辞史（如纽约青年领主党）以建构去殖民理论。

name: Anna Wiederhold Wolfe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how collective and stigmatized identities are constituted and contested in organizations and communities, and how dialogue bridges divides, through community-engaged research.
summary_zh: 通过与社区合作的参与式研究，探讨集体与污名化身份如何在组织和社区中建构与争夺，以及对话如何弥合分歧。

name: Yiping Xia
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies everyday news engagement, digital journalistic norms, and disinformation among diasporic and marginalized audiences using qualitative, interpretive fieldwork.
summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释性田野研究，探讨离散及边缘群体的日常新闻参与、数字时代新闻规范与虚假信息。

name: Meenakshi Yadav
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the communicative, affective, and organizational dimensions of social movements, theorizing caste as a system of power in labor, hierarchy, and stigma.
summary_zh: 研究社会运动的传播、情感与组织维度，将种姓理论化为关乎劳动、等级与污名的权力体系。

name: Harry Yan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the multilevel complexity of media effects on social and cognitive phenomena, with attention to misinformation and social inequity.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对社会与认知现象影响的多层次复杂性，关注虚假信息与社会不平等。

name: Yunkang Yang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how right-wing media, political actors, and online networks shape US political information and disinformation, using quantitative and computational analysis of large datasets.
summary_zh: 运用大规模数据的定量与计算分析，研究右翼媒体、政治行动者与网络如何塑造美国政治信息与虚假信息。

name: Bo Yang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how message features, audience traits, emotions, and social norms shape health persuasion and risk perceptions around tobacco, alcohol, and infectious disease.
summary_zh: 研究信息特征、受众特质、情绪与社会规范如何影响烟草、酒精与传染病等健康议题中的说服与风险感知。

name: Greg Bryant
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies vocal communication, laughter, and music from an evolutionary perspective using acoustic analysis, perception and psychophysiology experiments, and cross-cultural field studies.
summary_zh: 从进化视角研究声音传播、笑声与音乐，采用声学分析、知觉与心理生理实验以及跨文化田野研究。

name: Rick Dale
title: Professor and Mark Allen Itkin Centennial Chair in Communication
summary: Studies the dynamics of conversation and interpersonal coordination, from eye movements to vocal rhythm and body language, via computational modeling, naturalistic behavior analysis, and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究对话与人际协调的动态过程（从眼动到语音节奏与肢体语言），采用计算建模、自然行为分析与实验方法。

name: Rachit Dubey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychological roots of climate inaction and human motivation using computational modeling, machine learning, and experimental psychology to inform climate policy.
summary_zh: 运用计算建模、机器学习与实验心理学研究气候不作为与人类动机的心理根源，以服务气候政策。

name: Tao Gao
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies human social perception and intention recognition through cognitive modeling and psychophysical experiments to build communicative, trustworthy AI and robots.
summary_zh: 通过认知建模与心理物理实验研究人类社会知觉与意图识别，以构建善于沟通且值得信赖的人工智能与机器人。

name: Tim Groeling
title: Professor
summary: Examines how journalistic norms of newsworthiness shape coverage of party conflict and presidential communication, and how the resulting party messages affect US public opinion.
summary_zh: 考察新闻价值规范如何塑造对政党内部冲突与总统传播的报道，以及由此产生的政党信息如何影响美国舆论。

name: Martie Haselton
title: Professor
summary: Studies how evolution shapes the social mind, testing whether women's fertility cycles shift mating psychology and produce detectable cues, using photographs, vocal recordings, and body odor samples rated by others.
summary_zh: 研究进化如何塑造社会心智，检验女性生育周期是否改变择偶心理并产生可被察觉的线索，使用照片、声音录音和体味样本并由他人评分。

name: Homa Hosseinmardi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how recommendation algorithms shape exposure to content such as radical YouTube videos, using large-scale behavioral data, counterfactual bots, and causal inference.
summary_zh: 研究推荐算法如何影响用户对YouTube激进内容等信息的接触，采用大规模行为数据、反事实机器人与因果推断方法。

name: Kerri Johnson
title: Professor and Associate Vice Chancellor for Faculty Development
summary: Studies nonverbal visual communication and social categorization, pinpointing face and body cues with eye-tracking, 3D motion analysis, psychophysics, psychophysiology, and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究非语言视觉传播与社会分类，借助眼动追踪、三维动作分析、心理物理学、心理生理学与实验精确识别面部和身体线索。

name: Georgia Kernell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how party organizations shape candidate strategies, representation, and electoral competition across democracies via formal theory, experiments, statistics, interviews, and coded party rules.
summary_zh: 研究政党组织如何影响各民主国家的候选人策略、代表性与选举竞争，采用形式理论、实验、统计、访谈及政党章程编码。

name: Elisa Kreiss
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communicative context shapes language use, combining natural language processing, psycholinguistics, and HCI to generate image descriptions for blind and low-vision users.
summary_zh: 研究传播情境如何塑造语言使用，结合自然语言处理、心理语言学与人机交互，为盲人及低视力用户生成图像描述。

name: PJ Lamberson
title: Associate Professor and Vice Chair
summary: Uses mathematical and computational modeling to study how ideas, technologies, and behaviors spread through social networks and how the wisdom of crowds aggregates information.
summary_zh: 运用数学与计算建模研究观念、技术与行为如何在社会网络中扩散，以及群体智慧如何聚合信息。

name: Stuart Soroka
title: Professor
summary: Studies negativity in news coverage, how media inform publics about policy, and media effects on policy attitudes using surveys, automated content analysis, and psychophysiological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究新闻报道中的负面性、媒体如何向公众传递政策信息及其对政策态度的影响，采用调查、自动内容分析与心理生理实验。

name: Steve Stroessner
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social categories and stereotypes shape how people think about humans and non-humans, including basic shapes, voices, and robots.
summary_zh: 研究社会类别与刻板印象如何影响人们对人类及非人类对象（包括基本图形、声音与机器人）的认知。

name: Anne Warlaumont
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infant vocalizations and speech emerge in typical and atypical development and how human vocal signals evolved, using computational modeling and naturalistic audio recordings.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿发声与言语如何在典型及非典型发展中出现、人类声音信号如何进化，采用计算建模与自然情境录音。

name: Steve F. Anderson
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Professor
summary: Examines the history and culture of visual and digital media, from documentary and experimental history in film, TV, and games to data visualization and surveillance, as a scholar-practitioner.
summary_zh: 作为学者兼实践者，考察视觉与数字媒介的历史和文化，涵盖纪录片、影视与游戏中的实验性历史，以及数据可视化与监控。

name: Shelleen Greene
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Associate Professor
areas: Race and national identity in cinema
summary: Examines how Italian cinema represents mixed-race Italian and African subjects and shifting ideas of race and nation, alongside Black European and digital feminist studies.
summary_zh: 考察意大利电影如何再现意大利与非洲混血主体及种族与民族观念的变迁，并涉及欧洲黑人研究与数字女性主义研究。

name: Denise R. Mann
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Professor
areas: Film and television history and theory
summary: Studies contemporary entertainment industry practices, Hollywood independents and media labor, and film and television history through production studies and feminist film theory.
summary_zh: 通过制作研究与女性主义电影理论，研究当代娱乐产业实践、好莱坞独立制片与媒体劳动以及影视历史。

name: Sean Metzger
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Professor
summary: Examines how race, gender, and globalization interweave through visual culture, fashion, film, and performance across Asian American, Chinese, and Caribbean contexts.
summary_zh: 考察种族、性别与全球化如何通过视觉文化、时尚、电影与表演交织于亚裔美国、中国与加勒比语境之中。

name: Chon A. Noriega
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Distinguished Professor
areas: Aesthetic, social and institutional histories of media
summary: Studies Chicano/Latino arts and media through their aesthetic, social, and institutional histories, combining archival work, exhibition curation, and advocacy for media access.
summary_zh: 从美学、社会与制度史角度研究奇卡诺/拉丁裔艺术与媒体，结合档案整理、展览策划与媒体准入倡导。

name: Veronica Paredes
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Vintage movie theaters and screen landmarks
summary: Studies media histories, Latinx studies, and Los Angeles movie palaces and screen landmarks through feminist historiography and media-based organizing.
summary_zh: 通过女性主义史学与基于媒体的社群组织，研究媒介史、拉丁裔研究以及洛杉矶的老电影院与银幕地标。

name: Kriss Ravetto-Biagioli
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Professor
areas: Representations of violence, sexuality and trauma
summary: Examines European and Eastern European cinema, nationalism, violence, and trauma, as well as digital technologies, surveillance, and affect, through critical film and media theory.
summary_zh: 以批判性电影与媒介理论考察欧洲及东欧电影、民族主义、暴力与创伤，以及数字技术、监控与情动。

name: Ellen C. Scott
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies film in African-American communities, Classical Hollywood censorship, and media's role in struggles for racial justice through historical and critical analysis.
summary_zh: 通过历史与批判性分析，研究非裔美国人社群中的电影、古典好莱坞审查制度以及媒体在种族正义斗争中的作用。

name: Jasmine Nadua Trice
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies film aesthetics, industries, circulation, and audiences, especially Southeast Asian cinema and Manila's alternative film culture, through cultural studies and theories of space.
summary_zh: 借助文化研究与空间理论，研究电影美学、产业、流通与观众，尤其关注东南亚电影与马尼拉的另类电影文化。

name: Amy Villarejo
dept: Department of Film, Television and Digital Media (Cinema and Media Studies program)
title: Professor
summary: Studies television history, queer and feminist media, and global and Third Cinema through critical theory and cultural criticism.
summary_zh: 以批判理论与文化批评研究电视史、酷儿与女性主义媒体以及全球电影与第三电影。

name: James Angelini
title: Interim Chair of Communication, Professor
summary: Studies cognitive, emotional, and physiological responses to televised sports and advertising, plus content analysis of sports commentary and food ads aimed at youth.
summary_zh: 研究观众观看电视体育与广告时的认知、情绪和生理反应，并对体育解说及面向青少年的食品广告进行内容分析。

name: Amy Bleakley
title: Professor
summary: Studies media effects on adolescent health behaviors and develops and evaluates theory-based health messages for youth.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对青少年健康行为的影响，并开发和评估基于理论的青少年健康信息。

name: Paul Brewer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how news, entertainment, and social media messages shape public opinion on policy issues, including gay rights, and public perceptions of science.
summary_zh: 研究新闻、娱乐和社交媒体信息如何塑造公众对政策议题（包括同性恋权利）的舆论以及公众对科学的认知。

name: Scott Caplan
title: Professor
summary: Studies problematic internet use and online interpersonal behavior, building a cognitive-behavioral model and the GPIUS2 measurement scale.
summary_zh: 研究问题性网络使用与线上人际行为，构建认知行为模型并开发GPIUS2测量量表。

name: John P. Crowley
title: Professor
summary: Studies how interpersonal communication such as social support, disclosure, and forgiveness helps people cope with discrimination, using biosocial and physiological methods.
summary_zh: 运用生物社会与生理测量方法，研究社会支持、自我披露和宽恕等人际传播如何帮助人们应对歧视与伤害性沟通。

name: Morgan Ellithorpe
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media psychology and how people strategically use media, including social media and AI chatbots, for mental and physical well-being, plus enjoyment of characters.
summary_zh: 研究媒介心理学，关注人们如何策略性地使用媒介（含社交媒体和AI聊天机器人）促进身心健康，以及对媒介角色的喜爱与投入。

name: Andrew Gambino
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human relationships with media, media agents, and machines, including AI, immersive media, and privacy, drawing on embodied cognition and computational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究人与媒介、媒介代理及机器（含人工智能、沉浸式媒介与隐私）的关系，借鉴具身认知理论和计算方法。

name: Lindsay Hoffman
title: Professor, Director, Public Engagement, Center for Political Communication
summary: Studies political communication, civic engagement, polarization, incivility, and generative AI in politics using surveys, experiments, and content analysis.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验和内容分析，研究政治传播、公民参与、极化、网络不文明及生成式AI对政治的影响。

name: Tracey Quigley Holden
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric and public address of the American military and military dissent, along with organizational and political communication, social movements, and leadership.
summary_zh: 研究美国军队与军中异议的修辞和公共演说，以及组织与政治传播、社会运动和领导力。

name: Jennifer Lambe
title: Associate Chair, Associate Professor
summary: Studies freedom of expression, media ethics, and media accountability, examining public opinion on censorship, hate speech, and net neutrality and measuring willingness to censor.
summary_zh: 研究言论自由、媒介伦理与媒介问责，考察公众对审查、仇恨言论和网络中立的态度，并改进审查意愿的测量。

name: Steven Mortenson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how culture shapes the ways people communicate about and cope with difficult emotions, focusing on emotional support in interpersonal relationships.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何影响人们沟通和应对负面情绪，聚焦人际关系中的情感支持。

name: Emily Pfender
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies misinformation about women's health on social media, including contraception, cycle syncing, pregnancy, preeclampsia, and menopause, and its effects on health beliefs.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上关于女性健康（避孕、周期同步、妊娠、子痫前期、更年期）的虚假信息及其对健康信念的影响。

name: Kami Silk
title: Vice Provost and Dean for the Graduate College, Rosenberg Professor of Communication
summary: Studies effective health messaging for lay publics on breast cancer and environmental risk, suicide prevention, social norms, and nutrition among adolescent mothers.
summary_zh: 研究面向普通公众的有效健康信息传播，涉及乳腺癌与环境风险、自杀预防、社会规范及青少年母亲营养。

name: Xi Tian
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies supportive communication that fosters psychological and physical health after major stressors such as pregnancy loss and bereavement.
summary_zh: 研究在妊娠丢失、丧亲等重大生活压力事件后，支持性沟通如何促进心理和身体健康。

name: Lydia Timmins
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Academic Success
summary: Studies local television news and its impact on audiences, news media ethics, digital convergence, and telepresence.
summary_zh: 研究地方电视新闻及其对受众的影响、新闻媒介伦理、数字融合与远程临场感。

name: Dan Totzkay
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategic health message design and persuasion, using communication theory to understand health decisions and equip health professionals and community champions.
summary_zh: 研究战略性健康信息设计与说服，运用传播理论理解人们的健康决策，并助力医疗专业人员和社区倡导者有效沟通。

name: Dannagal G. Young
title: Professor, Director of Center for Political Communication
summary: Studies political media effects, public opinion, and the psychology of political satire, humor, irony, and outrage.
summary_zh: 研究政治媒介效果、舆论，以及政治讽刺、幽默、反讽与愤怒情绪背后的心理机制。

name: Seyram Avle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how digital technologies are made and used in Africa, China, and the US, examining tech entrepreneurship and labor through ethnography and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 通过民族志与话语分析，研究非洲、中国与美国的数字技术如何被生产和使用，关注科技创业与劳动问题。

name: Soo Young Bae
title: Associate Professor
areas: social and political impact of new communication technologies
user interaction and information flow in social media platforms
news and information flow in social relationships
summary: Studies the social and political impact of new communication technologies, focusing on user interaction and how news flows through social relationships on social media.
summary_zh: 研究新传播技术的社会与政治影响，关注社交媒体上的用户互动以及新闻如何经由社会关系流动并影响态度与行为。

name: Benjamin Bailey
title: Professor
areas: negotiation of meaning and identity in face-to-face interaction
summary: Studies language, race, and ethnic identity in face-to-face interaction, including code switching, naming practices, and street remarks, using discourse analysis of recorded talk.
summary_zh: 通过对录音谈话的话语分析，研究面对面互动中的语言、种族与族裔身份，包括语码转换、命名实践与街头言语。

name: Burcu Baykurt
title: Associate Professor
areas: automated decision systems in public agencies
summary: Studies technologies of statecraft such as smart cities, gov-tech, and automated decision systems in public agencies through ethnographic research on officials and tech firms.
summary_zh: 通过对政府官员与科技公司的民族志研究，考察智慧城市、政府科技与公共机构自动化决策系统等国家治理技术。

name: Mari Castañeda
title: Professor & Dean, Commonwealth Honors College
summary: Studies Latinx and ethnic media, global communication industries, and community-based civic engagement, with an engaged-scholarship focus on inequality and power.
summary_zh: 以参与式学术取向研究拉丁裔与少数族裔媒体、全球传播产业以及社区为本的公民参与，关注不平等与权力。

name: Briankle Chang
title: Professor
summary: Develops philosophy of communication and media theory, critically examining how cultural studies discourses reflect ideology and academic markets.
summary_zh: 从事传播哲学与媒介理论研究，批判性地考察文化研究话语如何反映意识形态与学术市场。

name: Anne Ciecko
title: Associate Professor | Core faculty member in the Interdepartmental Program in Film Studies and Coordinator of the Graduate Certificate in Film Studies.
areas: Cinemas of the Global South (Arab, Asian, and African cinema)
Afropop and Arabpop music and film
intercultural film/video and multimedia installations by women
summary: Studies international and Global South cinemas, especially Arab, Asian, and African film, along with film festivals, co-productions, stardom, and diasporic audiences.
summary_zh: 研究国际电影与全球南方电影（尤其是阿拉伯、亚洲与非洲电影），以及电影节、合拍片、明星现象与离散受众。

name: Gonen Dori-Hacohen
title: Professor
areas: Israeli and American culture and politics
summary: Studies everyday, media, and online interaction in Israeli and American culture and politics using conversation analysis, discourse pragmatics, and qualitative textual analysis.
summary_zh: 运用会话分析、话语语用学与质性文本分析，研究以色列与美国文化政治中的日常、媒体与网络互动。

name: Ayanna Dozier
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Researches alternative histories of experimental film and expanded cinema by Black feminist media-makers, combining historical criticism with artistic film practice.
summary_zh: 研究黑人女性主义媒体创作者的实验电影与扩展电影的另类历史，将历史批评与电影艺术实践相结合。

name: Stephen Olbrys Gencarella
title: Professor
summary: Studies folklore, rhetoric, and performance as expressive culture, using rhetorical criticism and critical genealogy to examine New England legends and heritage tourism.
summary_zh: 研究作为表达文化的民俗、修辞与表演，运用修辞批评与批判谱系学考察新英格兰传说与文化遗产旅游。

name: Seth K. Goldman
title: Honors Associate Professor | Department of Communication Commonwealth Honors College
areas: effects of mass media and political communication
public opinion about race, gender and sexuality
summary: Studies how mass media and political communication shape stereotyping, prejudice, and public opinion about race, gender, and sexuality, including experimental work funded by TESS.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒体和政治传播如何影响刻板印象、偏见以及有关种族、性别与性向的舆论，包括获TESS资助的实验研究。

name: Claudio Moreira
title: Professor
summary: Writes performance autoethnographies on race, gender, and class that critique and decolonize knowledge production and the exclusion of bodies in academic spaces.
summary_zh: 以表演自我民族志书写种族、性别与阶级，批判并去殖民化知识生产以及学术空间对身体的排斥。

name: Roopali Mukherjee
title: Professor
areas: race and racialization in media cultures
summary: Studies race and racialization in media cultures, using critical race theory and cultural studies to analyze brand culture, commodity activism, and post-racialism.
summary_zh: 运用批判种族理论与文化研究，考察媒介文化中的种族与种族化，分析品牌文化、商品行动主义与后种族主义。

name: Jonathan Corpus Ong
title: Professor of Global Digital Media | Director, GloTechLab.net
summary: Studies disinformation, digital humanitarianism, and tech justice in the Global Majority, using ethnographic and participatory methods with paid trolls and PR strategists.
summary_zh: 运用民族志与参与式方法研究全球多数世界中的虚假信息、数字人道主义与科技正义，访谈网络水军与政治公关策划者。

name: Kimberlee Pérez
title: Associate Professor, Undergraduate Program Director | Co-Editor Elect, Text & Performance Quarterly
areas: race, gender, sexuality, class, and nation
summary: Studies narrative performance as a site of identity, relationality, and queer intimacy across race, gender, sexuality, class, and nation through performance scholarship.
summary_zh: 通过表演研究，考察叙事表演作为身份、关系性与酷儿亲密关系的场域，涉及种族、性别、性向、阶级与民族。

name: Erica Scharrer
title: Professor
areas: media in the lives of children and adolescents
summary: Studies media as agents of socialization around gender and aggression, and adolescents' responses to media literacy education on ads, influencers, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究媒体在性别与攻击性方面的社会化作用，以及青少年对涉及广告、网红与AI的媒介素养教育的反应。

name: Shawn Shimpach
title: Professor
areas: cultural history of film, television, and media
social and institutional constructions of the media audience
summary: Studies the cultural history of film and television, screen genres, and screen industries, combining industry analysis with close reading and audience construction.
summary_zh: 研究电影与电视的文化史、银幕类型与银幕产业，将产业分析与文本细读及受众建构研究相结合。

name: Alena L. Vasilyeva
title: Associate Professor
areas: coordination of actions in personal and public contexts
summary: Studies how deliberation, argument, and identity are constructed through language and interaction, especially in dispute mediation and conflict management.
summary_zh: 研究审议、论证与身份如何通过语言与互动建构，尤其关注纠纷调解与冲突管理情境。

name: Emily E. West
title: Professor
summary: Studies promotional culture, branding, and platforms in the digital economy, including how Amazon normalized monopoly, through critical cultural and audience analysis.
summary_zh: 通过批判文化与受众分析，研究数字经济中的促销文化、品牌与平台，包括亚马逊如何使垄断常态化。

name: Anjuliet G. Woodruffe
title: Assistant Professor, Critical Performance Studies
summary: Studies Black feminist performance, Black transnational identity, and migration through autoethnography, poetry, and storytelling, exploring belonging and affective citizenship.
summary_zh: 运用自我民族志、诗歌与叙事方法研究黑人女性主义表演、黑人跨国身份与迁移，探讨归属感与情感公民身份。

name: Weiai (Wayne) Xu
title: Associate Professor | Affiliated Faculty at Computational Social
summary: Studies online political communities and coordinated behavior using computational and network methods, and develops agentic social science with AI agents as collaborators.
summary_zh: 运用计算与网络分析方法研究网络政治社群与协同行为，并发展以AI智能体为合作者的智能体社会科学。

name: Ethan Zuckerman
title: Associate Professor, School of Public Policy, Department of Communication, & College of Information and Computer Sciences
summary: Studies civic media, digital public infrastructure, and how activists and citizens use new media for social change, free expression, and global connection.
summary_zh: 研究公民媒体、数字公共基础设施，以及活动人士和公民如何利用新媒体推动社会变革、言论自由与全球连接。

name: Anthony Allegro
title: Professor
summary: Makes biographical, experimental, and animated documentary films on artistic and historical figures such as Chopin, Cicero, and García Lorca.
summary_zh: 创作关于肖邦、西塞罗、洛尔卡等艺术与历史人物的传记性、实验性及动画纪录片。

name: Grace Barnes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Produces independent documentaries on human rights and journalism in Latin America, including stories of a Guatemalan torture survivor and a Chilean journalist.
summary_zh: 制作关于拉丁美洲人权与新闻业的独立纪录片，包括危地马拉酷刑幸存者与智利记者的故事。

name: Sanjeev Chatterjee
title: Professor
summary: Uses documentary media making and visual storytelling to address sustainability, the environment, and the Indian diaspora.
summary_zh: 以纪录片创作和视觉叙事探讨可持续发展、环境议题与印度离散群体。

name: Terri Francis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies Black film history and aesthetics through archival research and critical analysis, including Josephine Baker's films and Jamaican nontheatrical cinema.
summary_zh: 通过档案研究与批判分析考察黑人电影史与美学，包括约瑟芬·贝克的电影和牙买加非院线电影。

name: Konstantia Kontaxis
title: Professor, Senior Associate Dean for Research and Creative Activity
summary: Produces and edits documentary and narrative films, often portraits of artists, screened at festivals and on public television.
summary_zh: 制作并剪辑纪录片与剧情片，多为艺术家人物影像，在电影节和公共电视上放映。

name: Christina Lane
title: Professor
summary: Studies feminist film history and Hollywood women producers, such as Hitchcock collaborator Joan Harrison, through archival biography and film criticism.
summary_zh: 通过档案传记与电影批评研究女性主义电影史和好莱坞女性制片人，如希区柯克的合作者琼·哈里森。

name: Alfred Martin
title: Associate Professor, Department Chair of Cinematic Arts
summary: Examines Blackness and queerness in television and comedy through media industry, audience reception, fandom, and archival studies.
summary_zh: 通过媒介产业、受众接受、粉丝与档案研究，考察电视与喜剧中的黑人性与酷儿性。

name: Rafal Sokolowski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Writes and directs award-winning narrative feature films and theater, with a focus on film directing and production.
summary_zh: 编剧并执导获奖剧情长片与戏剧作品，专注电影导演与制作。

name: John Soliday
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works in acting for the camera, directing, and stage and screen production.
summary_zh: 从事镜头表演、导演以及舞台与影视制作。

name: Ed Talavera
title: Professor
summary: Creates cinematography for narrative, documentary, and immersive 360-degree films distributed in theaters, festivals, and television.
summary_zh: 为剧情片、纪录片及沉浸式360度影片担任摄影，作品在影院、电影节和电视发行。

name: Nicholas Carcioppolo
title: Professor
summary: Designs and tests persuasive health message interventions and develops measures of risk perceptions and norms that shape health decision-making.
summary_zh: 设计并检验说服性健康信息干预，开发影响健康决策的风险感知与规范的测量工具。

name: Ronald L. Jackson II
title: Professor, Department Chair of Communication Studies
summary: Studies identity negotiation, masculinity, race, and culture in intercultural communication with a social justice orientation.
summary_zh: 以社会正义为导向，研究跨文化传播中的身份协商、男性气质、种族与文化。

name: Diane Millette
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies instructional, intercultural, and organizational communication, including communication apprehension and nonverbal communication in teaching.
summary_zh: 研究教学、跨文化与组织传播，包括教学中的传播焦虑与非语言传播。

name: Victoria Orrego
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops community-based health interventions and campaign messages to reduce health disparities, including HIV prevention among Latinos and in Guatemala and Zambia.
summary_zh: 开发社区健康干预与运动信息以减少健康不平等，包括拉丁裔群体及危地马拉、赞比亚的艾滋病预防。

name: Kallia Wright
title: Assistant Professor
areas: narratives about chronic illness experiences and the impact of culture
summary: Uses qualitative methods to study narratives of chronic illness and culture, focusing on Black maternal health and endometriosis.
summary_zh: 以质性方法研究慢性病叙事与文化影响，聚焦黑人孕产妇健康与子宫内膜异位症。

name: Ching-Hua Chuan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Builds and evaluates AI and machine learning systems for human-machine communication, human-centered AI, augmented reality, and music information retrieval.
summary_zh: 构建并评估用于人机传播、以人为本的人工智能、增强现实及音乐信息检索的AI与机器学习系统。

name: Clay Ewing
title: Associate Professor
summary: Designs serious and social impact games and gamified learning tools that address health, labor, and social justice issues with nonprofit partners.
summary_zh: 与非营利组织合作，设计关注健康、劳工与社会正义议题的严肃游戏、社会影响游戏和游戏化学习工具。

name: Lindsay Grace
title: Knight Chair, Professor
summary: Designs and studies games for social impact, including Black game studies and games about love and affection, through design practice and scholarship.
summary_zh: 通过设计实践与学术研究探讨社会影响游戏，包括黑人游戏研究以及关于爱与情感的游戏。

name: Kim Grinfeder
title: Professor, Department Chair of Interactive Media
summary: Creates and studies immersive media and extended reality experiences within human-centered computing, including climate-focused XR projects.
summary_zh: 在以人为本计算框架下创作和研究沉浸式媒介与扩展现实体验，包括气候主题XR项目。

name: Barbara Millet
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies user-centered design and mixed methods to improve risk communication products such as hurricane forecast graphics and occupational and mobile health tools.
summary_zh: 运用以用户为中心的设计与混合方法改进风险传播产品，如飓风预报图形、职业健康及移动健康工具。

name: Anna Queiroz
title: Assoc. Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and social effects of virtual reality in education and climate change awareness using lab and field studies combined with AI.
summary_zh: 结合实验室与田野研究及人工智能，考察虚拟现实在教育和气候变化认知中的认知与社会效果。

name: Michelle Seelig
title: Professor, Assoc. Dean for Graduate Studies
summary: Examines harmful narratives on social media and media advocacy for social change using ethnography, content and visual analysis, interviews, and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、内容与视觉分析、访谈和调查，考察社交媒体上的有害叙事及推动社会变革的媒介倡导。

name: Ayleen Cabas-Mijares
title: Asst. Professor
summary: Uses qualitative and critical methods to study how minoritized epistemologies and feminist movements shape journalism in Latin American and Latinx contexts.
summary_zh: 以质性与批判方法研究少数化认识论及女性主义运动如何影响拉美与拉丁裔语境中的新闻业。

name: Alberto Cairo
title: Professor, Knight Chair in Visual Journalism
summary: Studies and practices data visualization and infographics for visual journalism, including how charts mislead and the ethics of visualization design.
summary_zh: 研究并实践用于视觉新闻的数据可视化与信息图，包括图表如何误导及可视化设计伦理。

name: Michel Dupagne
title: Professor and Graduate Program Director in Media Management
summary: Studies media economics, new communication technologies such as high-definition television, and international communication and telecommunications policy.
summary_zh: 研究媒介经济学、高清电视等新传播技术，以及国际传播与电信政策。

name: Bruce Garrison
title: Professor
summary: Writes on news reporting, feature writing, computer-assisted reporting, and online news, including Latin American and sports journalism.
summary_zh: 撰写关于新闻报道、特稿写作、计算机辅助报道与网络新闻的著作，涉及拉美新闻与体育新闻。

name: Sallie Hughes
title: Professor, Department Chair of Journalism and Media Management
summary: Studies journalists' working conditions, safety, and professional values in Latin America through comparative research such as the Worlds of Journalism Study.
summary_zh: 通过“世界新闻业研究”等比较研究，考察拉美记者的工作条件、人身安全与职业价值观。

name: Rachel Mourao
title: Assoc. Professor
summary: Studies how political news about protests, social movements, and backlash is produced and consumed in Brazil and the United States amid declining media trust.
summary_zh: 研究巴西与美国关于抗议、社会运动及其反弹的政治新闻如何在媒体信任下降中被生产与消费。

name: Jyotika Ramaprasad
title: Professor
summary: Studies journalism cultures and media systems in non-Western countries using journalist surveys and interviews in India, Botswana, and the BRICS nations.
summary_zh: 通过在印度、博茨瓦纳及金砖国家开展记者调查与访谈，研究非西方国家的新闻文化与媒介体制。

name: Mitchell Shapiro
title: Professor, Director of Honors Program
summary: Documents the history of network television and radio programming and studies politics and media, media effects, and audience analysis.
summary_zh: 整理记录广播电视网节目编排史，并研究政治与媒介、媒介效果及受众分析。

name: Joseph B. Treaster
title: Professor
summary: Edits and writes environmental journalism on the worldwide water crisis, drawing on decades as a foreign correspondent to foster cross-cultural communication.
summary_zh: 依托多年驻外记者经验，编辑并撰写关于全球水危机的环境新闻，促进跨文化传播。

name: Isabel Villanueva
title: Asst. Professor
summary: Studies social factors shaping public perceptions of emerging science and technology using quantitative and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与计算方法研究影响公众对新兴科学技术认知的社会因素。

name: Yanfang Wu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how social media, AI, and emerging digital technologies affect journalism and communication using quantitative and qualitative analytics.
summary_zh: 运用定量与质性分析，考察社交媒体、人工智能和新兴数字技术对新闻与传播的影响。

name: Regina Ahn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children, families, and vulnerable audiences process advertising and persuasive media, and develops media literacy approaches.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、家庭及弱势受众如何处理广告与说服性媒介，并发展媒介素养教育路径。

name: Chen “Crystal” Chen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies presence in immersive environments and delegation of thinking to AI agents using experiments, behavioral measures, and drift diffusion modeling.
summary_zh: 运用实验、行为测量与漂移扩散模型，研究沉浸式环境中的临场感以及人们将思考委托给AI代理的现象。

name: Alyse Lancaster
title: Interim Dean, School of Communication
summary: Studies advertising effects, public service advertising, and targeted health messages, as well as branding and social media marketing.
summary_zh: 研究广告效果、公益广告与定向健康信息，以及品牌建设和社交媒体营销。

name: Queenie Li
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how organizations and governments use public relations, CSR, corporate social advocacy, and internal communication to promote health and social change.
summary_zh: 研究组织与政府如何运用公共关系、企业社会责任、企业社会倡导及内部传播促进健康与社会变革。

name: Sophia Mueller-Bryson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies purpose-driven, brand activist, and CSR advertising messages and advertising practitioners' perspectives in agencies.
summary_zh: 研究使命驱动、品牌行动主义与企业社会责任广告信息，以及广告公司从业者的视角。

name: Weiting Tao
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies corporate public relations, including CSR, crisis communication, corporate reputation, and cross-cultural and social media strategies.
summary_zh: 研究企业公共关系，包括企业社会责任、危机传播、企业声誉以及跨文化与社交媒体策略。

name: Wanhsiu Sunny Tsai
title: Professor, Department Chair of Strategic Communication
summary: Studies advertising as a cultural institution, including multicultural advertising, femvertising, brand glocalization, and chatbot and AR advertising.
summary_zh: 将广告视为文化制度加以研究，包括多元文化广告、女性主义广告、品牌全球本土化以及聊天机器人与AR广告。

name: Jeongwon Yang
title: Asst. Professor
summary: Studies how new media technologies, influencers, VTubers, and AI shape persuasion in CSR, crisis communication, and responses to misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究新媒体技术、网红、虚拟主播与AI如何在企业社会责任、危机传播及虚假信息应对中影响说服过程。

name: Shannon A. Bowen
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor
summary: Studies ethics in public relations and strategic communication, including AI ethics, issues management, internal communication, and emergency management.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系与战略传播中的伦理问题，涵盖人工智能伦理、议题管理、内部传播与应急管理。

name: Kenneth Campbell
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Interim Associate Director of Graduate Studies; Associate Professor
areas: representation of African Americans in the media
summary: Studies First Amendment legal history, news coverage of lynchings, and representations of African Americans in media using framing, collective memory, and cultivation analysis.
summary_zh: 运用框架、集体记忆与涵化分析，研究第一修正案法律史、私刑的新闻报道以及媒介中的非裔美国人再现。

name: Karikarn Chansiri
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human-AI interaction and designs adaptive, context-aware intelligent systems, combining computational methods, behavioral experiments, and human-centered design.
summary_zh: 研究人机（AI）交互，结合计算方法、行为实验与以人为本的设计，开发能适应情境的智能系统。

name: Candice L. Edrington
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social movements such as Black Lives Matter use visual and textual messaging on social media to mobilize, through a public relations lens.
summary_zh: 从公共关系视角研究“黑人的命也是命”等社会运动如何在社交媒体上运用视觉与文本信息进行动员。

name: Jabari Miles Evans
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor of Race and Media; Mass Communications Sequence Head
summary: Studies how urban youth of color use social media, hip-hop, and creator culture for self-expression, identity, and learning.
summary_zh: 研究城市有色人种青年如何借助社交媒体、嘻哈与创作者文化进行自我表达、身份建构与学习。

name: Mary Anne Fitzpatrick
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Interim Executive Vice President for Academic Affairs and Provost; Educational Foundation Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies family and marital communication from a social-psychological perspective, with additional work in text and discourse studies.
summary_zh: 从社会心理学视角研究家庭与婚姻传播，并涉及文本与话语研究。

name: Sabrina Habib
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how technology, especially AI, shapes the creative process and the teaching of creativity in advertising and communication education.
summary_zh: 研究技术（尤其是人工智能）如何影响广告与传播教育中的创意过程及创造力教学。

name: Delaney Harness
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: AI and blockchain in transparency and accountability
summary: Studies how organizational communication, data, and regulation shape environmental accountability and risk, including PFAS water quality, sustainability reporting, and carbon markets.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播、数据与监管如何塑造环境问责与风险，涉及PFAS水质、可持续发展报告与碳市场。

name: Haley R. Hatfield
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: virtual environments for education and communication
summary: Designs immersive virtual environments with communities to support education, youth engagement, and public understanding of environmental health.
summary_zh: 与社区合作设计沉浸式虚拟环境，以促进教育、青少年参与及公众对环境健康的理解。

name: Jameson L. Hayes
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor; Social Media Insights Lab Director
summary: Studies consumer-brand relationships and consumer engagement in advertising and social media, using data science.
summary_zh: 运用数据科学，研究广告和社交媒体中的消费者—品牌关系与消费者参与。

name: Kevin Hull
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Sports Media Sequence Head; Associate Professor
summary: Studies local sports broadcasters in the United States, including career challenges, race and gender, and sports communication education, mainly through surveys.
summary_zh: 主要通过调查研究美国地方体育播报员的职业挑战、种族与性别问题，以及体育传播教育。

name: Darin Johnson
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies code switching and self-presentation across social, cultural, and organizational contexts under stigma, drawing on communication neuroscience.
summary_zh: 借助传播神经科学，研究人们在污名之下于社会、文化与组织情境中的语码转换与自我呈现。

name: Jungmi Jun
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
areas: racial/ethnic minorities' communicative coping of racism
summary: Studies cancer and tobacco control communication, health information disparities, and minorities' coping with racism, including analysis of social media discourse.
summary_zh: 研究癌症与控烟传播、健康信息差异以及少数族裔对种族主义的传播性应对，并分析社交媒体讨论。

name: Sei-Hill Kim
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Eleanor M. & R. Frank Mundy Professor
summary: Studies how social issues in health, science, and politics are presented in the news and how that coverage affects audiences, using content analysis.
summary_zh: 运用内容分析，研究健康、科学与政治等社会议题如何在新闻中呈现及其对受众的影响。

name: Andrea Tanner Kornegay
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Dean, South Carolina Honors College; Professor
summary: Studies how practitioners develop health messages and how audiences access and comprehend health information across media, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与定性方法，研究传播从业者如何制作健康信息，以及受众如何在不同媒介中获取和理解健康内容。

name: Van Kornegay
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Visual Communications Sequence Head; Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual communication and international journalism through photojournalism, graphics, and photo essays.
summary_zh: 通过新闻摄影、图形与图片故事研究视觉传播和国际新闻。

name: Tong Lin
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: trust in health information and media platforms
tobacco and cancer prevention among youth and young adults
summary: Develops and tests tobacco and cancer prevention messages for youth and young adults, using online and lab experiments, ecological momentary assessment, and surveys.
summary_zh: 运用线上与实验室实验、生态瞬时评估及调查，开发并检验面向青少年与年轻成人的烟草与癌症预防信息。

name: Jacob Long
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media use and social relationships stabilize or change partisan and political identities, using longitudinal surveys and quantitative methods, and builds R packages.
summary_zh: 运用纵向调查与定量方法研究媒介使用与社会关系如何维持或改变党派与政治身份，并开发R统计软件包。

name: Denise Ann McGill
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Produces photojournalism and documentary video on migration, faith, multicultural issues, and sustainable agriculture.
summary_zh: 以新闻摄影与纪录视频创作关注移民、信仰、多元文化议题与可持续农业。

name: Tara Marie Mortensen
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual journalism, content creators, and audience credibility perceptions of news images, plus visual stereotyping, using eye-tracking, scale development, and content analysis.
summary_zh: 运用眼动追踪、量表开发与内容分析，研究视觉新闻、内容创作者、受众对新闻图片的可信度感知以及视觉刻板印象。

name: Scott Parrott
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Professor
areas: media effects on beliefs, attitudes, emotions and behavior
summary: Studies how mass media shape beliefs, attitudes, and stigma about mental health, focusing on military veterans and elite athletes in news and sports media.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒介如何塑造人们对心理健康的信念、态度与污名，聚焦新闻与体育媒体中的退伍军人和精英运动员。

name: Brett W. Robertson
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
areas: information flow and message design in high-risk events
preparedness and coordination during hazard events
summary: Studies emergency and risk communication, including message design, organizational response, and digital platforms during hazards, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与定性方法，研究应急与风险传播，包括灾害中的信息设计、组织响应与数字平台的作用。

name: Eric P. Robinson
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Reid H. Montgomery Freedom of Information Chair; Associate Professor, SJMC; Academic Affiliate, USC Joseph F. Rice School of Law
areas: social and new media and the legal system
summary: Studies media law, including how social and new media affect courts and juries, defamation, reporter's privilege, and freedom of information, through legal analysis.
summary_zh: 通过法律分析研究媒介法，包括社交与新媒体对法院和陪审团的影响、诽谤、记者特权与信息自由。

name: Wesley Elizabeth Stevens
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
areas: regulation and commodification of Black identity
racial affordances of social media platforms
summary: Studies how platforms, algorithms, and neoliberal discourses regulate and commodify Black identity, focusing on Black influencers, creators, and digital labor.
summary_zh: 研究平台、算法与新自由主义话语如何规训并商品化黑人身份，聚焦黑人网红、创作者与数字劳动。

name: Damion Waymer
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Director, School of Journalism and Mass Communications; Professor
summary: Studies public relations, crisis communication, and corporate social advocacy through rhetorical and critical lenses, with attention to race, class, and public memory.
summary_zh: 从修辞与批判视角研究公共关系、危机传播与企业社会倡导，关注种族、阶级与公共记忆。

name: Taylor Wen
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotions in advertising, marketing, and health messages, measuring consumer responses with experiments and psychophysiological tools such as eye-tracking and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究广告、营销与健康信息中的情绪，通过实验及眼动追踪、fMRI等心理生理工具测量消费者反应。

name: Linwan Wu
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Dean for Research; Associate Professor
areas: artificial intelligence in advertising and strategic communication
summary: Studies the psychological effects of advertising and digital media on consumers, especially reactions to AI in advertising and strategic communication, using social-scientific empirical methods.
summary_zh: 运用社会科学实证方法研究广告与数字媒体对消费者的心理影响，尤其关注消费者对广告和战略传播中人工智能的反应。

name: Anli Xiao
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies multicultural and global public relations, nonprofit communication, CSR perceptions, and organization-public relationships, including comparisons of US and Chinese publics.
summary_zh: 研究多元文化与全球公共关系、非营利组织传播、企业社会责任认知与组织—公众关系，包括中美公众比较。

name: Fan Yang
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Associate Professor; Emergent Information Technologies Lab Director
areas: biometric measures (eye-tracking, facial expression analysis, EEG)
summary: Studies human-AI and human-robot interaction and trust in emerging technologies, using biometric measures, experiments, surveys, and network and big data analytics.
summary_zh: 运用生物计量测量、实验、调查以及网络与大数据分析，研究人与AI及社交机器人的交互和对新兴技术的信任。

name: Viviana Carolina Zambrano Rodriguez
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communications
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decision-making about risky health, environmental, and traffic-safety behaviors, examining message framing and social media health information seeking with mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究健康、环境与交通安全相关的风险行为决策，考察信息框架与社交媒体健康信息寻求。

name: Mariaelena Bartesaghi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies power, authority, and accountability in discourse across health, crisis, and institutional settings, using discourse analysis of talk and texts.
summary_zh: 运用话语分析研究健康、危机与学术等机构场景中的权力、权威与问责。

name: Ambar Basu
title: Professor
summary: Studies culture, health, and underprivilege in marginalized communities through the culture-centered approach, using critical ethnography and autoethnography.
summary_zh: 以文化中心路径研究边缘化社群中的文化、健康与弱势处境，采用批判民族志与自我民族志方法。

name: Keith Berry
title: Professor and Associate Chair
summary: Studies how identities are co-constituted in relational communication, focusing on bullying and LGBTQ+ cultures, using autoethnography, fieldwork, and phenomenology.
summary_zh: 研究关系传播中身份的共同建构，聚焦霸凌与LGBTQ+文化，采用自我民族志、田野调查与现象学方法。

name: Patrice Buzzanell
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies careers, work-life policy, resilience, gender, and engineering design and ethics in organizations, including NSF-funded development of engineering ethics scales.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的职业生涯、工作与生活政策、韧性、性别以及工程设计与伦理，包括由NSF资助的工程伦理量表开发。

name: Tianen Chen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social support, interpersonal conversation, and identity shape responses to persuasive health messages among racial and sexual minorities, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用混合方法研究社会支持、人际对话与身份如何影响种族和性少数群体对说服性健康信息的反应。

name: Marleah Dean Kruzel
title: Professor
summary: Studies uncertainty, medical decision making, and communication of genetic cancer risk among previvors and in patient-clinician interaction.
summary_zh: 研究遗传性癌症风险携带者的不确定性、医疗决策与基因风险信息传播，以及医患互动。

name: Aisha Durham
title: Professor and Affiliated Professor, Departments of Humanities & Cultural Studies and Women's & Gender Studies
summary: Studies media representations, Black feminist thought, and hip hop culture in everyday life, using autoethnography and interpretive cultural analysis.
summary_zh: 运用自我民族志与阐释性文化分析，研究媒介再现、黑人女性主义思想与嘻哈文化在日常生活中的作用。

name: Aubrey Huber
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the intersections of performance and pedagogy, including public speaking instruction and instructor development.
summary_zh: 研究表演与教学法的交叉，包括公共演讲教学与教师培养。

name: Sonia Ivancic
title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how organizing around embodied difference shapes work, health, and food justice, using feminist and narrative analysis of discourse and materiality.
summary_zh: 运用女性主义与叙事视角分析话语与物质性，研究围绕身体差异的组织过程如何影响工作、健康与食物正义。

name: Navita James
title: Associate Professor Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies ethnic and gender diversity in media and culture, including narrative images of motherhood and the Madonna, and diversity teaching and intervention.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与文化中的族裔和性别多样性，包括母性与圣母形象的叙事，以及多样性教学与干预。

name: Peter Jensen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social and cultural assumptions shape everyday organizing and organizational agency, using ethnographic, rhetorical, and interview methods.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、修辞与访谈方法，研究社会文化假设如何塑造日常组织实践与组织能动性。

name: José Ángel Maldonado
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric of violence, neoliberalism, gender, and borders in contemporary Mexican visual culture, using rhetorical theory, film criticism, and memoir.
summary_zh: 运用修辞理论、影视批评与回忆录写作，研究当代墨西哥视觉文化中的暴力、新自由主义、性别与边界修辞。

name: Chris McRae
title: Professor
summary: Studies listening, performances of music and sound, and creative approaches to inquiry from a performance studies perspective.
summary_zh: 从表演研究视角研究聆听、音乐与声音的表演以及创造性的研究路径。

name: Mahuya Pal
title: Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication from the perspectives of communities worldwide, examining culture, structure, and agency amid global economic and environmental issues.
summary_zh: 从全球社群视角研究组织传播，考察全球经济与环境议题中的文化、结构与能动性。

name: Huma Rasheed
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of new media and technology in political and health contexts, using surveys, experiments, content analysis, and computational tools.
summary_zh: 运用调查、实验、内容分析与计算工具，研究新媒体与技术在政治与健康情境中的作用。

name: Joshua Scacco
title: Professor
summary: Studies presidential and political communication, media content and effects, and how leaders use communication technologies for democratic governance, using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用量化方法研究总统与政治传播、媒介内容与效果，以及领导者如何运用传播技术推进民主治理。

name: Steven Wilson
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies how people navigate difficult conversations, influence goals, and communicative resilience in families, health, and workplaces, including military families.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在家庭、健康与职场中应对困难对话、影响目标与沟通韧性，包括军人家庭。

name: Bruce Pinkleton
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Dean / Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies health promotion, media literacy, and public affairs decision making in the digital era, with a focus on adolescents and communication campaign evaluation.
summary_zh: 研究数字时代的健康促进、媒介素养与公共事务决策，关注青少年群体及传播运动效果评估。

name: Erica Austin
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Director of the Murrow Center for Media and Health Promotion Research / Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how media literacy helps children, adolescents, and adults make healthier decisions about health and civic affairs.
summary_zh: 研究媒介素养如何帮助儿童、青少年和成年人在健康与公共事务方面做出更健康的决策。

name: Porismita Borah
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies discourse on digital platforms and message effects in health and politics, including misinformation correction and AI, using multi-method designs.
summary_zh: 运用多方法设计研究数字平台上的话语以及健康与政治语境中的信息效果，包括虚假信息纠正与人工智能的作用。

name: Jordan Foley
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Assistant Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how political information flows through digital communication ecologies and shapes public opinion, combining rhetoric and argumentation with computational social science.
summary_zh: 结合修辞与论辩传统和计算社会科学方法，研究政治信息如何在数字传播生态中流动并影响舆论与民主治理。

name: Traci Gillig
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how interventions, media representations, and relationships shape the well-being of marginalized youth, especially LGBTQ+ youth, and audience attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究干预措施、媒介再现与人际关系如何影响边缘化青少年（尤其是LGBTQ+青少年）的福祉，以及媒介再现对大众态度的影响。

name: Jennifer Henrichsen
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Assistant Professor / Research Director / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies the state of journalism worldwide, including journalist safety and the cybersecurity and information-society challenges facing journalists.
summary_zh: 研究全球新闻业现状，包括记者安全以及记者面临的网络安全与信息社会挑战。

name: Qian Huang
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health message design and interpersonal communication to promote vaccination and other health behaviors, using quantitative and qualitative methods with underserved populations.
summary_zh: 运用定量与质性方法研究健康信息设计与人际传播，以促进疫苗接种等健康行为，关注服务不足人群。

name: Stacey Hust
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Dean of Faculty Affairs and College Operations / Professor / Graduate Faculty
areas: Use of Media to Reduce Sexual Assault and Promote Healthy Sexual Relationships
Parent-Child Communication About Media and Health
Media Effects and Strategies to Prevent Alcohol Abuse
summary: Studies media effects on youth sexual and romantic relationships and designs health messages to reduce sexual assault and alcohol abuse, including parent-child communication.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对青少年性与恋爱关系的影响，并设计减少性侵与酒精滥用的健康信息，包括亲子之间关于媒介与健康的沟通。

name: Bimbisar Irom
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how news and immersive media portray refugees and vulnerable groups in humanitarian crises, using visual, semiotic, and discourse analysis plus framing experiments.
summary_zh: 运用视觉、符号学与话语分析以及框架实验，研究新闻与沉浸式媒介如何呈现人道危机中的难民与弱势群体。

name: Yen-I Lee
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how emotional appeals, visuals, and narratives in health crisis, risk, and public relations messages are processed, using eye-tracking, EDA, heart rate, and facial EMG.
summary_zh: 运用眼动、皮肤电、心率与面部肌电等生理指标，研究健康危机、风险与公关信息中的情绪诉求、视觉与叙事如何被受众加工。

name: Yoon-Joo Lee
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Assistant Chair of Strategic Communication / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies how consumers make sense of social issue, CSR, and mental health advertising and public service announcements, and race and ethnicity issues in health communication.
summary_zh: 研究消费者如何理解社会议题广告、企业社会责任广告、心理健康广告与公益广告，以及健康传播中的种族与族裔问题。
kw: race and ethnicity in health communication

name: Nicole O’Donnell
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Graduate Faculty
areas: Communicating science, health, environment, and risk
summary: Studies message design for health, environmental, and risk campaigns, including how audiences engage with visual and entertaining messages, through community-engaged research.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究探讨健康、环境与风险传播运动中的信息设计，以及受众如何回应视觉化和娱乐性的运动信息。

name: Wei Peng
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Associate Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies the role of emotions in health information processing, social support, and coping with risk and uncertainty, evaluating emotion-based communication interventions.
summary_zh: 研究情绪在健康信息加工、社会支持以及应对风险与不确定性中的作用，并评估基于情绪的传播干预效果。

name: Lawrence Pintak
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Founding Dean (2009-2016) / Professor / Graduate Faculty
areas: Perceptions of the U.S. among the world’s Muslims
summary: Studies international journalism, press freedom, and journalists' motivations, with a focus on Muslim-world perceptions of the U.S. and Islamophobia.
summary_zh: 研究国际新闻、新闻自由与记者职业动机，重点关注穆斯林世界对美国的认知以及伊斯兰恐惧症。

name: Pawel Popiel
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the political economy of media and digital industries, including competition, speech, data and AI regulation, and media ownership concentration across countries.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与数字产业的政治经济学，包括竞争、言论、数据与人工智能规制，以及跨国媒介所有权集中问题。

name: Ryan Thomas
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Director of Graduate Studies / Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Studies journalism ethics and the sociology of news, examining how journalists make sense of change and how it affects journalism's role in democratic public life.
summary_zh: 研究新闻伦理与新闻社会学，考察记者如何理解行业变迁以及这些变迁如何影响新闻业在民主公共生活中的角色。

name: Jessica Willoughby
dept: Edward R. Murrow College of Communication
title: Professor / Graduate Faculty
summary: Develops and evaluates theory-based digital health communication interventions for adolescents and young adults on sexual health, substance misuse, and mental health.
summary_zh: 开发并评估面向青少年和青年的、基于理论的数字健康传播干预，涉及性健康、物质滥用与心理健康等议题。

name: Alexander Stille
title: San Paolo Professorship of International Journalism
summary: Writes international journalism and books on modern Italy, covering fascism, the Mafia, and Berlusconi's fusion of media ownership and political power.
summary_zh: 从事国际新闻写作并出版关于现代意大利的著作，涉及法西斯主义、黑手党以及贝卢斯科尼将媒体所有权与政治权力相结合的现象。

name: Alexis B. Clark
title: Assistant Professor of Journalism
summary: Writes narrative journalism on the history of race, culture and politics in World War II and the Civil Rights era, drawing on newspaper photo archives.
summary_zh: 以叙事新闻写作呈现二战与民权运动时期种族、文化与政治的历史，并利用报纸图片档案讲述被忽视的非裔美国人故事。

name: Alisa Solomon
title: Professor of Journalism; Director in Arts Concentration, MA Program
summary: Writes arts criticism and cultural history of theater and performance, with attention to gender, LGBT issues, and scripted television.
summary_zh: 从事艺术评论与戏剧表演的文化史写作，关注性别、LGBT议题与剧集电视。

name: Andie Tucher
title: H. Gordon Garbedian Professor of Journalism; Director, Ph.D. Program
summary: Studies the history of truth-telling conventions in American journalism, photography and nonfiction, including the history of fake news, as a historian.
summary_zh: 以历史学方法研究美国新闻、摄影与非虚构写作中的“讲真话”惯例演变，包括假新闻与伪新闻的历史。

name: Azmat Khan
title: Patti Cadby Birch Assistant Professor of Journalism; Director, Simon and June Li Center for Global Journalism
summary: Conducts investigative reporting on the human costs of war and military impunity, using on-the-ground investigations, secret military records and interviews.
summary_zh: 从事关于战争人道代价与军事有罪不罚的调查报道，结合实地调查、解密军事档案与访谈。

name: Daniel Alarcón
title: Godfrey Lowell Cabot Professor of Journalism
