summary: Produces long-form narrative journalism and Spanish-language podcasting on Latin America, especially Peruvian politics and society, alongside fiction.
summary_zh: 从事关于拉丁美洲（尤其是秘鲁政治与社会）的长篇叙事新闻与西班牙语播客创作，同时写作小说。

name: David Hajdu
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Writes criticism and cultural history of American popular music, comics and film, including the history of automation and AI in the arts.
summary_zh: 从事美国流行音乐、漫画与电影的评论和文化史写作，包括艺术中自动化与人工智能的历史。

name: Helen Benedict
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Writes journalism, oral history and fiction on refugees, the effects of war on civilians and soldiers, and sexual violence against women in the military.
summary_zh: 以新闻报道、口述历史与小说书写难民、战争对平民和士兵的影响，以及军中女性遭受的性暴力。

name: Howard French
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Writes global affairs journalism and books on Africa's role in the making of the modern world, drawing on a career as a foreign correspondent.
summary_zh: 从事全球事务新闻写作，并出版关于非洲在现代世界形成中作用的著作。

name: Jelani Cobb
title: Dean, Graduate School of Journalism and Henry R. Luce Professor of Journalism
summary: Writes journalism, commentary and documentaries on race, Black politics, voting and policing in American history and public life.
summary_zh: 以新闻写作、评论与纪录片探讨美国历史与公共生活中的种族、黑人政治、投票与警务问题。

name: Jonathan Weiner
title: Maxwell M. Geffen Professor of Medical and Scientific Journalism; Co-Director, MA Science Journalism Program
summary: Writes science journalism and nonfiction books on evolution, genetics and biology for general audiences.
summary_zh: 为大众撰写关于进化、遗传与生物学的科学新闻与非虚构著作。

name: June Cross
title: Fred W. Friendly Professor of Media and Society
summary: Produces documentary journalism on dispossessed communities and the intersection of race, politics and public health.
summary_zh: 制作关于弱势群体以及种族、政治与公共卫生交汇问题的纪录片新闻。

name: Keith Gessen
title: George T. Delacorte Associate Professor of Magazine Journalism
summary: Writes journalism, essays and translations on the aftermath of communism's collapse in the former Soviet Union, including Russia and the war in Ukraine.
summary_zh: 撰写关于前苏联地区共产主义崩溃后果的新闻、随笔与译作，涉及俄罗斯与乌克兰战争。

name: Mark Hansen
title: David and Helen Gurley Brown Professor of Journalism and Innovation; Director, David and Helen Gurley Brown Institute for Media Innovation
summary: Works at the intersection of data, art and technology, creating public data art and teaching computational journalism and advanced data analysis.
summary_zh: 在数据、艺术与技术的交叉领域工作，创作面向公众的数据艺术，并讲授计算新闻与高级数据分析。

name: Nicholas Lemann
title: Joseph Pulitzer II and Edith Pulitzer Moore Professor of Journalism; Director, Columbia Global Reports; Dean Emeritus, Columbia Journalism School
summary: Writes long-form magazine journalism and leads journalism education initiatives in investigative reporting, digital journalism and news leadership.
summary_zh: 从事长篇杂志新闻写作，并主导调查报道、数字新闻与新闻机构领导力等新闻教育项目。

name: Nina Alvarez
title: CBS Assistant Professor of International Journalism
summary: Reports and produces international broadcast, investigative and documentary journalism, with a recurring focus on migration and Latin America.
summary_zh: 从事国际广播、调查与纪录片新闻的报道与制作，长期关注移民问题与拉丁美洲。

name: Nina Berman
title: Professor of Journalism
summary: Creates documentary photography and film on American politics, militarism, environmental issues and post-violence trauma, including portraits and interviews with veterans.
summary_zh: 以纪实摄影与电影呈现美国政治、军事化、环境议题与暴力后创伤，包括对退伍军人的肖像与访谈。

name: Richard R. John
title: Professor of History and Communications
summary: Studies the history of American communications, business, technology and political development, including the postal system and telecommunications, as a historian.
summary_zh: 以历史学方法研究美国传播、商业、技术与政治发展的历史，包括邮政系统与电信业。

name: Robe Imbriano
title: Ira A. Lipman Associate Professor of Journalism; Director, Ira. A. Lipman Center for Journalism and Civil and Human Rights; Director, Documentary Journalism Program
summary: Produces documentary series on civil and human rights, racial equality and the lives of marginalized Americans.
summary_zh: 制作关于公民权与人权、种族平等以及美国边缘群体生活的纪录片系列。

name: Rachel Bailey
title: James E. Kirk Professor of Communication, Director of Doctoral Studies
summary: Studies how people process media through embodied and motivated cognition, examining health perceptions, food choice, substance use, and vicarious trauma from mediated violence.
summary_zh: 从具身与动机认知视角研究人们如何加工媒介信息，考察健康认知、食物选择、物质使用以及媒介暴力造成的替代性创伤。

name: Ulla Bunz
title: Associate Professor, Associate Dean for Student & Academic Affairs
summary: Studies internet and social media use, the digital divide, and how they relate to Big Five personality traits and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究互联网与社交媒体使用、数字鸿沟，以及它们与大五人格特质和幸福感之间的关系。

name: Sindy Chapa
title: Professor & Director of the Hispanic Marketing Center
summary: Studies how advertising strategies, including political advertising and advergames, affect Latino consumers and Hispanic marketing communication.
summary_zh: 研究广告策略（包括政治广告与广告游戏）如何影响拉丁裔消费者及西语裔营销传播。

name: Russell Clayton
title: Distinguished and Endowed Provost McKenzie Professor
summary: Evaluates and optimizes persuasive health messages to prevent substance use among young adults, drawing on media psychology and psychophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 结合媒介心理学与心理生理方法，评估并优化旨在预防年轻人物质使用的说服性健康信息。

name: Juliann Cortese
title: Professor, Director of Master's Studies
summary: Studies eHealth and health informatics, online message tailoring, hypermedia learning, and the uses and effects of internet media.
summary_zh: 研究电子健康与健康信息学、在线信息定制、超媒体学习以及互联网媒介的使用与效果。

name: Katherine R. Dale
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines how media can positively affect attitudes, behavior, and well-being, including intergroup attitudes, from a positive media psychology perspective.
summary_zh: 从积极媒介心理学视角考察媒介如何积极影响态度、行为与幸福感，包括群际态度。

name: Arienne Ferchaud
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emerging media technologies change engagement with entertainment and storytelling, including binge-watching and games, from a media psychology perspective.
summary_zh: 从媒介心理学视角研究新兴媒介技术如何改变人们对娱乐内容与叙事的参与，包括刷剧与游戏。

name: Brian Graves
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works on media writing and production, documentary storytelling, and public memory.
summary_zh: 从事媒介写作与制作、纪录片叙事以及公共记忆研究。

name: Davis W. Houck
title: Fannie Lou Hamer Professor of Rhetorical Studies
summary: Analyzes presidential rhetoric, the Black freedom movement, and mediated sport through rhetorical criticism and archival historiography.
summary_zh: 通过修辞批评与档案史学方法分析总统修辞、黑人自由运动以及体育的媒介再现。

name: Felecia F. Jordan Jackson
title: Associate Professor
areas: Perceptions and Effects on Relationships Development
Communicating and Coping with Relational Deterioration/Loss
summary: Studies verbal aggression, interracial communication, and how people develop relationships and cope with relational deterioration and loss.
summary_zh: 研究言语攻击、跨种族传播，以及人们如何发展关系并应对关系恶化与丧失。

name: Braidyn Lazenby
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate difficult health conversations with providers, family, friends, and partners, including talk about stigmatized conditions and eating disorders.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何与医护人员、家人、朋友和伴侣进行艰难的健康对话，包括关于污名化疾病与进食障碍的沟通。

name: Jaejin Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies consumer behavior, branding, and cause-related and social marketing communication, including health messaging and new media.
summary_zh: 研究消费者行为、品牌建设以及公益关联营销与社会营销传播，涉及健康信息与新媒体。

name: Stephen McDowell
title: Assistant Provost, John H. Phipps Professor of Communication
summary: Examines news, communication technology, internet governance, and media policy in South Asia and North America from a political economy perspective.
summary_zh: 从政治经济学视角考察南亚与北美的新闻、传播技术、互联网治理与媒介政策。

name: Patrick Merle
title: Professor, School Director
summary: Studies crisis and risk communication, the credibility of AI-generated communication, and science communication.
summary_zh: 研究危机与风险传播、人工智能生成内容的可信度以及科学传播。

name: Andrew Opel
title: James E. Kirk Professor of Communication
summary: Studies documentary history and production and environmental communication campaigns, linking media, environment, and consumer culture through scholarship and filmmaking.
summary_zh: 研究纪录片历史与制作以及环境传播运动，通过学术与电影创作连接媒介、环境与消费文化。

name: Jennifer Proffitt
title: Theodore Clevenger Professor in Communication
summary: Analyzes the political economy of media industries and production, media history, regulation, law, and policy in relation to democratic communication.
summary_zh: 分析媒介产业与生产的政治经济学、媒介史、规制、法律与政策及其与民主传播的关系。

name: Elizabeth Ray
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how audiences interpret risk and crisis information, judge AI-generated crisis messages, and build resilience, including during extreme weather events.
summary_zh: 研究受众如何理解风险与危机信息、评判人工智能生成的危机信息并建立韧性，包括在极端天气事件中。

name: Ruosi Shao
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Research interests span artificial intelligence, health communication, and human-computer interaction.
summary_zh: 研究兴趣涵盖人工智能、健康传播与人机交互。

name: Richard Waters
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations, nonprofit and fundraising communication, stakeholder relationship management, and social media strategy in organizational settings.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系、非营利与筹款传播、利益相关者关系管理以及组织情境中的社交媒体策略。

name: Jessica Wendorf Muhamad
title: Director of Undergraduate Studies | Director PEAKS Research Laboratory | Associate Professor
summary: Develops and tests entertainment-education and game-based health interventions through participatory, community-engaged, and mixed-methods design, including occupational health.
summary_zh: 通过参与式、社区参与和混合方法设计，开发并检验寓教于乐与游戏化健康干预，包括职业健康领域。

name: Yin Yang
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Health Communication (Women’s Health, Stigma and Health, Health Inequities)
summary: Examines how narrative and emotional messages shape beliefs and behaviors about stigmatized health and environmental issues such as menstrual health and climate justice.
summary_zh: 考察叙事与情绪性信息如何影响人们对月经健康、气候正义等被污名化健康与环境议题的信念和行为。

name: Annie Zhang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how digital spaces and emerging technologies shape public communication, understanding, and engagement with science, health, and environmental issues.
summary_zh: 研究数字空间与新兴技术如何塑造公众对科学、健康与环境议题的传播、理解与参与。

name: Pengfei Zhao
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how human and AI moral behaviors shape online community norms and develops AI-powered interventions to reduce online toxicity and harms.
summary_zh: 研究人类与人工智能的道德行为如何塑造网络社群规范，并开发人工智能驱动的干预以减少网络毒性与伤害。

name: Chris Anson
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Distinguished University Professor
areas: All aspects of writing theory and research, especially response to student writing
Writing across the curriculum and writing to learn
Digital literacies and computers in composition
Faculty development in the teaching of writing
summary: Studies writing instruction, including response to student writing, writing assessment, writing across the curriculum, literacy theory, and digital literacies.
summary_zh: 研究写作教学，包括对学生写作的反馈、写作评估、跨课程写作、读写理论与数字素养。

name: Zachary Beare
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and identity shape rhetorical activity and composition teaching, with queer and feminist pedagogy and secondary work on rhetorics of queer and reproductive health.
summary_zh: 研究情感与身份如何影响修辞活动与写作教学，关注酷儿与女性主义教学法，并兼及酷儿与生殖健康的修辞。

name: Kalyca Becktel
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies public relations with a focus on brand-public relationships, the public's use of digital media, and publics' relationships with extreme organizations.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系，聚焦品牌与公众的关系、公众的数字媒体使用以及公众与极端组织的关系。

name: David Berube
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies science and technology communication, especially risk communication about emerging technologies such as nanotechnology, along with climate, disaster, and pandemic communication.
summary_zh: 研究科学与技术传播，尤其是纳米技术等新兴技术的风险传播，并涉及气候、灾害与疫情传播。

name: Andy Binder
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how information about controversial science topics flows through communication channels and shapes risk perception, using national opinion surveys, meta-analysis, and systematic review.
summary_zh: 研究争议性科学议题的信息如何经由传播渠道流动并影响风险感知，采用全国民意调查、元分析与系统综述。

name: Helen Burgess
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies digital rhetorics, electronic literature, and critical code studies through critical making, multimedia production, web development, and text/textile practice.
summary_zh: 研究数字修辞、电子文学与批判代码研究，通过批判性制作、多媒体创作、网页开发与文本/织物实践开展。

name: Yang Alice Cheng
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies AI and strategic communication, including responsible AI, AI literacy, human-AI interaction, crisis communication, misinformation, public trust, and organization-public relationships.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能与战略传播，包括负责任的AI、AI素养、人机交互、危机传播、虚假信息、公众信任与组织—公众关系。

name: Kirsti Cole
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people learn to write, how writing programs support students and faculty, and how AI is reshaping writing practice, alongside feminist rhetoric and leadership.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何学习写作、写作项目如何支持师生，以及人工智能如何重塑写作实践，并关注女性主义修辞与领导力。

name: Deanna Dannels
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Dean - Humanities & Social Sci
summary: Leads the college of humanities and social sciences as dean; the profile describes administrative initiatives rather than a specific research program.
summary_zh: 担任人文与社会科学学院院长；简介主要介绍行政举措，未说明具体研究方向。

name: Meg Day
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Writes and studies poetry with a focus on disability poetics and Deaf and hard-of-hearing poetics.
summary_zh: 从事诗歌创作与研究，聚焦残障诗学以及聋人与听障诗学。

name: Huiling Ding
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies responsible AI, AI ethics, and risk and health communication, along with labor market analytics, technical communication, and intercultural and medical rhetoric.
summary_zh: 研究负责任的人工智能、AI伦理、风险与健康传播，并涉及劳动力市场分析、技术传播以及跨文化与医学修辞。

name: Robin Dodsworth
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies language variation and change in Raleigh, North Carolina, using a corpus of conversational recordings from residents, acoustic phonetics, and social network methods.
summary_zh: 研究北卡罗来纳州罗利市的语言变异与变化，使用居民会话录音语料、声学语音学与社会网络方法。

name: Fernanda Duarte
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies the sociotechnical dimensions of emerging media technologies and how people appropriate and subvert them, through critical making, media arts, and activism.
summary_zh: 研究新兴媒介技术的社会技术维度以及人们如何挪用和颠覆这些技术，通过批判性制作、媒介艺术与行动主义开展。

name: Veljko Dubljevic
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: University Faculty Scholar, Joseph D. Moore Distinguished Professor of Philosophy and Science, Technology & Society (STS)
summary: Studies neuroethics and the ethics of AI and neurotechnology, including the cognitive neuroscience of moral judgment, from a philosophical perspective.
summary_zh: 从哲学视角研究神经伦理学以及人工智能与神经技术伦理，包括道德判断的认知神经科学。

name: Tugce Ertem Eray
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies international public relations, public diplomacy, and social identity, including DEI and intersectional identities at work and bibliometric studies of the PR field.
summary_zh: 研究国际公共关系、公共外交与社会身份，包括职场中的多元平等包容与交叉身份，以及公关领域的文献计量研究。

name: Casie Fedukovich
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies writing program administration, academic labor, and teaching assistant preparation, with attention to class, body politics, and space, using qualitative methods and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究写作项目管理、学术劳动与助教培养，关注阶级、身体政治与空间，采用质性方法与话语分析。

name: Paul Fyfe
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies nineteenth-century British book and media history and the ethics of AI, using computer vision and multimodal AI to analyze Victorian newspapers and periodical illustrations.
summary_zh: 研究十九世纪英国书籍与媒介史以及人工智能伦理，运用计算机视觉与多模态AI分析维多利亚时期报纸与期刊插图。

name: Victoria Gallagher
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual and material rhetoric through rhetorical criticism of civil rights discourse, memorials, museums, and public art, and also communication ethics and organizational communication.
summary_zh: 研究视觉与物质修辞，对民权话语、纪念场所、博物馆与公共艺术进行修辞批评，并涉及传播伦理与组织传播。

name: Marsha Gordon
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies American film history, including documentary, the Hollywood studio system, independent filmmakers of the 1940s-50s, orphan and educational films, and race in nontheatrical film.
summary_zh: 研究美国电影史，包括纪录片、好莱坞制片厂制度、二十世纪四五十年代独立电影人、孤儿片与教育片，以及非院线电影中的种族。

name: Jessica Jameson
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor and Head
summary: Studies organizational communication that supports collaboration, conflict management, and wellbeing, including workplace mediation, dispute system design, and conflict in health care settings.
summary_zh: 研究促进协作、冲突管理与福祉的组织传播，包括职场调解、纠纷系统设计以及医疗场景中的冲突。

name: Andrew Johnston
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies film history and theory, especially abstract animation, avant-garde film, and the history of computer-generated imagery, through media archaeology and work on digital archives.
summary_zh: 研究电影史与电影理论，尤其是抽象动画、先锋电影与计算机生成图像的历史，采用媒介考古学并关注数字档案。

name: Kama Kosenko
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies how people with stigmatized conditions and identities communicate about them, focusing on sexual communication, disclosure, social support, and HIV/STI prevention.
summary_zh: 研究带有污名化疾病与身份的人群如何进行沟通，聚焦性沟通、自我披露、社会支持与艾滋病/性传播感染预防。

name: Chris Lindgren
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Associate Professor of Technical Communication
summary: Studies coding and data science work as rhetorical communication and Indigenous data sovereignty, designing community archives and data tools through community-engaged, design-justice work.
summary_zh: 将编程与数据科学工作作为修辞传播来研究，关注原住民数据主权，通过社区参与和设计正义路径构建社区档案与数据工具。

name: Michelle McMullin
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies team collaboration and communication, project planning, and research practice and mentoring, including mapping tools for fostering cooperation on complex problems.
summary_zh: 研究团队协作与沟通、项目规划以及研究实践与指导，包括用于促进复杂问题合作的映射工具。

name: Jeffrey Mielke
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies linguistic sound patterns and the phonetic origins of sound change, including covert articulatory variation, using laboratory and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言语音模式与音变的语音学起源，包括隐性发音差异，采用实验室与计算技术。

name: Jason Miller
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Writes books, films, and digital humanities projects on Martin Luther King Jr., Langston Hughes, and Nina Simone, including a dual biography on the birth of Black Power.
summary_zh: 围绕马丁·路德·金、兰斯顿·休斯与妮娜·西蒙创作书籍、影片与数字人文项目，包括一部关于黑人权力运动兴起的双人传记。

name: Juliana Makuchi Nfah-Abbenyi
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Associate Dean of Faculty & Staff Development & Success
summary: Serves as an associate dean for faculty and staff development; the profile describes administrative work in English and comparative literature rather than a specific research program.
summary_zh: 担任负责教职员发展的副院长；简介主要介绍其在英语与比较文学领域的行政工作，未说明具体研究方向。

name: Nii Kotei Nikoi
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies African popular culture and global media, focusing on hiplife and hip-hop music video production, creative work, and networked radio in Accra, Ghana.
summary_zh: 研究非洲流行文化与全球媒介，聚焦加纳阿克拉的嘻哈/hiplife音乐录影带制作、创意劳动与网络化广播。

name: Stacey Pigg
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Programs
summary: Studies how digital and networked writing practices shape work, learning, and engagement, including mobile writing workflows, attention dynamics, and public science engagement.
summary_zh: 研究数字与网络化写作实践如何塑造工作、学习与参与，包括移动写作流程、注意力动态与公众科学参与。

name: Jeffrey Reaser
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Walt Wolfram Distinguished Professor of Sociolinguistics
summary: Studies dialects and language variation in North Carolina and develops dialect awareness programs and critical language pedagogy for schools and teacher education.
summary_zh: 研究北卡罗来纳州的方言与语言变异，并为学校与教师教育开发方言意识课程与批判性语言教学法。

name: David Rieder
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies digital rhetoric through creative coding, Arduino-based physical computing, and generative AI, including computational analysis of the prosody of James Baldwin's speech.
summary_zh: 通过创意编程、基于Arduino的物理计算与生成式AI研究数字修辞，包括对詹姆斯·鲍德温演讲韵律的计算分析。

name: Roy Schwartzman
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies the formation and remediation of propaganda and prejudice, especially antisemitism and Holocaust survivor testimonies, along with public communication of science and teaching scholarship.
summary_zh: 研究宣传与偏见的形成与矫正，尤其是反犹主义与大屠杀幸存者证词，并涉及科学的公共传播与教学学术。

name: Ariel Seay-Howard
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assistant Professor of Communication, Race, Rhetoric
summary: Studies how the public remembers slavery and racial violence through rhetorical analysis of lynching memorials, plantation museums, and documentary films as counter-memories.
summary_zh: 通过对私刑纪念馆、种植园博物馆与纪录片等反记忆的修辞分析，研究公众如何记忆奴隶制与种族暴力。

name: Rico Self
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies race, gender, and sexuality through rhetorical and cultural studies, performance studies, and critical media studies, drawing on Black studies, Southern studies, and autoethnography.
summary_zh: 从修辞与文化研究、表演研究和批判媒介研究视角研究种族、性别与性向，借鉴黑人研究、美国南方研究与自我民族志。

name: Yasheng She
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies anime and analog and digital games as visual culture through cultural studies, gender and queer theory, and Asian/Asian American studies, including apocalyptic imaginations in global media.
summary_zh: 从文化研究、性别与酷儿理论及亚洲/亚裔美国研究视角，研究作为视觉文化的动漫与桌游/电子游戏，包括全球媒介中的末日想象。

name: John Stadler
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies how film and media shape modern notions of gender and sexual difference, focusing on queer media and the influence of adult media on gay culture.
summary_zh: 研究电影与媒介如何塑造现代性别与性差异观念，聚焦酷儿媒介以及成人媒介对同性恋文化的影响。

name: Timothy Stinson
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies medieval literature, manuscripts, and book history, publishing in medieval studies and bibliographical scholarship.
summary_zh: 研究中世纪文学、手稿与书籍史，成果发表于中世纪研究与目录学领域。

name: Jason Swarts
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Head
summary: Studies technical communication practice, genre, and knowledge work with emerging technologies, using mixed quantitative/qualitative discourse analysis, corpus techniques, and usability testing.
summary_zh: 研究新兴技术环境下的技术传播实践、文类与知识工作，采用定量/定性混合话语分析、语料库技术与可用性测试。

name: Anu Thapa
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Asst Professor
areas: Film and media history and theory
Special effects, religion and technology in cinema
summary: Studies film and media history and theory, focusing on South Asian cinemas, postcolonial and decolonial theory, and special effects as a site where religion and technology meet.
summary_zh: 研究电影与媒介史及理论，聚焦南亚电影、后殖民与去殖民理论，以及作为宗教与技术交汇点的电影特效。

name: Douglas Walls
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies digital rhetorics and user experience, designing inclusive information architecture for public health information and rural organizations serving marginalized communities.
summary_zh: 研究数字修辞与用户体验，为公共卫生信息及服务边缘化社群的农村机构设计包容性的信息架构。

name: Rebecca Walsh
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
areas: American literature and culture, transnationalism and Empire
Cultural geography, postcolonial theory, diaspora studies, feminist/queer theory
summary: Studies transatlantic and transnational modernist literature and American culture, examining space, migration, race, and gender through postcolonial, diaspora, and feminist/queer theory.
summary_zh: 研究跨大西洋与跨国现代主义文学及美国文化，借助后殖民、离散研究与女性主义/酷儿理论考察空间、移民、种族与性别。

name: Steve Wiley
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies decolonial media theory, globalization, and subject formation through ethnographic fieldwork and interviews in Latin America, especially Chile, Argentina, and Mexico.
summary_zh: 研究去殖民媒介理论、全球化与主体形成，在拉丁美洲（尤其是智利、阿根廷和墨西哥）开展民族志田野与访谈。

name: Kenneth Zagacki
dept: Ph.D. Program in Communication, Rhetoric and Digital Media (CRDM)
title: Professor
summary: Studies rhetorical theory and criticism, analyzing presidential foreign policy speeches, scientific argumentation, visual rhetoric, and civil rights discourse.
summary_zh: 研究修辞理论与批评，分析总统外交政策演讲、科学论证、视觉修辞与民权话语。

name: Melissa Tully
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Director, School of Journalism and Mass Communication / Professor and CLAS Collegiate Scholar
summary: Studies news literacy, misinformation and engagement in global media, with a focus on African media, including current work on misinformation in Kenya.
summary_zh: 研究全球媒介中的新闻素养、虚假信息与参与，重点关注非洲媒介，目前开展肯尼亚虚假信息与新闻素养研究。

name: Venise Berry
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Develops African American cultural criticism and a theory of "racialism" on media images of African Americans in youth media, popular culture and film.
summary_zh: 从事非裔美国人文化批评，发展“种族主义化”（racialism）理论，研究青少年媒介、流行文化与电影中的非裔美国人形象。

name: David Dowling
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies narrative, podcast and immersive longform journalism and how digital publishing industries shape multimedia storytelling, from 360/VR to gamified news.
summary_zh: 研究叙事新闻、播客新闻与沉浸式长篇报道，以及数字出版产业如何塑造从360度/VR到游戏化新闻的多媒体叙事。

name: Meenakshi Gigi Durham
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
areas: media and the politics of the body
summary: Examines media and the politics of the body, focusing on gender, sexuality, race, youth cultures and sexual violence from a feminist perspective.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与身体政治，聚焦性别、性向、种族、青少年文化与性暴力等议题，具有女性主义视角。

name: Brian Ekdale
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies algorithmic personalization, digital media production and disparities in scholarly knowledge production, including algorithmic imaginaries and election information disorder.
summary_zh: 研究算法个性化、数字媒介生产与学术知识生产中的不平等，包括社交媒体用户的算法想象与选举中的信息失序。

name: Brett Johnson
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: John Kamp Associate Professor of Media Law and Policy / Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies media law, media ethics and media sociology and how digital technology disrupts them, including hate speech coverage, public records and civility rules.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法、媒介伦理与媒介社会学及数字技术对其的冲击，涉及仇恨言论报道、公共记录与公共会议文明规范等。

name: Sang Jung Kim
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how technology, politics and social identity interact on social media, analyzing multimodal messages with experiments and computational methods such as visual framing at scale.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上技术、政治与社会身份的互动，运用实验和计算方法分析多模态信息，如大规模视觉框架分析。

name: Jamil Marques
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political communication, journalism and public opinion from a global and comparative perspective, with a focus on Latin America, Brazil and de-Westernizing knowledge production.
summary_zh: 从全球与比较视角研究政治传播、新闻业与舆论，聚焦拉丁美洲与巴西，并关注知识生产的去西方化。

name: Thomas Oates
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Professor / Director of Graduate Studies
areas: sports coverage in magazines, newspapers, websites, video games and video
summary: Studies how sport media make athletes and games meaningful, critically analyzing sports coverage in magazines, newspapers, websites, video games and video.
summary_zh: 研究体育媒介如何赋予运动员与赛事意义，以批判文化视角分析杂志、报纸、网站、电子游戏和视频中的体育报道。

name: Alex Scott
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
areas: non-fiction visual practices and social difference
summary: Studies the political, economic and aesthetic forces in photojournalism and how non-fiction visual practices construct social difference, with work on visual theory and migration.
summary_zh: 研究影响新闻摄影实践的政治、经济与美学力量，分析非虚构视觉实践如何建构社会差异，并涉及视觉理论与移民议题。

name: Sujatha Sosale
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
areas: media and social change in the Global South
South Asia, Southeast Asia and Africa
political economy of media technologies in colonial and postcolonial contexts
summary: Studies media and social change in the Global South, including news on development, the political economy of colonial media technologies, and mobile media use in rural South India.
summary_zh: 研究全球南方的媒介与社会变迁，包括发展议题新闻、殖民语境中媒介技术的政治经济学以及南印度农村的移动媒介使用。

name: Travis Vogan
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Erich Funke Professor
summary: Studies sport, media and U.S. culture, writing critical and industrial histories of sports film, television and documentary such as ESPN, NFL Films and ABC Sports.
summary_zh: 研究体育、媒介与美国文化，撰写体育电影、电视与纪录片的批判性与产业史研究，如ESPN、NFL Films和ABC Sports。

name: Rachel Young
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media effects on health, health journalism and stigma using mixed methods: textual and content analysis, interviews, a national survey and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究媒介对健康的影响、健康新闻与污名，采用混合方法，包括文本与内容分析、访谈、全国调查和实验。

name: Bingbing Zhang
dept: School of Journalism and Mass Communication
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people process (mis)information on health, science and politics and the effects of strategic messages and AI content, using surveys, experiments and content analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何处理有关健康、科学与政治的（虚假）信息，以及策略性信息和AI生成内容的效果，主要采用调查、实验与内容分析。

name: Kembrew McLeod
title: Department Chair / Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies popular music, independent media and copyright law, producing books and documentary films on intellectual property and freedom of expression.
summary_zh: 研究流行音乐、独立媒体与版权法，以著作和纪录片探讨知识产权与表达自由。

name: Logan Brown
title: Assistant Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Writes critical histories of games and entertainment software, tracing how the early American mobile games industry shaped platform economics and digital labor.
summary_zh: 以批判视角书写游戏与娱乐软件的历史，追溯早期美国手机游戏产业如何塑造平台经济与数字劳动。

name: Shelly Campo
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Designs and evaluates theory-based health campaigns and studies risk communication and persuasion for audiences such as college students and rural and minority populations.
summary_zh: 设计并评估基于理论的健康传播运动，研究面向大学生、农村和少数族裔人群的风险传播与说服。

name: Emerson Cram
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies / Associate Professor, Gender, Women's & Sexuality Studies
summary: Studies critical environmental justice, linking race, disability, sexuality and environment, through queer ecology and archives, interviews and fieldwork in the US West and Iowa.
summary_zh: 研究批判性环境正义，探讨种族、残障、性向与环境的关系，以酷儿生态学视角结合档案、访谈与田野调查研究美国西部与爱荷华。

name: Steve Duck
title: Professor, Rhetoric
areas: rhetorical presentation of relationships in everyday life
summary: Studies personal relationships and how they are rhetorically presented in everyday life.
summary_zh: 研究个人关系及其在日常生活中如何被修辞性地呈现。

name: Natalie Fixmer-Oraiz
title: F. Wendell Miller Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies rhetoric and reproductive justice, including US security culture, commercial surrogacy, queer kinship and care, and feminist movements.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与生育正义，涉及美国安全文化、商业代孕、酷儿亲属关系与照护以及女性主义运动。

name: Ashley Hall
title: Assistant Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies Black American rhetorical cultures and Black women's public discourse, ratchetness and worldmaking, including figures such as Cardi B and Megan Thee Stallion.
summary_zh: 研究美国黑人修辞文化与黑人女性的公共话语、“ratchetness”与世界建构，包括Cardi B和Megan Thee Stallion等人物。

name: Tim Havens
title: Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies television, media industries and media globalization, including race and media, platform studies, and Hungarian television and film location industries.
summary_zh: 研究电视、媒介产业与媒介全球化，涉及种族与媒介、平台研究以及匈牙利电视与影视拍摄地产业。

name: Joy Elizabeth Hayes
title: Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies media history and theory, including US and Mexican broadcasting history, race and ethnicity in media, community media, and the development of docudrama.
summary_zh: 研究媒介史与理论，包括美国与墨西哥广播史、媒介中的种族与族裔、社区媒体以及纪实剧的发展。

name: Jiyeon Kang
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies how marginalized groups reshape dominant discourses through digital media, publics and counterpublics, including youth Internet activism in South Korea and intercultural coexistence.
summary_zh: 研究边缘群体如何借助数字媒介、公众与反公众重塑主导话语，包括韩国青年网络行动主义与跨文化共存。

name: Helen Lillie
title: Assistant Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies health and interpersonal communication: how resilience is built with close others and how narratives and emotion persuade people toward healthy behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究健康与人际传播：如何通过与亲近者的沟通建立韧性，以及叙事与情绪如何说服人们采取健康行为。

name: Kate Magsamen-Conrad
title: Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies health and interpersonal communication through community-engaged mixed-methods projects, including interventions and technology's role in health management.
summary_zh: 通过社区参与式混合方法项目研究健康与人际传播，包括干预项目以及技术在健康管理中的作用。

name: Rachel McLaren
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies interpersonal communication, social cognition and hurtful messages, examining how relational turbulence shapes how couples process relational messages.
summary_zh: 研究人际传播、社会认知与伤害性信息，考察关系动荡如何影响伴侣对关系信息的处理。

name: Sylvia Mikucki-Enyart
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication under relational uncertainty, including in-law relationships, late-life parental divorce and sexual communication.
summary_zh: 研究关系不确定情境下的人际与家庭传播，包括姻亲关系、晚年父母离婚以及性沟通。

name: Carol Severino
title: Professor, Rhetoric / Director of the Writing Center
summary: Studies the relationships among writing, language background, culture and pedagogy, especially in writing centers and second-language writing.
summary_zh: 研究写作、语言背景、文化与教学之间的关系，尤其关注写作中心与二语写作。

name: Jenna Supp-Montgomerie
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies relationships among water, infrastructure and religion, including the religious origins of network culture traced through the 1858 Atlantic Telegraph.
summary_zh: 研究水、基础设施与宗教之间的关系，包括通过1858年大西洋电报追溯网络文化的宗教起源。

name: Rita Zajacz
title: Associate Professor, Communication Studies / Director of Graduate Studies, Communication Studies
summary: Studies how states seek control over global communications infrastructure, including the history of radio network governance and online anonymity.
summary_zh: 研究国家如何寻求对全球传播基础设施的控制，包括无线电网络治理的历史与网络匿名性。

name: Morana Alac
title: Professor
summary: Studies multimodal and multisensory interaction, such as gesture and the senses, in scientific laboratories and everyday technology use through ethnographic and ethnomethodological research.
summary_zh: 通过民族志与常人方法学研究，考察科学实验室及日常技术使用中的多模态、多感官互动，如手势与感官实践。

name: Patrick Anderson
title: Professor, Chair
areas: focusing in particular on the constitutive role of violence
pain in the production and experience of political subjectivity
summary: Studies how violence, mortality, pain, and illness shape political subjectivity, drawing on performance studies, cultural studies, and queer and gender studies.
summary_zh: 借助表演研究、文化研究以及酷儿与性别研究，探讨暴力、死亡、痛苦与疾病如何塑造政治主体性。

name: Boatema Boateng
title: Professor, Associate Chair
summary: Studies how intellectual property law intersects with race, gender, and nation, examining Ghanaian adinkra and kente cloth, U.S. quilting, and Black indigeneities in Africa and the diaspora.
summary_zh: 研究知识产权法如何与种族、性别和国族交织，考察加纳阿丁克拉与肯特布、美国拼布艺术以及非洲与离散群体中的黑人原住性。

name: Angela Booker
title: Associate Professor Provost of Eighth College
summary: Studies how youth, families, and schools use media and technology for civic participation, learning, and community development, using ethnographic, qualitative, and design-based research.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、质性与基于设计的研究方法，探讨青少年、家庭和学校如何利用媒介与技术进行公共参与、学习与社区发展。

name: Matilde Córdoba Azcárate
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies tourism, capitalism, space, and the politics of nature and heritage, with ethnographic work on tourism, megaprojects, and Maya territorial defense in Yucatán, Mexico.
summary_zh: 研究旅游、资本主义、空间以及自然与遗产政治，并以民族志方法考察墨西哥尤卡坦的旅游业、大型工程与玛雅领土捍卫。

name: Zeinabu Irene Davis
title: Professor
areas: Altering and diversifying the terrain of mass media
summary: Makes independent films centered on African American women and writes on film history, world cinema, folklore, and African and African American cinema.
summary_zh: 创作以非裔美国女性为中心的独立电影，并撰写关于电影史、世界电影、民间传说以及非洲与非裔美国电影的论述。

name: Andrew deWaard
title: Associate Professor MCC 124B
summary: Studies the cultural industries, financialization, and media ownership using critical political economy of media, including independent music in the streaming age.
summary_zh: 以媒介批判政治经济学方法研究文化产业、金融化与媒介所有权，包括流媒体时代的独立音乐。

name: Fernando Domínguez Rubio
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies art, museums, maintenance and repair, and the labor and ecologies that sustain cultural objects, working across sociology, science and technology studies, and design.
summary_zh: 横跨社会学、科学技术研究与设计，研究艺术、博物馆、维护与修复，以及维系文化物品所需的劳动与生态。

name: Alexander Fattal
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
areas: film and photography projects with immigrant
summary: Studies the politics of visual representation around Colombia's armed conflict, including counterinsurgency marketing and branding, through multimodal anthropology, photography, and documentary.
summary_zh: 通过多模态人类学、摄影与纪录片创作，研究围绕哥伦比亚武装冲突的视觉再现政治，包括反叛乱营销与品牌化。

name: Kelly Gates
title: Professor
areas: Critical analysis of digital media technologies
summary: Critically analyzes digital media technologies and the automation of surveillance in the United States, including facial recognition and the corporate police surveillance economy.
summary_zh: 批判性地分析数字媒介技术与美国监控的自动化，包括人脸识别技术以及企业与警方的监控经济。

name: Stuart Geiger
title: Assistant Professor
areas: governance and moderation of online platforms and communities
summary: Studies AI, data science, and content moderation on online platforms, including bias auditing of language models, using ethnography and computational and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用民族志以及计算与混合方法，研究人工智能、数据科学与网络平台内容审核，包括对语言模型的偏见审计。

name: Brian Goldfarb
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual and digital media cultures in education, disability, and environmental activism, and creates collaborative media projects on Tourette syndrome and refugee wellness.
summary_zh: 研究教育、残障与环境行动中的视觉与数字媒介文化，并开展关于妥瑞氏症与难民心理健康的协作媒体项目。

name: Anthony J. Harb
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language and media practices shape inequality for Latinx and Arab communities, from Spanish-language community radio to news coverage of Gaza, drawing on sociolinguistics.
summary_zh: 借助社会语言学研究语言与媒介实践如何塑造拉丁裔与阿拉伯社群所面临的不平等，涵盖西语社区电台与加沙新闻报道等。

name: Erin T. Hill
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Media Industry Organizational and Production Cultures
Below-the-Line Production Sectors and non-unionized “Gig” work
Film/TV Development Sector and Creative Collaborative Authorship
summary: Studies U.S. film and television production history and contemporary media industry labor, focusing on gender, race, and class in feminized and below-the-line creative work.
summary_zh: 研究美国电影电视制作史与当代媒介产业劳动，关注女性化及线下创意工作中的性别、种族与阶级问题。

name: Lilly Irani
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
areas: how technical practices are shaped by hierarchies of value
the cultural and economic project called ‘modernity.’
summary: Studies the cultural politics of high-tech work and innovation in India and global AI economies through ethnography, and designs software such as Turkopticon that offers alternatives to platforms.
summary_zh: 以民族志研究印度及全球人工智能经济中高科技工作与创新的文化政治，并设计如Turkopticon等为现有平台提供替代方案的软件。

name: Caroline Jack
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of advertising, corporate communication, and promotional culture, including how sponsored media such as PSAs, pamphlets, and educational films sold American capitalism.
summary_zh: 研究广告、企业传播与促销文化的历史，包括公益广告、小册子和教育影片等赞助媒介如何推销美国资本主义。

name: Shawna Kidman
title: Associate Professor
areas: contemporary issues related to pop culture and society
summary: Studies how corporate, legal, and financial systems shape entertainment, using business and legal history to examine broadcasting, streaming, film financing, copyright, and comics.
summary_zh: 运用商业史与法律史方法，研究企业、法律与金融体系如何塑造娱乐产业，涉及广播、流媒体、电影融资、版权与漫画。

name: Carol Padden
title: Distinguished Professor, Dean of the Division of Social Sciences
summary: Studies sign languages, especially American Sign Language, and how a new sign language develops structure such as word order across generations of signers.
summary_zh: 研究手语，特别是美国手语，以及一种新兴手语如何在几代使用者中形成语序等语言结构。

name: David Serlin
title: Professor
areas: Historical and cultural approaches to disability
summary: Studies the history and culture of disability, technology, and design, including architecture, material culture, and the senses, drawing on feminist, crip, and queer theories of embodiment.
summary_zh: 借助女性主义、残障（crip）与酷儿的身体理论，研究残障、技术与设计的历史与文化，包括建筑、物质文化与感官。

name: Christo Sims
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies technological change and social inequality through historically attuned ethnography, from tech-driven school reform to Silicon Valley's growth amid ecological limits.
summary_zh: 以具有历史视角的民族志研究技术变迁与社会不平等，从技术驱动的学校改革到生态约束下的硅谷发展。

name: Megan Ybarra
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies radical placemaking in environmental justice and abolition organizing, using archival research, surveys, participant observation, and institutional ethnography, including in Guatemala.
summary_zh: 运用档案研究、问卷调查、参与观察与制度民族志，研究环境正义与废除主义组织中的激进地方营造，包括在危地马拉的研究。

name: Elana Zilberg
title: Associate Professor
areas: mobility between the United States and Latin America
the production of space and urban built environment
summary: Studies security, space, and mobility between the United States and Latin America, and urban river revitalization movements, using ethnographic methods.
summary_zh: 运用民族志方法研究美国与拉丁美洲之间的安全、空间与流动，以及城市河流复兴运动。

name: Caitlin Bruce
title: Chair, Dept. of Communication; Professor
summary: Studies how public art and graffiti scenes create spaces of encounter across social difference, examining visual rhetoric, affect and public space in transnational contexts.
summary_zh: 研究公共艺术与涂鸦场景如何为跨越社会差异的相遇创造空间，考察跨国语境中的视觉修辞、情感与公共空间。

name: Elfriede Fürsich
title: Director of Graduate Studies; Associate Professor
summary: Critically analyzes media representation in lifestyle genres such as travel journalism and food media, and how newsgames and global media shape discourses of diversity, migration and identity.
summary_zh: 批判性分析旅游新闻、美食媒体等生活方式类新闻中的媒介再现，以及新闻游戏和全球媒体如何塑造关于多元文化、移民与身份的话语。

name: Litzy Galarza
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies Latina/o/x media representation, citizenship and labor in the culture industries, critically analyzing U.S. television portrayals of Latinx belonging and immigration as well as advertising.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔媒介再现、公民身份以及文化产业中的劳动，批判性分析美国电视对拉丁裔归属与移民的呈现以及广告。

name: Paul Elliott Johnson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Takes a critical approach to political communication and public address, focusing on populist rhetoric by conservative forces in Western democracies, especially the United States.
summary_zh: 以批判性路径研究政治传播与公共演说，聚焦西方民主国家（尤其是美国）保守势力的民粹主义修辞。

name: Olga Kuchinskaya
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies science communication about health and environmental hazards from a feminist STS perspective, using archival and ethnographic research on Chernobyl radiation in Belarus.
summary_zh: 从女性主义科学技术研究视角研究健康与环境风险的科学传播，运用档案和民族志方法研究白俄罗斯的切尔诺贝利辐射问题。

name: Brenton J. Malin
title: Professor
summary: Studies media history, theory and criticism, analyzing how popular media and media technologies constitute identity, masculinity and emotion in American culture.
summary_zh: 研究媒介历史、理论与批评，分析流行媒体和媒介技术如何建构美国文化中的身份、男性气质与情感。

name: David L. Marshall
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intellectual history of rhetoric, from Giambattista Vico in early modern Europe to Weimar-era German thinkers, treating historical work as theoretical inquiry.
summary_zh: 研究修辞学的思想史，从近代早期欧洲的维柯到魏玛时期的德国思想家，将历史研究视为理论探究。

name: Calum Matheson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies propaganda, misinformation and conspiracy communities such as QAnon and Internet subcultures, drawing on rhetoric, media studies and psychoanalysis.
summary_zh: 借助修辞学、媒介研究和精神分析，研究宣传、虚假信息以及匿名者Q等阴谋论社群和网络亚文化。

name: Gordon R. Mitchell
title: Associate Professor; Associate Professor of Clinical and Translational Science
summary: Studies rhetoric and argumentation in military and healthcare contexts, including missile defense advocacy, intelligence analysis, preventive force and debate pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究军事和医疗语境中的修辞与论证，包括导弹防御倡导、情报分析、先发制人武力以及辩论教学。

name: Samantha Shorey
title: Assistant Professor
areas: automated technologies (AI and robots) in the workplace
summary: Studies how automated technologies such as AI and robots are adopted in the workplace, using ethnography, design research and critical making.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、设计研究和批判性制作方法，研究人工智能和机器人等自动化技术在工作场所中的采纳与应用。

name: Samuel Woolley
title: Associate Professor; William S. Dietrich II Endowed Chair in Disinformation Studies
summary: Studies computational propaganda and disinformation: how groups worldwide use social bots, AI, algorithms and influencers to manipulate public opinion online.
summary_zh: 研究计算宣传与虚假信息：世界各地的群体如何利用社交机器人、人工智能、算法和网红在网络上操纵舆论。

name: Ronald J. Zboray
title: Professor; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies communication history through a biographical lens, using diaries and letters to examine print culture, disability and the lives of disempowered people in antebellum America.
summary_zh: 以传记视角研究传播史，利用日记和书信考察美国内战前的印刷文化、残障以及弱势群体的生活经历。

name: Lance Yong Jin Park
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Chair
areas: Social and Policy Implications of New Technologies
summary: Studies the social and policy implications of new information and communication technologies, including the internet's economic, political and policy dimensions.
summary_zh: 研究新兴信息传播技术的社会与政策影响，包括互联网在经济、政治与政策层面的意涵。

name: Loren Saxton Coleman
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Critically examines how Black people engage community media, social media, television and the Black press, using cultural theory to study race, spatial justice and representation.
summary_zh: 以批判视角考察黑人如何参与社区媒体、社交媒体、电视与黑人报刊，运用文化理论研究种族、空间正义与再现政治。

name: Gyo Hyun Koo
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies, platform governance and journalistic practices shape perceptions and the spread of misinformation, using experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 运用实验与计算方法，研究传播技术、平台治理与新闻实践如何影响公众认知及虚假信息的传播。

name: Chuka Onwumechili
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies sport communication and media in Africa, especially Nigerian football, including historical media framing of race, footballer migration and women's football.
summary_zh: 研究非洲的体育传播与媒介，尤其是尼日利亚足球，包括种族议题的历史媒介框架、球员迁移与女子足球。

name: Monica Lindsey Ponder
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Associate Professor, Health Communication & Culture
areas: Critical & cultural approaches to health communication
Moving images as a tool for social justice
summary: Studies organization-level public health and crisis communication practice through womanist and radical Black feminist lenses, including arts, healing and moving images for social justice.
summary_zh: 以妇女主义与激进黑人女性主义视角研究组织层面的公共卫生与危机传播实践，并关注艺术、疗愈与影像在社会正义中的作用。

name: Wei Sun
dept: Department of Communication, Culture and Media Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies intercultural, international and health communication, including Black and Asian American clinical trial hesitancy, skin-lightening health risks, stigma and misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化、国际与健康传播，包括黑人与亚裔美国人对临床试验的犹豫、美白产品的健康风险、社会污名与虚假信息。

name: Iccha Basnyat
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intersections of culture, gender, and health in South and Southeast Asia, along with health information seeking, exchange, and sense-making.
summary_zh: 研究南亚与东南亚地区文化、性别与健康的交叉问题，并关注健康信息的寻求、交流与意义建构。

name: Carl Botan
title: Professor
areas: Strategic communication as it is used in both public relations and strategic and emergency communication
summary: Studies strategic communication as used in public relations and in strategic and emergency communication, including public relations theory.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系以及战略与应急传播中的战略传播，包括公共关系理论。

name: Melissa A. Broeckelman-Post
title: Professor
summary: Studies instructional communication and public speaking pedagogy in the basic communication course, along with interpersonal communication and communication theory.
summary_zh: 研究教学传播与基础传播课程中的公共演讲教学，同时关注人际传播与传播理论。

name: Xiaomei Cai
title: Professor
summary: Studies children and media, especially children's online privacy and parents' sharenting, along with media effects and adolescent health prevention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童与媒介，尤其是儿童网络隐私与父母“晒娃”行为，并关注媒介效果与青少年健康预防。

name: Chris Clarke
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health and environmental risk perception and message design on fracking, vaccine safety, and climate change, partly drawing on national survey data.
summary_zh: 研究水力压裂、疫苗安全与气候变化等议题中的健康与环境风险认知及信息设计，部分研究使用全国性调查数据。

name: Richard T Craig
title: Associate Chair; Professor
areas: Media representation of marginalized groups (race, gender, religion, etc.)
summary: Studies the political economy of media, including ownership, telecommunication policy, and media representation of marginalized groups in popular culture.
summary_zh: 研究媒介政治经济学，包括媒介所有权、电信政策，以及流行文化中对边缘群体的媒介再现。

name: Pratiti Diddi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social media shapes public relations and strategic communication in health and crisis-risk contexts, with attention to message design.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体如何影响健康与危机风险情境中的公共关系和战略传播，并关注信息设计。

name: Tim Gibson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies critical media studies and the political economy of communication, focusing on urban communication, gentrification, and homelessness.
summary_zh: 从批判媒介研究与传播政治经济学视角研究城市传播、绅士化与无家可归问题。

name: Lisa Gring-Pemble
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies argumentation, persuasion, and political communication about public policy through rhetorical criticism, alongside social innovation and entrepreneurship.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评研究论辩、说服以及围绕公共政策的政治传播，同时关注社会创新与创业。

name: Madeleine Holland
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the scholarship of teaching and learning in introductory communication courses and the experiences of stigmatized populations, especially around gender identity.
summary_zh: 研究入门传播课程中的教学与学习学术，以及污名化群体的经历，尤其关注性别认同。

name: Sojung Claire Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health and risk message design and misinformation correction on issues like cancer, vaccination, and climate change, using eye tracking.
summary_zh: 运用眼动追踪研究癌症、疫苗接种和气候变化等议题中的健康与风险信息设计及虚假信息纠正。

name: Edward Wile Maibach
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies climate change and public health communication and social marketing, including the Climate Change in the American Mind polling project and climate reporting by TV weathercasters.
summary_zh: 研究气候变化与公共卫生传播及社会营销，包括“美国人心中的气候变化”民意调查项目和电视气象播报员的气候报道。
kw: climate change in the american mind

name: Star A. Muir
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric and technology, including attention and distractibility among digital natives in teaching and learning, and earlier environmental communication.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与技术，包括“数字原住民”在教与学中的注意力与分心问题，早期亦研究环境传播。

name: Anne M. Nicotera
title: Professor
summary: Studies organizational communication from a constitutive perspective, developing structurational divergence theory and a measure of intractable conflict, especially in nursing and healthcare.
summary_zh: 从构成性视角研究组织传播，提出结构化分歧理论及其测量工具以解释难以化解的冲突，尤其关注护理与医疗组织。

name: Sergei A. Samoilenko
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies subversive strategic communication, character assassination, and reputation management, along with climate misinformation, crisis communication, and political campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究颠覆性战略传播、人格暗杀与声誉管理，并关注气候虚假信息、危机传播和政治竞选。

name: Kimberly Meltzer Weisman
title: Chair; Professor
summary: Studies how journalists adapt to change, including opinion and commentary in news, civility, and journalists as a community of practice.
summary_zh: 研究新闻工作者如何适应变化，包括新闻中的观点与评论、文明话语以及作为实践共同体的新闻从业者。

name: Kevin B Wright
title: Professor
summary: Studies social support and health outcomes, provider-patient interaction, family health, and social media in interpersonal relationships and health.
summary_zh: 研究社会支持与健康结果、医患互动、家庭健康，以及社交媒体在人际关系与健康中的作用。

name: Xiaoquan Zhao
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies health message design and effects, campaign evaluation, and health information seeking on tobacco control, substance use, cancer risk, and climate change.
summary_zh: 研究烟草控制、物质使用、癌症风险与气候变化等议题中的健康信息设计与效果、传播运动评估及健康信息寻求。

name: Kristen Hoerl
title: Professor
areas: Civil Rights, Feminism, Anti-Vietnam War movements
summary: Studies how popular film and television represent social activism, feminism, and antiracist struggle, using critical media criticism of Hollywood memories of the 1960s.
summary_zh: 通过对影视作品的批判性解读，研究流行电影与电视如何呈现社会运动、女性主义与反种族主义斗争，以及好莱坞对1960年代的记忆建构。

name: Satveer Kaur
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Health activism with precarious migrant workers
summary: Studies health disparities and communicative inequalities among marginalized communities, including migrant worker health activism and patient-provider bias, using multimethod research.
summary_zh: 采用多方法研究，考察边缘化社群面临的健康不平等与传播不平等，包括移民劳工的健康行动主义及医患沟通中的偏见。

name: Casey Kelly
title: Professor
summary: Studies the political and cultural rhetoric of the U.S. far right and white masculinity in film, television, and digital culture through psychoanalytic rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 借助精神分析取向的修辞批评，研究美国极右翼的政治与文化修辞，以及电影、电视和数字文化中的白人男性气质。

name: Jody Koenig Kellas
title: Willa Cather Professor
areas: Storytelling and narrative sense-making in relationships and families (the links between storytelling and health)
Communication in the context of health and illness (e.g., cancer)
The dark side of interpersonal and family communication and relationships
summary: Studies how storytelling and communicated narrative sense-making help individuals and families cope with difficulty and illness, and develops narrative-based interventions for caregiving.
summary_zh: 研究讲故事与沟通式叙事意义建构如何帮助个人与家庭应对困境和疾病，并开发基于叙事的照护干预。

name: Angela Palmer-Wackerly
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how identity, supportive communication, and decision-making shape health outcomes for rural, immigrant, and refugee communities using community-based participatory and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 运用社区参与式研究与混合方法，研究身份认同、支持性沟通与决策如何影响农村、移民及难民群体的健康结果。

name: Kate Siegfried
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the rhetoric of political exile, social movements, and anti-colonial internationalism through transnational archival research grounded in materialist philosophy.
summary_zh: 以唯物主义哲学为基础，通过跨国档案研究考察政治流亡、社会运动与反殖民国际主义的修辞。

name: Jordan Soliz
title: Chairperson, Professor and Leland J. and Dorothy H. Olson Chair in Arts and Sciences
areas: Changing bias and prejudice through interactions
summary: Studies intergroup and family communication, including multiethnic-racial and interfaith families, intergroup contact and dialogue that reduce prejudice, and identity socialization.
summary_zh: 研究群际与家庭传播，包括多族裔与跨信仰家庭、减少偏见的群际接触与对话，以及身份认同的社会化过程。

name: Paul Haridakis
title: Professor
summary: Studies media uses and effects, free speech law and media regulation, sports communication, and the role of YouTube and social media in political campaigns.
summary_zh: 研究媒介使用与效果、言论自由法律与媒体规制、体育传播，以及YouTube等社交媒体在政治竞选中的作用。

name: Laurie Bentley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal and rhetorical communication, including gender portrayals in Caldecott Medal-winning children's books.
summary_zh: 研究人际传播与修辞传播，包括凯迪克奖获奖童书中的性别呈现。

name: Ginger Bihn-Coss
title: Associate Professor
areas: Disenfranchisement, power and resistance in health decision-making
summary: Studies health communication across settings, focusing on how disenfranchisement, power and resistance shape health decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究不同情境下的健康传播，关注剥夺、权力与抵抗如何影响健康决策。

name: Bei Cai
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies intercultural and gender communication and Chinese political communication, including state legitimacy discourse, environmental rhetoric and U.S. media portrayals of other nations.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化与性别传播及中国政治传播，包括国家合法性话语、环境修辞以及美国媒体对他国的呈现。

name: Patrick Dillon
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses qualitative interviews and participant observation to study health inequality among marginalized populations, focusing on end-of-life care, HIV/AIDS and substance abuse.
summary_zh: 运用质性访谈与参与式观察研究边缘群体的健康不平等，聚焦临终关怀、艾滋病与药物滥用。

name: Nichole L. Egbert
title: Professor
summary: Studies social support, health literacy and religiosity in health contexts, including family communication and parents' COVID-19 vaccination intentions.
summary_zh: 研究健康情境中的社会支持、健康素养与宗教性，包括家庭沟通模式与父母的新冠疫苗接种意愿。

name: Erin Hollenbaugh
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of interpersonal and mediated communication, especially how people use media for interpersonal purposes.
summary_zh: 研究人际传播与媒介化传播的交叉，尤其是人们如何为人际目的使用媒体。

name: Yesim Kaptan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Uses media ethnography to study Middle Eastern and Turkish media, global media industries and how mediated identities negotiate nationalism and globalization.
summary_zh: 运用媒介民族志研究中东与土耳其媒体、全球媒体产业，以及媒介化身份如何协商民族主义与全球化。

name: Mei-Chen Lin
title: Professor
areas: Older adults' identity and intergenerational communication
summary: Studies older adults' identity, intergenerational and intergroup communication, elder abuse in family caregiving, and political identity and partisan media use.
summary_zh: 研究老年人身份认同、代际与群际传播、家庭照护中的老年虐待，以及政治身份与党派媒体使用。

name: Jennifer L. McCullough
title: Associate Professor & Basic Course Director
summary: Studies how parent-child communication and parental mediation strategies can reduce advertising's effects on children's materialism, and consumer communication among college students.
summary_zh: 研究亲子沟通与父母介入策略如何减轻广告对儿童物质主义的影响，以及大学生家庭中的消费传播。

name: J D Ponder
title: Associate Professor & Undergraduate Coordinator
summary: Studies how media use for political information shapes partisanship and political discussion with in-group and out-group members, and consumer communication among college students.
summary_zh: 研究获取政治信息的媒体使用如何影响党派倾向及与内外群体的政治讨论，以及大学生的消费传播。

name: Rekha Sharma
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mass and political communication across news, film, infotainment, fandom, political social media use and conspiracy-theory-oriented media.
summary_zh: 研究新闻、电影、资讯娱乐、粉丝文化、政治性社交媒体使用及阴谋论媒体中的大众与政治传播。

name: Ikram Toumi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ICT adoption, the digital divide and social change, including post-revolution Tunisia and transnational Tunisian family communication, plus media literacy and acculturation.
summary_zh: 研究信息通信技术采纳、数字鸿沟与社会变迁，包括革命后的突尼斯与跨国突尼斯家庭沟通，以及媒介素养与文化适应。

name: Tewodros Workneh
title: Associate Professor
areas: State-media relations in Ethiopia and the Ethiopian diaspora
summary: Uses critical political economy and postcolonial approaches to study global media flows, media policy and state-media relations in Ethiopia and its diaspora.
summary_zh: 运用批判政治经济学与后殖民视角研究全球媒体流动、媒体政策，以及埃塞俄比亚及其海外侨民中的国家—媒体关系。

name: Michael Beam
title: Professor & Interim School Director
areas: Personalized and algorithmic news recommender systems
New media systems and information distribution
summary: Studies algorithmic news recommender systems, partisan news and political polarization, political information processing, health communication and user experience design.
summary_zh: 研究算法新闻推荐系统、党派新闻与政治极化、政治信息处理、健康传播以及用户体验设计。

name: Luke Armour
title: Professor, Flash Communications Coordinator
summary: Teaches public relations, digital PR and social media strategy and coordinates a student PR agency; no specific research agenda is described.
summary_zh: 讲授公共关系、数字公关与社交媒体策略并负责学生公关机构；未描述具体研究方向。

name: Peter Bobkowski
title: Professor/Knight Chair in Scholastic Journalism
summary: Studies journalism education, scholastic journalism, young people's media practices and information literacy.
summary_zh: 研究新闻教育、中学校园新闻、青少年媒介实践与信息素养。

name: Karisa Butler-Wall
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Gender, sexuality and disability in media
summary: Studies gender, sexuality and disability in film, television and digital media from a critical media studies perspective, focusing on health and embodiment.
summary_zh: 从批判媒介研究视角研究电影、电视与数字媒体中的性别、性与残障，关注健康与身体。

name: Tara L. Conley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies race, gender and technology across feminist, Black and digital humanities scholarship, including archiving Twitter hashtag feminism, alongside documentary filmmaking.
summary_zh: 跨女性主义、黑人研究与数字人文研究种族、性别与技术，包括存档推特标签女性主义，并从事纪录片创作。

name: Kathryn Cooper
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how scientists and journalists can communicate contentious science and environmental issues, using documentaries and narratives to counter biased judgment and engage citizens.
summary_zh: 研究科学家与记者如何传播具有争议的科学与环境议题，借助纪录片和叙事克服偏见判断并促进公民参与。

name: Michele Ewing
title: Professor
summary: Focuses on public relations education and digital public relations, integrating web and social media strategy into PR curricula.
summary_zh: 关注公共关系教育与数字公关，将网络与社交媒体策略融入公关课程。

name: David A. Foster
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works in multimedia journalism, photojournalism and documentary studies.
summary_zh: 从事多媒体新闻、新闻摄影与纪实研究。

name: Scott Hallgren
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works in sound design, screen composition and film and television production as a creative practitioner.
summary_zh: 以创作实践者身份从事声音设计、影视配乐创作及影视制作。

name: Gretchen Hoak
title: Associate Professor
areas: Psychological effects of covering traumatic news on journalists
summary: Studies the psychological and emotional effects on journalists of covering traumatic news, including post-traumatic stress, compassion fatigue and emotional labor.
summary_zh: 研究报道创伤性新闻对记者的心理与情绪影响，包括创伤后应激、同情疲劳与情绪劳动。

name: Cheryl Ann Lambert
title: Associate Professor/Graduate Coordinator
areas: Portrayals of public relations in media and popular culture
summary: Studies how public relations is portrayed in media, popular culture and publicity campaigns, and researches health messaging.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系在媒体、流行文化与宣传活动中的呈现，并研究健康信息传播。

name: Andrea Lorenz
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Sustainability, innovation and representation in media
summary: Studies journalism and press-politics issues, conducting engaged research with organizations on sustainability, innovation and representation in media.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与媒体—政治议题，并与多方组织合作开展关于媒体可持续性、创新与再现的参与式研究。

name: Jacqueline A. Marino
title: Professor
areas: Audience reception to digital long-form journalism
summary: Studies literary journalism and the digital evolution of magazines, including audience reception of digital long-form journalism.
summary_zh: 研究文学新闻与杂志的数字化演变，包括受众对数字长篇新闻的接受。

name: Mitch McKenney
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how newsroom managers handle online challenges, legacy newsroom transformation, startup news sites, reader comments and unpublishing requests.
summary_zh: 研究新闻编辑室管理者如何应对网络挑战、传统新闻编辑室转型、新闻创业网站、读者评论与撤稿请求。

name: Stefanie Moore
title: Professor
summary: Focuses on digital public relations, digital analytics, social media strategy and crisis communication.
summary_zh: 关注数字公关、数字分析、社交媒体策略与危机传播。

name: Becky Rolnick
title: Assistant Professor/Adviser Flash Film Commission
summary: Works in documentary filmmaking and film and television production as an independent filmmaker.
summary_zh: 以独立电影人身份从事纪录片创作及影视制作。

name: Tang Tang
title: Professor
areas: Uses and effects of emerging media technologies
summary: Studies uses and effects of emerging media such as social media, virtual reality and esports, cross-platform media behavior during mega sporting events, and media management.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体、虚拟现实与电子竞技等新兴媒体的使用与效果、大型体育赛事期间的跨平台媒介行为以及媒体管理。

name: Dana White
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works in filmmaking, screenwriting, directing and producing as a creative practitioner.
summary_zh: 以创作实践者身份从事电影制作、编剧、导演与制片。

name: Joshua D. Atkinson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how activists use alternative media for communicative resistance and how activist media shape US political communication, drawing on interviews with activists and media producers.
summary_zh: 研究社运人士如何借助另类媒体开展传播抵抗，以及行动主义媒体如何影响美国主流政治传播，研究基于对社运人士与另类媒体生产者的访谈。

name: Cheryl Campanella Bracken
title: Professor and Director
summary: Studies psychological and physiological processing of media content and form, especially telepresence and binge-watching, alongside work on STEM faculty diversity and academic leadership.
summary_zh: 研究受众对媒介内容与形式的心理和生理加工，尤其是临场感与追剧行为，同时关注STEM教师多元化与学术领导力。

name: Rick Busselle
title: Associate Professor
areas: Social construction of reality through media
summary: Studies how mediated stories shape perceptions of social issues such as poverty and crime, focusing on narrative engagement, perceived realism and conceptual work on narrative persuasion.
summary_zh: 研究媒介叙事如何影响人们对贫困、犯罪等社会问题的认知，聚焦叙事卷入、感知真实性，并对叙事说服进行概念性探讨。

name: Bailey Dick
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Faith and religion in first-person writing
summary: Examines, as a historian and critical media scholar, how women writers integrate trauma into their work, including the history of #MeToo-style writing and faith in first-person writing.
summary_zh: 以历史学者和批判媒介研究者的视角，考察女性写作者如何将创伤经历融入作品，包括#MeToo式写作的历史及第一人称写作中的信仰。

name: John Dowd
title: Associate Professor
summary: Explores the symbolic-material aspects of discourse, education and technology, drawing on media ecology, rhetoric and social theory, with interests in organizational communication.
summary_zh: 借助媒介生态学、修辞学与社会理论，探讨话语、教育与技术的符号—物质面向，并关注组织传播。

name: Sandra Faulkner
title: Professor
areas: Critical qualitative methods and poetic inquiry
summary: Studies close relationships, sexualities and identity negotiation in interpersonal and family communication using critical qualitative methods, arts-based research and poetic inquiry.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系、性与身份在人际及家庭传播中的协商，采用批判性质性方法、艺术本位研究与诗性探究。

name: Jim Foust
title: Professor
summary: Studies the history of US electronic media and communication law, using historical research on broadcast regulation and technology, plus online journalism and journalism education.
summary_zh: 研究美国电子媒介史与传播法，以历史研究考察广播规制与传播技术，并涉及网络新闻和新闻教育。

name: Radhika Gajjala
title: Professor
summary: Studies globalization, digital labor, feminism and digital diasporas, using feminist ethnography of South Asian women and online communities across the global north and south.
summary_zh: 研究全球化、数字劳动、女性主义与数字离散社群，以女性主义民族志考察南亚女性及横跨全球南北的网络社群。

name: Alberto Gonzalez
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Examines political discourses surrounding immigrant identities and popular music as rhetoric through intercultural communication and rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 运用跨文化传播视角与修辞批评，考察围绕移民身份的政治话语以及作为修辞的流行音乐。

name: Ellen Gorsevski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Analyzes the rhetoric and embodied communication of leaders in peacebuilding, social justice and environmental movements, using rhetorical and media criticism.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评与媒介批评，分析和平建设、社会正义与环境运动领袖的修辞及具身传播实践。

name: Louisa Ha
title: Distinguished Research Professor
summary: Studies misinformation, social media influencers, online video, and online and international advertising, with comparative cross-national work on audiences and international conflicts.
summary_zh: 研究虚假信息、社交媒体网红、网络视频以及网络与国际广告，并开展关于受众和国际冲突的跨国比较研究。

name: Lisa Hanasono
title: Professor
summary: Studies how mentoring, academic leadership, supportive communication and institutional change support faculty and student success and reveal the hidden curriculum of higher education.
summary_zh: 研究导师制、学术领导力、支持性传播与制度变革如何促进教师和学生的发展，并揭示高等教育中的隐性课程。

name: Xiaofeng Jia
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how message and creator traits shape engagement with AI chatbots and social media in strategic and health communication, using quantitative and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究信息与内容创作者特征如何影响AI聊天机器人、社交媒体等新兴平台上的互动，涉及战略与健康传播，采用量化与计算方法。

name: Ilyoung Ju
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies advertising effectiveness and consumer psychology, including nostalgic advertising, influencer marketing and word-of-mouth.
summary_zh: 研究广告效果与消费者心理，包括怀旧广告、网红营销与口碑传播。

name: Lara Martin Lengel
title: Professor
areas: Gender and identity in transnational performance studies
summary: Studies international and critical intercultural communication, including gender and identity in transnational performance, and communication for social, economic and environmental justice.
summary_zh: 研究国际与批判性跨文化传播，包括跨国表演中的性别与身份，以及传播如何推进社会、经济与环境正义。

name: Yanqin Lu
title: Associate Professor
areas: Emerging media use and political attitudes
summary: Studies how social and emerging media use shapes political attitudes, engagement and perceptions of fake news, using survey research.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与新兴媒体使用如何影响政治态度、政治参与及对假新闻的认知，采用调查研究方法。

name: Terry Rentner
title: Professor
summary: Studies crisis, health and sport communication and public relations, including health campaigns, social marketing and social norms programming for college students.
summary_zh: 研究危机传播、健康传播、体育传播与公共关系，包括健康运动、社会营销以及面向大学生的社会规范干预项目。

name: Clayton Rosati
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies, as a geographer, the political economy of urban culture industries and how technology and the built environment produce mass culture, including New York City and MTV.
summary_zh: 以地理学视角研究城市文化产业的政治经济学，以及技术与建成环境如何生产大众文化，涉及纽约市与MTV。

name: Divya S
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies human-machine communication, examining how conversational agents and AI-driven technologies can advance health, strengthen interpersonal relationships and support wellbeing.
summary_zh: 研究人机传播，考察对话代理与AI驱动技术如何促进健康、加强人际关系并支持身心福祉。

name: Stine Eckert
title: Associate Professor
areas: Journalism Studies, Journalism and News Media
summary: Studies gender and intersectionality in journalism, public sphere and counterpublic theory, and online hate speech and harassment.
summary_zh: 研究新闻业中的性别与交叉性问题、公共领域与反公共领域理论，以及网络仇恨言论与骚扰。

name: Michael Fuhlhage
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cultural history of US journalism, from the antebellum and Civil War press to civil rights reporting, and news coverage of race, Latinos and immigration.
summary_zh: 研究美国新闻业的文化史，从内战前与内战时期的报刊到民权运动报道，并关注新闻对种族、拉丁裔与移民的报道。

name: Rosie Jahng
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media effects, digital media, crisis public relations and science communication, including journalists' handling of fake news and scientific uncertainty, using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究媒介效果、数字媒体、危机公关与科学传播，包括记者如何应对假新闻与科学不确定性，并采用计算研究方法。

name: Loraleigh Keashly
title: Professor, Communication; Wayne State University Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies conflict, incivility and bullying in workplaces, especially academia, and how organizational structure and culture enable or prevent them.
summary_zh: 研究职场（尤其是学术界）中的冲突、不文明行为与霸凌，以及组织结构与文化如何助长或预防这些行为。

name: Katheryn Maguire
title: Professor; Member, Academy of Teachers
areas: Dark Side Issues in Interpersonal Communication
summary: Studies how people use communication to maintain relationships and cope with stress, including long-distance relationships, computer-mediated interaction and work-family conflict.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何借助沟通维系关系、应对压力，包括异地恋、计算机中介互动与工作-家庭冲突。

name: Patricia McCormick
title: Associate Professor
areas: Use of satellites and drones for monitoring climate change
summary: Studies telecommunications and space policy and the use of drones and satellites to monitor climate change, water scarcity and migration, focusing on MENA, the EU, Africa and the Caribbean.
summary_zh: 研究电信与太空政策，以及利用无人机和卫星监测气候变化、水资源短缺与移民，关注中东北非、欧盟、非洲与加勒比地区。

name: Rahul Mitra
title: Associate Professor of Organizational Communication; Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies organizing around environmental resources, corporate social responsibility and meaningful work using ethnography, interviews, focus groups and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究环境资源组织、企业社会责任与有意义的工作，采用民族志、访谈、焦点小组与话语分析等方法。

name: Anita Mixon
title: Assistant Professor and Basic Course Director COM 1010
summary: Studies African American rhetoric, analyzing how Black speakers, writers and activists advocate for equality and social change, including rhetoric of Black maternal health.
summary_zh: 研究非裔美国人修辞，分析黑人演说者、作家与行动者如何倡导平等与社会变革，也涉及黑人孕产妇健康的修辞。

name: Jessica Moorman
title: Assistant Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how media and gender norms shape Black women's singlehood and sexual socialization, using interviews in Detroit, and how screen media affects young children's health.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与性别规范如何塑造黑人女性的单身与性社会化（以底特律访谈为基础），以及屏幕媒介如何影响幼儿健康。

name: Julie Novak
title: Associate Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
areas: risk and crisis communication issues pertaining to health and food safety
issues of disability through narrative and autoethnographic analyses
summary: Studies health, risk and crisis communication on food safety and disability, using mixed methods, critical interpretive and autoethnographic analysis, including Arab American communities in Detroit.
summary_zh: 研究食品安全与残障相关的健康、风险与危机传播，采用混合方法、批判阐释与自我民族志分析，并关注底特律阿拉伯裔社区。

name: Hayg Oshagan
title: Associate Professor
areas: relationship of individuals to the mass media
summary: Studies mass media effects on perception and public opinion, how media frame debates, and the role of ethnic media in ethnic communities and identity.
summary_zh: 研究大众媒介对认知与舆论的影响、媒介如何框架公共议题，以及少数族裔媒体在族裔社区与身份认同中的作用。

name: Donyale Padgett
title: Associate Professor -- Diversity, Culture & Communication
areas: Inclusive leadership and compassionate response to social crises
summary: Studies crisis rhetoric and organizational legitimacy, culture and diversity in communication, hip hop identity and social movement rhetoric from a critical perspective.
summary_zh: 从批判视角研究危机修辞与组织合法性、传播中的文化与多元性、嘻哈文化身份以及社会运动修辞。

name: Matthew Seeger
title: Distinguished Professor
areas: the role of media in crisis
failure of complex systems and post-crisis renewal
summary: Studies crisis and risk communication, health promotion, agency coordination, crisis ethics, and failure of complex systems and post-crisis renewal.
summary_zh: 研究危机与风险传播、健康促进、机构协调、危机伦理，以及复杂系统失灵与危机后复苏。

name: Pradeep Sopory
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies message design and effects in health, risk and science communication, especially how metaphor and figurative language shape attitudes, and evidence synthesis methodology.
summary_zh: 研究健康、风险与科学传播中的信息设计与效果，尤其是隐喻与修辞性语言如何影响态度，以及证据综合方法论。

name: Elizabeth Stoycheff
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social media and technology shape public opinion about democracy, including surveillance, censorship, content moderation and disinformation, using large-scale surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与技术如何塑造公众对民主的看法，涉及监控、审查、内容审核与虚假信息，采用大规模调查与实验。

name: Stephanie Tong
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people initiate, maintain and end relationships through social media and relational technologies, including AI.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何借助社交媒体与关系型技术（包括人工智能）建立、维系与结束人际关系。

name: Fred Vultee
title: Professor
summary: Studies media framing, news routines and securitization, using content analysis of media content and examining how frames shape audience attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究媒介框架、新闻常规与安全化议题，运用内容分析考察媒介内容，并探讨框架如何影响受众态度。

name: Kelly Young
title: Interim Dean, College of Fine, Performing and Communication Arts; Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies argumentation and rhetoric of public memory, protest and controversy, Native American discourse, and competitive speech and debate pedagogy through rhetorical criticism.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评研究论辩以及公共记忆、抗议与争议的修辞、美洲原住民话语，以及竞技演讲与辩论教学。

name: Roger Aden
title: Charles E. Zumkehr Professor of Speech Communication
summary: Studies how places such as the National Mall become rhetorically constructed sites of public memory and fan pilgrimage, using rhetorical and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用修辞与质性方法，研究国家广场等地点如何被修辞性地建构为公共记忆与粉丝朝圣之地。

name: Jonathan Baker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how everyday talk and public discourse, from patient–clinician encounters to policy, shape structural health disparities, difficult health conversations, and communicating difference.
summary_zh: 研究从医患互动到公共政策的日常言谈与公共话语如何塑造结构性健康不平等、困难的健康对话以及对差异的沟通。

name: Benjamin R. Bates
title: Professor, Health Communication
