areas: Communication and International Health and Development
summary: Studies the public understanding of health and healing, health campaigns and messaging, and international health and development, combining rhetorical, critical, qualitative, and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 结合修辞、批判、质性与量化方法，研究公众对健康与疗愈的理解、健康传播活动与信息设计，以及国际健康与发展传播。

name: Christina S. Beck
title: Interim Director of the School of Communication Studies
summary: Studies the intersection of health communication, popular culture, celebrity, and fandom, including how celebrity health narratives and pandemic messaging reach media audiences.
summary_zh: 研究健康传播与流行文化、名人和粉丝文化的交汇，包括名人健康叙事与疫情信息如何触达媒介受众。

name: Devika Chawla
title: Professor of Interpersonal Communication
summary: Studies family, home, and social identity in urban north India, including arranged marriage and Partition refugees, using ethnography, oral history, and life history methods.
summary_zh: 运用民族志、口述史与生命史方法，研究印度北部城市中的家庭、家园与社会身份，包括包办婚姻与印巴分治难民。

name: Matthew deTar
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the concepts in public discourse that produce national identity and political action in Turkey and the Middle East, using rhetorical analysis and conceptual history.
summary_zh: 运用修辞分析与概念史方法，研究土耳其及中东地区公共话语中塑造民族认同与政治行动的核心概念。

name: Lynn Harter
title: Professor and Co-Director of the Barbara Geralds Institute for Storytelling and Social Impact
summary: Studies how storytelling and art function in health organizing, public advocacy, and social change, drawing on narrative, aesthetic, and feminist perspectives.
summary_zh: 借助叙事、美学与女性主义视角，研究讲故事与艺术如何在健康组织、公共倡导与社会变革中发挥作用。

name: Angela M. Hosek
title: Interim Associate Dean, Professor School of Communication Studies
summary: Studies how social group membership and identity shape relational communication in instructional settings and families, including narrative sense-making about birth, breastfeeding, and parenting.
summary_zh: 研究社会群体归属与身份如何影响教学情境和家庭中的关系沟通，包括围绕分娩、哺乳与育儿的叙事意义建构。

name: Sarah E. Jones
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the power and politics of gender in organizations, including membership and commodification in the breastmilk banking industry, using critical-qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用批判质性方法，研究组织中性别的权力与政治，包括母乳库产业中的成员身份与商品化问题。

name: Inbal Leibovits
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people experiencing homelessness and survivors of intimate partner violence participate in civic and policymaking processes, using community-engaged ethnographic and rhetorical methods.
summary_zh: 运用社区参与式民族志与修辞方法，研究无家可归者和亲密伴侣暴力幸存者如何参与公民与政策制定过程。

name: Jerry L. Miller
title: Professor, Director of the Political Communication Certificate Program, Ohio Fellows Faculty Mentor
summary: Studies political communication, including political advertising and debates, along with place-based research and the teaching of political communication and rhetoric.
summary_zh: 研究政治传播，包括政治广告与政治辩论，并关注在地化研究以及政治传播与政治修辞的教学。

name: Brittany L. Peterson
title: Professor | Director of E-Learning, Scripps College of Communication
summary: Studies the communicative construction of organizational membership, from involuntary membership of inmates to high-stakes volunteering and stigmatized members such as parolees.
summary_zh: 研究组织成员身份的传播建构，涵盖囚犯的非自愿成员身份、高风险志愿服务以及假释人员等受污名化成员。

name: Scott Titsworth
title: Professor
summary: Studies classroom communication effectiveness, including how students' emotional experiences relate to note-taking, learning activities, and cognitive performance.
summary_zh: 研究课堂传播的有效性，包括学生的情绪体验如何与记笔记、学习活动及认知表现相关联。

name: China Billotte Verhoff
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies stigma, social support, and disclosure among people with marginalized identities across interpersonal and organizational contexts, including maternity leave and maternal rage.
summary_zh: 在人际与组织传播的交汇处研究边缘化身份群体的污名、社会支持与自我披露，包括产假与母亲愤怒等议题。

name: Candice Rios Wenmoth
title: Assistant Professor & Internship Coordinator | Associate Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies the role of vulnerability in storytelling competitions, drawing on narrative performance and storytelling.
summary_zh: 研究讲故事比赛中脆弱性表达的作用，借鉴叙事表演与讲故事研究。

name: Nicole Blau
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication in interpersonal, family, group, and health contexts, with an interest in the scholarship of teaching and learning.
summary_zh: 研究人际、家庭、群体与健康情境中的传播，并关注教学学术研究。

name: Purba Das
title: Professor
summary: Studies nations, media, and health narratives in populations in India and the United States from a critical intercultural and health communication perspective.
summary_zh: 从批判性的跨文化与健康传播视角，研究印度与美国人群中的国家、媒介与健康叙事问题。

name: Sarah E. Mahan-Hays
title: Associate Professor of Communication Studies
summary: No research statement is available; trained in rhetorical studies and teaches persuasion, communication theory, and interpersonal and family communication.
summary_zh: 暂无研究介绍；修辞学博士出身，讲授说服、传播理论以及人际与家庭传播等课程。

name: Rita M. Ng
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies culture and communication with a focus on Confucianism and Chinese perspectives on rhetoric and communication.
summary_zh: 研究文化与传播，聚焦儒家思想以及中国视角下的修辞与传播。

name: Candice Thomas-Maddox
title: Professor, Associate Director for Online Graduate Programs
summary: Works in interpersonal, family, and organizational communication and communication pedagogy, including team-based and community-based learning.
summary_zh: 从事人际、家庭与组织传播以及传播教学法研究，包括团队学习与社区服务学习。

name: Lisa Wallace
title: Associate Professor
summary: No research description is available; holds a communication studies faculty appointment on the Athens and Chillicothe campuses.
summary_zh: 暂无研究介绍；在雅典校区与奇利科西校区担任传播学教职。

name: Janice Marie Collins
title: Associate Professor; Director of the Institute for International Journalism
summary: Works on broadcast and digital journalism, media storytelling for social impact, de-marginalization, and leadership development, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 采用混合研究方法，关注广播与数字新闻、面向社会影响的媒介叙事、去边缘化以及领导力发展。

name: Ken Collins
title: Associate Professor/Coordinator of Electronic Media
summary: No research statement is available; background in broadcast news and audio production, including an audio production textbook.
summary_zh: 暂无研究介绍；背景为广播新闻与音频制作，合著有音频制作教材。

name: Craig Davis
title: Professor
summary: No research statement is available; brings agency experience in interactive and integrated advertising and marketing for consumer and technology brands.
summary_zh: 暂无研究介绍；拥有为消费品与科技品牌从事互动与整合广告营销的广告公司经验。

name: Bernhard Debatin
title: Professor
summary: Studies media ethics, theory of the public sphere, mass media and communication theory, metaphor theory, new media, and international media.
summary_zh: 研究媒介伦理、公共领域理论、大众传播与传播理论、隐喻理论、新媒体以及国际媒介。

name: Aimee Edmondson
title: Interim Dean, Scripps College of Communication; Professor, E.W. Scripps School of Journalism
summary: Studies media law and journalism history, focusing on libel law, public records law, and free expression, including the use of libel law during the U.S. civil rights struggle.
summary_zh: 研究媒介法与新闻史，聚焦诽谤法、公共记录法与表达自由，包括美国民权运动时期诽谤法的使用与滥用。

name: Kelly K. Ferguson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works on longform and immersion journalism and the researched essay, using narrative tools of creative nonfiction to craft true stories.
summary_zh: 从事长篇与沉浸式新闻及研究型随笔写作，运用创意非虚构的叙事技巧讲述真实故事。

name: Elizabeth Meyers Hendrickson
title: Professor, Associate Director for Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies podcasting, magazine editing and production, celebrity journalism, media organization and ownership, and journalism pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究播客、杂志编辑与制作、名人新闻、媒介组织与所有权以及新闻教学。

name: Parul Jain
title: Professor; Associate Director for Undergraduate Online Education, Scripps College of Communication
summary: Studies how media can promote health behavior and reduce disparities, narrative processing effects on attitudes, and patient–provider communication of international medical graduates.
summary_zh: 研究传统与新媒体如何促进健康行为并减少健康不平等、叙事加工对态度的影响，以及国际医学毕业生医生的医患沟通。

name: Hans Meyer
title: Professor; Director of the E.W. Scripps School of Journalism
summary: Studies what motivates citizen contributions to online news, credibility and audience community online, and how social media, VR, and 360-degree video connect journalists and audiences.
summary_zh: 研究公民参与网络新闻的动机、网络媒体中的受众社群与可信度，以及社交媒体、虚拟现实和360度视频如何连接记者与受众。

name: Bill Reader
title: Professor
areas: Various forms of audience feedback (letters to the editor, online comments, etc.)
summary: Studies community and participatory journalism, applied journalism ethics, and audience feedback in the news media such as letters to the editor and online comments.
summary_zh: 研究社区新闻与参与式新闻、应用新闻伦理，以及读者来信和网络评论等新闻媒体中的受众反馈。

name: Jatin Srivastava
title: Professor, Associate Director for Graduate Studies
summary: Conducts theory-based research on the new media environment, including interactions between media and society and new media and health communication in India.
summary_zh: 开展基于理论的新媒体环境研究，包括印度的媒介与社会互动以及新媒体与健康传播。

name: Benjamin Tetteh
title: Assistant Professor, Journalism
summary: Studies threats to journalistic editorial independence and the mechanisms journalists use to cope with them, drawing on investigative and documentary journalism experience.
summary_zh: 研究新闻编辑独立性面临的威胁以及记者应对这些威胁的机制，并结合其调查报道与纪录片实践经验。

name: Mark Turner
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies diversity and inclusion in newsgathering and media leadership, young journalists' role perceptions, and news coverage of online social movements.
summary_zh: 研究新闻采集与媒体领导层中的多元与包容、年轻记者的角色认知，以及新闻媒体对网络社会运动的报道。

name: Josh Antonuccio
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Director, School of Media Arts & Studies + Associate Professor
areas: Music business, entrepreneurship, technology, and the emerging music industry
summary: Studies the music business and emerging music industry, entrepreneurship and technology, artificial intelligence and music, music production, and experiential learning.
summary_zh: 研究音乐商业与新兴音乐产业、创业与技术、人工智能与音乐、音乐制作以及体验式学习。

name: Eddie Ashworth
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor of Music Production and Recording Industry
areas: History of the recording industry and popular music
Commerce and culture on the creation of popular music
The history and development of the recording industry
summary: Studies the history and development of the recording industry, how technology, commerce, and culture shape popular music, the post-modern music business, and audio preservation.
summary_zh: 研究唱片产业的历史与发展、技术商业与文化如何塑造流行音乐、后现代音乐商业以及音频保存与修复。

name: Tyler Ayres
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor + Transfer & Advising Coordinator
summary: Works in character animation and short animated storytelling.
summary_zh: 从事角色动画与动画短片叙事创作。

name: Roger Cooper
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Professor, Director, Semester-in-LA Program
areas: Career Development for the Media Professions
summary: Studies the personality attributes that lead to success in media and creative professions, along with cross-platform audience behaviors and sports fandom.
summary_zh: 研究促成媒体与创意行业成功的人格特质，以及跨平台受众行为与体育粉丝文化。

name: Laeeq Khan
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor, Media Arts & Studies; Director, Social Media Analytics Research Team (SMART) Lab
summary: Studies audience engagement, content virality, and brand strategy on digital platforms, health and crisis messaging, and ethical AI adoption, using social media analytics.
summary_zh: 运用社交媒体数据分析，研究数字平台上的受众参与、内容病毒式传播与品牌策略、健康与危机信息传播以及AI的伦理采用。

name: Frederick Lewis
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Professor
summary: Works in documentary production and studies and screenwriting, including documentaries on artist and activist Rockwell Kent.
summary_zh: 从事纪录片制作与研究以及编剧，包括关于艺术家和社会活动家罗克韦尔·肯特的纪录片。

name: Greg Newton
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor; Associate Dean of Academic Affairs, Graduate College; Faculty Advisor, ACRN (All-Campus Radio Network) Media
areas: Free speech and the regulation of electronic media
Management and leadership in media businesses
summary: Studies radio and TV programming and promotion, free speech and the regulation of electronic media, and management and leadership in media businesses.
summary_zh: 研究广播电视节目编排与推广、电子媒介的言论自由与监管，以及媒体企业的管理与领导。

name: Eve Ng
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Professor
summary: Studies queer media production and consumption, fan cultures, digital media cultures including cancel culture, and LGBTQ activism from a critical media studies perspective.
summary_zh: 从批判媒介研究视角，研究酷儿媒介的生产与消费、粉丝文化、包括取消文化在内的数字媒介文化以及LGBTQ行动主义。

name: Beth Novak
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Dean for Academic Affairs and Director of the Honors Tutorial Programs, Associate Professor
summary: Works on immersive storytelling, user interface design, and the history and production of animation, including theme parks and digital games.
summary_zh: 从事沉浸式叙事、用户界面设计以及动画历史与制作，涉及主题公园与数字游戏。

name: Saumya Pant
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor, School of Media Arts & Studies,; Director, Communication and Development Studies
summary: Studies gender equity, communication for social change, entertainment-education, and indigenous identity through folk culture via participatory field research in Ecuador, Norway, and India.
summary_zh: 通过在厄瓜多尔、挪威和印度开展参与式田野研究，探讨性别平等、社会变革传播、娱乐教育以及原住民借助民间文化重塑身份。

name: Brian Plow
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: No research statement is available; works as a documentary and narrative filmmaker with an emphasis on storytelling, technology, and community engagement.
summary_zh: 暂无研究介绍；作为纪录片与剧情片导演，注重叙事、技术与社区参与。

name: Kate Raney
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Assistant Professor + Undergraduate Coordinator
summary: Works in traditional animation and visual storytelling, combining live action and animation to investigate gender representation in the digital age.
summary_zh: 从事传统动画与视觉叙事创作，结合真人影像与动画探讨数字时代的性别再现。

name: Wolfgang Suetzl
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor
summary: Works as a philosopher and media theorist on media activism and critical perspectives on the information society.
summary_zh: 以哲学与媒介理论视角研究媒介行动主义以及对信息社会的批判性观点。

name: Lawrence Wood
dept: School of Media Arts and Studies
title: Associate Professor, Media Arts & Studies
summary: Studies mobile photography on Instagram and how it perpetuates geographic stereotypes, along with the digital divide, rural development policy, and media constructions of poverty.
summary_zh: 研究Instagram等社交媒体上的手机摄影及其如何强化地域刻板印象，并关注数字鸿沟、农村发展政策与媒体对贫困的建构。

name: Ronald Bishop
title: Professor
summary: Studies investigative and sports journalism, sourcing patterns, journalism history and the cultural history of fame through textual, narrative and ideological analysis.
summary_zh: 研究调查性报道与体育新闻、新闻信源模式、新闻史及名声的文化史，采用文本、叙事与意识形态分析方法。

name: Bernat Ivancsics
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies data and computational journalism, the use of machine learning and automation in digital news, and the history of computational communication technologies.
summary_zh: 研究数据新闻与计算新闻、机器学习和自动化在数字新闻中的应用，以及计算传播技术的历史。

name: Nahyun Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategic communication including relationship, reputation and crisis management and CSR/CSA, plus science and environmental communication and audiences' emotional and cognitive responses.
summary_zh: 研究战略传播，包括关系管理、声誉管理、危机传播与企业社会责任/社会倡导，以及科学与环境传播和公众的情绪与认知反应。

name: Hyunmin “Min” Lee
title: Professor; Interim Department Head; Graduate Faculty Member, Communication, Culture & Media
summary: Studies public relations strategies for organizational relationship and reputation management, including AI, social media and crisis storytelling, and strategic health messaging.
summary_zh: 研究组织关系与声誉管理中的公共关系策略，包括人工智能、社交媒体与危机叙事，以及战略性健康信息传播。

name: Alexander Nikolaev
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations, political and crisis communication, international negotiations and international news coverage, using political discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系、政治传播与危机传播、国际谈判及国际新闻报道，采用政治话语分析方法。

name: Douglas V. Porpora
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people converse and argue politically and morally in chatrooms and on Twitter, combining quantitative content analysis with qualitative discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在聊天室和推特上进行政治与道德层面的交谈和争论，结合定量内容分析与定性话语分析。

name: Rachel R. Reynolds
title: Professor; Graduate Faculty Member, Communication, Culture & Media
summary: Studies portrayals of violence against women and multilingual productions in television and streaming video, using multimodal discourse analysis of content and audience-producer dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究电视与流媒体视频中对女性暴力的呈现及多语种影视作品，运用多模态话语分析考察内容及受众与制作者之间的互动。

name: Wesley Shumar
title: Professor; Director, Graduate Programs in Communication, Culture & Media; Graduate Faculty Member, Communication, Culture & Media
areas: Consumer Culture and the Production of Value
summary: Studies the commodification of culture and production of value, cultural change in American higher education, and how digital technologies and AI shape online learning interactions.
summary_zh: 研究文化商品化与价值生产、美国高等教育的文化变迁，以及数字技术和人工智能如何塑造在线学习中的互动。

name: Asta Zelenkauskaite
title: Professor; Graduate Faculty Member, Communication, Culture & Media
summary: Studies emergent online practices, disinformation, inauthentic coordinated behavior and gendered interaction on social media, using mixed-method analysis of user-generated content across cultures.
summary_zh: 研究网络新兴实践、虚假信息、协同性不真实行为及社交媒体上的性别化互动，采用混合方法分析跨文化情境中的用户生成内容。

name: Hannah Ball
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies theory-driven health campaign messaging, psychological reactance in persuasion, and adult child-parent caregiving communication using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 运用定量与定性方法，研究以理论为导向的健康运动信息设计、说服中的心理抗拒，以及成年子女与年迈父母之间的照护沟通。

name: Jennifer Bevan
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people communicatively negotiate difficult relational interactions such as conflict, jealousy, caregiving, chronic illness and online surveillance, and their health correlates.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在冲突、嫉妒、照护、慢性病和网络监视等困难关系互动中进行沟通协商，以及这些经历与身心健康的关联。

name: Rebecca Tukachinsky Forster
title: Professor
summary: Studies media psychology: how audiences choose, process and are influenced by media, including parasocial bonds with characters and celebrities, racial stereotypes, identity and media literacy.
summary_zh: 研究媒介心理学：受众如何选择、理解媒介并受其影响，包括与角色和名人的准社会关系、种族刻板印象、身份认同与媒介素养。

name: Mark Hopson
title: Professor
summary: Studies culture, African American rhetorical traditions, social movement rhetoric and organizational diversity using rhetorical and qualitative methods such as autoethnography.
summary_zh: 运用修辞研究及自传民族志等质性方法，研究传播与文化，包括非裔美国人修辞传统、社会运动修辞、组织多元化与暴力预防传播。

name: Sophie Janicke-Bowles
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies positive media psychology: how traditional and new media shape self-transcendent emotions, prosocial behavior, character development, well-being, spirituality and entertainment enjoyment.
summary_zh: 研究积极媒介心理学：传统与新媒体如何影响自我超越情绪、亲社会行为、品格发展、幸福感、灵性以及娱乐享受。

name: Wenshan Jia
title: Professor
summary: Studies intercultural and global communication theory, especially communication between East Asia and the West, China's globalization and the Belt and Road Initiative, and peace and harmony.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化与全球传播理论，尤其关注东亚与西方之间的传播、中国特色的全球化与“一带一路”倡议，以及和平与和谐。

name: Vikki Katz
title: Professor; Fletcher Jones Foundation Endowed Chair in Free Speech
areas: young people and parents navigating technology use
equitable access to digital and educational opportunities
summary: Studies how young people and parents, especially lower-income and immigrant families, navigate technology use and digital inequality, and develops civil discourse interventions for youth.
summary_zh: 研究青少年与家长（尤其是低收入和移民家庭）如何应对技术使用与数字不平等，并为青少年开发公民对话干预项目。

name: Sara LaBelle
title: Associate Professor; Associate Dean of Graduate Education
summary: Studies instructional and health communication, including teacher authenticity, student-to-student confirmation, faculty-student talk about mental health, and health campaigns on stimulant misuse.
summary_zh: 研究教学传播与健康传播，包括教师真实性、学生间认可、师生间关于心理健康的沟通，以及针对处方兴奋剂滥用的健康运动。

name: Gabriel Miao Li
title: Assistant Professor
areas: public attitudes toward public policies and political issues
summary: Studies how beliefs, information and heuristics shape public attitudes toward contentious policies, and applies statistical and computational methods to misinformation correction and public opinion.
summary_zh: 研究信念、信息与启发式如何塑造公众对争议性政策的态度，并运用统计与计算方法研究虚假信息纠正效果和舆论。

name: Michelle Miller-Day
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of family and health communication, including mother-daughter relationships, mental health, narratives in health, and substance use prevention programs for youth.
summary_zh: 研究家庭传播与健康传播的交叉领域，包括母女关系、心理健康、健康叙事以及面向青少年的物质滥用预防项目。

name: Lisa Sparks
title: Professor; Foster and Mary McGaw Endowed Professor in Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies health and risk communication, with emphasis on cancer communication, caregiving and communication in aging.
summary_zh: 研究健康与风险传播，重点关注癌症传播、照护以及老龄化过程中的传播。

name: Rachel Wade
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how strategic message design interacts with audience identity to shape persuasion, experimentally testing metacognitive and affective processes in health, politics and sustainability.
summary_zh: 研究战略信息设计如何与受众身份交互影响说服效果，通过实验检验健康、政治与可持续议题信息中的元认知与情感过程。

name: Keith Weber
title: Professor; Interim Dean for the School of Communication; Interim Dean of the School of Communication
summary: Studies campaign and strategic message design, audience segmentation and social movement campaigns, with expertise in research methodology and statistics.
summary_zh: 研究传播运动与战略信息设计、受众细分以及社会运动传播运动，专长于研究方法与统计。

name: Mike Allen
title: Professor
areas: Social influence in personal, relational, organizational, media, and public contexts
summary: Studies social influence across personal, relational, organizational, media, and public contexts, often synthesizing research through meta-analysis.
summary_zh: 研究个人、关系、组织、媒体与公共情境中的社会影响，常以元分析方法整合既有研究。

name: Xiaoxia Cao
title: Professor
summary: Studies persuasion and media effects in health, political, and charitable appeals, including message framing and stigmatizing campaigns, using online experiments.
summary_zh: 研究健康、政治与慈善诉求中的说服与媒介效果，包括信息框架和污名化宣传，并采用在线实验方法。

name: Derek Handley
title: Associate Professor; Affiliated Assoc. Professor, Urban Studies; Affiliated Assoc. Professor, African and Africa Diaspora Studies
areas: 19th and 20th century African American rhetoric and literature
summary: Studies 19th- and 20th-century African American rhetoric and literature, rhetorics of place and citizenship, and civic engagement in urban settings such as the Black Freedom Movement.
summary_zh: 研究19至20世纪非裔美国人的修辞与文学、地方与公民身份修辞，以及黑人自由运动等城市情境中的公民参与。

name: Leslie Harris
title: Professor; Department Chair
summary: Studies rhetoric and public culture, focusing on public controversy, intersectional race and gender identity, white supremacist and anti-suffrage rhetoric, and gun violence in Milwaukee.
summary_zh: 研究修辞与公共文化，关注公共争议、种族与性别的交叉身份、白人至上与反选举权修辞，以及密尔沃基的枪支暴力。

name: John Jordan
title: Associate Professor
areas: Subaltern groups and rhetoric engaging authoritative control
summary: Uses critical rhetorical analysis to study how technology shapes public sensibilities and how subaltern groups use rhetoric to engage authoritative control, including television and film.
summary_zh: 运用批判修辞分析，研究技术如何影响公众感知、底层群体如何以修辞回应权威控制，也涉及电视与电影。

name: Tae-Seop Lim
title: Professor
areas: Theory of culture and cultural differences
summary: Studies cross-cultural and international communication, developing a theory of culture that addresses limits of Hofstede's dimensions and Hall's context theory.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化与国际传播，致力于构建一种能弥补霍夫斯泰德文化维度与霍尔语境理论局限的文化理论。

name: Michael Mirer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sports media and journalism, including boundary work and ethics of in-house sports reporters, media framing of head injuries, and candidates' social media messaging.
summary_zh: 研究体育媒体与新闻业，包括内部体育记者的边界工作与伦理、媒体对头部损伤的框架呈现，以及候选人的社交媒体表达。

name: Anjana Mudambi
title: Associate Professor; Undergraduate Program Director
areas: Identity construction, discursive reproduction, and agency among South Asian Americans
Systems of power and anti-racist solidarity
summary: Uses critical qualitative and ethnographic methods to study identity, race, and anti-racist solidarity among South Asian Americans and critical intercultural communication pedagogy.
summary_zh: 运用批判性质性与民族志方法，研究南亚裔美国人的身份、种族与反种族主义团结，以及批判性跨文化传播教学。

name: Erin Parcell
title: Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication in long-distance relationships and deployed military families, mainly through in-depth interviews, plus community stories of gun violence in Wisconsin.
summary_zh: 研究异地恋与军人派驻家庭中的人际与家庭传播，主要采用深度访谈，并关注威斯康星州社区的枪支暴力叙事。

name: Sarah Riforgiate
title: Professor; MA Program Director
summary: Studies the intersection of organizational and interpersonal communication, including work-life concerns, emotions at work, conflict, leadership, and remote workers' technology use.
summary_zh: 研究组织传播与人际传播的交叉领域，包括工作与生活平衡、职场情绪、冲突协商、领导力及远程员工的技术使用。

name: Erin Ruppel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how communication technologies shape interpersonal relationships, self-disclosure, and small-group and health communication, including meta-analysis of mediated vs. face-to-face interaction.
summary_zh: 研究传播技术如何影响人际关系、自我表露以及小群体与健康传播，包括对中介与面对面互动差异的元分析。

name: Sara Vanderhaagen
title: Associate Professor; PhD Program Director
areas: Public discourse about race and gender
summary: Uses rhetorical criticism to study public memory, how publics argue about the past, and Black American women's memory work and rhetorical activism.
summary_zh: 运用修辞批评研究公共记忆、公众如何就历史展开论辩，以及美国黑人女性的记忆实践与修辞行动主义。

name: Lia Wolock
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the racialization of South Asian American diaspora communities in digital and social media, their media activism, and media representations of India and Indian Americans.
summary_zh: 研究数字与社交媒体时代南亚裔美国人离散社群的种族化、其媒体行动主义，以及媒体对印度与印度裔美国人的再现。

name: Karrin Vasby Anderson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how political identity and gender are rhetorically constructed and contested in popular media, and how gender equity relates to democratic health.
summary_zh: 研究政治身份与性别如何在流行媒介中被修辞性地建构与争夺，以及性别平等与民主健康之间的关系。

name: Eric Aoki
title: Professor
summary: Examines identity, voice and cultural representation in media and public spaces, including ethnographic work on Mexican American ethnicity and rhetoric of museums and memory.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与公共空间中的身份、声音与文化再现，包括关于墨西哥裔美国人族裔的民族志研究以及博物馆与记忆的修辞。

name: Martín Carcasson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how local communities address wicked problems through public deliberation, collaborative decision-making and improved public communication in northern Colorado.
summary_zh: 研究地方社区如何通过公共协商、协作决策与改进的公共沟通来应对“棘手问题”，聚焦科罗拉多州北部。

name: Hye Seung Chung
title: Professor
summary: Studies race and ethnicity in American popular culture, East Asian and South Korean cinema, film censorship and regulation, and feminist film theory.
summary_zh: 研究美国流行文化中的种族与族裔、东亚与韩国电影、电影审查与规制，以及女性主义电影理论。

name: Vanessa Cozza
title: Assistant Professor, Director
summary: Investigates how nineteenth-century American board games act as cultural artifacts that narrate national identity and the rhetorical power of design-based messaging.
summary_zh: 研究十九世纪美国桌游作为文化器物如何讲述国家身份，以及基于设计的信息所具有的修辞力量。

name: Greg Dickinson
title: Morgan Chair for the Liberal Arts, Professor, Communication Studies
summary: Studies the rhetoric of memory, place and materiality in everyday spaces such as museums, malls and suburbs, along with race, gender and Trump-era politics.
summary_zh: 研究博物馆、商场与郊区等日常空间中记忆、地方与物质性的修辞，以及种族、性别与特朗普时代的政治。

name: Scott Diffrient
title: Professor
summary: Studies film and television history and genres, including American TV, horror, omnibus films, fandom and transnational flows between Hollywood and South Korean cinema.
summary_zh: 研究电影与电视的历史和类型，包括美国电视、恐怖片、集锦电影、粉丝文化，以及好莱坞与韩国电影之间的跨国流动。

name: Thomas R. Dunn
title: Professor
summary: Examines the rhetoric of LGBTQ and queer public memory, including monuments, visual communication and the legacy of Nazi persecution for LGBTQ rights.
summary_zh: 研究LGBTQ与酷儿公共记忆的修辞，包括纪念碑、视觉传播以及纳粹迫害对LGBTQ权利运动的影响。

name: Evan Elkins
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cultural politics of digital platforms, streaming services and media industries, including geoblocking and the global expansion of Spotify and Netflix.
summary_zh: 研究数字平台、流媒体服务与媒介产业的文化政治，包括地理封锁以及Spotify和Netflix的全球扩张。

name: Meara Faw
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how communication in friendships and families, especially social support and informal caregiving, shapes health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究朋友与家庭关系中的沟通，尤其是社会支持与非正式照护，如何影响健康与福祉。

name: Katie Gibson
title: Professor, Director of Basic Course (SPCM200: Public Speaking)
summary: Studies the politics of gender representation in legal discourse, political communication and popular culture, including rhetorical analysis of judicial opinions.
summary_zh: 研究法律话语、政治传播与流行文化中性别再现的政治，包括对司法意见的修辞分析。

name: Kit Hughes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of useful and workplace media, such as business television and educational film, and how ideas about the economy and small business circulate in US culture.
summary_zh: 研究实用媒介与职场媒介（如企业电视与教育影片）的历史，以及关于经济和小企业的观念如何在美国文化中流通。

name: Abraham Khan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies rhetoric, sport and racial politics in the US, focusing on Black athlete activism, sports labor politics and racial capitalism.
summary_zh: 研究美国的修辞、体育与种族政治，关注黑人运动员的行动主义、体育劳工政治与种族资本主义。

name: Julia Khrebtan-Hörhager
title: Professor, Faculty Program Director, ACT Human Rights Film Festival, Director &, Leader, Education Abroad Programs in Europe
summary: Studies intercultural communication, international relations and global conflict, cultural memory, migration, and feminist perspectives on communication and leadership.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化传播、国际关系与全球冲突、文化记忆、移民，以及关于传播与领导力的女性主义视角。

name: Katherine Knobloch
title: Professor, Director, Democracy Initiative, College of Liberal Arts, Associate Director, Center for Public Deliberation
summary: Studies public participation and deliberative democracy, focusing on the design and impact of community engagement programs such as the Citizens' Initiative Review.
summary_zh: 研究公众参与与协商民主，关注“公民倡议审议”等社区参与项目的设计及其影响。

name: Ziyu Long
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies career and entrepreneurial organizing and gendered digital labor from feminist and decolonial perspectives, with work in the United States, China and Denmark.
summary_zh: 从女性主义与去殖民视角研究职业与创业组织过程以及性别化的数字劳动，研究涉及美国、中国与丹麦。

name: Nick Marx
title: Professor, Founding Co-Director, Center for Democracy, Art, &, Popular Culture
summary: Studies American television comedy, media industries and politics, including conservative comedians, Saturday Night Live archives and millennial masculinity.
summary_zh: 研究美国电视喜剧、媒介产业与政治，包括保守派喜剧演员、《周六夜现场》档案以及千禧一代男性气质。

name: Natalie Pennington
title: Associate Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies friendship and social connection and how communication technologies and modalities help people meet relational needs in the United States.
summary_zh: 研究友谊与社会联结，以及沟通技术与不同沟通方式如何帮助美国人满足关系需求。

name: Elizabeth Williams
title: Department Chair and Professor
summary: Studies how high reliability organizations such as fire departments communicate to protect member health and safety, respond to accidents, learn and use wearables.
summary_zh: 研究消防部门等高可靠性组织如何通过沟通保障成员健康与安全、应对事故、开展组织学习并使用可穿戴技术。

name: Katie Abrams
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor
summary: Designs and studies strategic behavior-change communication on environmental, wildlife conservation, public health and food system issues, such as wildfire smoke protection.
summary_zh: 设计并研究面向环境、野生动物保护、公共卫生与食品系统议题的战略性行为改变传播，如野火烟雾防护。

name: Ashley Anderson
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor
summary: Studies public engagement with science and environmental risks, including humor and incivility online, trust in information sources, and social media talk about climate.
summary_zh: 研究公众对科学与环境风险的参与，包括网络中的幽默与不文明言论、对信息来源的信任，以及社交媒体上的气候讨论。

name: Tori Omega Arthur
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor, Graduate Programs Director
areas: intersections of media and technology, race, gender, disability, sexuality, and transnational mobilities
summary: Studies race, gender, disability and transnational mobility in digital media, including Black women travel influencers on Instagram, using qualitative social media research.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒介中的种族、性别、残障与跨国流动，包括Instagram上的黑人女性旅行网红，采用质性社交媒体研究方法。

name: Seth Ashley
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies media and democracy, linking news literacy with the sociology of media institutions and the historical development of communication policy.
summary_zh: 研究媒介与民主，将新闻素养与媒介机构社会学以及传播政策的历史发展联系起来。

name: Joe Champ
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication, culture and the natural world, such as stakeholder meanings of wildfire mitigation and online wilderness stories, using qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究传播、文化与自然世界的交汇，如利益相关者对野火防治的理解与线上荒野故事，采用质性方法。

name: Umberto Famulari
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Assistant Professor of Visual Communication
areas: Visual Communication, New media, Content Graphic Design, Data Visualization, Motion Graphics, Non-Linear Storytelling
summary: Studies multimodal and visual storytelling in news and politics, including how visuals shape audience attitudes and how campaigns are portrayed in online news across countries.
summary_zh: 研究新闻与政治中的多模态与视觉叙事，包括视觉如何影响受众态度，以及各国网络新闻如何呈现竞选活动。

name: Jaime Jacobsen
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Assistant Professor, Director, Center for Science Communication
summary: Makes documentary films on science and social justice and works on participatory, community-based media production and migration and refugee stories.
summary_zh: 制作关于科学与社会正义的纪录片，并从事参与式、社区为本的媒介创作以及移民与难民题材工作。

name: Jangyul Robert Kim
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Applies communication and persuasion theories to public relations and develops PR models, extending them to public diplomacy, crisis management and corporate reputation.
summary_zh: 将传播与说服理论应用于公共关系并发展公关模型，并将其扩展至公共外交、危机管理与企业声誉。

name: Yeunjae Lee
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies strategic internal communication among organizations, leaders and employees, how it shapes trust and relationships, and the role of social media and generative AI.
summary_zh: 研究组织、领导者与员工之间的战略性内部沟通如何塑造信任与关系，以及社交媒体和生成式AI的作用。

name: Marilee Long
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies health and science communication, including messages for behavior change, citizen science on wildfire smoke and air quality, and media effects on youth views of science.
summary_zh: 研究健康与科学传播，包括促进行为改变的信息、关于野火烟雾与空气质量的公民科学，以及媒介对青少年科学态度的影响。

name: Gregory Luft
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor, Journalism and Media Communication
areas: Primary focus is Video Production and Broadcast News
summary: Studies news coverage and journalist behavior around major events, especially reporting on crime and tragedy victims, and television news and documentary production.
summary_zh: 研究重大事件中的新闻报道与记者行为，尤其是对犯罪与悲剧受害者的报道，以及电视新闻与纪录片制作。

name: Rosa Mikeal Martey
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor, Director of Faculty Retention and Success
summary: Studies identity and social interaction in virtual worlds, games and generative AI, using critical-cultural analysis, interviews, observation, surveys, experiments and game design.
summary_zh: 研究虚拟世界、游戏与生成式AI中的身份与社会互动，采用批判文化分析、访谈、观察、问卷、实验与游戏设计。

name: Gayathri Sivakumar
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive, attitudinal and behavioral effects of mediated communication in health, politics and children's educational television.
summary_zh: 研究中介传播在健康、政治以及儿童教育电视领域对认知、态度与行为的影响。

name: Samuel M. Tham
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies advertising and media psychology, including problematic social media and video game use, synthetic media and AI, media leadership and ethical messaging.
summary_zh: 研究广告与媒介心理，包括问题性社交媒体与电子游戏使用、合成媒介与AI、媒介领导力以及伦理化的信息传播。

name: Esther Thorson
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Professor
summary: Holds a professorship in journalism and media communication; the department profile provides no research description.
summary_zh: 任新闻与媒介传播系教授；系所主页未提供研究方向描述。

name: David Wolfgang
dept: Department of Journalism and Media Communication
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies journalists' relationships with audiences, role conceptions and minority representation using textual analysis, ethnography, interviews and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究记者与受众的关系、记者角色认知以及少数群体的媒介再现，采用文本分析、民族志、访谈与问卷调查。

name: Patricia A.K. Amaral
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies science communication, emergent media and Indigenous storytelling, using creative multimedia to bridge Indigenous knowledge and science for civic engagement.
summary_zh: 研究科学传播、新兴媒介与原住民叙事，借助创意多媒体沟通原住民知识与科学，以促进公民参与。

name: Krystyna Aune
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people in close relationships express and manage emotions, adult play and persona sharing, using surveys, diaries, laboratory studies and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中人们如何表达和管理情绪，以及成人游戏与“人设共享”现象，采用问卷调查、日记法、实验室研究和实验。

name: Wayne Buente
title: Professor
summary: Studies how information and communication technologies and social media address social inequality, including digital divide, broadband policy and substance use prevention.
summary_zh: 从社会技术视角研究信息通信技术与社交媒体如何应对社会不平等，涉及数字鸿沟、宽带政策和物质滥用预防。

name: Jessica Gasiorek
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people process and produce messages and accommodate their communication in intergroup settings, including communication about age and aging, grounded in accommodation theory.
summary_zh: 以传播顺应理论为基础，研究人们在群际情境中如何加工与产出信息、调整彼此的沟通，以及关于年龄与老龄化的传播。

name: Rich Gazan
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people integrate diverse knowledge in interdisciplinary scientific collaborations and social Q&A communities, using sociotechnical document analysis and scientometrics.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在跨学科科研合作与社会化问答社区中整合多元知识，采用社会技术文献分析与科学计量学方法。

name: Julien Gorbach
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of American media and the Middle East, literary journalism, and media portrayals of outlaws and rebels through media history and biography.
summary_zh: 通过媒介史与传记研究，探讨美国媒体与中东的历史、文学新闻以及媒体对法外之徒和反叛者的报道与呈现。

name: Jingyi Gu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies gender, sexuality, labor and governance in platformized cultural production such as Chinese live streaming, using ethnography, interviews, walkthroughs and discourse analysis.
summary_zh: 研究平台化文化生产（如中国直播）中的性别、性、劳动与治理，采用民族志、访谈、平台走查和话语分析等方法。

name: Amy Hubbard
title: Professor
summary: Studies communication during problematic relationship events, including conflict, deception, breakups and apologies, and how nonverbal behaviors shape interpersonal judgments.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中问题事件（冲突、欺骗、分手与道歉等）中的沟通，以及触碰、气味、目光接触等非语言行为如何影响人际判断。

name: Ava Kikut-Stein
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media exposure, social identity and trust shape adolescent health behavior, using quantitative, mixed-methods and community-based participatory action research.
summary_zh: 研究媒介接触、社会身份与信任如何影响青少年健康行为，结合定量、混合方法与社区参与式行动研究。

name: Ji Young Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies public relations, strategic communication and political campaigns, developing agenda-building and agenda-setting theory in US and international contexts.
summary_zh: 研究公共关系、战略传播与政治竞选，在美国及国际情境中发展议程建构与议程设置理论。

name: Min-Sun Kim
title: Professor
summary: Studies intercultural communication, persuasion and social influence, and human-machine communication, including non-Western perspectives and Korean culture.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化传播、说服与社会影响以及人机传播，关注非西方传播视角与韩国文化。

name: Youjeong Kim
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the social and psychological effects of immersive media such as virtual environments and video games, and develops interactive interventions for health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究虚拟环境与电子游戏等沉浸式媒介的社会与心理效果，并开发交互式媒介干预项目以促进健康与福祉。

name: Hanae Kramer
title: Associate Professor
areas: Hawaiian diaspora in the Bonin Islands
summary: Studies intercultural communication and Japanese and East Asian history, including the Hawaiian diaspora in the Bonin Islands, wartime propaganda and historic Japanese audio recordings.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化传播及日本与东亚历史，涉及小笠原群岛的夏威夷离散群体、战时宣传以及日本历史唱片的保存。

name: Keahiahi Long
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies Indigenous and Native Hawaiian information practices, co-creating Hawaiian-language controlled vocabularies and knowledge organization systems.
summary_zh: 研究原住民及夏威夷原住民的信息实践，共同创建夏威夷语受控词表与知识组织体系。

name: Rachel Neo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how online platform features and political content influence attitudes, judgments and behaviors, and how platforms inform risky practices among vulnerable people.
summary_zh: 研究在线平台功能与政治内容如何影响态度、判断与行为，以及平台如何影响弱势群体的风险行为与社会联结。

name: Alexandria Rayburn
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies data practices and gendered data work in library, archive and museum collections from an intersectional feminist lens, using archival research and interviews.
summary_zh: 从交叉性女性主义视角研究图书馆、档案馆与博物馆藏品中的数据实践与性别化数据劳动，采用档案研究和访谈。

name: Emiko Taniguchi-Dorios
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies interpersonal health communication, especially mental illness disclosure and social support, and family and peer communication about body image.
summary_zh: 研究人际健康传播，尤其是精神疾病的自我披露与社会支持，以及家庭和同伴关于身体意象的沟通。

name: John Temple
title: Professor
summary: Writes narrative nonfiction and investigative journalism on American life, including the opioid epidemic and the patriot movement, and adapts journalism for the screen.
summary_zh: 创作关于美国社会的叙事性非虚构作品与调查新闻，涉及阿片类药物危机和爱国者运动，并将新闻改编为影视作品。

name: Andrew Wertheimer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the history of libraries and archives, ethnic print cultures, Asian American and Pacific Islanders in LIS, and intellectual freedom and censorship.
summary_zh: 研究图书馆与档案馆史、族裔印刷文化、图书情报领域的亚太裔群体，以及知识自由与审查。

name: Jenifer Sunrise Winter
title: Professor
areas: Big Data and artificial intelligence (AI) governance
Strategic communication in the public interest
Information and communication technology for development (ICTD)
summary: Studies governance, policy and ethics of big data, AI and the Internet of Things, including health data for AI, communication rights and social media platform governance.
summary_zh: 研究大数据、人工智能与物联网的治理、政策与伦理，包括面向AI的健康数据治理、传播权利与社交媒体平台治理。
